articles.title: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

paras.en: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料如何为现代机械提供动力

paras.en: Have you ever wondered what enables everything from roaring construction machinery to agricultural machinery plowing the fields to industrial equipment shuttling through factories—the precise starting, smooth operation, and reliable braking they achieve?
paras.zh: 您有没有想过，从轰鸣的工程机械到耕地的农业机械，再到穿梭于工厂的工业设备，是什么让它们能够实现精确的启动、平稳的运行和可靠的制动？

paras.en: The answer lies in a seemingly insignificant yet crucial core component: friction material. It acts as the "safety guard" and "power link" of machinery, ensuring every brake is safe and effective, and every power transmission is smooth and flawless.
paras.zh: 答案就在于一个看似微不足道却至关重要的核心部件：摩擦材料。它充当机械的“安全卫士”和“动力纽带”，保证每一次制动都安全有效，每一次动力传递平稳无瑕。

paras.en: Among the vast family of friction materials, wet friction materials are becoming the new favorite in modern machinery due to their exceptional reliability, safety, and exceptionally long lifespan. Among wet materials, paper-based friction materials stand out as a leading force thanks to their excellent overall performance, cost-effectiveness, and broad application prospects.
paras.zh: 在众多的摩擦材料家族中，湿式摩擦材料因其卓越的可靠性、安全性和超长的使用寿命而成为现代机械的新宠。在湿式材料中，纸基摩擦材料以其优异的综合性能、成本效益和广阔的应用前景脱颖而出，成为主导力量。

paras.en: Today, let's delve deeper into the fascinating world of this "unsung hero"—paper-based friction materials.
paras.zh: 今天，让我们深入探究这个“无名英雄”——纸基摩擦材料的迷人世界。

paras.en: What is Paper-Based Friction Material? — A Sponge-Like Power Core
paras.zh: 什么是纸基摩擦材料？ — 海绵状动力核心

paras.en: Imagine a "sponge" with countless tiny pores—that's the most intuitive image of paper-based friction material.
paras.zh: 想象一下有无数微小孔隙的“海绵”——这就是纸基摩擦材料最直观的形象。

paras.en: It is a material with a reticular porous structure composed of three core components: reinforcing fibers, functional fillers, and a binder resin. This unique structure gives it extraordinary capabilities:
paras.zh: 它是一种具有网状多孔结构的材料，由增强纤维、功能填料和粘结剂树脂三种核心成分组成。这种独特的结构赋予了它非凡的功能：

paras.en: - Oil Storage Capacity: The porous structure acts like a miniature "oil depot," capable of storing large quantities of lubricant.
paras.zh: - 储油能力：多孔结构就像一个微型“油库”，能够储存大量润滑剂。

paras.en: - Dynamic Lubrication: When the friction plate and mating plate engage and are subjected to pressure, the lubricant within the material is instantly squeezed onto the friction surface, forming a tough lubricant film, enabling smooth, gentle "wet" friction.
paras.zh: - 动态润滑：当摩擦片和配合片接合并受到压力时，材料内的润滑剂立即被挤压到摩擦表面上，形成坚韧的润滑膜，从而实现平滑、温和的“湿”摩擦。

paras.en: - Self-Recovery: When the friction plates separate, the material rebounds like memory foam, "absorbing" the lubricant back into the pores, ready for the next operation.
paras.zh: - 自我恢复：当摩擦片分离时，材料会像记忆海绵一样反弹，将润滑剂“吸收”回毛孔中，为下一次操作做好准备。

paras.en: It is this dynamic cycle of "oil storage-oil squeezing-oil return" that allows paper-based friction materials to perform well in an oil bath environment, achieving a perfect combination of high durability and stable friction performance.
paras.zh: 正是这种“储油-挤油-回油”的动态循环，让纸基摩擦材料在油浴环境下表现良好，实现了高耐用性和稳定摩擦性能的完美结合。

paras.en: Exploring Core Performance: How Do Three Key Factors Affect It?
paras.zh: 探索核心绩效：三个关键因素如何影响它？

paras.en: The performance of paper-based friction materials is not static. Like a top athlete, its performance is influenced by the "field," "equipment," and "condition." Let's examine how these three key factors shape its performance.
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料的性能并不是静态的。就像顶尖运动员一样，其成绩受到“场地”、“装备”、“条件”的影响。让我们来看看这三个关键因素如何影响其性能。

paras.en: Factor 1: The "Stage Effect" of Lubricants
paras.zh: 因素一：润滑油的“阶段效应”

paras.en: Paper-based friction materials are highly sensitive to lubricants, and different lubricants create distinct "stages" for their performance. Even the same friction material can exhibit significantly different friction characteristics (especially the kinetic friction coefficient) when exposed to different lubricants.
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料对润滑剂高度敏感，不同的润滑剂为其性能创造了不同的“阶段”。即使是相同的摩擦材料，当接触不同的润滑剂时也会表现出明显不同的摩擦特性（尤其是动摩擦系数）。

paras.en: Figure 1: Kinetic friction coefficient curve for a paper-based friction material in gear oil
paras.zh: 图 1：纸基摩擦材料在齿轮油中的动摩擦系数曲线

paras.en: Figure 2: Dynamic friction coefficient curve of the same material in hydraulic oil
paras.zh: 图2：同材质在液压油中的动摩擦系数曲线

paras.en: Interpretation: The above chart clearly shows that the same material behaves very differently in gear oil and hydraulic fluid. Furthermore, various additives added to lubricating oils (such as dispersants and anti-wear agents) can interact complexly with the material surface, further affecting its friction properties. Therefore, choosing the right oil for paper-based friction materials is the first step in achieving optimal performance.
paras.zh: 解读：上图清楚地表明，相同的材料在齿轮油和液压油中的表现截然不同。此外，润滑油中添加的各种添加剂（如分散剂和抗磨剂）会与材料表面发生复杂的相互作用，进一步影响其摩擦性能。因此，为纸基摩擦材料选择合适的油是实现最佳性能的第一步。

paras.en: Density is a trump card for paper-based friction materials. It is directly related to the material's porosity, leading to a delicate balancing act in terms of performance.
paras.zh: 密度是纸基摩擦材料的王牌。它与材料的孔隙率直接相关，从而导致性能方面的微妙平衡。

paras.en: High density (low porosity) means a denser material, resulting in better strength and thermal conductivity, lower wear rate, and longer life. However, the downside is reduced oil storage capacity, which can lead to a lower coefficient of friction and compromise power transmission.
paras.zh: 高密度（低孔隙率）意味着材料更致密，从而具有更好的强度和导热性、更低的磨损率和更长的使用寿命。然而，其缺点是储油能力降低，这可能导致摩擦系数降低并损害动力传输。

paras.en: Low density (high porosity) means the material is more porous, resulting in greater oil storage capacity and a higher coefficient of friction, which can provide greater braking force or transmit torque. However, the downside is reduced mechanical strength and wear resistance, shortening service life.
paras.zh: 低密度（高孔隙率）意味着材料孔隙较多，从而产生更大的储油能力和更高的摩擦系数，从而可以提供更大的制动力或传递扭矩。但其缺点是机械强度和耐磨性降低，使用寿命缩短。

paras.en: Figure 3: Comparison of the dynamic coefficient of friction for materials of varying densities (Type 2 to Type 6, increasing density)
paras.zh: 图 3：不同密度材料的动摩擦系数比较（类型 2 至类型 6，密度增加）

paras.en: Figure 4: Comparison of wear rates of materials with different densities
paras.zh: 图4：不同密度材料的磨损率比较

paras.en: Interpretation: Figures 3 and 4 vividly illustrate this balancing act. There's no such thing as absolute good or bad, only suitability. When selecting a paper-based friction material, the optimal trade-off between friction coefficient and durability must be determined based on specific application requirements (e.g., high torque versus long life).
paras.zh: 解读：图3和图4生动地说明了这种平衡行为。没有绝对的好或坏，只有合适。选择纸基摩擦材料时，必须根据具体应用要求（例如高扭矩与长寿命）确定摩擦系数和耐用性之间的最佳权衡。

paras.en: Factor 3: Extreme Challenges of Operating Conditions
paras.zh: 因素三：运行条件的极端挑战

paras.en: In addition to oil type and density, actual operating conditions, such as surface pressure, sliding speed, and oil temperature, pose extreme challenges to paper-based friction materials. These factors directly affect the temperature of the friction interface, the thickness and stability of the oil film, and thus dynamically alter the coefficient of friction.
paras.zh: 除了油的类型和密度之外，实际操作条件，例如表面压力、滑动速度和油温，对纸基摩擦材料提出了极大的挑战。这些因素直接影响摩擦界面的温度、油膜的厚度和稳定性，从而动态地改变摩擦系数。

paras.en: Therefore, please remember: the coefficient of friction of a particular paper-based friction material is not a fixed value, but rather a performance range determined through extensive and repeated testing under specific operating conditions.
paras.zh: 因此，请记住：特定纸基摩擦材料的摩擦系数不是一个固定值，而是在特定操作条件下通过广泛和反复测试确定的性能范围。

paras.en: Broad Applications: Injecting a Powerful "Heart" into Machinery
paras.zh: 广泛应用：为机械注入强大的“心脏”

paras.en: Thanks to its excellent overall performance and customizability, Carlisle Brake & Friction's paper-based friction materials have been successfully applied to the core components of various heavy-duty machinery, becoming their powerful and reliable "heart."
paras.zh: 凭借其优异的综合性能和可定制性，卡莱制动摩擦材料纸基摩擦材料已成功应用于各类重型机械的核心部件，成为其强大而可靠的“心脏”。

paras.en: We understand that different machines and applications require significantly different friction materials. For example:
paras.zh: 我们了解不同的机器和应用需要截然不同的摩擦材料。例如：

paras.en: - Service brakes for construction machinery (such as excavators and loaders) require materials that provide a stable, powerful braking force under high loads to ensure safety.
paras.zh: - 工程机械（如挖掘机和装载机）的行车制动器需要能够在高负载下提供稳定、强大制动力的材料，以确保安全。

paras.en: - Powershift transmissions for agricultural machinery (such as tractors) require materials that provide smooth engagement and excellent heat resistance to handle frequent shifting.
paras.zh: - 农业机械（如拖拉机）的动力换档变速箱需要能够提供平稳接合和出色耐热性的材料，以应对频繁换档。

paras.en: - Clutches for industrial machinery require materials that respond quickly and have a long lifespan to ensure continuous and efficient operation of production lines.
paras.zh: - 工业机械离合器需要响应快且使用寿命长的材料，以确保生产线连续高效运行。

paras.en: To this end, Carlisle Brake & Friction has developed a series of special paper-based friction materials for different application scenarios, providing each customer with the most suitable and reliable solution.
paras.zh: 为此，卡莱制动摩擦开发了一系列针对不同应用场景的特种纸基摩擦材料，为每位客户提供最合适、最可靠的解决方案。

paras.en: Continuous Innovation, Driving the Future
paras.zh: 持续创新，驱动未来

paras.en: Technological advancement is endless. To meet increasingly demanding application requirements and broaden market prospects, Carlisle Brake & Friction remains at the forefront of innovation.
paras.zh: 技术进步永无止境。为了满足日益苛刻的应用要求并拓宽市场前景，Carlisle Brake & Friction 始终走在创新的前沿。

paras.en: We are not only continuously optimizing the formulation and processing of paper-based friction materials to push their performance limits, but are also actively exploring next-generation wet friction materials with even higher performance. These R&D efforts have made significant progress, aiming to provide global customers with more diverse and advanced options, driving the infinite possibilities of future machinery.
paras.zh: 我们不仅不断优化纸基摩擦材料的配方和加工工艺以突破其性能极限，而且还积极探索具有更高性能的下一代湿式摩擦材料。这些研发工作取得了重大进展，旨在为全球客户提供更多样化、更先进的选择，驱动未来机械的无限可能。

articles.title: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees

paras.en: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees
paras.zh: 与麦地那市长和员工一起庆祝 100 周年

paras.en: MEDINA, OHIO — September 24, 2025 — Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF), a global leader in the development and manufacture of high-performance brake and friction solutions, today welcomed Medina Mayor Dennis Hanwell, Economic Development Director Kimberly Marshall, and Executive Director of the Medina Chamber of Commerce Jaclyn Ringstmeier, for a special photo op at the company’s headquarters, located at 920 Lake Road. The event was a commemorative celebration of CarlisleCBF’s 100-year anniversary and its enduring presence in the Medina community.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州梅迪纳 — 2025 年 9 月 24 日 — 高性能制动和摩擦解决方案开发和制造领域的全球领导者 Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF) 今天欢迎梅迪纳市长 Dennis Hanwell、经济发展总监 Kimberly Marshall 和梅迪纳商会执行董事 Jaclyn Ringstmeier 在位于湖路 920 号的公司总部进行了特别合影。该活动是为了纪念 CarlisleCBF 成立 100 周年及其在麦地那社区的持久存在。

paras.en: The photo op featured Mayor Hanwell alongside Carlisle’s Operations Leader, David Smith, and a number of employees who have been with the company for decades. The occasion honored CarlisleCBF’s century of innovation and its deep roots in the Medina area, where it has been a significant employer and community partner.
paras.zh: 这张照片的主角是汉威尔市长、卡莱尔的运营负责人大卫·史密斯以及一些在公司工作了几十年的员工。此次活动旨在表彰 CarlisleCBF 的百年创新历程及其在麦地那地区的深厚根基，该公司一直是该地区重要的雇主和社区合作伙伴。

paras.en: "We are incredibly proud of our history and our strong connection to the city of Medina," said David Smith. "This milestone is a testament to the hard work and dedication of our employees, many of whom have been with us for decades. We are grateful for the continued support of Mayor Hanwell and the entire Medina community."
paras.zh: “我们对我们的历史以及我们与麦地那市的紧密联系感到无比自豪，”大卫·史密斯说。 “这一里程碑证明了我们员工的辛勤工作和奉献精神，其中许多人已经在我们身边工作了数十年。我们感谢汉威尔市长和整个麦地那社区的持续支持。”

paras.en: The photo op followed a recent employee and family event at the Medina plant that celebrated the 100-year milestone. The celebration was filled with games, face painting, food, and fun for all ages, reinforcing the company's commitment to its employees and their families.
paras.zh: 这张照片是在麦地那工厂最近举行的庆祝 100 周年里程碑的员工和家庭活动之后​​拍摄的。庆祝活动充满了适合各个年龄段的游戏、面部彩绘、美食和乐趣，强化了公司对员工及其家人的承诺。

paras.en: Mayor Hanwell expressed his gratitude for CarlisleCBF’s presence in the city. “Carlisle has been a part of the Medina community for nearly 65 years, providing good jobs and a strong economic foundation,” said Mayor Hanwell. "We are proud to celebrate their 100-year anniversary and recognize the significant role they have played in our city’s growth and prosperity."
paras.zh: 汉威尔市长对 CarlisleCBF 来到该市表示感谢。 “近 65 年来，卡莱尔一直是麦地那社区的一部分，提供了良好的就业机会和强大的经济基础，”汉威尔市长说。 “我们很自豪能够庆祝他们的 100 周年纪念日，并认识到他们在我们城市的发展和繁荣中发挥的重要作用。”

paras.en: CarlisleCBF, a brand of CentroMotion, was founded in 1925 and has grown to become a global leader in its field, serving a wide range of markets including agriculture, construction, and mining.
paras.zh: CarlisleCBF 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，成立于 1925 年，现已发展成为该领域的全球领导者，服务于农业、建筑和采矿等广泛市场。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a leading global provider of highly engineered and integrated brake and friction solutions for a wide range of industrial applications. With over 100 years of experience, the company is dedicated to delivering innovative, reliable, and high-performance products to its customers worldwide.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，是一家为各种工业应用提供精心设计的集成制动和摩擦解决方案的全球领先供应商。该公司拥有 100 多年的经验，致力于为全球客户提供创新、可靠和高性能的产品。

paras.en: Agritechnica 2025 was an incredible opportunity to connect with industry leaders, customers, and partners from around the world. We want to extend a sincere thank you to everyone who visited the CarlisleCBF and CentroMotion team at the show.

articles.title: SEMA Industry Honors to Recognize 2026 Hall of Fame Class
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The automotive and powersports aftermarket will recognize its innovators, leaders and visionaries during the 2026 SEMA Industry Honors on Thursday, Nov. 5 at the BleauLive Theater inside the Fontainebleau Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 汽车和动力运动售后市场将于 11 月 5 日星期四在拉斯维加斯枫丹白露内的 BleauLive 剧院举行 2026 年 SEMA 行业荣誉颁奖典礼，表彰其创新者、领导者和远见者。

paras.en: Held during the 2026 SEMA Show, SEMA Industry Honors is the industry’s annual celebration of the people whose creativity, leadership and passion continue to move the automotive and powersports aftermarket forward. The evening will recognize the SEMA Hall of Fame Class of 2026, SEMA Content Creator of the Year, SEMA Person of the Year and the recipient of the Robert E. Petersen Lifetime Achievement Award.
paras.zh: SEMA 行业荣誉奖在 2026 年 SEMA 展会期间举行，是业界对那些凭借创造力、领导力和热情不断推动汽车和动力运动售后市场向前发展的人们的年度庆典。当晚将表彰 2026 年 SEMA 名人堂成员、SEMA 年度内容创作者、SEMA 年度人物以及 Robert E. Petersen 终身成就奖获得者。

paras.en: “SEMA Industry Honors brings our community together around the people, ideas and achievements that are shaping the future of the aftermarket,” said Tom Gattuso, vice president of events for SEMA. “By celebrating industry legends alongside today’s most influential leaders and storytellers, the event connects the aftermarket’s proud history with its next chapter. It is an opportunity for everyone at the SEMA Show to recognize excellence, strengthen relationships and be inspired by the individuals moving our industry forward.”
paras.zh: SEMA 活动副总裁 Tom Gattuso 表示：“SEMA 行业荣誉将我们的社区聚集在一起，围绕塑造售后市场未来的人员、想法和成就。” “通过与当今最具影响力的领导者和故事讲述者一起庆祝行业传奇人物，该活动将售后市场的辉煌历史与其下一个篇章联系起来。SEMA 展会上的每个人都是一个认识卓越、加强关系并受到推动我们行业发展的个人启发的机会。”

paras.en: The program will be emceed by Kevin Oeste, who will guide attendees through an evening of recognition, personal stories and celebration. Members of the SEMA community and other familiar faces from the automotive world will also take the stage to help honor this year’s award recipients.
paras.zh: 该计划将由 Kevin Oeste 主持，他将引导与会者度过一个表彰、个人故事和庆祝活动的夜晚。 SEMA 社区的成员和汽车界的其他熟悉面孔也将登台帮助表彰今年的获奖者。

paras.en: Celebrating the Industry’s Highest Achievements
paras.zh: 庆祝行业最高成就

paras.en: The SEMA Hall of Fame is the association’s highest honor, recognizing individuals whose careers and contributions have helped shape and advance the automotive specialty equipment industry. The 2026 SEMA Hall of Fame class includes Doug Dwyer, Jay Leno, Ellen McKoy and Dennis Overholser.
paras.zh: SEMA 名人堂是该协会的最高荣誉，旨在表彰其职业生涯和贡献有助于塑造和推动汽车专用设备行业的个人。 2026 年 SEMA 名人堂成员包括 Doug Dwyer、Jay Leno、Ellen McKoy 和 Dennis Overholser。

paras.en: Members of SEMA’s Councils & Networks will participate in the Hall of Fame presentations, helping recognize the inductees’ contributions and lasting impact on the industry.
paras.zh: SEMA 理事会和网络的成员将参加名人堂演讲，帮助表彰入选者的贡献和对行业的持久影响。

paras.en: SEMA Industry Honors will also recognize outstanding achievements in leadership, automotive storytelling and lifetime contributions to the specialty automotive industry.
paras.zh: SEMA 行业荣誉还将表彰在领导力、汽车故事讲述和对特种汽车行业的终身贡献方面取得的杰出成就。

paras.en: The SEMA Person of the Year award honors an individual whose leadership, service and contributions have significantly strengthened the industry and the SEMA community.
paras.zh: SEMA 年度人物奖旨在表彰其领导力、服务和贡献显着增强了行业和 SEMA 社区实力的个人。

paras.en: The SEMA Content Creator of the Year award recognizes an individual who uses compelling and innovative content to expand the reach of the automotive lifestyle, engages new audiences and inspires greater participation in the industry.
paras.zh: SEMA 年度内容创作者奖旨在表彰那些利用引人注目的创新内容来扩大汽车生活方式的影响力、吸引新受众并激发更多人参与该行业的个人。

paras.en: Presented by the Petersen Automotive Museum, the Robert E. Petersen Lifetime Achievement Award honors individuals whose careers and contributions have made a lasting impact on motorsports, particularly drag racing. Named for the museum’s late founder, Robert E. Petersen, the award is considered one of the specialty automotive industry’s highest honors.
paras.zh: 罗伯特·E·彼得森终身成就奖由彼得森汽车博物馆颁发，旨在表彰那些在职业生涯和贡献上对赛车运动（尤其是飙车运动）产生持久影响的个人。该奖项以博物馆已故创始人罗伯特·彼得森 (Robert E. Petersen) 的名字命名，被认为是特种汽车行业的最高荣誉之一。

paras.en: “Guests can expect a high-energy evening that blends meaningful recognition with the camaraderie that makes the SEMA Show so special,” said Andy Tompkins, trade show director for SEMA. “From connecting with colleagues during the reception to hearing the stories behind this year’s honorees, attendees will experience an entertaining and inspiring celebration of the people who make the automotive aftermarket extraordinary.”
paras.zh: SEMA 贸易展览总监安迪·汤普金斯 (Andy Tompkins) 表示：“来宾们可以期待一个充满活力的夜晚，将有意义的认可与友情融为一体，使 SEMA 展会如此特别。” “从在招待会上与同事交流，到聆听今年获奖者背后的故事，与会者将体验到一场有趣且鼓舞人心的庆祝活动，庆祝那些使汽车售后市场变得非凡的人们。”

paras.en: The evening begins at 6 p.m. with a cocktail reception, followed by the Industry Honors awards program at 7:30 p.m. (Reception will include heavy appetizers; dinner will not be served.)
paras.zh: The evening begins at 6 p.m.晚上 7:30 举行鸡尾酒会，随后举行行业荣誉颁奖活动。 （招待会包括丰盛的开胃菜；不提供晚餐。）

paras.en: SEMA Show exhibitors receive two tickets to SEMA Industry Honors and may purchase additional tickets for $50 each through Registration Customer Service. Show attendees may purchase tickets for $50 each when registering for the SEMA Show, or by logging into the Registration Resource Center.
paras.zh: SEMA 展会参展商将收到两张 SEMA 行业荣誉奖门票，并可通过注册客户服务购买每张 50 美元的额外门票。展会参加者在注册 SEMA 展会时或登录注册资源中心可以购买每张 50 美元的门票。

paras.en: Each ticket includes admission to the cocktail reception and awards ceremony, hors d’oeuvres and an open bar. Space is limited, and exhibitors and attendees are encouraged to secure their tickets early. For more information or to purchase tickets, visit semashow.com/industry-honors.
paras.zh: 每张门票均包含鸡尾酒会和颁奖典礼的入场券、开胃小菜和开放式酒吧。空间有限，鼓励参展商和与会者尽早获取门票。如需了解更多信息或购买门票，请访问 semashow.com/industry-honors。

paras.en: The 2026 SEMA Show will take place Nov. 3-6 at the Las Vegas Convention Center. Attendee registration and qualification information are available here. Hotel reservations at guaranteed low rates are available exclusively through SEMA’s official hotel provider, onPeak.
paras.zh: 2026 年 SEMA 展将于 11 月 3 日至 6 日在拉斯维加斯会议中心举行。此处提供与会者注册和资格信息。酒店预订可通过 SEMA 的官方酒店提供商 onPeak 独家以保证低价格预订。

paras.en: Spaces are still available for companies interested in exhibiting and connecting with tens of thousands of qualified buyers. For more information, visit semashow.com/exhibitor.
paras.zh: 对于有兴趣参展并与数以万计的合格买家建立联系的公司来说，仍然可以使用空间。欲了解更多信息，请访问 semashow.com/exhibitor。

paras.en: The 2026 SEMA Show opens on Election Day, Nov. 3. SEMA’s Drive the Vote campaign encourages attendees to make a plan to vote before traveling to Las Vegas. Visit sema.org/vote for more information.
paras.zh: 2026 年 SEMA 展会于 11 月 3 日选举日开幕。SEMA 的“推动投票”活动鼓励与会者在前往拉斯维加斯之前制定投票计划。请访问 sema.org/vote 了解更多信息。

articles.title: Rivian Names CARSTAR Ideal Auto Body Littleton Northwest Region Collision Center of Year
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: CARSTAR Ideal Auto Body Littleton, a Rivian Certified Collision Center owned by Puget Collision Group, was named Northwest Region Collision Center of the Year at the 2026 Rivian Summit.
paras.zh: CARSTAR Ideal Auto Body Littleton 是 Puget Collision Group 旗下的 Rivian 认证碰撞中心，在 2026 年 Rivian 峰会上被评为西北地区年度碰撞中心。

paras.en: As a Rivian Certified Collision Center, CARSTAR Ideal Auto Body Littleton provides collision repair services for Rivian owners. The recognition celebrates the Littleton team’s work and commitment.
paras.zh: 作为 Rivian 认证碰撞中心，CARSTAR Ideal Auto Body Littleton 为 Rivian 车主提供碰撞修复服务。这一认可表彰了利特尔顿团队的工作和承诺。

paras.en: “We are incredibly proud of the team at CARSTAR Ideal Auto Body Littleton for earning this recognition,” said Joe Morella, founder and CEO of Puget Collision Group. “This award reflects the hard work and dedication our team brings to the shop every day. It is an honor to see their efforts recognized by Rivian, and we are excited to celebrate this achievement together.”
paras.zh: Puget Collision Group 创始人兼首席执行官 Joe Morella 表示：“我们为 CARSTAR Ideal Auto Body Littleton 团队获得这一认可感到无比自豪。” “这个奖项反映了我们团队每天为商店带来的辛勤工作和奉献精神。很荣幸看到他们的努力得到 Rivian 的认可，我们很高兴能够共同庆祝这一成就。”

paras.en: “This is an outstanding accomplishment for CARSTAR Ideal Auto Body Littleton,” said Damien Reyna, COO, Driven Brands Collision Group. “Recognition like this reflects the commitment our franchise partners and their teams bring to delivering quality repairs and exceptional service. Congratulations to the entire Littleton team on this well-deserved honor.”
paras.zh: “这是 CARSTAR Ideal Auto Body Littleton 的一项杰出成就，”Driven Brands Collision Group 首席运营官 Damien Reyna 说道。 “这样的认可反映了我们的特许经营合作伙伴及其团队对提供优质维修和卓越服务的承诺。祝贺整个利特尔顿团队获得这一当之无愧的荣誉。”

paras.en: For more information, visit CARSTAR.com.
paras.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 CARSTAR.com。

articles.title: CCC Intelligent Solutions Adds Azimuth to Diagnostics Network
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) has announced an integration with Azimuth Claims Solutions, bringing Azimuth’s ADAS calibration identification and labor time capabilities to the CCC ONE platform.
paras.zh: CCC Intelligence Solutions Inc. (CCC) 宣布与 Azimuth Claims Solutions 进行整合，将 Azimuth 的 ADAS 校准识别和劳动时间功能引入 CCC ONE 平台。

paras.en: The integration connects Azimuth’s ADAS calibration recommendations to CCC ONE, enabling repair facilities to view recommendations within their existing workflow. Azimuth combines OEM procedures, vehicle build data and real-world time studies to help identify required OEM calibration operations and associated labor times.
paras.zh: 该集成将 Azimuth 的 ADAS 校准建议连接到 CCC ONE，使维修机构能够在其现有工作流程中查看建议。 Azimuth 结合了 OEM 程序、车辆制造数据和实际时间研究，以帮助确定所需的 OEM 校准操作和相关的劳动时间。

paras.en: Repairers will be able to add Azimuth recommendations to the estimate to help reduce manual steps and support more efficient, consistent repair planning. As advanced driver-assistance systems become more common, identifying calibration requirements has become a more complex and critical part of the collision repair process.
paras.zh: 维修人员将能够在估算中添加方位角建议，以帮助减少手动步骤并支持更高效、一致的维修计划。随着先进的驾驶员辅助系统变得越来越普遍，确定校准要求已成为碰撞修复过程中更加复杂和关键的部分。

paras.en: Integrating Azimuth with CCC ONE gives repairers access to actionable calibration information earlier in the repair process without requiring them to move between separate systems.
paras.zh: 将 Azimuth 与 CCC ONE 集成后，维修人员可以在维修过程的早期访问可操作的校准信息，而无需在不同的系统之间移动。

paras.en: “ADAS technology continues to add complexity to the repair process, making it increasingly important for repairers to have the right information available at the right time,” said Dan Risley, vice president, market solutions, automotive services group at CCC Intelligent Solutions. “By integrating Azimuth with CCC ONE, we’re giving repairers another way to access actionable calibration recommendations within their existing workflow, helping them make informed decisions and keep repairs moving.”
paras.zh: CCC 智能解决方案汽车服务集团市场解决方案副总裁 Dan Risley 表示：“ADAS 技术不断增加维修过程的复杂性，使得维修人员在正确的时间获得正确的信息变得越来越重要。” “通过将 Azimuth 与 CCC ONE 集成，我们为维修人员提供了另一种方式，在其现有工作流程中获取可行的校准建议，帮助他们做出明智的决策并保持维修进度。”

paras.en: Azimuth’s platform is designed to bring greater transparency and consistency to ADAS calibration planning by identifying required OEM procedures and labor associated with the vehicle and repair. The company’s technology helps insurers and collision repairers navigate increasingly complex calibration requirements as vehicle systems continue to evolve.
paras.zh: Azimuth 的平台旨在通过确定与车辆和维修相关的所需 OEM 程序和劳动力，为 ADAS 校准计划带来更大的透明度和一致性。随着车辆系统的不断发展，该公司的技术可帮助保险公司和碰撞修理商满足日益复杂的校准要求。

paras.en: “ADAS calibration has become one of the most critical and least standardized components of modern collision repair,” said Charles Rich, CEO of Azimuth Claims Solutions. “With sensors, cameras and software-driven systems now involved in nearly every repair, the industry needs clearer, more consistent guidance to determine what procedures are required. By bringing Azimuth’s calibration identification engine and labor time intelligence into the CCC ONE platform, CCC is helping deliver the level of transparency, consistency and workflow support that repairers and insurers expect from a modern, data-driven ecosystem. This collaboration enables a more informed, unified view of ADAS requirements tied directly to the repair plan, supporting better outcomes as vehicles continue their evolution into software-defined platforms.”
paras.zh: Azimuth Claims Solutions 首席执行官 Charles Rich 表示：“ADAS 校准已成为现代碰撞修复中最关键且标准化程度最低的组成部分之一。” “现在传感器、摄像头和软件驱动系统几乎涉及到每一次维修，行业需要更清晰、更一致的指导来确定需要哪些程序。通过将 Azimuth 的校准识别引擎和劳动时间智能引入 CCC ONE 平台，CCC 正在帮助提供维修人员和保险公司期望从现代数据驱动的生态系统中获得的透明度、一致性和工作流程支持。这种合作能够对与维修计划直接相关的 ADAS 要求提供更明智、更统一的视图，随着车辆继续向软件定义的平台。”

paras.en: The addition of Azimuth expands CCC’s diagnostics network and reflects the company’s focus on connecting collision repairers with the tools, information and partners they need to navigate increasingly complex vehicle technology and repair requirements.
paras.zh: Azimuth 的加入扩大了 CCC 的诊断网络，反映了该公司致力于将碰撞维修人员与他们所需的工具、信息和合作伙伴联系起来，以应对日益复杂的车辆技术和维修要求。

paras.en: To learn more about CCC Diagnostics, visit CCC Diagnostics.
paras.zh: 要了解有关 CCC 诊断的更多信息，请访问 CCC 诊断。

articles.title: Federal bill aims to reform permitting, would reportedly expedite building and manufacturing
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: A recent bill introduced in the U.S. Senate promises cheaper energy, more jobs, and responsible growth nationwide, according to the bill sponsors.
paras.zh: 据法案发起者称，美国参议院最近提出的一项法案承诺提供更便宜的能源、更多的就业机会以及全国范围内负责任的增长。

paras.en: U.S. Sens. Shelley Moore Capito (R-WV), Mike Lee (R-UT), Sheldon Whitehouse (D-RI), and Martin Heinrich (D-NM) introduced the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (BAAJA) on Sept. 30.
paras.zh: 美国参议员雪莱·摩尔·卡皮托 (R-WV)、迈克·李 (R-UT)、谢尔顿·怀特豪斯 (D-RI) 和马丁·海因里希 (D-NM) 于 9 月 30 日提出了两党《2026 年美国负担能力和就业法案》(BAAJA)。

paras.en: The sponsors say the BAAJA provides certainty that permitted energy and infrastructure projects will retain their permits, except under extraordinary circumstances, violations of law, a court order, or targeted reforms for energy projects.
paras.zh: 发起人表示，BAAJA 提供了确定性，即获准的能源和基础设施项目将保留其许可证，除非在特殊情况、违反法律、法院命令或能源项目有针对性的改革的情况下。

paras.en: The bill would expedite project approvals by amending the National Environmental Policy Act, Clean Water Act, Endangered Species Act, and National Historic Preservation Act.
paras.zh: 该法案将通过修改《国家环境政策法》、《清洁水法》、《濒危物种法》和《国家历史保护法》来加快项目审批。

paras.en: “For far too long, our broken and outdated federal environmental review and permitting processes have stood in the way of energy reliability, secure jobs, modern infrastructure, and economic growth,” said Capito in a press release about the bill. “The bipartisan reforms we secured in this deal will transform our nation’s ability to power our economy and fuel future growth, while continuing to protect the land, water, and wildlife we all cherish.”
paras.zh: 卡皮托在有关该法案的新闻稿中表示：“长期以来，我们破碎且过时的联邦环境审查和许可程序一直阻碍着能源可靠性、就业保障、现代基础设施和经济增长。” “我们在这项协议中实现的两党改革将改变我们国家推动经济和推动未来增长的能力，同时继续保护我们都珍惜的土地、水和野生动物。”

paras.en: Lee added that permitting often delays building infrastructure.
paras.zh: 李补充说，获得许可常常会延误基础设施建设。

paras.en: “[W]hat too often stands in the way is a permitting system that takes too long and costs too much,” he said. “After years of work in Congress and many months of negotiations, I’m proud we’ve reached a bipartisan agreement to fix this broken process and get America back to building.”
paras.zh: “最常见的障碍是许可制度耗时太长、成本太高，”他说。 “经过在国会多年的工作和数月的谈判，我很自豪我们达成了两党协议，以修复这个破碎的进程，让美国重新开始建设。”

paras.en: John Bozzella, president and CEO of the Alliance for Automotive Innovation (Auto Innovators), made a similar argument in support of the bill as it relates to the automotive industry, backing the bill sponsors’ plan to increase domestic production of critical manufacturing elements.
paras.zh: 汽车创新联盟（汽车创新者）总裁兼首席执行官约翰·博泽拉（John Bozzella）也提出了类似的观点来支持该法案，因为该法案涉及汽车行业，支持法案发起者增加关键制造要素的国内产量的计划。

paras.en: “The auto industry in America supports our economic and national security,” Bozzella wrote in a statement of support for the bill. “For the auto sector to remain competitive in today’s global marketplace, it’s essential to have reliable access to energy and the critical minerals that power our advanced vehicles.
paras.zh: “美国的汽车工业支持我们的经济和国家安全，”博泽拉在支持该法案的声明中写道。 “汽车行业要想在当今的全球市场上保持竞争力，就必须可靠地获取能源和为我们的先进车辆提供动力的关键矿物。

paras.en: “Sens. Capito, Whitehouse, Lee and Heinrich understand this dynamic and have a plan to make American permitting more predictable by increasing domestic production of elements that are critical to the country’s largest manufacturing sector. We know that when those supply chains are disrupted, it can ripple across the country’s industrial base.”
paras.zh: “参议员卡皮托、怀特豪斯、李和海因里希了解这一动态，并制定了一项计划，通过增加对美国最大的制造业至关重要的要素的国内生产，使美国的许可更加可预测。我们知道，当这些供应链遭到破坏时，可能会波及整个国家的工业基础。”

paras.en: He added that the bill is key to increasing advanced manufacturing, economic growth, jobs, and protecting the country’s defense base.
paras.zh: 他补充说，该法案对于增加先进制造业、经济增长、就业和保护国家国防基础至关重要。

paras.en: The Automotive National and Economic Security Act of 2026 was introduced in the U.S. House in August to study the national and economic security risks foreign adversaries, such as China, pose to the U.S. automotive industry, according to a press release from bill sponsor Rep. Diana Harshbarger’s (R-TN). She co-sponsors the bill with Rep. Debbie Dingell (D-MI).
paras.zh: 根据该法案发起人众议员戴安娜·哈什巴格 (R-TN) 的一份新闻稿，美国众议院于 8 月提出了《2026 年汽车国家和经济安全法案》，旨在研究中国等外国对手对美国汽车行业构成的国家和经济安全风险。她与众议员黛比·丁格尔（密歇根州民主党）共同发起该法案。

paras.en: - “Foreign ownership of, and state-directed investment in, U.S. automakers by foreign military organizations, political parties, and state-owned enterprises.
paras.zh: -“外国军事组织、政党和国有企业对美国汽车制造商的外资所有权和国家指导投资。

paras.en: - “Joint ventures, subsidiaries, and commercial partnerships between U.S. manufacturers and foreign adversaries.
paras.zh: -“美国制造商与外国对手之间的合资企业、子公司和商业伙伴关系。

paras.en: - “Transfers of critical and emerging technologies to foreign adversaries.
paras.zh: - “向外国对手转让关键和新兴技术。

paras.en: - “Impacts on U.S. national security, economic competitiveness, and intellectual property protection.”
paras.zh: - “对美国国家安全、经济竞争力和知识产权保护的影响。”

paras.en: The Bipartisan Policy Center published an explainer of the 411-page BAAJA, drilling down to how each environmental and energy act listed above would change if the bill passes.
paras.zh: 两党政策中心发布了 411 页的 BAAJA 解释，深入探讨了如果该法案通过，上面列出的每项环境和能源法案将如何变化。

paras.en: The National Environmental Policy Act’s procedural provisions would be rewritten “along three lines: scope of review (what agencies must analyze), which projects get reviewed at all, and how long the process takes,” according to the explainer.
paras.zh: 解释者表示，《国家环境政策法》的程序规定将“沿着三条线重写：审查范围（机构必须分析哪些内容）、哪些项目需要接受审查以及审查过程需要多长时间”。

paras.en: The Bipartisan Policy Center adds in its explainer that the BAAJA would amend the Clean Water Act to reduce friction caused by some of the provisions on linear infrastructure and industrial facilities permitting while still protecting waters.
paras.zh: 两党政策中心在其解释中补充说，BAAJA 将修订《清洁水法》，以减少线性基础设施和工业设施许可的一些条款造成的摩擦，同时仍保护水源。

paras.en: The explainer states the BAAJA would tighten consultation and approval timelines under the Endangered Species Act “without changing the jeopardy standard or the criteria for listing a species.”
paras.zh: 解释者表示，BAAJA 将根据《濒危物种法》收紧咨询和批准时间表，“但不会改变危险标准或列出物种的标准”。

paras.en: BAAJA would “write a narrower definition” into Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act. Section 106 deals with funding and permit issuance for projects that affect historic properties.
paras.zh: BAAJA 将在《国家历史保护法》第 106 条中“写入更狭义的定义”。第 106 条涉及影响历史遗产的项目的资金和许可证发放。

paras.en: “The result is that the federal approval, not the entire project footprint, would set the boundaries of review,” the explainer states.
paras.zh: “结果是联邦批准，而不是整个项目足迹，将设定审查的界限，”解释者说。

paras.en: The Bipartisan Policy Center covers several other aspects of the proposed amendments, including power sector emissions, electricity costs, grid data access, ratepayer protection from data centers, and more.
paras.zh: 两党政策中心涵盖拟议修正案的其他几个方面，包括电力部门排放、电力成本、电网数据访问、数据中心的纳税人保护等。

paras.en: According to Whitehouse, if the BAAJA passes, the U.S. power grid will be flooded with clean, affordable energy.
paras.zh: 白宫称，如果 BAAJA 通过，美国电网将充满清洁、负担得起的能源。

paras.en: “America is entering a new era of energy demand,” he said in the release. “We have an enormous opportunity to build big things again to meet that moment — to build more generation, expand our grid, create more jobs, lower energy costs, and make sure we have the energy we need to compete. It should not take decades to build the infrastructure our country needs.”
paras.zh: “美国正在进入能源需求的新时代，”他在新闻稿中表示。 “我们有巨大的机会再次建设伟大的事物来迎接这一时刻——建设更多发电，扩大我们的电网，创造更多就业机会，降低能源成本，并确保我们拥有竞争所需的能源。建设我们国家所需的基础设施不应该需要几十年的时间。”

paras.en: Featured image credit: halbergman/iStock
paras.zh: 特色图片来源：halbergman/iStock

articles.title: IIHS pedestrian, vehicle-to-vehicle tests show struggling cargo vans and pickups
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: New commercial vehicle safety ratings from the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS) show that cargo vans and heavy-duty pickups lag behind passenger vehicles in front crash prevention.
paras.zh: 美国公路安全保险协会 (IIHS) 的新商用车安全评级显示，货车和重型皮卡在预防正面碰撞方面落后于乘用车。

paras.en: While IIHS says marginal and poor ratings are common among the first commercial vehicles put through vehicle-to-vehicle and pedestrian crash avoidance tests, at least one performs well in each test, “showing that meeting the challenge is not out of reach for manufacturers.”
paras.zh: 虽然 IIHS 表示，在第一批进行车对车和行人防撞测试的商用车中，评级较低和较差的情况很常见，但至少有一辆在每次测试中表现良好，“这表明应对挑战对于制造商来说并非遥不可及。”

paras.en: “These results are a wake-up call for commercial vehicle makers,” said IIHS President David Harkey in a press release. “Front crash prevention is especially important for these larger, heavier vans and trucks because of the danger they pose to other road users.”
paras.zh: IIHS 总裁 David Harkey 在一份新闻稿中表示：“这些结果给商用车制造商敲响了警钟。” “对于这些较大、较重的货车和卡车来说，预防正面碰撞尤其重要，因为它们会对其他道路使用者构成危险。”

paras.en: Cargo vans scored the highest in both tests. The Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 2500 earned a good rating for vehicle-to-vehicle front crash prevention.
paras.zh: 货车在两项测试中得分最高。梅赛德斯-奔驰 Sprinter 2500 在车辆正面碰撞预防方面获得了良好的评价。

paras.en: The Chevrolet BrightDrop 400 and Rivian RCV-Delivery 500 earned good ratings for pedestrian crash avoidance.
paras.zh: 雪佛兰 BrightDrop 400 和 Rivian RCV-Delivery 500 在避免行人碰撞方面获得了良好的评价。

paras.en: IIHS launched its commercial vehicle assessment program in June, including driver protection information.
paras.zh: IIHS 于 6 月推出了商用车辆评估计划，其中包括驾驶员保护信息。

paras.en: “That part of the assessment checks for essential features such as standard front and side airbags, advanced seatbelt technology, and effective seatbelt reminders,” the IIHS press release states. “Many government standards for passenger vehicles, including airbag requirements, don’t apply to delivery vans, box trucks, tractor-trailers, and larger work pickups.
paras.zh: IIHS 新闻稿称：“这部分评估检查基本功能，例如标准的正面和侧面安全气囊、先进的安全带技术和有效的安全带提醒。” “许多政府针对乘用车的标准，包括安全气囊要求，并不适用于货车、厢式卡车、牵引拖车和大型工作皮卡车。

paras.en: “Unlike the driver protection evaluation, the vehicle-to-vehicle front crash prevention and pedestrian front crash prevention evaluations use the Institute’s scale of good, acceptable, marginal, or poor. The test protocols and rating requirements are the same as those used for passenger vehicles.”
paras.zh: “与驾驶员保护评估不同，车辆对车辆正面碰撞预防和行人正面碰撞预防评估使用研究所的良好、可接受、边缘或差的等级。测试协议和评级要求与乘用车所使用的相同。”

paras.en: IIHS notes that 6,215 people were killed in crashes involving heavy- or medium-duty vehicles or light vans in 2024, accounting for 16% of all roadway fatalities in the U.S. It adds that reducing that toll is a key part of the Institute’s 30×30 vision of reducing fatalities 30% by 2030.
paras.zh: IIHS 指出，2024 年，有 6,215 人在涉及重型或中型车辆或轻型货车的事故中丧生，占美国所有道路死亡人数的 16%。它补充说，减少死亡人数是该研究所 30×30 愿景的关键部分，即到 2030 年将死亡人数减少 30%。

paras.en: The initial evaluations focus on cargo vans and Class 3 pickup trucks. Class 3 pickups have a gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR) of 10,001 to 14,000 pounds. GVWR is the maximum weight a vehicle can safely carry, including passengers, cargo, and the vehicle’s weight.
paras.zh: 初步评估主要针对货车和 3 级皮卡车。 3 级皮卡的车辆总重等级 (GVWR) 为 10,001 至 14,000 磅。 GVWR是车辆可以安全承载的最大重量，包括乘客、货物和车辆的重量。

paras.en: IIHS will continue to evaluate Class 3 vehicles this year and next, adding ratings for headlights and rear automatic emergency braking (AEB), according to the release. The Institute plans to phase in trucks in classes four through six later.
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，IIHS 将在今年和明年继续评估 3 级车辆，增加前灯和后自动紧急制动 (AEB) 的评级。该学院计划稍后在第四至六年级中分阶段使用卡车。

paras.en: The Chevrolet Express 2500 and the GMC Savana 2500 cargo vans earn poor ratings in the vehicle-to-vehicle and pedestrian tests because they lack AEB. IIHS says AEB is an optional feature only available on vehicles with a forward collision warning system.
paras.zh: 雪佛兰 Express 2500 和 GMC Savana 2500 货车由于缺乏 AEB，在车对车和行人测试中得分较低。 IIHS 表示，AEB 是一项可选功能，仅适用于配备前方碰撞警告系统的车辆。

paras.en: Performance varied widely among the other vans and pickup trucks in the vehicle-to-vehicle test. The test evaluates forward collision warning and AEB at different speeds with a passenger car target and a motorcycle target. It also evaluates forward collision warning with a semitrailer.
paras.zh: 在车对车测试中，其他货车和皮卡车的性能差异很大。该测试以乘用车目标和摩托车目标来评估不同速度下的前方碰撞警告和 AEB。它还评估半挂车的前方碰撞警告。

paras.en: The Sprinter 2500 earned a good rating, the BrightDrop 400 an acceptable rating, and the others marginal or poor.
paras.zh: Sprinter 2500 获得了良好的评级，BrightDrop 400 获得了可接受的评级，其他的则处于边缘或较差的评级。

paras.en: IIHS found that the motorcycle target was the biggest challenge. In most motorcycle trials, several of the systems failed to issue warnings or slow down at all.
paras.zh: IIHS 发现摩托车目标是最大的挑战。在大多数摩托车试验中，有几个系统根本无法发出警告或减速。

paras.en: At most speeds, others successfully slowed to avoid or mitigate collisions with the motorcycle and passenger car targets, but were downgraded because they didn’t provide timely warnings to the driver.
paras.zh: 在大多数速度下，其他系统成功地减速以避免或减轻与摩托车和客车目标的碰撞，但由于没有及时向驾驶员发出警告而被降级。

paras.en: Overall, the vehicles performed better in the pedestrian evaluation than in the vehicle-to-vehicle test, IIHS said.
paras.zh: IIHS 表示，总体而言，这些车辆在行人评估中的表现优于车辆间测试。

paras.en: The pedestrian test represents common daytime and nighttime crashes involving an adult or child crossing the road or an adult walking in the travel lane.
paras.zh: 行人测试代表常见的白天和夜间碰撞事故，涉及成人或儿童过马路或成人在行车道上行走。

paras.en: Among cargo vans, the BrightDrop 400 and RCV-Delivery 500 earned good ratings, and the Sprinter 2500 earned an acceptable rating. Among Class 3 pickups, the F-350 and Ram 3500 earned acceptable ratings.
paras.zh: 在货车中，BrightDrop 400 和 RCV-Delivery 500 获得了良好的评级，Sprinter 2500 获得了可接受的评级。在 3 级皮卡中，F-350 和 Ram 3500 获得了可接受的评级。

paras.en: Several vehicles, including the F-350 and Ram 3500, had a harder time detecting and avoiding the child pedestrian dummy in daylight conditions than the adult at night.
paras.zh: 包括 F-350 和 Ram 3500 在内的多种车辆在白天条件下检测和避开儿童行人假人比夜间成人假人更困难。

paras.en: “The problem may be related to the shorter height of the child dummy and the tall front ends of the vehicles,” the release states. “That’s because the sensors used for detection are positioned near the rearview mirror. In some instances, the child dummy was detected at a distance but then ‘disappeared’ as the vehicle got closer.”
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“问题可能与儿童假人的高度较短和车辆前端较高有关。” “这是因为用于检测的传感器位于后视镜附近。在某些情况下，儿童假人在远处被检测到，但随着车辆靠近而‘消失’。”

paras.en: The poor and marginal systems also failed to slow down enough in most of the nighttime trials with the adult. Those trials are done with low-beam headlights and then again with high beams. Others performed worse at the slowest test speed.
paras.zh: 在大多数与成人进行的夜间试验中，贫困和边缘系统也未能放慢足够的速度。这些试验是使用近光灯进行的，然后再使用远光灯进行的。其他人在最慢的测试速度下表现更差。

paras.en: Featured image: The 2025 Chevrolet BrightDrop 400 in IIHS’s pedestrian front crash prevention test.
paras.zh: 特色图片： 2025年雪佛兰BrightDrop 400在IIHS的行人前碰撞预防测试中。

paras.en: The 2025 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 2500 in IIHS’s vehicle-to-vehicle front crash prevention test.
paras.zh: 2025梅赛德斯-奔驰Sprinter 2500在IIHS的车对车前防撞测试中。

paras.en: The 2025 Rivian RCV-Delivery 500 in IIHS’s pedestrian front crash prevention test.
paras.zh: 2025 Rivian RCV-Delivery 500 参加 IIHS 行人正面碰撞预防测试。

paras.en: All photos and ratings chart provided by IIHS
paras.zh: 所有照片和评级图表均由 IIHS 提供

articles.title: Two Democrats vie for insurance commissioner position in California
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: California will elect its next insurance commissioner on Nov. 3, as incumbent Ricardo Lara is term-limited.
paras.zh: 加州将于 11 月 3 日选举下一任保险专员，现任保险专员里卡多·拉拉 (Ricardo Lara) 任期有限。

paras.en: The insurance commissioner seat is elected for four years and is limited to serving two terms.
paras.zh: 保险专员席位的任期为四年，仅限连任两届。

paras.en: Sens. Ben Allen and Jane Kim, a consumer advocate and an attorney, will be on this year’s midterm ballot. Both are Democrats.
paras.zh: 参议员本·艾伦 (Ben Allen) 和消费者权益倡导者兼律师简·金 (Jane Kim) 将参加今年的中期选举。两人都是民主党人。

paras.en: Allen has served in the state’s legislature since 2014, according to his campaign website. He lists climate and environmental policies as a focus during his tenure.
paras.zh: 据艾伦的竞选网站称，他自 2014 年以来一直在该州立法机构任职。他将气候和环境政策列为任期内的重点。

paras.en: The website also lists work on strengthening transparency, including expanding ballot access and championing the DISCLOSE Act.
paras.zh: 该网站还列出了加强透明度的工作，包括扩大投票范围和支持《披露法案》。

paras.en: “He has consistently scored tops in the legislature in the California Clean Money Campaign’s reports for his commitment to transparency and political reform,” the website states.
paras.zh: 该网站称：“在加州清洁货币运动的报告中，他因其对透明度和政治改革的承诺而在立法机构中一直名列前茅。”

paras.en: Allen’s plan focuses on strengthening the state’s insurance market as wildfires and climate disasters intensify.
paras.zh: 艾伦的计划重点是随着野火和气候灾害加剧，加强该州的保险市场。

paras.en: “My plan will restore a competitive insurance market, ensure Californians are treated fairly after disasters, and build resilient communities that can withstand the climate challenges ahead,” he states on his website.
paras.zh: 他在网站上表示：“我的计划将恢复有竞争力的保险市场，确保加州人在灾难后得到公平对待，并建立能够抵御未来气候挑战的有弹性的社区。”

paras.en: Fighting insurers that “deny and delay” and post-disaster insurer compliance are other planned action items, Allen’s site claims.
paras.zh: 艾伦的网站称，打击“拒绝和拖延”的保险公司以及灾后保险公司的合规是其他计划采取的行动项目。

paras.en: This would include higher upfront payments for coverage requiring insurers to clearly explain claim denials and maintain post-disaster real-time reporting on delays and outstanding claims.
paras.zh: 这将包括更高的保险预付款，要求保险公司明确解释索赔被拒绝的情况，并维护有关延误和未决索赔的灾后实时报告。

paras.en: modernize customer service and filings infrastructure, improve consumer communication, and provide data transparency.
paras.zh: 实现客户服务和备案基础设施现代化，改善消费者沟通并提供数据透明度。

paras.en: Kim previously served on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors, as California political director for Bernie Sanders, and as California director for the Working Families Party, according to her campaign website.
paras.zh: 据她的竞选网站称，金此前曾在旧金山监事会任职，担任伯尼·桑德斯的加州政治主任，以及工作家庭党的加州主任。

paras.en: Her priorities focus on “affordable, available insurance for all,” the website states. She proposes a single-payer disaster insurance policy for state residents.
paras.zh: 该网站称，她的首要任务是“为所有人提供负担得起的、可用的保险”。她提议为州居民提供单一付款人灾难保险政策。

paras.en: The website also says she’ll ensure premiums cover claims, or lower them.
paras.zh: 该网站还表示，她将确保保费覆盖索赔，或降低保费。

paras.en: “Insurance companies should spend premium dollars on their intended purpose: protecting policyholders,” the website states. “If companies collect more than they need to cover claims and a reasonable profit, that money should go back to policyholders or be invested in statewide resilience, not huge payouts at our expense — like the $27 million salary one insurance company CEO was paid last year.”
paras.zh: 该网站指出：“保险公司应该将保费用于其预期目的：保护保单持有人。” “如果公司收取的金额超出了他们支付索赔和合理利润所需的金额，那么这笔钱应该返还给保单持有人或投资于全州的恢复力，而不是由我们承担巨额支出——就像去年向一位保险公司首席执行官支付的 2700 万美元的薪水一样。”

paras.en: Her site states that a long-term goal is to build a public auto insurance option to compete in the market.
paras.zh: 她的网站指出，长期目标是建立公共汽车保险选项以参与市场竞争。

paras.en: She also notes that she’s focused on “fast and fair claims.” This includes freezing rates when a claim is filed, penalizing delays to speed up payments, and immediate payouts.
paras.zh: 她还指出，她专注于“快速、公平的索赔”。这包括提出索赔时冻结费率、惩罚延迟以加快付款以及立即付款。

paras.en: Under Kim, insurance companies would be held accountable through market conduct examinations and elevated complaint rates, according to the website. She also proposes an insurance performance dashboard that consumers can use to assess insurer risks before choosing a policy.
paras.zh: 据该网站称，在金的领导下，保险公司将通过市场行为检查和提高投诉率来追究责任。她还提出了一个保险绩效仪表板，消费者可以在选择保单之前使用它来评估保险公司的风险。

paras.en: Oklahoma, California, and Georgia are the states where policyholders are most likely to feel influenced by a new insurance commissioner on their home insurance premiums, according to an Insurify analysis.
paras.zh: 根据 Insurify 的分析，俄克拉荷马州、加利福尼亚州和佐治亚州是保单持有人最有可能在家庭保险费方面受到新保险专员影响的州。

paras.en: California saw a 5% homeowners insurance increase last year, the analysis found. It also found home insurance rates have increased 22% since 2023.
paras.zh: 分析发现，加州去年的房主保险增加了 5%。它还发现自 2023 年以来家庭保险费率增加了 22%。

paras.en: Feature photo courtesy of smartboy10/iStock
paras.zh: 专题照片由 smartboy10/iStock 提供

paras.en: Embedded photos of candidates Ben Allen and Jane Kim from campaign websites.
paras.zh: 嵌入竞选网站上候选人本·艾伦 (Ben Allen) 和简·金 (Jane Kim) 的照片。

articles.title: NC Collision Shop Brings ADAS Calibration In-House
articles.author: Eric Garbe

paras.en: See how Vann York Collision Center in High Point, NC, is using Autel technology to bring ADAS calibration in-house, streamline collision repair workflows, and reduce reliance on outsourced services.
paras.zh: 了解位于北卡罗来纳州海波因特的 Vann York 碰撞中心如何使用 Autel 技术将 ADAS 校准引入内部、简化碰撞修复工作流程并减少对外包服务的依赖。

paras.en: ASE-Certified Master Automobile Technician Eric visits Vann York to talk with the team about their transition to Autel diagnostic, ADAS calibration and wheel alignment equipment. After working with other scan and calibration tools, the team shares how Autel has helped simplify setup, improve usability and bring alignment and ADAS calibration together in a more efficient workflow.
paras.zh: ASE 认证汽车技术大师 Eric 拜访 Vann York，与团队讨论他们向 Autel 诊断、ADAS 校准和车轮定位设备的过渡。在与其他扫描和校准工具合作后，该团队分享了 Autel 如何帮助简化设置、提高可用性以及在更高效的工作流程中将对准和 ADAS 校准结合在一起。

paras.en: With guided software, integrated alignment and calibration capabilities, training and technical support, Vann York is building more control into the repair process—and planning to expand its use of Autel equipment as the business grows.
paras.zh: 凭借引导软件、集成对准和校准功能、培训和技术支持，Vann York 正在对维修过程进行更多控制，并计划随着业务的增长扩大 Autel 设备的使用。

paras.zh: - 为什么 Vann York 将 ADAS 校准引入内部
