articles.title: Insomniac & ADE Partnering on New Dance Music Summit Coming to Las Vegas in May
articles.author: Katie Bain

paras.en: Insomniac Events is partnering with Amsterdam Dance Event for a new dance industry gathering set to happen this May in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: Insomniac Events 与阿姆斯特丹舞蹈活动 (Amsterdam Dance Event) 合作，将于今年五月在拉斯维加斯举办新的舞蹈行业聚会。

paras.en: Called Map Point Summit, the event will take place at Virgin Hotels Las Vegas between the between the two editions of EDC Las Vegas 2027, which next year will happen on consecutive weekends (May 14-16 and May 21-23) for the first time ever.
paras.zh: 该活动名为 Map Point Summit，将于两届 EDC 拉斯维加斯 2027 之间在拉斯维加斯维珍酒店举行，明年将首次在连续周末（5 月 14 日至 16 日和 5 月 21 日至 23 日）举行。

paras.en: The Summit will focus on providing a gathering place for creators, independent promoters, artists, entrepreneurs and professionals to focus on the future of the dance scene. Registration is open now, with the full program to be announced in the coming months.
paras.zh: 峰会将致力于为创作者、独立发起人、艺术家、企业家和专业人士提供一个聚集场所，共同关注舞蹈界的未来。注册现已开放，完整的计划将在未来几个月内公布。

paras.en: Map Point Summit was announced during ADE 2026, the dance music industry gathering happening this week in the Dutch capital. The news came at the end of a keynote conversation with Insomniac Events founder Pasquale Rotella, who revealed Map Point Summit alongside ADE managing director Jan-Willem van de Ven. The three-day Summit will be ADE’s first partnership of this kind and its first event outside of Amsterdam as an exclusive partnership in North America. Map Point Summit is aiming to combine ADE’s established network and experience with Insomniac’s strong North American presence and create a new meeting point for the international electronic dance music community.
paras.zh: Map Point 峰会是在 ADE 2026 期间宣布的，ADE 2026 是本周在荷兰首都举行的舞曲音乐行业聚会。这一消息是在与 Insomniac Events 创始人 Pasquale Rotella 的主题演讲结束时发布的，后者与 ADE 董事总经理 Jan-Willem van de Ven 一起透露了 Map Point Summit。为期三天的峰会将是 ADE 首次开展此类合作，也是首次在阿姆斯特丹以外的地区作为独家合作伙伴在北美举办活动。 Map Point Summit 旨在将 ADE 已建立的网络和经验与 Insomniac 在北美的强大影响力相结合，为国际电子舞曲社区创建一个新的交汇点。

paras.en: Map Point Summit is named for the method of finding parties during the early days of rave culture, an era Rotella spoke about at length during his keynote. In front of a packed room, he reflected on his early days throwing illegal underground raves in Los Angeles and ultimately parlaying those parties into Insomniac Events, which is now the biggest dance event producer in the world.
paras.zh: Map Point Summit 得名于狂欢文化早期寻找派对的方法，罗特拉在他的主题演讲中详细谈到了这个时代。在挤满人的房间前，他回顾了自己早年在洛杉矶举办非法地下狂欢的经历，并最终将这些派对投入到了 Insomniac Events 中，该公司现在是世界上最大的舞蹈活动制作商。

paras.en: During this conversation, Rotella spoke about partnering with Live Nation in 2013, a year that marked a high point of the U.S. EDM boom. Rotella noted that there had been several such partnership offers on the table in this era when dance music was exploding in popularity in the United States, and that because he took his time deciding with whom to partner, the offer amounts just getting higher. He added that partnering with Live Nation was the right move given how much freedom the company provides Insomniac to operate independently. “They don’t even know our office address,” Rotella joked during the talk.
paras.zh: 在这次谈话中，Rotella 谈到了 2013 年与 Live Nation 的合作，这一年标志着美国 EDM 热潮的顶峰。罗特拉指出，在这个舞曲音乐在美国迅速流行的时代，已经有好几份这样的合作邀请摆在桌面上，而且由于他花了很多时间来决定与谁合作，所以邀请的金额越来越高。他补充说，考虑到 Live Nation 为 Insomniac 提供了独立运营的自由度，与 Live Nation 合作是正确的举措。 “他们甚至不知道我们的办公室地址，”罗特拉在谈话中开玩笑说。

paras.en: The conversation also touched on Insomniac’s own partnerships with brands including German festival Time Warp, Miami festival III Points, German hard techno event Unreal and other promoters, with Rotella stressing the importance of grassroots brands in keeping true rave culture alive. He said that he thinks of these promoters and others like them “like bands” that are coming with their own unique vibe, and that each vibe is important to preserve for the longterm health of dance music.
paras.zh: 谈话还谈到了 Insomniac 自己与德国音乐节 Time Warp、迈阿密音乐节 III Points、德国硬科技活动 Unreal 和其他发起人的合作关系，Rotella 强调了草根品牌在保持真正的锐舞文化活力方面的重要性。他说，他认为这些发起人和其他像他们一样的人“就像乐队一样”，他们有着自己独特的氛围，而每种氛围对于保持舞曲音乐的长期健康都很重要。

paras.en: When asked about the markets Insomniac has expanded into and avoiding saturation, he noted the company brings events like EDC to markets where nothing else like it exists — there are currently editions of EDC in Las Vegas, Mexico, Colombia, Thailand and South Korea — and that the company wouldn’t attempt to do a festival in a market where there’s already something similar.
paras.zh: 当被问及 Insomniac 已拓展的市场并避免饱和时，他指出，该公司将 EDC 之类的活动带到了没有其他类似活动的市场——目前在拉斯维加斯、墨西哥、哥伦比亚、泰国和韩国都有 EDC 版本——并且该公司不会尝试在已经有类似活动的市场举办音乐节。

paras.en: With the struggles independent promoters often face in booking talent, he also posited the idea that big name DJs could do a certain number of shows a year where their fees are lowered, which would make such independent promoters better able to build lineups and strengthen dance culture overall.
paras.zh: 鉴于独立发起人在预订人才方面经常面临困难，他还提出了这样的想法：大牌 DJ 每年可以举办一定数量的演出，而费用会降低，这将使此类独立发起人能够更好地建立阵容并整体加强舞蹈文化。

paras.en: Map Point Summit was the second partnership announced by Insomniac this week, with the company deepening its relationship with Time Warp by launching Time Warp Records. This new imprint will exist as part of Insomniac Music Group, an arm of Insomniac Events.
paras.zh: Map Point Summit 是 Insomniac 本周宣布的第二个合作伙伴关系，该公司通过推出 Time Warp Records 加深了与 Time Warp 的关系。这个新品牌将作为 Insomniac Events 旗下子公司 Insomniac Music Group 的一部分存在。

articles.title: Jennifer Siebel Newsom Thinks It’s Time Tech Leaders Faced Accountability: “We’ve Let These Guys Go Unregulated for Too Long”
articles.author: Katie Kilkenny

paras.en: A lot has changed since 2011. The urgency of talking about the way women are represented in media, unfortunately, has not, according to Jennifer Siebel Newsom.
paras.zh: 自 2011 年以来发生了很多变化。不幸的是，根据詹妮弗·西贝尔·纽瑟姆 (Jennifer Siebel Newsom) 的说法，谈论媒体中女性形象的紧迫性并没有改变。

paras.en: The documentary filmmaker and the current First Partner of California initially tackled the subject of media’s impact on the underrepresentation of women in positions of power in her 2011 documentary Miss Representation. Around 15 years later, she’s returning with a follow-up, Miss Representation: Rise Up, which chronicles how social-media platforms and AI tools are undercutting women and girls, enabling harassment and supercharging misogyny.
paras.zh: 这位纪录片制片人和现任加州第一合伙人最初在 2011 年的纪录片《代表小姐》中探讨了媒体对权力职位上女性代表性不足的影响这一主题。大约 15 年后，她带着续作《Miss Representation: Rise Up》回归，记录了社交媒体平台和人工智能工具如何削弱妇女和女孩的利益，助长骚扰并加剧厌女症。

paras.en: Like its predecessor, the film, which premieres in New York theaters on Thursday, with more screenings to come, enlists a series of high-powered female interviewees to make its point. Hillary Rodham Clinton, Nancy Pelosi, Amy Klobuchar, Jameela Jamil and Gretchen Carlson all make appearances. They show up in between footage showing young students speaking about the way social media has impacted them (“It makes me feel like, what is wrong with me?” asks one) and showing female candidates describing online abuse and harassment in political races. Victoria Hinks, the mother of a 16-year-old who died by suicide after Hinks says she became addicted to social media, also speaks for the film.
paras.zh: 与前作一样，这部电影于周四在纽约影院首映，接下来还将放映更多场，并邀请了一系列有权势的女性受访者来阐述自己的观点。希拉里·罗德姆·克林顿、南希·佩洛西、艾米·克洛布查尔、贾米拉·贾米尔和格雷琴·卡尔森都出现了。他们出现在年轻学生谈论社交媒体对他们的影响方式的镜头中（其中一人问道：“这让我觉得，我怎么了？”）和女性候选人描述政治竞选中的网络虐待和骚扰。维多利亚·辛克斯 (Victoria Hinks) 是一名 16 岁女孩的母亲，辛克斯表示自己沉迷于社交媒体，之后她自杀身亡，她也为这部电影代言。

paras.en: Siebel Newsom said in an interview with The Hollywood Reporter that tech titans need to be held accountable for the harm occurring to women and girls with their tools. “The fact of the matter is we’ve let these guys go unregulated for too long, and they’ve prioritized profit over the health and wellbeing of not just women and girls, but any vulnerable population,” Siebel Newsom said. “And they’ve exploited women and girls for profit. We are the product, and they’ve done this intentionally.”
paras.zh: 西贝尔·纽瑟姆在接受《好莱坞报道》采访时表示，科技巨头需要对其工具对妇女和女孩造成的伤害负责。西贝尔·纽瑟姆说：“事实是，我们让这些人不受监管太久了，他们将利润置于首位，不仅是妇女和女孩的健康和福祉，而且是所有弱势群体的健康和福祉。” “他们剥削妇女和女孩以获取利润。我们就是产品，他们是故意这样做的。”

paras.en: Newsom also discussed how her personal experiences as a high-profile woman and mother shaped the film and the solutions she believes are most promising to helping women feel more secure online. And she offered her thoughts on the ongoing controversy over an alleged gang rape at Cornell University.
paras.zh: 纽瑟姆还讨论了她作为一位备受瞩目的女性和母亲的个人经历如何塑造了这部电影，以及她认为最有希望帮助女性在网上感到更加安全的解决方案。她还对康奈尔大学涉嫌轮奸事件持续不断的争议提出了自己的看法。

paras.en: Miss Representation was first released in released in 2011. Why did you decide it was time for a follow-up?
paras.zh: 《Miss Representation》于 2011 年首次发布。您为什么决定是时候推出后续作品了？

paras.en: To be honest, I hoped I never had to make a follow-up. I hoped because of the incredible reception of Miss Representation with lines outside the door at Sundance Film Festival and standing room-only audiences, and then a sale to Oprah Winfrey Network, and again, TV broadcast and big screenings around the world, I thought, okay, we’re making progress. This film is really going to do its work in the world. And it did. We started to see more and more women aspiring towards leadership and running for elected office and becoming leaders in the C-suite. And then we elected Donald Trump in 2016 and normalized rape culture. And we started to see the rollback of Roe v. Wade and the ascension of the manosphere online and then Trump 2.0 and more women’s rights rolled back and a devaluation of research on women’s health and anything having to do with women and gender. And then we had the CDC study that came out and proved that after the advent of the “like” button in around 2011 with Facebook online, that girls were persistently feeling sadness and hopeless at a rate of 57 percent and that one in three seriously considered suicide and that 99 percent of deepfakes were targeting women and girls, 96 percent of them non-consensual deepfake pornography. And so all of this combined, and always me leaning into both cultural issues and policy issues with a mother’s frame and perspective, I knew that we had to make Miss Representation: Rise Up.
paras.zh: 老实说，我希望我永远不必跟进。我希望，因为《代表小姐》在圣丹斯电影节上受到了令人难以置信的欢迎，在门外排起了长队，观众只能站着，然后被奥普拉·温弗瑞网络出售，再次在世界各地进行电视转播和大放映，我想，好吧，我们正在取得进展。这部电影确实会在世界上发挥作用。确实如此。我们开始看到越来越多的女性渴望成为领导者、竞选民选职位并成为最高管理层的领导者。然后我们在 2016 年选举了唐纳德·特朗普，并使强奸文化正常化。我们开始看到罗伊诉韦德案的倒退和在线男性圈的崛起，然后特朗普2.0和更多妇女权利的倒退以及对妇女健康和与妇女和性别有关的任何研究的贬值。然后我们得到了 CDC 的研究，该研究证明，在 2011 年左右 Facebook 在线“点赞”按钮出现后，57% 的女孩持续感到悲伤和绝望，三分之一的人认真考虑过自杀，99% 的 Deepfake 都是针对女性和女性的。 女孩，其中 96％ 是未经同意的深度伪造色情内容。因此，所有这些结合在一起，而且我总是以母亲的框架和视角来研究文化问题和政策问题，我知道我们必须制作《代表小姐：崛起》。

paras.en: It’s not an easy time for social-issue documentaries to receive funding, so how did you fund this one?
paras.zh: 对于社会问题纪录片来说，现在获得资助并不容易，那么您是如何资助这部纪录片的呢？

paras.en: The truth is when I made Miss Representation, my first documentary, there must have been 500 people that contributed individually to that film. I had seed money from one funder, and then I went on the road hosting little house parties and would raise $2,500, $1,500, $15,000, $2,000. And it was crazy, but I’d never directed a documentary before and so I really involved these house parties in the whole process. With Miss Representation: Rise Up, I went back to some of the initial supporters, but by this time there were more women with some means in the documentary realm. And I just think they all really recognized that we had a responsibility to correct this inequity and this backslide that has been happening at scale, and again, at an unprecedented rate because of technology.
paras.zh: 事实上，当我制作第一部纪录片《代表小姐》时，一定有 500 个人为这部电影做出了个人贡献。我从一位资助者那里得到了种子资金，然后我开始举办小型家庭聚会，筹集 2,500 美元、1,500 美元、15,000 美元、2,000 美元。这很疯狂，但我以前从未执导过纪录片，所以我真的让这些家庭聚会参与了整个过程。通过《代表小姐：崛起》，我回到了一些最初的支持者，但此时有更多的女性在纪录片领域拥有一定的能力。我只是认为他们都真正认识到我们有责任纠正这种不平等和这种由于技术而以前所未有的速度大规模发生的倒退。

paras.en: In your director’s statement, you pointed to personal experiences that led you to tell this story as a visible woman with a voice online and a mother of two daughters. How did those experiences shape how you told this story?
paras.zh: 在导演的声明中，您指出了个人经历，这些经历促使您作为一个在网上发声的知名女性和两个女儿的母亲来讲述这个故事。这些经历如何影响了你讲述这个故事的方式？

paras.en: I read a Rumi poem this morning called “The Guest House,” and I think I’ve come to learn in life sometimes the hard way that experiences that I have or that people close to me have, you don’t have to get stuck in the negative or the pain or the suffering, that you can turn this into light and into hope and into change. That’s what I take from that in particular. And I would say that that’s kind of what spurs so much of my work. Also with a real understanding that girls and women are the backbones not just of our families, but our communities and our democracy. And so I think for me, just witnessing the rollback of women’s mental health, our safety and our political power alongside the increasing attacks on our democracy really raised the stakes for me in terms of technology’s role in diminishing women’s power and technology’s role really in silencing our voices. Our voices are critical in a thriving democracy. So I would say that is a large part of why this film became so urgent and necessary to make.
paras.zh: 今天早上我读了一首鲁米的诗，名叫《宾馆》，我想我在生活中有时会以艰难的方式学到，我所经历的或我身边的人所经历的，你不必陷入消极、痛苦或苦难中，你可以将其转化为光明、希望和改变。这就是我特别从中得到的收获。我想说，这正是我工作的动力。我们还真正认识到，女孩和妇女不仅是我们家庭的支柱，也是我们社区和民主的支柱。因此，我认为对我来说，仅仅目睹女性心理健康、我们的安全和政治权力的倒退，以及对我们民主的越来越多的攻击，就确实提高了我的风险，因为技术在削弱女性权力方面发挥了作用，而技术在压制我们的声音方面发挥了真正的作用。我们的声音对于繁荣的民主至关重要。所以我想说，这就是为什么这部电影变得如此紧迫和必要的一个重要原因。

paras.en: And it was personal because of stuff that has happened to my own children, but it was professional in the sense that I care about our country and I love women so much, and I just am so inspired by feminine leadership and what’s possible when we have more of the feminine at the tables of power. And it’s not to replace [men], I just think, and I’ve always felt this way, that we need to represent our population. The point is our voices have not been in leadership and we find ourselves in crisis after crisis after crisis, not just in this country, but around the world. And the fact that our democracy is so fragile and that we’ve got a climate crisis, a global war and global unrest, a political divide like we’ve never seen before, skyrocketing rates of suicidal ideation, anxiety and depression and then, what am I missing? Did I say wealth inequality?
paras.zh: 这是个人的，因为发生在我自己孩子身上的事情，但它是专业的，因为我关心我们的国家，我非常爱女性，我只是受到女性领导力的启发，以及当我们在权力桌上有更多女性时可能发生的事情。这并不是要取代[男性]，我只是认为，而且我一直这么认为，我们需要代表我们的人民。关键是我们的声音没有发挥领导作用，我们发现自己陷入了一次又一次的危机，不仅在这个国家，而且在全世界。事实上，我们的民主是如此脆弱，我们面临着气候危机、全球战争和全球动荡，我们从未见过的政治分歧，自杀意念、焦虑和抑郁的比率飙升，然后，我错过了什么？我有说过财富不平等吗？

paras.en: Tremendous wealth and equality, worse than it’s ever been. For me, women wouldn’t have allowed us to get to this place if we had more women in leadership or more of the feminine. I do believe that there are incredible men that embody the feminine or value the feminine, but there’s nothing like having just four moms in a room who are invested in a sustainable future, not just for their own children, but everyone’s children.
paras.zh: 巨大的财富和平等，比以往任何时候都更糟糕。对我来说，如果我们有更多的女性担任领导职务或更多的女性，女性就不会允许我们到达这个地方。我确实相信有一些令人难以置信的男人体现了女性气质或重视女性气质，但没有什么比一个房间里只有四位妈妈投资于可持续未来更好的了，不仅是为了自己的孩子，而且是为了每个人的孩子。

paras.en: The film touches on the difficulties of being an aspiring female politician today. You’ve had a backstage pass to the political process as the First Partner of California. Have you seen firsthand certain female lawmakers deciding not to run for reelection or potentially promising candidates deciding not to run at all because of these online pressures?
paras.zh: 这部电影讲述了当今成为一名有抱负的女性政治家所面临的困难。作为加州第一合伙人，您已经获得了政治进程的后台通行证。您是否亲眼目睹过某些女性立法者决定不竞选连任，或者有潜力的候选人因为这些网络压力而决定根本不竞选？

paras.en: Yes, I have seen it personally, and politics really takes a toll on the individual. It takes a toll on the family. It is not always kind to women. It’s increasingly unkind to people that care about people or people that are doing, I would say, the right thing. We’re such an individualistic society, and I think the current administration in particular has doubled down on individualism and the “me, me, me” culture. And we have to get back to the “we” culture where we recognize that individuals have a personal role and responsibility in their own success, but we also recognize that we’re nothing without each other and that we’re all connected, and there’s no leak on, as my husband likes to say, on your side of our boat. There needs to be a balance between the individual and the collective, and we’re really missing the collective.
paras.zh: 是的，我亲眼所见，政治确实对个人造成了影响。这会给家庭带来损失。它并不总是对女性友善。我想说，对于关心他人或正在做正确事情的人来说，这越来越不友善。我们是一个个人主义社会，我认为现任政府尤其加倍强调个人主义和“我，我，我”文化。我们必须回到“我们”文化，我们认识到个人在自己的成功中扮演着个人角色和责任，但我们也认识到，没有彼此，我们什么都不是，我们都是相互联系的，正如我丈夫喜欢说的那样，在我们的船这边，没有任何泄漏。个人和集体之间需要保持平衡，而我们确实缺少集体。

paras.en: A number of women explain potential solutions to the problems outlined in the film, like the repeal of Section 230 or social media companies reporting to a nonpartisan regulator. Which were most compelling or promising to you?
paras.zh: 许多女性解释了影片中概述的问题的潜在解决方案，例如废除第 230 条或社交媒体公司向无党派监管机构报告。哪些对您来说最有吸引力或最有希望？

paras.en: Well, look, I am proud of the work that we’re doing in California, which is not just leading the nation, but leading the world in holding tech titans accountable. But obviously we need to do more at the federal level because what you have then is this individual tech titan saying they’re just going to move to another state. They’re full of threats and they have a lot of wealth, and so they can play games. They often forget that they built their wealth off of many of the regulations and the tax breaks or tax incentives that we provided in California. I included those different lines in the documentary because we need more transparency and we need more accountability, period. And sometimes accountability requires the person at the top to be financially accountable. Sometimes it just requires that there be this outside entity or body that has a look into that black box to create more transparency. But the fact of the matter is we’ve let these guys go unregulated for too long, and they’ve prioritized profit over the health and wellbeing of not just women and girls, but any vulnerable population. And they’ve exploited women and girls for profit. We are the product, and they’ve done this intentionally.
paras.zh: 好吧，我为我们在加州所做的工作感到自豪，这不仅引领了全国，而且引领了世界追究科技巨头的责任。但显然我们需要在联邦层面做更多的事情，因为这个科技巨头表示他们将搬到另一个州。他们充满了威胁，而且有很多财富，所以他们可以玩游戏。他们常常忘记，他们的财富是建立在我们在加州提供的许多法规和税收减免或税收优惠的基础上的。我在纪录片中加入了这些不同的台词，因为我们需要更多的透明度，我们需要更多的问责制，就这样。有时，问责制要求最高层人员承担财务责任。有时，它只需要有一个外部实体或机构可以查看黑匣子以创建更多透明度。但事实是，我们让这些人不受监管太久了，他们将利润置于优先地位，不仅是妇女和女孩的健康和福祉，而且是任何弱势群体的健康和福祉。他们剥削妇女和女孩以获取利润。我们就是产品，他们是故意这样做的。

paras.en: As this film is preparing its release, the story of an alleged gang rape at Cornell University is exploding and involving all sorts of issues this film touches on. Have you been following that case and what lens do you have on it, having worked on this film?
paras.zh: 在这部电影准备上映之际，康奈尔大学涉嫌轮奸的故事正在爆炸，并涉及该电影涉及的各种问题。在拍摄这部电影的过程中，你一直在关注这个案件吗？你对这个案件有什么看法？

paras.en: I have been loosely following it and it’s been very disturbing, mostly because I have two boys and two girls, and I know that what’s happened at Cornell is not unique to Cornell. I know that this has been going on and happening around the world, and it happens in fraternities across our country. And what’s most disturbing to me is that we have come to a place where the highest leader in our country has normalized rape culture, not just in his office, but in other offices or appointments, whether they’re affiliated with Epstein or affiliated with their own darkness and bad male behavior. And so what I get upset about is that of course our young men think that this is acceptable behavior because they’re seeing it online with the Tate brothers and the manosphere online, and then they’re seeing it in the highest offices in our country.
paras.zh: 我一直在松散地关注它，这非常令人不安，主要是因为我有两个男孩和两个女孩，而且我知道康奈尔大学发生的事情并不是康奈尔大学独有的。我知道这种情况在世界各地都在发生，也发生在我们国家各地的兄弟会中。最令我不安的是，我们国家的最高领导人将强奸文化正常化，不仅在他的办公室，而且在其他办公室或任命中，无论他们是与爱泼斯坦有联系，还是与他们自己的黑暗和不良男性行为有关。所以我感到不安的是，我们的年轻人当然认为这是可以接受的行为，因为他们在泰特兄弟和马诺圈网上看到了这种行为，然后他们在我们国家的最高办公室看到了这种行为。

paras.en: I don’t know if you know this, but I was an executive producer on The Hunting Ground, Kirby Dick and Amy Ziering’s documentary. And so I also thought we’d made all this progress with that film and also with The Invisible War and then On the Record. But all three of those big industries continue to see harm done to women. And again, the current administration says that’s fine and scoffs at it, laughs at it, in fact makes it worse. [That’s] why we need to make sure we have healthier role models in leadership and why it’s also critical that men aren’t bystanders and that they speak up and out and hold other men and other young men accountable when these sorts of things happen.
paras.zh: 我不知道你是否知道这一点，我是柯比·迪克和艾米·齐林的纪录片《狩猎场》的执行制片人。所以我也认为我们在那部电影以及《看不见的战争》和《记录在案》中都取得了所有这些进展。但所有这三个大行业仍然继续对女性造成伤害。再说一遍，现任政府说这很好，却对此嗤之以鼻，嘲笑它，事实上，这让情况变得更糟。 [这就是]为什么我们需要确保我们在领导力方面有更健康的榜样，以及为什么男性不要成为旁观者，并且当此类事情发生时，他们要大声疾呼并让其他男性和其他年轻人承担责任，这一点也很重要。

paras.en: You mentioned you’re working on some other films in different stages of the process. What’s next for you as a filmmaker?
paras.zh: 你提到你正在制作处于不同阶段的其他一些电影。作为一名电影制片人，你的下一步计划是什么？

paras.en: I’m looking at climate and feminism and also masculinities and what’s going on in the manosphere. And then I’m looking at some scripted biopics because I just am really inspired by uplifting women’s stories. I feel like we need hope and inspiration, and there’s so many incredible people doing wonderful things in the world, and so I just want to shed a light on their stories and inspire future generations through their stories and through storytelling. And so I think I’ll just figure out what’s next, but have a few things going at the same time, as I typically do.
paras.zh: 我关注的是气候、女权主义、男性气质以及大气层中正在发生的事情。然后我会看一些有剧本的传记片，因为我真的受到了振奋人心的女性故事的启发。我觉得我们需要希望和灵感，世界上有很多不可思议的人在做着奇妙的事情，所以我只想阐明他们的故事，并通过他们的故事和讲故事来激励后代。所以我想我会弄清楚接下来要做什么，但同时做一些事情，就像我通常做的那样。

paras.en: This interview has been edited for length and clarity.
paras.zh: 为了篇幅和清晰度，本次采访经过编辑。

articles.title: ‘Tangles,’ ‘Iron Boy’ Win Animation Is Film Festival
articles.author: Scott Roxborough

paras.en: Tangles, Leah Nelson’s animated dramedy about a young woman dealing with her mother’s early onset dementia, has won top honors, the Grand Jury Prize for best film, at this year’s Animation Is Film Festival in Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 利亚·尼尔森 (Leah Nelson) 的动画喜剧《缠结》(Tangles) 讲述了一位年轻女子与母亲早发性痴呆症的故事，该片在今年的洛杉矶动画电影节上获得了最高荣誉——最佳影片评审团大奖。

paras.en: Nelson’s 2D black-and-white feature, which premiered as a special screening in Cannes, is adapted from Sarah Leavitt’s autobiographical graphic novel and features an all-star voice cast led Abbi Jacobsen, Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Beanie Feldstein, and Seth Rogen. Tangles has been picked up by Independent Film Company for the U.S.. It will have an Oscar-qualifying release on Nov. 27 followed by a limited rollout on Jan. 15 and a nationwide bow Jan. 22.
paras.zh: 纳尔逊的这部 2D 黑白故事片在戛纳电影节特别放映，改编自莎拉·莱维特的自传体图画小说，由艾比·雅各布森、朱莉娅·路易斯-德雷弗斯、布莱恩·科兰斯顿、比尼·费尔德斯坦和塞斯·罗根等全明星配音。 《魔发奇缘》已被美国独立电影公司选中。该片将于 11 月 27 日获得奥斯卡资格上映，随后于 1 月 15 日限量上映，并于 1 月 22 日全国上映。

paras.en: “We loved the fluid 2D animation which uses a stark monochrome framing to bring to life the personal story of a family impacted by the mother’s battle with dementia,” the festival jury said. “We were especially impressed with how director Leah Nelson and her perfectly cast voice team were able to remain faithful to Sarah Leavitt’s graphic novel which tackles a serious, painful subject with great beauty, honesty, and a gentle touch and also offers a great flashback to 1990s-era San Francisco.”
paras.zh: “我们喜欢流畅的 2D 动画，它使用鲜明的单色框架，生动地讲述了一个受母亲与痴呆症斗争影响的家庭的个人故事，”节日评审团说。 “导演 Leah Nelson 和她的配音团队完美地忠实于 Sarah Leavitt 的图画小说，给我们留下了特别深刻的印象，该小说以美丽、诚实和温柔的手法处理了一个严肃、痛苦的主题，同时也提供了 1990 年代旧金山的精彩闪回。”

paras.en: The festival’s Fumi Kitahara Special Jury Prize went to Iron Boy, a French coming-of-age drama from director Louis Clichy, which premiered in Un Certain Regard in Cannes. (The award is named in memory of beloved publicist and Animation is Film champion Fumi, who died last year).
paras.zh: 电影节北原文美评审团特别奖颁给了路易斯·克利奇导演的法国成长剧《钢铁男孩》，该片在戛纳电影节“一种注目”单元首映。 （该奖项的命名是为了纪念去年去世的深受喜爱的公关和动画电影冠军福米）。

paras.en: Iron Boy follows a young boy growing up in rural France who strains against the rigid restrictions of his home life, and the metal corset he is forced to wear 24/7 to correct his spinal conditions. Sony Pictures Classics acquired the film for North America and multiple international territories out of Cannes. It will do a qualifying bow for the film in December, followed by a North American theatrical bow Jan. 22.
paras.zh: 《钢铁男孩》讲述了一个在法国乡村长大的小男孩的故事，他努力克服家庭生活的严格限制，并且被迫每天 24/7 穿着金属紧身胸衣来矫正脊柱状况。索尼经典影业公司从戛纳电影节收购了北美和多个国际地区的这部电影。它将在 12 月为这部电影进行预演，随后于 1 月 22 日在北美院线进行预演。

paras.en: “Iron Boy is pure beauty from the medium we all love,” said the festival jury, calling Clichy’s hand-drawn 2D feature “an easy stand-out thanks to its beautifully crafted water-color-like and Chinese ink-brush style visuals and how it told a story inspired by the director’s own memories of growing up in rural France. We also admired the way Clichy conveyed a world of emotions with his impressionistic visuals as well as his depiction of a young boy’s personal struggles with a physical handicap and the heartfelt portrayal of a strained father-and-son relationship which avoids sentimentality and the pitfalls of a traditional comic-of-age story.”
paras.zh: 电影节评审团表示：“《钢铁男孩》是我们都喜爱的媒介中的纯粹之美，”电影节评审团称克利希的手绘 2D 影片“因其制作精美的水彩般和中国水墨风格的视觉效果，以及它如何讲述一个受导演自己在法国乡村长大的记忆启发的故事而轻松脱颖而出。我们还钦佩克利希通过印象派视觉效果以及对小男孩个人生活的描绘来传达情感世界的方式。与身体残疾作斗争，并真诚地描绘了紧张的父子关系，避免了感伤和传统漫画故事的陷阱。”

paras.en: Iron Boy also won the features audience award, voted on by the festival public.
paras.zh: 《钢铁男孩》还获得了由电影节公众投票选出的专题观众奖。

paras.en: Highlights of the 9th Animation Is Film Festival, which ran Oct. 16-19 at the TCL Chinese 6 Theatres in Hollywood and the David Geffen Theater at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures, included the first theatrical screening of Dana Terrace’s online sensation Knights of Guinevere, and a special screening of Travis Knight’s stop-motion epic Wildwood.
paras.zh: 第九届动画电影节于 10 月 16 日至 19 日在好莱坞的 TCL 中国六大剧院和学院电影博物馆的大卫·格芬剧院举行，亮点包括首映达纳·泰瑞斯 (Dana Terrace) 的网络热门影片《吉尼薇儿骑士团》(Knights of Guinevere)，以及特别放映特拉维斯·奈特 (Travis Knight) 的定格动画史诗片《怀尔德伍德》(Wildwood)。

paras.en: On Sunday, the festival also hosted the inaugural live edition of The Hollywood Reporter’s Animation Roundtable, which featured Bill Hader (The Cat in the Hat), Travis Knight (Wildwood), Louis Clichy (Iron Boy), Leah Nelson (Tangles), Joel Crawford (Forgotten Island), Phuong Mai Nguyen (In Waves) and Fawn Veerasunthorn (Hexed).
paras.zh: 周日，电影节还举办了首届现场版《好莱坞报道者动画圆桌会议》，嘉宾包括比尔·哈德尔（《戴帽子的猫》）、特拉维斯·奈特（怀尔德伍德）、路易斯·克利奇（《钢铁小子》）、利亚·尼尔森（《魔发奇缘》）、乔尔·克劳福德（《被遗忘的岛》）、Phuong Mai Nguyen（《浪潮》）和 Fawn Veerasunthorn（《Hexed》）。

paras.en: See the full list of the Animation Is Film winners below.
paras.zh: 请参阅下面的“动画即电影”获奖者完整名单。

paras.zh: 如果您通过我们网站上的链接购买独立审查的产品或服务，《好莱坞报道》可能会收到附属佣金。

paras.en: Season 23 of Grey’s Anatomy airs every Thursday on ABC, but for viewers without cable, the live broadcast is available through DirecTV, Hulu + Live TV, Fubo and Sling TV. articles.title: Elon Musk reportedly invests about $1 billion in Skydance

paras.en: Elon Musk has made an investment in Skydance of roughly $1 billion, according to a report from Semafor Thursday.
paras.zh: 根据 Semafor 周四的一份报告，埃隆·马斯克已向 Skydance 投资了约 10 亿美元。

paras.en: The financial injection comes as the company looks to cut costs. Paramount closed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery on Oct. 6, naming the combined entity Skydance. Co-CEOs David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz are tasked with merging two major film studios in Paramount and Warner Bros., two popular streaming platforms — Paramount+ and HBO Max — and a host of corporate functions to support a portfolio of TV networks and two news divisions.
paras.zh: 此次资金注入正值该公司寻求削减成本之际。派拉蒙于 10 月 6 日完成了对华纳兄弟探索频道的收购，并将合并后的实体命名为 Skydance。联合首席执行官 David Ellison 和 Ynon Kreiz 的任务是合并派拉蒙和华纳兄弟的两家主要电影制片厂、两个流行的流媒体平台——派拉蒙+和 HBO Max——以及支持电视网络组合和两个新闻部门的一系列企业职能。

paras.en: Skydance has said it expects to see $6 billion in cost savings over three years, though it faces a debt burden of nearly $80 billion.
paras.zh: Skydance 表示，尽管面临着近 800 亿美元的债务负担，但预计三年内将节省 60 亿美元的成本。

paras.en: Musk's commitment is part of a wider effort by Skydance to raise equity investments, Semafor reported. Representatives for Musk and Skydance did not immediately respond to CNBC's requests for comment.
paras.zh: 据 Semafor 报道，马斯克的承诺是 Skydance 筹集股权投资的更广泛努力的一部分。马斯克和 Skydance 的代表没有立即回应 CNBC 的置评请求。

paras.en: Shares of Skydance fell about 1% following the report.
paras.zh: 报告发布后，Skydance 股价下跌约 1%。

paras.en: Ellison's father, Larry Ellison, has a history with Musk. The Oracle co-founder invested $1 billion in Musk's 2022 deal to purchase Twitter, now called X. Larry Ellison also invested in Tesla in 2018 and served on the company's board of directors.
paras.zh: 埃里森的父亲拉里·埃里森与马斯克有过渊源。这位甲骨文联合创始人在马斯克 2022 年收购 Twitter（现称为 X）的交易中投资了 10 亿美元。拉里·埃里森还于 2018 年投资了特斯拉，并担任该公司董事会成员。

paras.en: The elder Ellison also personally guaranteed more than $40 billion of equity financing in Paramount's offer to take over WBD.
paras.zh: 老埃里森还在派拉蒙收购WBD的要约中亲自担保了超过400亿美元的股权融资。

articles.title: Third-party evaluators found vulnerabilities in OpenAI monitoring system during test pilot

paras.en: Nonprofit evaluators METR and Redwood Research on Thursday said they conducted a pilot review of an internal monitoring system at OpenAI, the artificial intelligence company's latest effort to determine how it will deepen its work with third-party safety organizations.
paras.zh: 非营利评估机构 METR 和 Redwood Research 周四表示，他们对 OpenAI 的内部监控系统进行了试点审查，这是这家人工智能公司的最新努力，以确定如何深化与第三方安全组织的合作。

paras.en: METR and Redwood said the exercise was designed for OpenAI to test what it would look like to give external researchers "a deep level of access" to its internal infrastructure.
paras.zh: METR 和 Redwood 表示，此次演习是为 OpenAI 设计的，目的是测试让外部研究人员“深入访问”其内部基础设施的效果。

paras.en: From July 21 to Aug. 11, an employee from each organization had access to OpenAI's internal codebase, documentation and some technical staffers. The employees were chaperoned while on-site and used OpenAI-issued devices that "never left the premises," according to a release.
paras.zh: 从7月21日到8月11日，每个组织的一名员工都可以访问OpenAI的内部代码库、文档和一些技术人员。据一份新闻稿称，这些员工在现场有人陪同，并使用“从未离开过现场”的 OpenAI 发放的设备。

paras.en: The evaluators discovered several "novel vulnerabilities," including an exploit that would allow agents to prevent "hundreds" of recent actions from being monitored. OpenAI told METR and Redwood that it has patched the identified vulnerabilities that impact its production safeguards, according to the release.
paras.zh: 评估人员发现了几个“新漏洞”，其中包括一个允许代理阻止“数百个”近期操作受到监控的漏洞。据新闻稿称，OpenAI 告诉 METR 和 Redwood，它已经修复了影响其生产保障的已识别漏洞。

paras.en: METR and Redwood said they agreed to only publish a high-level public post about their findings since the pilot was not designed to "provide robust public transparency about OpenAI's monitoring system." They shared a 61-page internal report with OpenAI, and said they expect to publicly share more details about future exercises.
paras.zh: METR 和 Redwood 表示，他们同意仅发布有关其发现的高级公开帖子，因为该试点项目的目的并不是“为 OpenAI 监控系统提供强大的公共透明度”。他们与 OpenAI 分享了一份长达 61 页的内部报告，并表示他们希望公开分享有关未来演习的更多细节。

paras.en: "This collaboration builds on our longstanding commitment to pioneering new approaches to third-party testing, and we're using what we learned to strengthen our safeguards and shape future collaborations with independent evaluators," an OpenAI spokesperson told CNBC in a statement.
paras.zh: OpenAI 发言人在一份声明中告诉 CNBC：“此次合作建立在我们对开拓第三方测试新方法的长期承诺之上，我们正在利用所学到的知识来加强我们的保障措施并塑造与独立评估人员的未来合作。”

paras.en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman pledged to grant independent evaluators "employee-like access" to the company in September, after Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei proposed the idea as part of his plan to slow the pace of AI development. Anthropic has since announced agreements with organizations like Accenture, METR and SecureBio. OpenAI said earlier this month that it's "actively finalizing contracts with third-party safety assessors."
paras.zh: 在 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 提出这一想法作为其减缓人工智能发展步伐计划的一部分后，OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 承诺于 9 月向独立评估人员授予该公司“员工般的访问权限”。此后，Anthropic 宣布与埃森哲、METR 和 SecureBio 等组织达成协议。 OpenAI 本月早些时候表示，它正在“积极与第三方安全评估机构敲定合同”。

paras.en: President Donald Trump, who has taken a light-touch approach to AI regulation, has also shown support for third-party assessment. He encouraged AI companies to "partner with an independent external auditor or evaluator" as part of a voluntary accord he presented at the White House. Anthropic's Amodei signed the accord, as did top executives at Google, Meta, OpenAI, SpaceX and Nvidia.
paras.zh: 对人工智能监管采取宽松态度的唐纳德·特朗普总统也表示支持第三方评估。作为他在白宫提出的自愿协议的一部分，他鼓励人工智能公司“与独立的外部审计员或评估员合作”。 Anthropic 的 Amodei 签署了该协议，谷歌、Meta、OpenAI、SpaceX 和 Nvidia 的高管也签署了该协议。

paras.en: Independent evaluators have historically occupied a relatively quiet corner of the multitrillion-dollar AI industry, so experts told CNBC that questions remain about how these groups will be funded and what their reporting structures will ultimately look like.
paras.zh: 独立评估机构历来在价值数万亿美元的人工智能行业中占据着一个相对安静的角落，因此专家告诉 CNBC，关于这些团体将如何获得资金以及他们的报告结构最终会是什么样子的问题仍然存在。

paras.en: METR and Redwood said Thursday that they stress-tested OpenAI's internal misalignment monitoring system during its three-week pilot. In AI, alignment is how researchers describe whether a model behaves in line with human interests and values.
paras.zh: METR 和 Redwood 周四表示，他们在为期三周的试点期间对 OpenAI 的内部失调监控系统进行了压力测试。在人工智能中，一致性是研究人员描述模型的行为是否符合人类兴趣和​​价值观的方式。

paras.en: The evaluators assessed the monitoring system as it existed on and before July 21, and noted that OpenAI was expanding the system during the exercise.
paras.zh: 评估人员评估了 7 月 21 日及之前存在的监控系统，并指出 OpenAI 正在演习期间扩展该系统。

articles.title: Virginia state Sen. L. Louise Lucas, a Trump critic, charged in marijuana racketeering case

paras.en: Virginia state Sen. L. Louise Lucas has been charged in a federal indictment with leading an alleged marijuana racketeering conspiracy that included family members of the powerful Democrat, according to court documents made public on Thursday.
paras.zh: 根据周四公布的法庭文件，弗吉尼亚州参议员路易斯·卢卡斯 (L. Louise Lucas) 在一份联邦起诉书中被指控领导一项涉嫌大麻敲诈勒索的阴谋，其中包括这位强大的民主党人的家人。

paras.en: The indictment and the FBI said the five-year scheme, which was worth an estimated $4.5 million, obtained and illegally distributed "large quantities of illegal marijuana," and aimed to procure "generational wealth" for members of the enterprise.
paras.zh: 起诉书和联邦调查局称，这项为期五年的计划价值估计为 450 万美元，获取并非法分发“大量非法大麻”，旨在为企业成员获取“代际财富”。

paras.en: Lucas, 82, is a critic of President Donald Trump, and was an architect of ultimately failed efforts in Virginia to redraw the state's congressional map for November to boost chances for Democrats to win certain districts. She also has been a proponent of legalizing marijuana in the state.
paras.zh: 82 岁的卢卡斯是唐纳德·特朗普总统的批评者，也是弗吉尼亚州重新绘制该州 11 月份国会地图以增加民主党赢得某些选区机会的努力的策划者，但最终失败了。她还一直是该州大麻合法化的支持者。

paras.en: The criminal case, which also charges members of Lucas' family, was made public by the Department of Justice less than two weeks before the midterm election. Those contests will determine what political party controls both chambers of Congress.
paras.zh: 这起刑事案件还对卢卡斯的家人提出指控，在中期选举前不到两周，司法部公布了这一案件。这些竞争将决定哪个政党控制国会两院。

paras.en: Lucas, the state Senate's president pro tempore and chairman of the Finance and Appropriations Committee, is not on the ballot this year. The indictment alleges that Lucas, who was first elected to the Senate in 1991, leveraged her position as chairman of the powerful committee to protect her marijuana enterprise.
paras.zh: 州参议院临时议长兼财政和拨款委员会主席卢卡斯今年没有参加投票。起诉书称，1991 年首次当选参议员的卢卡斯利用她作为强大委员会主席的地位来保护她的大麻企业。

paras.en: The indictment says Lucas "was the leader of the enterprise," that she "arranged for the acquisition and distribution of marijuana, supervises the laundering of marijuana proceeds," and "used her political influence to attempt to influence Virginia legislation for the benefit of herself and her family and maintained a premise for the distribution of marijuana." The alleged scheme used two stores, CBD Shopped and The Cannabis Outlet, for its operation.
paras.zh: 起诉书称卢卡斯“是该企业的领导者”，她“安排大麻的收购和分配，监督大麻收益的洗钱活动”，并“利用她的政治影响力试图影响弗吉尼亚州的立法，以谋求她自己和家人的利益，并维持大麻分配的前提。”据称，该计划使用了两家商店（CBD Shopped 和 The Cannabis Outlet）进行运营。

paras.en: "On May 6, the FBI executed federal search warrants at The Cannabis Outlet and The CBD Shoppe," the Department of Justice said in a statement. "Agents recovered marijuana and firearms at both locations."
paras.zh: 美国司法部在一份声明中表示：“5 月 6 日，联邦调查局对 The Cannabis Outlet 和 CBD Shoppe 执行了联邦搜查令。” “特工在两个地点起获了大麻和枪支。”

paras.en: Six other defendants are charged in the alleged scheme, among them Lucas' two daughters and her grandson, Ryan Eichelbeger. One of the daughters, Lisa Lucas-Burke, is running for mayor of Portsmouth.
paras.zh: 其他六名被告因涉嫌诈骗而受到指控，其中包括卢卡斯的两个女儿和她的孙子瑞安·艾切尔贝格。其中一个女儿丽莎·卢卡斯-伯克正在竞选朴茨茅斯市长。

paras.en: Lucas is in custody with the other defendants, Attorney General Todd Blanche announced at a press conference Thursday. She is scheduled to appear before a magistrate judge in U.S. District Court in Norfolk, Virginia, at 2:30 p.m. ET Thursday.
paras.zh: Lucas is in custody with the other defendants, Attorney General Todd Blanche announced at a press conference Thursday. She is scheduled to appear before a magistrate judge in U.S. District Court in Norfolk, Virginia, at 2:30 p.m.美国东部时间周四。

paras.en: In addition to racketeering conspiracy, Lucas is charged with conspiracy to distribute and possess with intent to distribute marijuana; conspiracy to launder money; conspiracy to commit honest services fraud; and maintaining a drug involved premises.
paras.zh: 除了串谋敲诈勒索之外，卢卡斯还被指控串谋分发和持有大麻并意图分发大麻；串谋洗钱；串谋进行诚实服务欺诈；以及维护涉及毒品的场所。

paras.en: "Today, the FBI, the Department of Justice, and the full weight of the federal government have been wielded against an 82-year-old great-grandmother," Lucas said in a statement posted on X.
paras.zh: 卢卡斯在 X 上发布的一份声明中说：“今天，联邦调查局、司法部和联邦政府的全部力量都用来对付一位 82 岁的曾祖母。”

paras.en: "I grew up under Jim Crow. I've seen what happens when people in power try to silence those who stand up to them. I spent my life fighting back, and I'm not stopping now," she said. "I will not be intimidated. I will not be bullied. And I will not back down."
paras.zh: “我是在种族隔离制度下长大的。我亲眼目睹了当权者试图压制那些反抗他们的人时会发生什么。我一生都在反抗，现在我不会停止，”她说。 “我不会被吓倒。我不会被欺负。我不会退缩。”

paras.en: Blanche, when asked at the press conference about criticism from Lucas's attorney that the case is politically motivated, said, "We don't do political paybacks."
paras.zh: 布兰奇在新闻发布会上被问及卢卡斯律师批评此案出于政治动机时表示，“我们不会进行政治报复。”

paras.en: The attorney general noted the investigation of Lucas began before the current Trump administration, and that a federal grand jury had determined there was enough evidence to indict her.
paras.zh: 司法部长指出，对卢卡斯的调查在现任特朗普政府之前就开始了，联邦大陪审团已确定有足够的证据来起诉她。

paras.en: "There's decision and processes in place at the department when we're bringing a case against a political official, and the ... first question is: is this investigation proper?" Blanche said. "And the conclusion of that is yes. Is the timing proper? And the conclusion of that is yes."
paras.zh: “当我们对政治官员提起诉讼时，该部门已经制定了决定和流程，而……第一个问题是：这项调查是否正确？”布兰奇说道。 “结论是肯定的。时机合适吗？结论是肯定的。”

paras.en: The indictment was issued by a grand jury on Oct. 14, but was only unsealed Thursday.
paras.zh: 起诉书于 10 月 14 日由大陪审团发布，但直到周四才启封。

paras.en: The indictment says that after he was hired in 2022, a senior law enforcement officer "warned Louise Lucas that selling marijuana was illegal and was going to get her in trouble one day."
paras.zh: 起诉书称，在 2022 年受聘后，一名高级执法人员“警告路易斯·卢卡斯，出售大麻是非法的，有一天会给她带来麻烦。”

paras.en: Lucas since 2021 has been a partner in The Cannabis Outlet, a shop that sells selling hemp and CBD, or cannabidiol products.
paras.zh: 卢卡斯自 2021 年以来一直是 The Cannabis Outlet 的合作伙伴，这是一家销售大麻和 CBD 或大麻二酚产品的商店。

paras.en: After a 2024 burglary at the store, two of Lucas' co-defendants claimed to Portsmouth Police that about $3,000 of marijuana products were missing.
paras.zh: 2024 年商店发生盗窃案后，卢卡斯的两名同案被告向朴茨茅斯警方声称，约 3,000 美元的大麻产品丢失。

paras.en: One of the overt acts listed in the indictment was an April 2022 meeting between Lucas, her two daughters and an indicted co-conspirator at Lucas' office. At that meeting, the indictment alleges, Lucas asked the unidentified co-conspirator "if they were a member of law enforcement before purchasing between three and five pounds of marijuana" from the co-conspirator with a check for $6,600 from Lisa Lucas-Burke. The check was made out to "Freedom is Dope."
paras.zh: 起诉书中列出的公开行为之一是卢卡斯、她的两个女儿以及一名被起诉的同谋于 2022 年 4 月在卢卡斯办公室举行的一次会面。起诉书称，在那次会议上，卢卡斯向身份不明的同谋者询问“他们是否是执法人员，然后用丽莎·卢卡斯-伯克 (Lisa Lucas-Burke) 开出的一张 6,600 美元的支票从同谋那里购买了三到五磅大麻”。支票上写着“自由就是毒品”。

paras.en: On Feb. 5, 2026, the indictment says, Lucas called an unindicted co-conspirator and discussed the language surrounding the recreational marijuana legislation pending in the Virginia General Assembly, and the possibility of [the co-conspirator] receiving a license and sharing the proceeds with her because 'this is our last chance at generational wealth . . .. I've got too old to not be greedy.'"
paras.zh: 起诉书称，2026 年 2 月 5 日，卢卡斯打电话给一名未被起诉的同谋，讨论了弗吉尼亚州议会悬而未决的娱乐性大麻立法的措辞，以及[同谋]获得许可证并与她分享收益的可能性，因为“这是我们获得代际财富的最后机会”。 。 ..我已经太老了，不能不贪心了。’”

paras.en: The charges come five months after FBI agents executed a search warrant at Lucas' Portsmouth office.
paras.zh: 这些指控是在联邦调查局特工对卢卡斯朴茨茅斯办公室执行搜查令五个月后提出的。

paras.en: At the time of that May 6 raid, Lucas noted in a statement that it came two weeks after Virginia voters approved the redistricting plan, adding, "Virginians sent a powerful message when they voted to stop Trump's scheme to manipulate the 2026 midterm elections."
paras.zh: 5 月 6 日的突袭行动发生时，卢卡斯在一份声明中指出，这是弗吉尼亚州选民批准选区重划计划两周后的事，并补充道，“弗吉尼亚人投票阻止特朗普操纵 2026 年中期选举的计划时，发出了一个强有力的信息。”

paras.en: "I was proud to help lead that effort and I have never been afraid to stand up to Donald Trump."
paras.zh: “我很自豪能够帮助领导这项工作，而且我从不害怕与唐纳德·特朗普对抗。”

articles.title: Astronomers unlock a mystery hidden in van Gogh’s The Starry Night

paras.en: Researchers say they’ve identified the constellation depicted in Vincent van Gogh’s famous painting The Starry Night—and that the discovery changes what historians have assumed about the timing of the artwork’s creation.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，他们已经确定了文森特·梵高名画《星夜》中描绘的星座，这一发现改变了历史学家对这幅艺术品创作时间的假设。

paras.en: The painting, now in the permanent collection of the Museum of Modern Art in New York City, is said to date back to mid-June 1889, when van Gogh was in Saint-Rémy-de-Provence in France. But astronomers seeking to use the painting’s stars to pin down the exact time and place it was created have reached conflicting conclusions.
paras.zh: 这幅画现在被纽约市现代艺术博物馆永久收藏，据说其创作时间可以追溯到 1889 年 6 月中旬，当时梵高在法国圣雷米普罗旺斯。但天文学家试图利用这幅画中的星星来确定它创作的确切时间和地点，却得出了相互矛盾的结论。

paras.en: In a paper published on October 22 in Scientific Reports, researchers identified the stars in The Starry Night as those of the V-shaped Hyades cluster within the Taurus constellation, as observed on July 22, 1889.
paras.zh: 在《科学报告》10 月 22 日发表的一篇论文中，研究人员将《星夜》中的恒星识别为 1889 年 7 月 22 日观测到的金牛座内 V 形毕星团的恒星。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “To my eyes, the star cluster in The Starry Night was the Hyades in Taurus. But earlier studies explained it as Aries,” says space researcher Elijah Jeong-hyun Kim, who is first author of the paper. “At that moment, I was sure this painting was worth studying.”
paras.zh: “在我看来，《星夜》中的星团是金牛座的毕星团。但早期的研究将其解释为白羊座，”该论文的第一作者、太空研究员 Elijah Jeong-hyun Kim 说道。 “那一刻，我确信这幅画值得研究。”

paras.en: To find the constellation in The Starry Night, the researchers used a software program called Procrustes, which looked for patterns based on the shape formed by the relative positions of a group of stars rather than likely artistic embellishments such as size or color. This “shape analysis” technique matched five stars in the painting with five stars in the Hyades cluster, which had the strongest statistical fit out of any of the alternative constellations tested, including Aries, which had previously been proposed to be the constellation in the center of the painting. The researchers also tested this method on a van Gogh painting with a known constellation in it, the Big Dipper in Starry Night over the Rhône, and found its match had a comparably strong result to that of The Starry Night and Hyades.
paras.zh: 为了找到《星夜》中的星座，研究人员使用了一个名为 Procrustes 的软件程序，该程序根据一组恒星相对位置形成的形状来寻找图案，而不是根据大小或颜色等可能的艺术装饰。这种“形状分析”技术将画作中的五颗星与毕星团中的五颗星进行了匹配，毕星团星团在所有测试的替代星座中具有最强的统计拟合度，其中包括白羊座，此前曾被认为白羊座是画作中心的星座。研究人员还在梵高的一幅包含已知星座的画作《罗纳河上的星夜》中测试了这种方法，发现其匹配结果与《星夜》和《毕星团》的匹配效果相当强。

paras.en: To bolster their case, Kim and his colleagues looked to evidence from van Gogh’s letters at the time he was working on The Starry Night to show that perhaps he had painted it in several sessions, with the stars being observed from late July. Although van Gogh mentioned “a new study” of the starry sky in a June 18, 1889, letter, the researchers say that doesn’t mean he had finished the painting. Van Gogh’s letters also make no mention of Aries, despite his regular references to observing Venus, which was close to that constellation in the sky. “The stars of Aries are relatively faint, hardly enough to inspire a painter” at dawn, Kim says, which was when van Gogh often watched the stars.
paras.zh: 为了支持他们的论点，金和他的同事从梵高创作《星夜》时的信件中寻找证据，证明这幅画可能是梵高从七月下旬开始观察星星而分几次画出来的。尽管梵高在 1889 年 6 月 18 日的一封信中提到了对星空的“一项新研究”，但研究人员表示，这并不意味着他已经完成了这幅画。梵高的信中也没有提到白羊座，尽管他经常提到观察金星，因为金星距离天空中的那个星座很近。金说，黎明时分“白羊座的星星相对微弱，几乎不足以激发画家的灵感”，而梵高经常在那时观看星星。

paras.en: Another argument against a mid-June date for The Starry Night is the lunar cycle—at that time, the moon would have been in a waning gibbous phase, with its sunlit side appearing as a lopsided oval. Yet the painting shows a waning crescent moon, as it would have been in a late-July sky. Kim also visited Saint-Rémy-de-Provence in June and July 2019 to fully capture van Gogh’s field of view from the precise location where he painted The Starry Night. Kim’s observations there, he says, further confirm the match with the Hyades cluster.
paras.zh: 反对将《星夜》定于六月中旬拍摄的另一个理由是月球周期——那时，月亮处于亏凸相，其受阳光照射的一面呈现为不平衡的椭圆形。然而，这幅画却展现了一轮渐亏的新月，就像七月底的天空中那样。 Kim 还于 2019 年 6 月和 7 月访问了圣雷米普罗旺斯，从梵高画《星夜》的精确地点充分捕捉梵高的视野。他说，金在那里的观察进一步证实了与毕宿星团的匹配。

paras.en: “During this time, van Gogh’s view of the sky was quite restricted” from his window at the Saint-Paul-de-Mausole mental asylum, says James Beattie, a Hubble fellow at NASA. “If the identification holds, we can look up today and recognize the same stars van Gogh saw.”
paras.zh: 美国宇航局哈勃研究员詹姆斯·贝蒂说，“在这段时间里，梵高从圣保罗德莫索尔精神病院的窗户看到的天空非常有限”。 “如果这个鉴定成立，我们今天抬头就能认出梵高看到的那些星星。”

paras.en: Despite the study’s thoroughness, of course, for a painting as iconic as The Starry Night, there will always be competing versions of an origin story.
paras.zh: 当然，尽管研究很彻底，但对于像《星夜》这样的标志性绘画来说，起源故事总会有相互竞争的版本。

paras.en: “The calculated position of brilliant Venus, in relation to the V shape of the Hyades asterism, does not match the painting,” says Don Olson, a self-proclaimed “celestial sleuth” for astronomical artwork and a professor emeritus of physics and astronomy at Texas State University. The researchers’ conclusions “require strong evidence to overcome Vincent van Gogh’s plain statement that ‘at last I have... a new study of a starry sky’ ... on June 18, 1889.”
paras.zh: “计算出的明亮金星相对于毕宿星团 V 形的位置与这幅画并不相符，”自称天文艺术品“天体侦探”、德克萨斯州立大学物理和天文学名誉教授唐·奥尔森 (Don Olson) 说。研究人员的结论“需要强有力的证据来推翻文森特·梵高 (Vincent van Gogh) 在 1889 年 6 月 18 日说的‘我终于……对星空进行了一项新的研究’的简单陈述。”

paras.en: Although there are still mysteries to resolve, Kim says the burden of proof has now reversed to proving the painting could not have been made in late July.
paras.zh: 尽管仍有待解开的谜团，但金表示，举证责任现在已转变为证明这幅画不可能是在七月下旬制作的。

paras.en: “The Starry Night spoke to an astronomer like me,” Kim says. “I listened to its voice.”
paras.zh: “星夜与我这样的天文学家进行了对话，”金说。 “我听到了它的声音。”

articles.title: The inside story behind OpenAI’s million-dollar math proof

paras.en: Room 109 of New York University’s Warren Weaver Hall wasn’t ready for what hit it.
paras.zh: 纽约大学沃伦韦弗大厅 109 室还没有做好应对袭击的准备。

paras.en: A half hour ahead of a special seminar scheduled for 3:30 P.M., attendees hoping to snag a spot already packed the hallway outside. When the doors opened, they all surged in, some climbing over rows of chairs to secure a good spot. Soon every inch of floor and both aisles were filled, with late-arriving onlookers trailing out the entrances. “Surely this is the most people this hall has ever seen,” I heard one bystander say. “This is no ordinary seminar. This is a rock concert,” said another.
paras.zh: 距离定于下午 3:30 举行的特别研讨会还有半小时，希望抢到席位的与会者已经挤满了外面的走廊。当门打开时，他们都涌了进来，有些人爬过一排排椅子以占据一个好位置。很快，每一寸地板和两条过道都挤满了迟到的围观者，他们从入口处走出来。 “这肯定是这个大厅里见过最多的人了，”我听到一位旁观者说道。 “这不是普通的研讨会。这是一场摇滚音乐会，”另一个人说。

paras.en: The headliner was N.Y.U. mathematician Tristan Buckmaster. It was his first public lecture since September 8, the day OpenAI claimed to have solved one of math’s “million-dollar problems”—right after Buckmaster publicly called the company out for seeming to steal his work.
paras.zh: 头条新闻是纽约大学。数学家特里斯坦·巴克马斯特。这是他自 9 月 8 日以来的第一次公开演讲，当天 OpenAI 声称已经解决了数学中的一个“价值百万美元的问题”——就在巴克马斯特公开指责该公司似乎窃取了他的工作成果之后。

paras.en: While Buckmaster set up, I peeked at the open laptops in the row ahead of me. Each showed a chat window with a large language model (LLM), either Anthropic’s Claude Code or OpenAI’s ChatGPT Codex. The prompters were asking their LLM to help construct a mathematical proof, or rewrite part of a manuscript in progress. In other words, they were doing math in 2026.
paras.zh: 当巴克马斯特设置时，我瞥了一眼前面一排打开的笔记本电脑。每个都显示了一个带有大型语言模型 (LLM) 的聊天窗口，可以是 Anthropic 的 Claude Code 或 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT Codex。提示者要求他们的法学硕士帮助构建数学证明，或重写正在进行的手稿的一部分。换句话说，他们在 2026 年做数学题。

paras.en: “I hope you stay with me,” Buckmaster began. “I have been so busy these last few weeks that I literally wrote this talk last night.”
paras.zh: “我希望你留在我身边，”巴克马斯特开始说道。 “过去几周我太忙了，所以我昨晚才写了这篇演讲。”

paras.en: The public discord surrounding the biggest math breakthrough in decades capped off a summer of disruption that has left humanity’s oldest academic discipline forever changed. Ever since the momentous OpenAI announcement, the events behind it have appeared as messy and confusing as the proof itself. But now, as the community races to reverse-engineer the LLM’s opaque logic, a few things are becoming clear.
paras.zh: 围绕数十年来最大的数学突破的公众分歧结束了这个夏天的混乱，这场混乱使人类最古老的学科永远改变了。自从 OpenAI 重大声明发布以来，其背后的事件就和证据本身一样混乱且令人困惑。但现在，随着社区竞相对法学硕士不透明的逻辑进行逆向工程，一些事情正在变得清晰。

paras.en: OpenAI’s internal model indeed found the right answer. And it did so by following a different path than anyone—including the company’s top mathematicians—initially realized.
paras.zh: OpenAI的内部模型确实找到了正确的答案。为此，它采取了一条与任何人（包括公司顶级数学家）最初意识到的不同的道路。

paras.en: Clearest of all, though, is that we’re entering a troubling new era. Inscrutable models are making scientific history while cloaked in proprietary secrets. Humans, with their foibles and petty jockeying, are barely keeping up. Consequently, that history has never been harder to write down.
paras.zh: 但最明显的是，我们正在进入一个令人不安的新时代。深不可测的模型在隐藏着专有秘密的同时正在创造科学历史。人类由于自身的弱点和小伎俩，几乎无法跟上。因此，这段历史从未如此难以书写。

paras.en: Buckmaster’s tale starts a year ago, with an e-mail from someone he’d never met: mathematician and Anthropic employee Levent Alpöge.
paras.zh: 巴克马斯特的故事始于一年前，一封来自他从未见过的人的电子邮件：数学家兼 Anthropic 员工 Levent Alpöge。

paras.en: “I fear a world in which corporations are the only ones with claim to the deepest pure math work,” Alpöge wrote. “It seems to me there will be only one Millennium Problem solved in the foreseeable future,” he continued, proposing that he and Buckmaster could work together to solve it.
paras.zh: “我担心这样一个世界：企业是唯一拥有最深奥的纯数学工作的人，”阿尔波格写道。 “在我看来，在可预见的未来，只会解决一个千年难题，”他继续说道，并提议他和巴克马斯特可以共同努力解决这一问题。

paras.en: That problem—one of Clay Mathematics Institute’s seven “Millennium Prize Problems”—is known simply as “Navier-Stokes.” The nickname refers to the Navier-Stokes equations, which dictate how fluids swirl and flow. Mathematicians had long suspected that the equations don’t always work. That sometimes, they would predict that a fluid does the impossible—that its flow, at points, “blows up,” reaching an infinite and entirely nonsensical velocity.
paras.zh: 这个问题是克莱数学研究所的七个“千年奖问题”之一，简称为“纳维-斯托克斯问题”。这个绰号指的是纳维-斯托克斯方程，它决定了流体如何旋转和流动。数学家们长期以来一直怀疑这些方程并不总是有效。有时，他们会预测流体会做出不可能的事情——它的流动在某些点上会“爆炸”，达到无限且完全荒谬的速度。

paras.en: Find such a flaw—using a mathematical proof—and the Clay Institute would owe you a cool $1 million. Alpöge wasn’t the only one in Silicon Valley who thought that goal was within reach.
paras.zh: 找到这样一个缺陷——使用数学证明——克莱研究所将欠你 100 万美元。 Alpöge 并不是硅谷唯一一个认为这一目标可以实现的人。

paras.en: “At that time, you have to understand that the Navier-Stokes equation became this tech bro obsession,” Buckmaster told N.Y.U. audience. Most of those tech bros didn’t even understand the equations, he said, but they’d heard mathematicians point to them as a place artificial intelligence might help. As Buckmaster put it, solving Navier-Stokes was becoming “the yardstick to say, ‘We’re better than that other AI company.’”
paras.zh: 巴克马斯特告诉纽约大学：“那时，你必须明白，纳维-斯托克斯方程成为了科技界人士的痴迷。”观众。他说，大多数技术兄弟甚至不理解这些方程式，但他们听到数学家指出人工智能可能会有所帮助。正如巴克马斯特所说，解决纳维尔-斯托克斯问题正在成为“衡量‘我们比其他人工智能公司更好’的标准。”

paras.en: In fact, Buckmaster had collaborated with Google’s DeepMind team in their own pursuit of this goal—Navier-Stokes, he tells me, has always been the “North Star” of his research. So he accepted Alpöge’s overture.
paras.zh: 事实上，巴克马斯特曾与谷歌的 DeepMind 团队合作，以实现这一目标——他告诉我，纳维-斯托克斯一直是他研究的“北极星”。于是他接受了阿尔波格的提议。

paras.en: They focused on a potential loophole in the Clay Institute’s posing of the problem, which said a mathematician could “stir” the fluid with a finely-tuned force. A few years ago, the Spanish mathematicians Diego Córdoba and Luis Martínez-Zoroa realized that phrasing might allow an exploit. The Spaniards sketched out a specific program—to contrive an ultraprecise, unrealistic force that pokes and prods each point in the fluid just so, massaging it into blowing up.
paras.zh: 他们关注的是克莱研究所提出问题时的一个潜在漏洞，即数学家可以用微调的力“搅拌”流体。几年前，西班牙数学家迭戈·科尔多瓦 (Diego Córdoba) 和路易斯·马丁内斯·索罗亚 (Luis Martínez-Zoroa) 意识到措辞可能会导致漏洞利用。西班牙人制定了一个具体的计划——设计一种超精确的、不切实际的力量，恰如其分地戳戳流体中的每个点，将其按摩至爆炸。

paras.en: Alpöge and Buckmaster started by instructing their LLMs—a mix of Anthropic and OpenAI models—to carry out Córdoba and Martínez-Zoroa’s program. They first managed to blow up simpler sets of equations describing idealized fluids—easier proxies for Navier-Stokes. Buckmaster told me their collaboration was “purely personal,” without official involvement from Anthropic—although, he acknowledged in his lecture, during their work Alpöge did have access to Anthropic’s computing resources and unreleased versions of Claude.
paras.zh: Alpöge 和 Buckmaster 首先指导他们的法学硕士（Anthropic 和 OpenAI 模型的混合）执行 Córdoba 和 Martínez-Zoroa 的项目。他们首先成功地炸毁了描述理想流体的更简单的方程组——纳维-斯托克斯的更简单的代理。巴克马斯特告诉我，他们的合作“纯粹是个人的”，没有 Anthropic 的官方参与——尽管他在演讲中承认，在他们的工作期间，Alpöge 确实可以访问 Anthropic 的计算资源和未发布版本的 Claude。

paras.en: Alpöge’s math output has been the subject of some consternation. In the last several months, he’s prodded Claude into resolving several famous open problems, often announcing them in cryptic, playful posts on social media. He’s left mathematicians unsure to what extent these explosive results represent his employer and has built a strange reputation somewhere between folk hero and Internet troll. Downplaying his affiliation, Alpöge has characterized his work with Buckmaster as “mostly me and Claude having a good time YOLO-ing random stuff in the corner.”
paras.zh: Alpöge 的数学成果引起了一些人的震惊。在过去的几个月里，他敦促克劳德解决几个著名的开放性问题，并经常在社交媒体上以神秘、有趣的帖子形式宣布这些问题。他让数学家们不确定这些爆炸性的结果在多大程度上代表了他的雇主，并在民间英雄和网络巨魔之间建立了一个奇怪的声誉。 Alpöge 淡化了自己的关系，将他与 Buckmaster 的合作描述为“主要是我和克劳德在角落里随意玩弄 YOLO 玩得很开心”。

paras.en: Contrast his approach with that of OpenAI, whose assault on mathematics has been overwhelming and deliberate. The company has strategically poached much of the field’s top young talent, arming them with lavish resources to bag the biggest mathematical game they can. They unveil their papers alongside carefully-worded press releases, substituting the impersonal, monolithic byline “OpenAI” for the traditional list of human contributors. They’ve become notorious for disregarding academic norms, and their lead scientist Sébastien Bubeck has now had to apologize repeatedly after these aggressive rollouts sparked furious backlash.
paras.zh: 将他的方法与 OpenAI 的方法进行对比，后者对数学的攻击是压倒性的、刻意的。该公司战略性地挖走了该领域的许多顶尖年轻人才，为他们提供了大量资源，以尽可能地囊括最大的数学游戏。他们在发表论文的同时，还发布了措辞谨慎的新闻稿，用客观、单一的署名“OpenAI”取代了传统的人类贡献者名单。他们因无视学术规范而臭名昭著，在这些激进的推出引发了强烈反对后，他们的首席科学家塞巴斯蒂安·布贝克现在不得不一再道歉。

paras.en: In August, after several months of slow progress, Alpöge and Buckmaster’s prompting suddenly took off. On the 15th, Alpöge informed Buckmaster that Claude had blown up the Euler equations—equivalent to Navier-Stokes without friction, a simplification seen as a crucial step toward solving the full problem. “He didn’t quite believe it himself,” Buckmaster recalled during his public talk. Looking at the document the AIs had spit out explaining their proof, Buckmaster didn’t believe it, either.
paras.zh: 八月份，经过几个月的缓慢进展，阿尔波格和巴克马斯特的推动突然取得了进展。 15 日，阿尔波格通知巴克马斯特，克劳德已经炸毁了欧拉方程——相当于无摩擦的纳维-斯托克斯方程，这一简化被视为解决整个问题的关键一步。 “他自己也不太相信，”巴克马斯特在公开演讲中回忆道。看着人工智能吐出的解释他们的证明的文件，巴克马斯特也不相信。

paras.en: “This was the most horrible mathematics I’ve ever seen in my life,” he said to laughter as he flashed a slide showing some of the proof’s impenetrable wall of garbled text and numbers.
paras.zh: “这是我一生中见过的最可怕的数学，”他笑着说，同时亮出了一张幻灯片，展示了证明中一些难以穿透的乱码文本和数字之墙。

paras.en: “Although they’re English words, it’s not English,” Buckmaster went on. “But all the different LLM models understand this complete gibberish.” As unbelievable as it seems, when LLMs team up on a math problem, they begin communicating in their own “weird slop dialect,” as one mathematician put it to me.
paras.zh: “虽然它们是英语单词，但它不是英语，”巴克马斯特继续说道。 “但所有不同的法学硕士模型都明白这完全是胡言乱语。”尽管看起来令人难以置信，但当法学硕士们组队解决数学问题时，他们开始用自己的“奇怪的方言”进行交流，正如一位数学家对我所说的那样。

paras.en: And on August 22 Buckmaster and Alpöge prompted their LLMs to code the whole thing in Lean—a programming language that breaks a math proof into tiny steps and confirms that each follows from those before it. “This complete and utter nonsense was Lean-verified,” Buckmaster said, meaning it was correct.
paras.zh: 8 月 22 日，Buckmaster 和 Alpöge 促使他们的法学硕士用 Lean 编写整个过程——一种编程语言，将数学证明分解为微小的步骤，并确认每个步骤都遵循之前的步骤。 “这完全是胡说八道，经过了精益验证，”巴克马斯特说，这意味着它是正确的。

paras.en: But he and Alpöge didn’t want to post a result they didn’t understand. So the pair began a sprint to rewrite the proof for human consumption, relying heavily on OpenAI’s ChatGPT Codex.
paras.zh: 但他和 Alpöge 不想发布他们不理解的结果。因此，两人开始冲刺，重写人类消费的证明，严重依赖 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT Codex。

paras.en: Here the timelines get fuzzy. The following was gleaned from public statements plus supporting documentation provided by Buckmaster. Alpöge and Bubeck both declined on-the-record interviews, but Bubeck corroborated the basic facts and direct quotes.
paras.zh: 这里时间线变得模糊。以下内容来自巴克马斯特的公开声明以及支持文件。阿尔波格和布贝克都拒绝接受正式采访，但布贝克证实了基本事实和直接引述。

paras.en: On August 28 OpenAI happened to begin training a new internal model that proved to be far better at math than any predecessor. Then, on August 31, Alpöge tweeted “Augustus Mirabilis”—Latin for “miraculous August.” Alarmed, Bubeck and his team at OpenAI took this and other rumors to mean Anthropic “had solved at least one Millennium Problem.” By Tuesday, September 1, they had launched a rushed counterattack, sending a squadron of copies of their new model at each open Millennium Problem, plus a few others—including the Euler equations for fluids.
paras.zh: 8 月 28 日，OpenAI 碰巧开始训练一个新的内部模型，事实证明该模型在数学方面比任何前辈都要好得多。然后，8 月 31 日，Alpöge 在推特上发了一条“Augustus Mirabilis”——拉丁语，意思是“奇迹般的八月”。布贝克和他在 OpenAI 的团队感到震惊，认为这一传闻和其他谣言意味着 Anthropic“已经解决了至少一个千年难题”。到了 9 月 1 日星期二，他们发起了一次仓促的反击，在每个开放的千年问题上发送了一个中队的新模型副本，以及其他一些模型，包括流体的欧拉方程。

paras.en: The following day, Wednesday, Buckmaster and Alpöge learned through back channels about OpenAI’s frenzied efforts. Buckmaster attempted a détente on Thursday morning, e-mailing a mathematician on the company’s math team. He informed them that his collaboration with Alpöge was the subject of the rumors and clarified that their work was not an official Anthropic effort—that he’d been using OpenAI models as well, in fact. The mathematician’s response was encouraging—offering computing resources and asking for more details because “it would be useful to avoid competing here.”
paras.zh: 第二天，即星期三，Buckmaster 和 Alpöge 通过秘密渠道了解到 OpenAI 的疯狂努力。周四早上，巴克马斯特试图缓和局势，他给公司数学团队的一位数学家发了电子邮件。他告诉他们，他与 Alpöge 的合作是谣言的主题，并澄清他们的工作并不是 Anthropic 的官方工作——事实上，他也一直在使用 OpenAI 模型。这位数学家的回应令人鼓舞——提供计算资源并要求提供更多细节，因为“避免在这里竞争会很有用。”

paras.en: But that night, a squad of 100 agents that OpenAI had set upon the Euler equations leapfrogged Bubeck and Alpöge. The agents figured out a way to remove the weird force that was the centerpiece of Córdoba and Martínez-Zoroa’s approach—that is, OpenAI’s agents managed to make the fluid blow up on its own, without stirring it at all, producing their own Euler proof.
paras.zh: 但那天晚上，OpenAI 在欧拉方程上设置的由 100 名智能体组成的小队超越了 Bubeck 和 Alpöge。特工们找到了一种方法来消除科尔多瓦和马丁内斯-索罗亚方法核心的奇怪力量——也就是说，OpenAI 的特工们成功地让流体自行爆炸，而根本没有搅拌它，从而产生了他们自己的欧拉证明。

paras.en: Stunned, the team decided to redirect all its resources at Navier-Stokes. The researchers assembled a swarm of 10,000 intercommunicating agents and fed it the new Euler proof as a starting point.
paras.zh: 震惊之余，团队决定将所有资源转移到纳维-斯托克斯。研究人员聚集了 10,000 个相互通信的代理，并向其提供新的欧拉证明作为起点。

paras.en: On Saturday, after consuming a reported $15 million in computing resources, the 10,000-agent swarm solved Navier-Stokes. It had to reintroduce a force to do so—reopening the loophole it had managed to close for Euler.
paras.zh: 周六，据报道消耗了 1500 万美元的计算资源后，由 10,000 名智能体组成的群体解决了纳维-斯托克斯问题。它必须重新引入力量才能做到这一点——重新打开它为欧拉堵住的漏洞。

paras.en: On Sunday, Buckmaster and Bubeck finally spoke. Bubeck claimed that OpenAI’s new model had solved the Clay problem in a single go, without any input beyond the official problem statement. He then backpedaled, revealing some details of the company’s weeklong agent extravaganza. Seeing Bubeck’s story change mid-telling, Buckmaster lost confidence that OpenAI was acting in good faith. He became suspicious that the company’s internal model had somehow accessed the work he had done with their public Codex model.
paras.zh: 周日，巴克马斯特和布贝克终于发表了讲话。 Bubeck 声称 OpenAI 的新模型一次性解决了 Clay 问题，除了官方问题陈述之外没有任何输入。然后他改变主意，透露了公司为期一周的代理盛会的一些细节。看到布贝克的故事讲到一半就发生了变化，巴克马斯特对 OpenAI 的善意行为失去了信心。他开始怀疑公司的内部模型以某种方式访问​​了他使用公共 Codex 模型所做的工作。

paras.en: From there, the conversation couldn’t be salvaged. “You are not going to be able to convince me that you did not get the key ideas from a leak,” Buckmaster told Bubeck. Bubeck offered Buckmaster lead authorship on OpenAI’s Navier-Stokes paper—but demanded that Alpöge’s name be removed because of his affiliation with OpenAI’s competitor. When Buckmaster threatened to go to the press, Bubeck asked, “Why would you risk your career?” After Buckmaster’s defiant reply, Bubeck rejoined, “if you don’t want me to be nice, then I don’t have to be nice.”
paras.zh: 从那时起，谈话就无法挽回了。 “你无法让我相信你没有从泄密事件中获得关键想法，”巴克马斯特告诉布贝克。布贝克向巴克马斯特提供了 OpenAI 纳维-斯托克斯论文的主要作者身份，但要求删除 Alpöge 的名字，因为他与 OpenAI 竞争对手有联系。当巴克马斯特威胁要向媒体曝光时，布贝克问道：“你为什么要拿自己的职业生涯冒险？”在巴克马斯特挑衅性的回答后，布贝克反驳道：“如果你不想让我友善，那我就不必友善。”

paras.en: At that point, there was nothing more to say. By Tuesday morning, each team had posted their proof, along with their side of the story.
paras.zh: 到了这个时候，就没有什么可说的了。到周二早上，每个团队都发布了他们的证据以及他们的故事。

paras.en: In the Sunday phone call with Buckmaster, and their blog post and press conference on Tuesday, OpenAI’s math team said that their solution to Navier-Stokes followed the same mathematical path as Buckmaster and Alpöge’s.
paras.zh: 在周日与 Buckmaster 的电话会议以及周二的博客文章和新闻发布会上，OpenAI 的数学团队表示，他们的 Navier-Stokes 解决方案遵循了与 Buckmaster 和 Alpöge 相同的数学路径。

paras.en: But it turned out they were wrong. The models had carved out their own way.
paras.zh: 但事实证明他们错了。模特们开辟了自己的道路。

paras.en: The swarm’s proof does exploit the same loophole before—it constructs a strange, perfectly calibrated force to coax the fluid into blowing up. But the way it constructs this force is distinct from the Spanish program and thus distinct from Buckmaster and Alpöge’s Euler proof.
paras.zh: 群体的证明确实利用了之前相同的漏洞——它构造了一种奇怪的、完美校准的力来诱使流体爆炸。但它构造这种力的方式与西班牙纲领不同，因此也与巴克马斯特和阿尔波格的欧拉证明不同。

paras.en: Buckmaster himself acknowledges that OpenAI’s Navier-Stokes proof introduced new ideas. But he still believes OpenAI somehow relied on his progress. The company’s Euler proof, he said in his lecture, clearly uses the Spanish program. “That was our result,” he said plainly.
paras.zh: 巴克马斯特本人承认 OpenAI 的纳维-斯托克斯证明引入了新的想法。但他仍然相信 OpenAI 在某种程度上依赖于他的进步。他在演讲中说，该公司的欧拉证明显然使用了西班牙语程序。 “这就是我们的结果，”他简单地说。

paras.en: As he sees it, his work with Alpöge on the Spanish program blazed a trail to get to a specific destination—using a force to blow up the Euler equations. And he believes OpenAI’s agents followed that same trail. From there, Buckmaster thinks, the agents continued in two forking directions.
paras.zh: 在他看来，他与 Alpöge 在西班牙项目上的合作开辟了一条通往特定目的地的道路——利用力量炸毁欧拉方程。他相信 OpenAI 的特工也遵循了同样的路线。巴克马斯特认为，从那里开始，特工们继续朝两个方向发展。

paras.en: The left fork cleverly removed the force after doing all that work to construct it. OpenAI’s 100-agent squad found a way to encode that complicated stir into the fluid’s initial state, rather than applying it externally. Buckmaster says this fork only goes a tiny distance further, mathematically, than their own preexisting proof.
paras.zh: 在完成所有构建工作后，左叉巧妙地消除了力。 OpenAI 的 100 名智能体团队找到了一种方法，将这种复杂的搅拌编码到流体的初始状态中，而不是从外部应用它。巴克马斯特说，这个分​​叉在数学上只比他们自己先前存在的证明更进一步。

paras.en: Mathematicians are still comparing the two Euler proofs, but at least one expert agrees with Buckmaster’s take. “As far as I can tell, OpenAI’s proof basically follows the framework of our program,” says Fan Zheng, a collaborator of Córdoba and Martínez-Zoroa at the Institute of Mathematical Sciences in Spain. “But OpenAI is able to overcome a couple of technical difficulties to remove the force.”
paras.zh: 数学家们仍在比较两个欧拉证明，但至少一位专家同意巴克马斯特的观点。 “据我所知，OpenAI 的证明基本上遵循我们程序的框架，”西班牙数学科学研究所 Córdoba 和 Martínez-Zoroa 的合作者范正说。 “但是 OpenAI 能够克服一些技术困难来消除这种力量。”

paras.en: The right fork, according to Buckmaster, led to Navier-Stokes. He views it as an extension of the same path that added some more significant new ideas—still a fork, but a longer one. (He also says that he and Alpöge used similar ideas in an alternate AI-generated Euler proof that they never made public but that they did feed into Codex.) Other experts studying OpenAI’s Navier-Stokes proof, however, feel that the company’s swarm instead carved an entirely new path that bears only cursory similarities to the trail Buckmaster and Alpöge’s AIs had previously blazed.
paras.zh: 根据巴克马斯特的说法，正确的分叉通向纳维-斯托克斯。他认为这是同一条道路的延伸，增加了一些更重要的新想法——仍然是一个分叉，但更长。 （他还说，他和 Alpöge 在人工智能生成的欧拉证明中使用了类似的想法，虽然他们从未公开过，但确实将其输入到 Codex 中。）然而，其他研究 OpenAI 纳维-斯托克斯证明的专家认为，该公司的群体反而开辟了一条全新的道路，与巴克马斯特和 Alpöge 的人工智能之前开辟的道路只有粗略的相似之处。

paras.en: OpenAI emphatically denies the allegations. “No user inputs, including anything from Dr. Buckmaster’s Codex and ChatGPT usage, after July 3, 2026, could have influenced the model or the math results it produced in any way,” a spokesperson wrote in a statement to Scientific American.
paras.zh: OpenAI 断然否认这些指控。一位发言人在给《科学美国人》的一份声明中写道：“2026 年 7 月 3 日之后，任何用户输入，包括巴克马斯特博士的 Codex 和 ChatGPT 使用中的任何内容，都不可能以任何方式影响该模型或其产生的数学结果。”

paras.en: This narrative, still murky more than a month after the fact, warns of a new normal that has already arrived. LLMs are proving math results far faster than humans can make sense of them. OpenAI announced one of the most important proofs in history without anyone on staff understanding even the broad strokes of the math it contained. Bubeck himself said on X that OpenAI “collectively had no research-level expertise in fluid dynamics.”
paras.zh: 这一叙述在事实发生一个多月后仍然模糊，警告新常态已经到来。法学硕士证明数学结果的速度远远快于人类理解它们的速度。 OpenAI 宣布了历史上最重要的证明之一，但没有任何工作人员理解其中所包含的数学的大致内容。 Bubeck 本人在 X 上表示，OpenAI“在流体动力学方面总体上没有研究水平的专业知识”。

paras.en: In Buckmaster’s first e-mail to OpenAI back on September 3, he explained why he and Alpöge were taking the time to rewrite their Euler proof before posting it. “I feel strongly that the first thing anyone reads should be a mathematical argument they can follow and argue with,” he said. The company disagrees—as punctuated a few weeks later, when it dropped hundreds more nigh-impenetrable math results on the community, many without Lean verification.
paras.zh: In Buckmaster’s first e-mail to OpenAI back on September 3, he explained why he and Alpöge were taking the time to rewrite their Euler proof before posting it. “我强烈地认为，任何人读到的第一件事应该是他们可以遵循和争论的数学论证，”他说。 The company disagrees—as punctuated a few weeks later, when it dropped hundreds more nigh-impenetrable math results on the community, many without Lean verification.

paras.en: In the Q&A after Buckmaster’s talk, he declined the audience’s requests to predict the future. He only knows that September 8 marks the day after which math would never be the same, and that mathematicians need to decide how to respond. But his own feelings on that question, he said, still change day to day.
paras.zh: 在巴克马斯特演讲后的问答中，他拒绝了观众预测未来的要求。他只知道 9 月 8 日标志着数学将不再一样的一天，数学家需要决定如何应对。但他说，他自己对这个问题的看法仍然每天都在变化。

paras.en: Asked what should happen next, his reply received the loudest applause of the day—a clear signal of the audience’s pent-up feeling.
paras.zh: 当被问及接下来会发生什么时，他的回答赢得了当天最响亮的掌声——这是观众压抑的情绪的明显信号。

paras.en: “What we should do right now,” he blurted out, “is get the AI companies to stop acting like children.”
paras.zh: “我们现在应该做的，”他脱口而出，“就是让人工智能公司停止像孩子一样行事。”

articles.title: Data centers are a target of modern warfare. How do we secure the infrastructure that runs our digital lives?

paras.en: When Alexander Olshansky received a call in September telling him that the data center hosting his company's infrastructure in Kyiv had been destroyed by a Russian attack, he made a beeline for the scene.
paras.zh: 9 月份，当 Alexander Olshansky 接到电话，告知他在基辅托管公司基础设施的数据中心已被俄罗斯袭击摧毁时，他径直赶往现场。

paras.en: “As I was driving up to the data center, I saw a column of black smoke, a block cordoned off by the police and fire trucks,” recalls Olshansky, president of the Ukrainian domain registration and Web hosting provider MiroHost. The data center was damaged, but Olshansky’s employees had been sheltering elsewhere when the attack happened.
paras.zh: “当我开车前往数据中心时，我看到一柱黑烟，警察和消防车封锁了一个街区，”乌克兰域名注册和网络托管提供商 MiroHost 总裁 Olshansky 回忆道。数据中心遭到损坏，但袭击发生时奥尔尚斯基的员工已经在其他地方避难。

paras.en: Despite the facility’s destruction on September 23, just around one in 20 of MiroHost’s customers were affected. The company had reserved enough computing capacity in Poland, the Czech Republic and Slovakia to back up its Ukrainian infrastructure in the event of an attack.
paras.zh: 尽管该设施于 9 月 23 日被毁，但只有大约二十分之一的 MiroHost 客户受到影响。该公司在波兰、捷克共和国和斯洛伐克保留了足够的计算能力，以便在发生攻击时支持其乌克兰基础设施。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Other data centers haven’t fared as well. In October Ukrainian drones struck three data centers operated by the Russian technology giant Yandex, disrupting services and damaging artificial intelligence infrastructure. Earlier this year Iranian drones damaged Amazon Web Services facilities in the United Arab Emirates and Bahrain, causing Web outages across the region.
paras.zh: 其他数据中心的表现也不佳。 10 月，乌克兰无人机袭击了俄罗斯科技巨头 Yandex 运营的三个数据中心，导致服务中断并破坏了人工智能基础设施。今年早些时候，伊朗无人机损坏了阿拉伯联合酋长国和巴林的亚马逊网络服务设施，导致该地区网络中断。

paras.en: What is inarguable is that, like them or not, data centers are increasingly important parts of our lives, and as such, they’re increasingly seen as fair targets in war. How they are secured is a matter of national—and even international—importance.
paras.zh: 无可争议的是，无论是否喜欢他们，数据中心已成为我们生活中越来越重要的一部分，因此，它们越来越被视为战争中的公平目标。如何确保它们的安全是一个具有国家乃至国际重要性的问题。

paras.en: “I would say 2026 is going to be the first year of drone strikes taking out data centers being a thing,” says Doug Madory, head of international Internet analysis at the cybersecurity company Infoblox. “I just don’t think that anybody had anticipated this as a risk to interrupt service.”
paras.zh: 网络安全公司 Infoblox 的国际互联网分析主管 Doug Madory 表示：“我认为 2026 年将是无人机袭击摧毁数据中心的元年。” “我只是认为没有人预料到这会带来服务中断的风险。”

paras.en: Because of their vital role in the economy, data centers are designed with multiple layers of security. These include restricted access to the site, constant surveillance and backup power systems. In the event of fire, suppression equipment keeps flames at bay. But those defenses are mostly focused on stopping bad actors from getting inside or on keeping services running when equipment fails—not on withstanding attacks from the air.
paras.zh: 由于数据中心在经济中发挥着至关重要的作用，因此数据中心的设计具有多层安全性。其中包括限制进入现场、持续监控和备用电源系统。如果发生火灾，灭火设备可以阻止火焰。但这些防御措施主要侧重于阻止不良行为者进入或在设备发生故障时保持服务运行，而不是抵御来自空中的攻击。

paras.en: “Most data center security standards in the industry focus on physical access restrictions,” says Connor Martin, an international affairs fellow in national security at the Council on Foreign Relations. But protecting facilities against drone or missile strikes is a different challenge—and one the sector must start focusing on. Data centers can seem like sitting ducks from the air because they’re massive, cavernous buildings containing enormously expensive equipment in often remote areas. They “can’t pick up and move,” Martin says.
paras.zh: “业内大多数数据中心安全标准都侧重于物理访问限制，”外交关系委员会国家安全国际事务研究员康纳·马丁说。但保护设施免受无人机或导弹袭击是另一项挑战，也是该行业必须开始关注的挑战。从空中看，数据中心就像是坐鸭子一样，因为它们是巨大的、洞穴状的建筑，通常位于偏远地区，包含极其昂贵的设备。他们“无法拿起并移动，”马丁说。

paras.en: Still, some protection is possible without going as far as installing missile defenses at key data center locations. Peter Judge, senior research analyst at the Uptime Institute, says operators can build shields around vulnerable equipment such as generators and air-handling units and use overhead netting or screens to hinder aerial surveillance. Yet more sophisticated systems might combine radar, cameras and radio sensors to identify approaching drones or aircraft.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，无需在关键数据中心位置安装导弹防御系统，仍然可以提供一些保护。 Uptime Institute 的高级研究分析师 Peter Judge 表示，运营商可以在发电机和空气处理机组等易受攻击的设备周围建造防护罩，并使用高架网或屏幕来阻碍空中监视。然而，更复杂的系统可能会结合雷达、摄像头和无线电传感器来识别接近的无人机或飞机。

paras.en: But if a craft is spotted, what can actually be done is trickier. Aviation laws typically prevent jamming drone signals—scrambling their radio signals—or bringing them down without authorization. Some newer drones don’t transmit radio control signals at all.
paras.zh: 但如果发现了一艘飞船，实际上能做什么就更棘手了。航空法通常禁止干扰无人机信号（扰乱其无线电信号）或未经授权将其击落。一些较新的无人机根本不传输无线电控制信号。

paras.en: For his part, Olshansky isn’t convinced physical protection is viable in a war zone anyway. “No fire suppression system is designed for a direct hit by a bomb, missile or drone,” he says.
paras.zh: 就奥尔尚斯基而言，无论如何，他并不相信实物保护在战区是可行的。 “没有任何灭火系统是为炸弹、导弹或无人机的直接打击而设计的，”他说。

paras.en: Truly protecting such a facility could mean burying it deep underground, which isn’t feasible. Instead, the industry’s best approach may be in redundancy—distributing services across multiple facilities so that when one is destroyed, another can take over. It works, as MiroHost showed, but it also costs more: Olshansky says his company effectively doubled its available computing capacity to prepare for an attack.
paras.zh: 真正保护这样的设施可能意味着将其深埋在地下，这是不可行的。相反，该行业最好的方法可能是冗余——在多个设施之间分配服务，这样当一个设施被毁时，另一个可以接管。正如 MiroHost 所展示的那样，它确实有效，但成本也更高：Olshansky 表示，他的公司实际上将可用计算能力增加了一倍，以准备攻击。

paras.en: Madory points out that cloud providers already offer ways to distribute workloads across different geographic regions. The problem is that many customers don’t bother because of the additional cost and technical complexity. “In theory, you could be resilient, but in practice, a lot of stuff is not,” he says.
paras.zh: Madory 指出，云提供商已经提供了跨不同地理区域分配工作负载的方法。问题是，由于额外的成本和技术复杂性，许多客户不会打扰。 “从理论上讲，你可以保持弹性，但实际上，很多东西都不是，”他说。

paras.en: The recent attacks could change where companies choose to build their data centers, Martin says. The Gulf states have invested heavily in attracting those kinds of instalments, but their proximity to regional conflicts could make future projects harder to justify. Larger countries such as the U.S. and China, meanwhile, have more opportunities to build facilities far from potential conflict zones. But even then, there are no guarantees. As Olshansky says, “It is always better to have two copies of something than just one, even if it is highly protected.”
paras.zh: 马丁说，最近的攻击可能会改变公司选择建立数据中心的地点。海湾国家为吸引此类分期付款投入了大量资金，但它们靠近地区冲突可能会使未来项目更难以证明其合理性。与此同时，美国和中国等大国有更多机会在远离潜在冲突地区的地方建设设施。但即便如此，也没有任何保证。正如 Olshansky 所说：“拥有两份副本总是比只有一份更好，即使它受到高度保护。”

articles.title: This ‘living drug’ could change the course of autoimmune disease
articles.author: Meghan Rosen

paras.en: Two months before the treatment that would change Lynn Montgomery-Haga’s life, she could barely walk down a hallway.
paras.zh: 在接受改变林恩·蒙哥马利-哈加生活的治疗之前两个月，她几乎无法在走廊上行走。

paras.en: In a test at the University of Colorado Anschutz, Montgomery-Haga struggled to walk 25 feet, often reaching out to the walls for support. Usually, the 49-year-old relied on her walker or wheelchair. “She had a very stiff, hesitant gait,” says Montgomery-Haga’s neurologist, Amanda Piquet.
paras.zh: 在科罗拉多大学安舒茨分校的一次测试中，蒙哥马利-哈加很难行走 25 英尺，经常伸手到墙壁寻求支撑。这位 49 岁的女士通常依靠助行器或轮椅出行。 “她的步态非常僵硬、犹豫，”蒙哥马利-哈加的神经科医生阿曼达·皮奎特 (Amanda Piquet) 说。

paras.en: For about a decade, Montgomery-Haga had lived with a debilitating autoimmune disease known as stiff person syndrome. The progressive condition can lock up the body’s muscles without warning, leading to falls, broken bones, excruciating pain and difficulty moving. Singer Celine Dion, who returned to the stage in September after years of battling the disease, has said it can feel “like somebody’s strangling you.”
paras.zh: 大约十年来，蒙哥马利-哈加一直患有一种使人衰弱的自身免疫性疾病，称为僵人综合症。这种进行性的病症会在没有警告的情况下锁住身体的肌肉，导致跌倒、骨折、剧痛和行动困难。歌手席琳·迪翁 (Celine Dion) 在与这种疾病作斗争多年后于 9 月重返舞台，她说感觉“就像有人勒死你一样”。

paras.en: Montgomery-Haga’s own days were marked by dizziness, fatigue and pain. And sudden muscle spasms would send her sprawling. It was like the fainting goat videos popular on the internet, she says. “They get surprised and they fall over, and there’s nothing they can do about it.”
paras.zh: 蒙哥马利-哈加自己的日子充满了头晕、疲劳和疼痛。突然的肌肉痉挛会让她四肢瘫痪。她说，这就像互联网上流行的山羊晕倒视频。 “他们感到惊讶并摔倒，但他们对此无能为力。”

paras.en: But stiff person syndrome is no joke. It stripped Montgomery-Haga of her accounting job and her ability to drive. She couldn’t sit up in bed unless she had a safety bar to pull on. If she dropped the soap in the shower, it’d take her 10 minutes to pick it up.
paras.zh: 但僵人综合症可不是闹着玩的。这剥夺了蒙哥马利-哈加的会计工作和驾驶能力。除非有安全杆可以拉动，否则她无法在床上坐起来。如果她把肥皂掉在淋浴间里，她需要 10 分钟才能捡起来。
