articles.title: NASA to Conduct NCAA Flyover, Engage Fans at University of Alabama
articles.author: Lee Mohon

paras.en: As part of the agency’s Inspiration Tour, NASA will conduct a flyover at the University of Alabama vs. Texas A&M football game in Tuscaloosa, Alabama, on Saturday, Oct. 24. NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman will pilot one of three F-5 fighter jets during the flyover, highlighting NASA’s contributions to aeronautics and the agency’s continued commitment to advancing aviation technologies.
paras.zh: 作为该机构“灵感之旅”的一部分，NASA 将于 10 月 24 日星期六在阿拉巴马州塔斯卡卢萨举行的阿拉巴马大学对阵德克萨斯农工大学的橄榄球比赛中进行飞行表演。NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼将在飞行表演中驾驶三架 F-5 战斗机中的一架，强调 NASA 对航空业的贡献以及该机构对推进航空技术的持续承诺。

paras.en: Ahead of the game, members of the news media are invited to visit the NASA Experience Zone on Champions Lane, where Isaacman will participate in a media opportunity at 11 a.m. CDT. Media interested in attending should confirm their attendance by 12 p.m. Friday, Oct. 23, with Lance D. Davis at lance.d.davis@nasa.gov to receive additional details and instructions.
paras.zh: 比赛前，新闻媒体成员受邀参观位于 Champions Lane 的 NASA 体验区，艾萨克曼将在那里参加中部时间上午 11 点的媒体机会。有兴趣参加的媒体请在中午 12 点之前确认出席。 10 月 23 日星期五，通过 lance.d.davis@nasa.gov 与 Lance D. Davis 联系，获取更多详细信息和说明。

paras.en: Supported by NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama, the NASA Experience Zone will be open to the public from 10:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. CDT, with no game ticket required. The experience will give visitors an opportunity to meet NASA team members and learn more about the people and technologies advancing the agency’s missions in aeronautics and space exploration.
paras.zh: 在位于阿拉巴马州亨茨维尔的 NASA 马歇尔太空飞行中心的支持下，NASA 体验区将于上午 10:30 至下午 2:30 向公众开放。 CDT，无需游戏票。此次体验将使参观者有机会与 NASA 团队成员见面，并更多地了解推动该机构航空和太空探索任务的人员和技术。

paras.en: Attendees can engage with NASA team members and explore exhibits highlighting the agency’s Artemis campaign and efforts to return astronauts to the Moon, including:
paras.zh: 与会者可以与 NASA 团队成员互动，并探索突出该机构阿耳忒弥斯计划和宇航员重返月球努力的展览，包括：

paras.en: - An inflatable SLS (Space Launch System) rocket.
paras.zh: - 充气式 SLS（太空发射系统）火箭。

paras.en: - Displays featuring the Starship and Blue Moon human landing systems.
paras.zh: - 展示星舰和蓝月亮人类登陆系统。

paras.en: - Information about NASA internship opportunities.
paras.zh: - 有关 NASA 实习机会的信息。

paras.en: - Photo opportunities featuring NASA exhibits and displays.
paras.zh: - 以 NASA 展览和展示为特色的拍照机会。

paras.en: With stops across the nation, NASA’s Inspiration Tour convenes academic, industry, and public sector stakeholders to connect the agency with the people, technologies, and organizations that drive American leadership in space.
paras.zh: NASA 的灵感之旅在全国各地停靠，聚集了学术界、工业界和公共部门的利益相关者，将该机构与推动美国在太空领域发挥领导作用的人员、技术和组织联系起来。

paras.en: The tour will culminate in MAX POWER, a public exposition of American air and space innovation, Saturday, Nov. 7, and Sunday, Nov. 8, on and near the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. Held in honor of America’s historic 250th anniversary, the multi-day, family-friendly event will showcase the next-generation aircraft, spacecraft, autonomous vehicles, and technologies that will help define the future of transportation in air and space.
paras.zh: 此次巡演将在 MAX POWER 上达到高潮，这是一场美国航空航天创新的公开展览，将于 11 月 7 日星期六和 11 月 8 日星期日在该机构位于佛罗里达州的肯尼迪航天中心及其附近举行。为纪念美国历史性的 250 周年而举办的这项为期多天、适合家庭的活动将展示下一代飞机、航天器、自动驾驶汽车以及有助于定义航空和太空运输未来的技术。

paras.en: For more information about MAX POWER and the agency’s missions, visit:
paras.zh: 有关 MAX POWER 和该机构使命的更多信息，请访问：

paras.en: Marshall Space Flight Center, Huntsville, Ala.
paras.zh: 马歇尔太空飞行中心，阿拉巴马州亨茨维尔。

articles.title: NASA JPL Looks to Next 90 Years of Innovation, Exploration
articles.author: Amanda Barnett

paras.en: Interstellar probes. Lunar drones. Helicopters on Mars.
paras.zh: 星际探测器。月球无人机。火星上的直升机。

paras.en: When a group of Caltech graduate students and enthusiasts began conducting rocket-propulsion tests in Pasadena’s Arroyo Seco on Oct. 31, 1936, they had no idea that their work marked the inception of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Ninety years later, the lab, now managed by Caltech for NASA, isn’t only celebrating the long line of historic firsts accomplished here; it’s paving the way for many to come.
paras.zh: 1936 年 10 月 31 日，当一群加州理工学院的研究生和爱好者开始在帕萨迪纳的阿罗约塞科进行火箭推进测试时，他们并不知道他们的工作标志着喷气推进实验室的成立。九十年后，这个实验室现在由加州理工学院为 NASA 管理，不仅庆祝这里完成的一系列历史性第一；它为许多人的到来铺平了道路。

paras.en: Initially a contractor for the U.S. Army, JPL launched America’s first satellite, Explorer 1 in 1958. But rather than just orbiting Earth like the Soviet Union’s Sputnik, Explorer 1 became the first spacecraft to conduct science, thanks to an onboard Geiger counter that discovered the protective radiation belts encircling Earth.
paras.zh: 喷气推进实验室最初是美国陆军的承包商，于 1958 年发射了美国第一颗卫星——探索者 1 号。但探索者 1 号并没有像苏联的人造卫星那样只绕地球轨道运行，而是成为第一艘进行科学研究的航天器，这要归功于机载盖革计数器发现了环绕地球的保护性辐射带。

paras.en: The lab joined part of the newly formed NASA that same year. Within six years, in 1964, JPL sent the first U.S. mission to the Moon, Ranger 7. It also went on to lead the first planetary flyby, the first probe to visit all four gas giants, the first infrared telescope, the first rovers to roll on Mars, and the first rotorcraft to fly there, among many other historic milestones.
paras.zh: 同年，该实验室加入了新成立的美国宇航局的一部分。六年之内，即 1964 年，喷气推进实验室向月球发射了第一个美国任务——游侠 7 号。它还完成了第一次行星飞越、第一个访问所有四颗气态巨行星的探测器、第一台红外望远镜、第一架在火星上滚动的漫游车、第一架飞向火星的旋翼机，以及许多其他历史性的里程碑。

paras.en: “Over the course of 90 years, JPL’s first-of-a-kind missions have transformed our understanding of the universe and our place in it,” said Dave Gallagher, JPL’s director since 2025. In 1992, only a couple years after he started as an engineer at the lab, Gallagher led the JPL team that built and tested the Wide-Field and Planetary 2 Camera for NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope, which delivered many of the mission’s most iconic images. “We stand on an extraordinary foundation, and we’re ready to push the boundaries with exciting new missions so that future generations can go even further.”
paras.zh: 自 2025 年起担任喷气推进实验室主任的戴夫·加拉格尔 (Dave Gallagher) 表示：“在 90 年的时间里，喷气推进实验室的首个任务改变了我们对宇宙和我们在宇宙中的地位的理解。”1992 年，加拉格尔在实验室担任工程师仅仅几年后，就领导了喷气推进实验室团队为 NASA 的哈勃太空望远镜建造并测试了宽视场和行星 2 号相机，该相机为该任务提供了许多最先进的相机。标志性图像。 “我们拥有非凡的基础，我们已准备好通过令人兴奋的新使命来突破界限，以便子孙后代能够走得更远。”

paras.en: Aiming for a 2028 launch, the JPL-managed SkyFall mission will deploy three helicopters mid-descent over Mars to search to map hidden ice deposits and analyze weather patterns. Helping advance NASA’s Moon Base, JPL is developing MoonFall, a mission that will land a group of large propulsive drones at the lunar South Pole that same year. Set for a 2027 launch, SunRISE (Sun Radio Interferometer Space Experiment) features six toaster-oven-size satellites that will fly in formation to create a miles-wide radio antenna dish in order to study the Sun’s activity. What it reveals could help make space exploration safer for humans.
paras.zh: 喷气推进实验室管理的 SkyFall 任务计划于 2028 年发射，将部署三架直升机在火星上空降落，搜索隐藏的冰沉积物并分析天气模式。为了帮助推进美国宇航局的月球基地，喷气推进实验室正在开发“MoonFall”，这项任务将于同年在月球南极着陆一组大型推进无人机。 SunRISE（太阳无线电干涉仪空间实验）计划于 2027 年发射，拥有六颗烤面包机大小的卫星，它们将编队飞行，形成一个数英里宽的无线电天线盘，以研究太阳的活动。它所揭示的内容可能有助于使人类的太空探索更加安全。

paras.en: Protecting humanity is also the goal of the asteroid-hunting NEO Surveyor (Near-Earth Object Surveyor) mission, which, managed by JPL, will hunt for potentially hazardous space rocks that other telescopes can’t find. Once an object is spotted, NASA can offer a threat assessment and plan accordingly.
paras.zh: 保护人类也是小行星搜寻 NEO 勘测者（近地天体勘测者）任务的目标，该任务由喷气推进实验室管理，将搜寻其他望远镜无法找到的潜在危险的太空岩石。一旦发现物体，美国宇航局就可以提供威胁评估并制定相应的计划。

paras.en: Closer to home, the same lab that launched the first oceanographic satellite in 1978 is at work on several missions that will offer a deeper reading of Earth’s vital signs. Where one mission will monitor the movement of water by measuring slight changes in gravity, another will study how powerful tropical convective storms form. A third will detail how different types of air pollution affect human health.
paras.zh: 言归正传，1978 年发射第一颗海洋卫星的同一个实验室目前正在执行多项任务，以更深入地了解地球的生命体征。其中一项任务将通过测量重力的微小变化来监测水的运动，另一项任务将研究强大的热带对流风暴是如何形成的。第三部分将详细介绍不同类型的空气污染如何影响人类健康。

paras.en: They add to a fleet of other Earth missions and projects JPL helps lead, including NISAR (NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar) a joint mission with the Indian Space Research Organisation that can pinpoint how Earth’s surface changes in relation to natural disasters. Another, one of a series of instruments called AVIRIS (Airborne Visible Infrared Imaging Spectrometer), can even detect rare Earth elements critical to modern technology.
paras.zh: 它们是 JPL 帮助领导的一系列其他地球任务和项目的补充，其中包括 NISAR（NASA-ISRO 合成孔径雷达），这是与印度空间研究组织的联合任务，可以查明地球表面与自然灾害相关的变化。另一种仪器是 AVIRIS（机载可见红外成像光谱仪）系列仪器之一，甚至可以检测对现代技术至关重要的稀土元素。

paras.en: Flown on airplanes, the AVIRIS sensors were developed at JPL’s Microdevices Laboratory, which invented the “camera on a chip” technology that enables cellphones to take pictures. It’s also where the detectors are being developed for PRIMA (PRobe far-Infrared Mission for Astrophysics), a newly announced NASA mission that will strengthen humanity’s understanding of the universe by studying radiant energy visible only in the far-infrared.
paras.zh: 飞机上飞行的 AVIRIS 传感器是由喷气推进实验室的微型设备实验室开发的，该实验室发明了“芯片上的相机”技术，使手机能够拍照。这里也是为 PRIMA（PRObe 远红外天体物理学任务）开发探测器的地方，这是 NASA 新宣布的一项任务，将通过研究仅在远红外范围内可见的辐射能来加强人类对宇宙的理解。

paras.en: “Bringing together the very best of scientific brilliance and engineering ingenuity from across Caltech and JPL continues to advance NASA’s priorities and empower America’s space leadership,” said Caltech’s president Ray Jayawardhana, who is also a professor of astronomy. “I can only imagine what those Caltech students experimenting with rockets in a little patch of dry riverbed would think if they could to see what Caltech and JPL have accomplished since, and where we’re headed next. Ninety years later, the same spirit of daring is still opening new frontiers and inspiring humanity.”
paras.zh: 加州理工学院院长、天文学教授雷·贾亚瓦德纳 (Ray Jayawardhana) 表示：“将加州理工学院和喷气推进实验室最优秀的科学才华和工程创造力结合在一起，将继续推进 NASA 的优先事项，并增强美国的太空领导地位。” “我只能想象那些在一小片干涸的河床上用火箭进行实验的加州理工学院的学生，如果他们能够看到加州理工学院和喷气推进实验室自那时以来所取得的成就以及我们下一步的发展方向，他们会怎么想。九十年后，同样的大胆精神仍然在开辟新的领域并激励人类。”

paras.en: The 90th anniversary comes just a few weeks before another milestone, when on Nov. 18 Voyager 1 reaches a full light-day — the distance light will travel in 24 hours, which is some 16 billion miles, or 26 billion kilometers — from Earth. Ed Stone led the mission for 50 years, serving as JPL’s director for 10 of them. Stone died in 2024, but the Voyagers are continuing on their journey deeper into interstellar space, a place no other spacecraft have ventured. Turning 50 next year, they rely on NASA’s Deep Space Network (developed by JPL in the Apollo era) to receive commands and send back science data. Stone said that with both Voyagers exploring regions never before visited, “every day is a day of discovery.” The same could be said for JPL.
paras.zh: 就在距离 90 周年纪念日还有几周的时候，另一个里程碑即将到来，即 11 月 18 日，旅行者一号到达一个完整的光日——光在 24 小时内传播的距离，距地球约 160 亿英里或 260 亿公里。埃德·斯通 (Ed Stone) 领导了这项任务 50 年，其中 10 年担任喷气推进实验室的主任。斯通于 2024 年去世，但航海者号仍在继续深入星际空间，这是其他航天器从未涉足过的地方。明年将迎来 50 岁生日，他们依靠 NASA 的深空网络（由阿波罗时代的喷气推进实验室开发）接收命令并发回科学数据。斯通说，两艘航行者号都在探索以前从未去过的地区，“每一天都是发现的一天。”对于喷气推进实验室来说也是如此。

paras.en: Jet Propulsion Laboratory, Pasadena, Calif.
paras.zh: 喷气推进实验室，加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳

articles.title: NASA’s Hubble Charts Path for Roman with Gravitational Lenses

paras.en: A sweeping barred spiral galaxy marks the spot in this image, but the real treasure is the gravitational lens in the lower-right corner, where a distant background galaxy is being magnified and distorted by the gravity of a closer galaxy.
paras.zh: 一个横扫的棒旋星系标志着这幅图像中的位置，但真正的宝藏是右下角的引力透镜，其中一个遥远的背景星系被较近的星系的引力放大和扭曲。

paras.en: This observation is one of many gravitational lensing images taken by NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope in preparation for science with the new Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope.
paras.zh: 这一观测结果是美国宇航局哈勃太空望远镜拍摄的众多引力透镜图像之一，为新的南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜的科学研究做准备。

paras.en: Gravitational lensing occurs when the mass of a foreground object – such as a galaxy – warps spacetime, causing light to bend, distort, and magnify as it passes around the object, similar to a giant lens in space. Lenses like this occur when a precise chance alignment takes place between the foreground and background galaxies, causing light from the background galaxy to curve around the foreground galaxy.
paras.zh: 当前景物体（例如星系）的质量扭曲时空时，就会发生引力透镜效应，导致光线在穿过该物体时弯曲、扭曲和放大，类似于太空中的巨型透镜。当前景星系和背景星系之间发生精确的偶然对准时，就会出现这样的透镜，导致来自背景星系的光在前景星系周围弯曲。

paras.en: In this image, the gravitational lens features a foreground elliptical galaxy that is about 4.5 billion light-years away. That means the light we see from this galaxy now would have first started traveling toward us when our solar system was still forming. The background galaxy is about eight billion light-years away, almost twice as far. It appears as a pair of arcs, one large and very noticeable to the upper left of the foreground galaxy, the other a much smaller, flipped image of the same background galaxy to the lower right. This configuration is called an arc-counterarc pair.
paras.zh: 在这张图像中，引力透镜的前景是一个距离我们约 45 亿光年的椭圆星系。这意味着我们现在从这个星系看到的光将在我们的太阳系仍在形成时首先开始向我们传播。背景星系距离我们大约八十亿光年，几乎是两倍远。它看起来像一对弧线，一个很大，在前景星系的左上方非常明显，另一个是右下角相同背景星系的小得多的翻转图像。这种配置称为弧对弧对。

paras.en: The more massive the foreground galaxy is, the stronger the gravitational lens and the more significantly it bends light. By studying the distortion of the background galaxy, researchers can determine how much mass the foreground galaxy contains. This plays a huge role in the study of dark matter, the mysterious, invisible substance that makes up the majority of mass in the universe. The visible matter is not enough to account for the level of distortion in the background galaxy, which allows researchers to calculate both the mass of the foreground galaxy and how much dark matter it contains.
paras.zh: 前景星系的质量越大，引力透镜就越强，对光线的弯曲也就越明显。通过研究背景星系的扭曲，研究人员可以确定前景星系包含多少质量。这在暗物质的研究中发挥着巨大作用，暗物质是构成宇宙质量大部分的神秘、不可见的物质。可见物质不足以解释背景星系的扭曲程度，这使得研究人员能够计算前景星系的质量及其含有多少暗物质。

paras.en: Almost all of the objects in this image are galaxies, except for a few scattered foreground stars. The barred spiral galaxy in this image – so called because its arms extend from a bar of stars in its center – is about the size of our own Milky Way galaxy, which astronomers think is a barred spiral as well. The tiny spiral to the left of the large spiral may be a satellite galaxy, similar to the Large and Small Magellanic Clouds that orbit the Milky Way.
paras.zh: 除了一些分散的前景恒星外，该图像中几乎所有物体都是星系。这张图片中的棒旋星系——之所以如此命名，是因为它的旋臂从中心的一条恒星延伸出来——大约有我们银河系的大小，天文学家认为它也是一个棒旋星系。大螺旋左侧的小螺旋可能是卫星星系，类似于绕银河系运行的大麦哲伦星云和小麦哲伦星云。

paras.en: Hubble views the cosmos primarily in visible and ultraviolet light with some infrared coverage, and Roman sees mainly infrared wavelengths and some visible light. Hubble can provide high-resolution views of individual objects, while Roman has a much larger field of view conducive to panoramas.
paras.zh: 哈勃主要用可见光和紫外光观察宇宙，并覆盖一些红外光，而罗曼主要用红外波长和一些可见光观察宇宙。哈勃望远镜可以提供单个物体的高分辨率视图，而罗曼则拥有更大的视野，有利于全景图。

paras.en: Images like this offer a glimpse of how Hubble and Roman will work together to build an even more comprehensive picture of the cosmos. This is just one of many gravitational lens images captured by Hubble. Astronomers will use them to analyze gravitational distortions to learn more about dark matter in the foreground galaxies and to lay the groundwork for future Roman observations.
paras.zh: 像这样的图像让我们得以一睹哈勃和罗曼如何共同努力构建更全面的宇宙图景。这只是哈勃望远镜捕捉到的众多引力透镜图像之一。天文学家将利用它们来分析引力扭曲，以更多地了解前景星系中的暗物质，并为未来的罗马观测奠定基础。

paras.en: Hubble can only view these gravitational lenses one at a time, while Roman’s wide view of the sky will provide a greater sample of these lenses. Astronomers are using Hubble’s sharp images to build a computer model to better analyze dark matter-induced distortions. This tool will help astronomers analyze Roman’s large images. Hubble will also follow up on interesting lenses Roman detects.
paras.zh: 哈勃一次只能观察到这些引力透镜，而罗曼的广阔天空视野将提供这些透镜的更多样本。天文学家正在利用哈勃望远镜的清晰图像建立计算机模型，以更好地分析暗物质引起的扭曲。该工具将帮助天文学家分析罗曼的大图像。哈勃望远镜还将跟踪罗曼探测到的有趣镜头。

paras.en: NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center, Greenbelt, MD
paras.zh: 美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心，马里兰州格林贝尔特

articles.title: Migrants paid up to $500 million in smuggling fees on European sea routes

paras.en: Migrants paid up to $500 million in smuggling fees on European sea routes
paras.zh: 移民在欧洲海上航线上支付了高达 5 亿美元的走私费

paras.en: The price tag for smuggling on European sea routes reached up to half a billion dollars last year, the UN Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) and the UN migration office, IOM, reported on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室 (UNODC) 和联合国移民办公室 (IOM) 周三报告称，去年欧洲海上航线的走私价格高达 5 亿美元。

paras.en: - Total fees paid to smugglers on sea routes to Europe reached between $388 and $509 million in 2025: UNODC estimates
paras.zh: - 毒品和犯罪问题办公室估计，到 2025 年，向欧洲海上航线走私者支付的费用总额将达到 388 至 5.09 亿美元

paras.en: - The busiest smuggling corridor was the Central Mediterranean route, where 84,000 to 100,400 people attempted a crossing
paras.zh: - 最繁忙的走私走廊是地中海中部航线，有 84,000 至 100,400 人试图过境

paras.en: Almost half of migrants trying to get smuggled into Italy or Malta from North Africa or Türkiye reported paying fees of over $7,500 each, an IOM survey found.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织的一项调查发现，近一半试图从北非或土耳其偷渡到意大利或马耳他的移民表示，每人支付的费用超过 7,500 美元。

paras.en: Other routes are cheaper than this busy Central Mediterranean corridor.
paras.zh: 其他航线比这条繁忙的地中海中部走廊便宜。

paras.en: Smugglers received as little as $170 per person for transport across the Northwest African Atlantic route, a dangerous maritime path where people travel in open boats from the coasts of Northwest Africa to Spain’s Canary Islands.
paras.zh: 走私者通过西北非大西洋航线的运输每人仅获得 170 美元，这是一条危险的海上路径，人们乘坐敞篷船从西北非海岸前往西班牙加那利群岛。

paras.en: The report found that around 190,000 to 209,000 people were smuggled along the four main sea routes to Europe in 2025.
paras.zh: 报告发现，2025年约有19万至20.9万人沿着4条主要海上航线被偷运至欧洲。

paras.en: The busiest smuggling route was the Central Mediterranean route (84,000 to 100,400 people), followed by the Eastern Mediterranean (48,400 to 51,300), which runs from Türkiye, Libya and the Middle East towards Greece, Cyprus and Bulgaria.
paras.zh: 最繁忙的走私路线是中地中海路线（84,000至100,400人），其次是东地中海路线（48,400至51,300人），从土耳其、利比亚和中东通往希腊、塞浦路斯和保加利亚。

paras.en: The Northwest African Atlantic came third, with 33,000 people smuggled, followed lastly by the Western Mediterranean route (24,500) which connects North and West Africa to Spain.
paras.zh: 西北非大西洋航线排名第三，有 33,000 人被偷运，最后是连接北非和西非与西班牙的西地中海航线（24,500 人）。

paras.en: Many of the people who paid these fees to get smuggled to Europe did not arrive at the destination, according to the UN.
paras.zh: 据联合国称，许多支付这些费用偷渡到欧洲的人并没有到达目的地。

paras.en: Among all those departing on the sea routes in 2025, 3,404 lost their lives or were reported missing.
paras.zh: 2025年所有从海上出发的人中，有3,404人丧生或失踪。

paras.en: Another 104,200 people were intercepted at sea and returned.
paras.zh: 另有10.42万人在海上被拦截并返回。

paras.en: “Perpetrators commit smuggling offences to make a profit,” UNODC said. But, the agency stressed that not all those attempting irregular entry on sea routes are smuggled.
paras.zh: 毒品和犯罪问题办公室表示：“犯罪者实施走私犯罪是为了牟利。”但是，该机构强调，并非所有试图通过海上航线非法入境的人都是走私的。

paras.en: The UN office estimates that 72 to 86 per cent of people departing on the Central Mediterranean route in 2025 were smuggled, along with 73 to 83 per cent of people on the Northwest African Atlantic route.
paras.zh: 联合国办公室估计，到 2025 年，沿地中海中部航线出发的人员中有 72% 至 86% 被偷渡，而沿西北非大西洋航线出发的人员则有 73% 至 83%。

paras.en: On the Western Mediterranean route, 57 to 90 per cent were smuggled, and on the Eastern Mediterranean route, it oscillated between 75 and 90 per cent.
paras.zh: 在西地中海航线上，57％至90％是走私的，在东地中海航线上，这一比例在75％至90％之间波动。

articles.title: ‘Connect the dots’ between street protests and global turmoil, urges Guterres

paras.en: ‘Connect the dots’ between street protests and global turmoil, urges Guterres
paras.zh: 古特雷斯敦促“连接街头抗议和全球动荡之间的点”

paras.en: Speaking to reporters in New York ahead of a visit to Egypt, António Guterres addressed growing public discontent in Europe and beyond, as people have taken to the streets to express frustration over the rising cost of living.
paras.zh: 安东尼奥·古特雷斯在访问埃及之前在纽约接受记者采访时谈到了欧洲及其他地区日益增长的公众不满情绪，因为人们走上街头表达对生活成本上涨的不满。

paras.en: “Everywhere, pressures are building over the price of food, fuel and other basics,” he said. “Interest rates are up – for people and countries. And for young people, the promise of a better future is slipping further out of reach.”
paras.zh: “在任何地方，食品、燃料和其他基本物资的价格压力都在增加，”他说。 “对于人民和国家来说，利率都在上升。而对于年轻人来说，更美好未来的承诺正变得更加遥不可及。”

paras.en: While Mr. Guterres clearly denounced the violence and destruction seen during days of protests in France, Italy and elsewhere – stressing that those responsible for criminal activities must be held accountable – he said legitimate grievances of the protestors cannot be overlooked.
paras.zh: 虽然古特雷斯明确谴责了法国、意大利和其他地区几天抗议活动中发生的暴力和破坏行为，强调必须追究犯罪活动责任人的责任，但他表示，抗议者的合理不满不容忽视。

paras.en: “We must connect the dots and better understand how deeply linked those very real and peacefully expressed grievances are to the wider turmoil in our world,” he told journalists.
paras.zh: 他对记者说：“我们必须把这些点联系起来，更好地理解这些非常真实且和平表达的不满与我们世界更广泛的动荡有多么紧密的联系。”

paras.en: He said that today, conflicts are not only intensifying but expanding, which he likened to the El Niño climate phenomenon that occurs in one region but disrupts weather patterns and upends lives thousands of kilometres away.
paras.zh: 他说，今天，冲突不仅在加剧，而且在扩大，他将这比作厄尔尼诺气候现象，发生在一个地区，但却扰乱了天气模式，颠覆了数千公里之外的生活。

paras.en: “We are now witnessing an El Niño of war,” he warned, referring to the extreme weather pattern which threatens to upend the global climate in the coming months. “Conflict is feeding conflict. And the consequences are travelling farther and faster.”
paras.zh: 他警告说：“我们现在正在目睹一场厄尔尼诺战争。”他指的是未来几个月可能颠覆全球气候的极端天气模式。 “冲突正在助长冲突。其后果传播得更远、更快。”

paras.en: The Secretary-General pointed to the Middle East, Ukraine and Sudan, where civilians and civilian infrastructure – homes, hospitals, schools, airports, power stations and energy facilities – are deliberately coming under fire.
paras.zh: 秘书长指出，在中东、乌克兰和苏丹，平民和民用基础设施——住宅、医院、学校、机场、发电站和能源设施——遭到蓄意攻击。

paras.en: “But the consequences do not stop in the battle zones,” he continued, as war disrupts energy markets, shipping, supply chains and financial systems.
paras.zh: “但后果并不止于战区，”他继续说道，因为战争扰乱了能源市场、航运、供应链和金融体系。

paras.en: He said these shocks are hitting a world that was already profoundly unequal – “where some can absorb higher prices, while others must choose between food and heat”.
paras.zh: 他表示，这些冲击正在冲击一个本来就很不平等的世界——“一些人可以承受更高的价格，而另一些人则必须在食物和取暖之间做出选择”。

paras.en: Moreover, while some countries can borrow more cheaply to protect their people, others must choose between paying off debt and investing in health, education and the future.
paras.zh: 此外，虽然一些国家可以更便宜地借贷来保护本国人民，但其他国家则必须在偿还债务和投资于健康、教育和未来之间做出选择。

paras.en: “War does not create all these inequalities,” he said. “But it feeds and exploits them – and exposes the fundamental unfairness of an economic system that forces those with the least to absorb the greatest shocks.”
paras.zh: “战争不会造成所有这些不平等，”他说。 “但它滋养和剥削了他们 — — 并暴露了经济体系的根本不公平，迫使那些最穷的人承受最大的冲击。”

paras.en: The Secretary-General insisted that “the answer cannot be an ever-widening circle of confrontation, including in the Middle East”. Highlighting the situation in Yemen, he voiced concern over escalation around the city of Taiz and elsewhere and continued Houthi attacks against civilian targets in Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 秘书长坚称，“答案不能是不断扩大的对抗圈，包括在中东”。他强调了也门的局势，对塔伊兹市和其他地方的局势升级以及胡塞武装继续袭击沙特阿拉伯的平民目标表示担忧。

paras.en: The violence is inflicting immense suffering on civilians, adding to regional tensions and increasing displacement and humanitarian needs, he said, appealing for restraint and political dialogue.
paras.zh: 他说，暴力事件给平民造成巨大痛苦，加剧了地区紧张局势，增加了流离失所和人道主义需求，呼吁各方保持克制和政治对话。

paras.en: Turning to the Occupied Palestinian Territory, he noted that Israel is still severely restricting essential aid ahead of the winter season. Difficulties also persist around implementing the UN Security Council-backed Comprehensive Plan to End the Gaza Conflict.
paras.zh: 谈到巴勒斯坦被占领土，他指出，以色列在冬季到来之前仍在严格限制基本援助。实施联合国安理会支持的结束加沙冲突的全面计划也仍然存在困难。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Palestinians in the occupied West Bank continue to suffer daily attacks by Israeli settlers, and journalists and diplomats are being attacked.
paras.zh: 与此同时，被占领的约旦河西岸的巴勒斯坦人继续遭受以色列定居者的日常袭击，记者和外交官也受到袭击。

paras.en: He appealed to donors to step up contributions to the UN World Food Programme (WFP) which urgently requires $450 million for its operations in Gaza and the West Bank for the next six months.
paras.zh: 他呼吁捐助者增加对联合国世界粮食计划署（粮食计划署）的捐款，该计划迫切需要 4.5 亿美元用于其未来六个月在加沙和西岸的行动。

paras.en: He also reiterated the need for a two-State solution between Israelis and Palestinians.
paras.zh: 他还重申以色列和巴勒斯坦之间需要实现两国解决方案。

paras.en: The Secretary-General said that his message in Egypt will focus on stopping the widening of war, protecting civilians and creating the political space for diplomacy and peace.
paras.zh: 秘书长表示，他在埃及的信息将集中于制止战争扩大、保护平民以及为外交与和平创造政治空间。

paras.en: “People everywhere want security. They want dignity. They want governments and international institutions to deliver,” he concluded.
paras.zh: “世界各地的人们都想要安全。他们想要尊严。他们希望政府和国际机构能够兑现承诺，”他总结道。

paras.en: “That means tackling the inequalities that divide societies – and stopping the conflicts that are multiplying human suffering, driving prices higher, draining resources from development, and pushing an already unequal world further apart.”
paras.zh: “这意味着解决导致社会分裂的不平等问题，并制止那些加剧人类苦难、推高物价、耗尽发展资源、使本已不平等的世界进一步分化的冲突。”

articles.title: DR Congo: Ebola responders under pressure as outbreak expands

paras.en: DR Congo: Ebola responders under pressure as outbreak expands
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国：埃博拉疫情扩大，应对人员面临压力

paras.en: As the deadly Ebola disease outbreak reached an eighth province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), investigators pursued all leads on Thursday to assess the risk of the disease spreading in Nigeria.
paras.zh: 随着致命的埃博拉疫情蔓延到刚果民主共和国（DRC）的第八个省份，调查人员于周四追踪所有线索，以评估该疾病在尼日利亚传播的风险。

paras.en: Authorities in Abuja confirmed their first case of infection in an individual arriving from Uganda, which borders the worst-hit provinces in DRC.
paras.zh: 阿布贾当局确认了首例来自乌干达的感染病例，乌干达与刚果民主共和国受灾最严重的省份接壤。

paras.en: “The source of exposure is still not known and the travel history of the patient is being pieced together now in terms of her movement from Uganda up to Nigeria,” said Dr Patrick Otim, from the UN World Health Organization (WHO)’s Emergency Response programme, in an online update.
paras.zh: 联合国世界卫生组织（WHO）紧急响应项目的帕特里克·奥蒂姆（Patrick Otim）博士在一份在线更新中表示：“暴露来源仍不清楚，目前正在根据该患者从乌干达到尼日利亚的旅行史来拼凑。”

paras.en: “This is rapidly evolving. As we get more information, we’ll try to determine where she was exposed. And then it’s at that point where we can say whether there is any transmission happening.”
paras.zh: “情况正在迅速发展。随着我们获得更多信息，我们将尝试确定她是在哪里暴露的。然后到那时我们就可以判断是否有任何传播发生。”

paras.en: Nigeria is the fifth country this year after DRC, France, Uganda and Kenya to confirm the presence of Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚是今年继刚果民主共和国、法国、乌干达和肯尼亚之后第五个确认存在由本迪布焦病毒引起的埃博拉疾病的国家。

paras.en: The original DRC outbreak was declared in mid-May where it has led to more than 4,600 deaths and a total of 9,552 confirmed infections. Around six in 10 of these deaths have occurred outside health centres, indicating the continuing difficulty of halting community transmission.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国最初的疫情爆发于 5 月中旬，已导致 4,600 多人死亡，总共有 9,552 人确诊感染。其中约十分之六的死亡发生在卫生中心之外，这表明阻止社区传播仍然存在困难。

paras.en: The latest DRC province to confirm infections is Nord Ubangi, which borders Central African Republic, where ongoing armed violence continues to uproot thousands of people, increasing the difficulty of halting transmission.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国最新确诊感染的省份是北乌班吉省，该省与中非共和国接壤，那里持续的武装暴力继续导致数千人流离失所，增加了阻止传播的难度。

paras.en: The Kenyan authorities have reported a total of nine cases of infection including one death earlier this month, of a Kenyan national who had been working in DRC before flying back to Nairobi via Entebbe, Uganda.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚当局本月早些时候报告了总共九例感染病例，其中一例死亡，感染者是一名肯尼亚国民，该国民曾在刚果民主共和国工作，然后经乌干达恩德培飞回内罗毕。

paras.en: Uganda previously recorded two deaths and 20 confirmed cases of infection, before officially declaring the Ebola threat over at the end of August.
paras.zh: 乌干达此前记录了 2 例死亡和 20 例确诊感染病例，并于 8 月底正式宣布埃博拉威胁结束。

paras.en: “Immediately after [the death of the Kenyan patient], we commenced on contact tracing,” said Dr Patrick Amoth, Director General of Kenya’s Ministry of Health, adding that 135 contacts with the deceased patient have been traced “and we have been able to account for them, 100 per cent”.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚卫生部总干事帕特里克·阿莫斯博士表示：“[肯尼亚患者死亡]后，我们立即开始追踪接触者。”他补充说，已追踪到 135 名与已故患者的接触者，“我们已经能够 100% 地查清他们的情况”。

paras.en: According to the Nigerian authorities, the patient developed symptoms on 7 October and sought care at a clinic before being hospitalised 48 hours later.
paras.zh: 据尼日利亚当局称，该患者于 10 月 7 日出现症状，前往诊所寻求治疗，48 小时后住院。

paras.en: Genetic sequencing of the infection is underway to confirm that it is the same Ebola Bundibugyo disease circulating inside DRC. More than 40 close contacts have been identified to date, WHO has said.
paras.zh: 正在对感染进行基因测序，以确认它与刚果民主共和国境内流行的埃博拉本迪布焦疾病相同。世卫组织表示，迄今为止已确定了 40 多名密切接触者。

paras.en: “All the Infection Prevention and Control measures have been put in place to try to ensure that the risk of amplification of transmission within the health facilities is limited,” said WHO’s Dr Otim.
paras.zh: 世卫组织的奥蒂姆博士说：“所有感染预防和控制措施都已到位，以努力确保卫生设施内传播扩大的风险受到限制。”

paras.en: “The message is being passed to all the private facilities within [Abuja] and also all the other health facilities within the country to step up.”
paras.zh: “这一信息正在传递给[阿布贾]内的所有私人机构以及该国境内的所有其他医疗机构，要求他们加强行动。”

paras.en: Inside DRC, in addition to the essential work of contact tracing, vaccination research is ongoing using Ervebo vaccine, which was originally designed for and is effective against Ebola disease caused by Zaire virus, in a bid to find out if it provides protection against Ebola Bundibugyo.
paras.zh: 在刚果民主共和国境内，除了接触者追踪的基本工作外，正在使用 Ervebo 疫苗进行疫苗接种研究，该疫苗最初是为扎伊尔病毒引起的埃博拉疾病设计的，并且对扎伊尔病毒引起的埃博拉疾病有效，以查明它是否能提供针对埃博拉本迪布焦的保护。

paras.en: “We still do not have preliminary data yet as to whether there is…sufficient cross-protection between the Ervebo vaccine – which is for the Zaire species – and the Bundibugyo species. As soon as we get it, we'll be able to share that information,” Dr Otim told journalists.
paras.zh: “我们仍然没有关于 Ervebo 疫苗（针对扎伊尔物种）和 Bundibugyo 物种之间是否存在……足够的交叉保护的初步数据。一旦我们获得数据，我们将能够分享该信息，”奥蒂姆博士告诉记者。

paras.en: Responding to questions about the Ebola response inside DRC, the UN health agency highlighted ongoing transmission of infection and reports last week of 15 deaths per day in the rural commune of Mangina in Beni territory, North Kivu province.
paras.zh: 在回答有关刚果民主共和国境内埃博拉应对措施的问题时，联合国卫生机构强调了感染的持续传播，并报告上周北基伍省贝尼县曼吉纳农村公社每天有 15 人死亡。

paras.en: After negotiating access, an emergency response team from WHO arrived there two weeks ago and started working with impacted communities.
paras.zh: 在就进入事宜进行谈判后，世卫组织的一个应急小组于两周前抵达那里，并开始与受影响的社区合作。

paras.en: “There was a lot of community preoccupation and community resistance in the beginning to receive help, it’s a very highly insecure area,” said Dr Anne Ancia, WHO Country Representative in DRC.
paras.zh: “在开始接受帮助时，社区存在很多关注和抵制，这是一个非常不安全的地区，”世卫组织驻刚果民主共和国国家代表 Anne Ancia 博士说。

paras.en: “Ebola does not wait. It follows movement, exploits gaps and tests the strength of our health systems,” said Dr Mohamed Janabi, Regional Director for WHO Africa, underscoring that the virus is “no longer confined to one place, it is a regional concern”.
paras.zh: 世卫组织非洲区域主任穆罕默德·贾纳比博士说：“埃博拉病毒不会等待。它会跟随运动，利用差距并测试我们卫生系统的实力。”他强调该病毒“不再局限于一个地方，而是一个区域性问题”。

paras.en: He added: “We must reach people earlier, bring safe care closer and strengthen trust before fear becomes a barrier to survival. We also know that success is possible where surveillance is strong, where contacts are found and followed.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“在恐惧成为生存障碍之前，我们必须更早地接触到人们，拉近安全护理的距离并加强信任。我们还知道，只要监控有力、发现并追踪接触者，就有可能取得成功。”

articles.title: Carrick will be in charge for 'pivotal' Bournemouth game despite growing concerns

paras.en: Man Utd boss Michael Carrick remaining in charge vs Bournemouth amid growing concerns at Old Trafford
paras.zh: 由于老特拉福德球场的担忧日益加剧，曼联主帅迈克尔·卡里克仍负责对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛

paras.en: Watch Man Utd vs Bournemouth in the Premier League on Sunday from 12.30pm on Sky Sports Main Event; kick-off 2pm; Man Utd without a win in seven matches; Bruno Fernandes likely to avoid punishment for criticism of coach's tactics after thrashing in Como
paras.zh: 周日中午 12 点 30 分，在天空体育主赛事中观看曼联对阵伯恩茅斯的英超联赛；下午2点开始；曼联七场比赛未尝一胜；布鲁诺·费尔南德斯在科莫惨败后可能会避免因批评教练战术而受到的惩罚

paras.en: Michael Carrick will be in charge of Manchester United against Bournemouth on Sunday but there is growing concern among club bosses about the team's poor run of form.
paras.zh: 迈克尔·卡里克将在周日对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中执教曼联，但俱乐部老板们越来越担心球队糟糕的表现。

paras.en: There is a feeling both inside and outside Old Trafford that Sunday's Premier League match - live on Sky Sports - could be pivotal in determining Carrick's future.
paras.zh: 老特拉福德球场内外都有一种感觉，天空体育直播的周日英超比赛可能对决定卡里克的未来至关重要。

paras.en: No decision has been taken about plans beyond Sunday as things stand following Wednesday's 4-1 defeat to Como in the Champions League.
paras.zh: 就周三欧冠联赛1-4输给科莫后的情况来看，周日之后的计划尚未做出任何决定。

paras.en: Bruno Fernandes will not be stripped of the captaincy in light of his criticism of the United coaching staff and is unlikely to face any punishment for his comments after the crushing defeat in Italy.
paras.zh: 鉴于布鲁诺·费尔南德斯对曼联教练组的批评，他不会被剥夺队长职务，而且在意大利惨败后也不太可能因他的言论而受到任何惩罚。

paras.en: - 'They're not special anymore' - How Man Utd reached their latest low
paras.zh: - “他们不再特别了” - 曼联是如何达到最新低点的

paras.en: - Who was right about Man Utd tactics: Carrick or Fernandes?
paras.zh: - 对于曼联的战术，卡里克和费尔南德斯谁是正确的？

paras.en: - Got Sky? Watch Premier League games LIVE on your phone📱
paras.zh: - 有天空吗？在手机上观看英超联赛直播📱

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream PL games with no contract📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 PL 比赛📺

paras.en: There is a feeling within the Carrington training ground that the performance and result in the Champions League on Wednesday night was unacceptable - as Carrick himself said after the match.
paras.zh: 卡林顿训练场内有一种感觉，周三晚上欧冠的表现和结果是不可接受的——正如卡里克本人赛后所说。

paras.en: There is sympathy for Carrick when it comes to the injury problems he is dealing with, and many United supporters agreed with Lisandro Martinez's outspoken views of last week when he said the squad is not strong enough to compete at the top level. Martinez levelled the criticism at the United hierarchy, not the head coach.
paras.zh: 当谈到卡里克正在处理的伤病问题时，人们对他表示同情，许多曼联支持者也同意利桑德罗·马丁内斯上周直言不讳的观点，当时他说球队不够强大，无法参加顶级比赛。马丁内斯将批评归咎于曼联高层，而不是主教练。

paras.en: But it is clear United's bosses feel that, despite those factors, the squad is stronger than it was last season when Carrick secured a third-placed Premier League finish, and so far this season the team has woefully underperformed.
paras.zh: 但很明显，曼联的老板们认为，尽管有这些因素，球队的阵容比上赛季卡里克获得英超第三名的时候要强大，而本赛季到目前为止，球队的表现却严重不佳。

paras.en: United's directors assessed and interviewed a host of other candidates in January as part of their due diligence before appointing Carrick, and while it is thought there has been no formal contact with those candidates recently, such discussions cannot be ruled out in the coming days.
paras.zh: 作为任命卡里克之前尽职调查的一部分，曼联董事在一月份评估并采访了许多其他候选人，虽然人们认为最近没有与这些候选人进行正式接触，但不能排除在未来几天内进行此类讨论。

paras.en: Fernandes unlikely to be punished for criticism of staff
paras.zh: 费尔南德斯不太可能因批评员工而受到惩罚

paras.en: Fernandes will not be stripped of the Manchester United captaincy and is unlikely to be disciplined by the club following his criticism of the coaching staff and the tactics in the 4-1 defeat to Como.
paras.zh: 费尔南德斯不会被剥夺曼联队长职务，也不太可能受到俱乐部的纪律处分，因为他在1-4输给科莫的比赛中批评了教练组和战术。

paras.en: Sky Sports News has been told that, while there is disappointment within the club with what last season's PFA Player of the Year said post-match, the wider feeling is that he was voicing an understandable frustration and anger at the manner of the defeat.
paras.zh: 天空体育新闻获悉，虽然俱乐部内部对上赛季PFA年度最佳球员赛后的言论感到失望，但更广泛的感觉是，他对失败的方式表达了可以理解的沮丧和愤怒。

paras.en: A string of ex-professionals have lined up to criticise Fernandes, with Jamie Carragher calling him "an absolute disgrace".
paras.zh: 一系列前职业球员排队批评费尔南德斯，杰米·卡拉格称他“绝对是耻辱”。

paras.en: In his own post-match news conference, head coach Carrick responded to his captain's comments by saying: "If you don't run back, you ain't going to win."
paras.zh: 在赛后新闻发布会上，主教练卡里克回应了队长的评论说：“如果你不跑回来，你就不会赢。”

paras.en: Asked by TNT Sports about a lack of cohesion in United's work out of possession, Fernandes defended his team-mates and put the blame on Carrick and his coaches on Wednesday night.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，当被TNT体育问及曼联在控球时缺乏凝聚力时，费尔南德斯为他的队友辩护，并将责任归咎于卡里克和他的教练。

paras.en: "It's a decision from the staff to not press man-to-man, and sometimes leave a little space in behind and try to get the ball in the first moment, to wait for them, to give them the ball," he said.
paras.zh: “这是工作人员的决定，不进行盯人逼抢，有时在身后留出一点空间，试图在第一时间拿到球，等待他们，把球交给他们，”他说。

paras.en: "But sometimes when you give too much the ball to these teams they get confident, they have so many bodies behind the ball that make you run a lot, make people get frustrated, and then obviously when you recover the ball the legs are, and the brain, much more difficult to make it work."
paras.zh: “但有时候，当你给这些球队太多的球权时，他们就会变得自信，他们在球后面有这么多的身体，这会让你跑很多，让人们感到沮丧，然后很明显，当你收回球时，腿和大脑就更难以发挥作用。”

paras.en: Was that tactical idea what cost Man Utd in Como? "That's on the manager and on the staff to see it, it's not on me," said Fernandes.
paras.zh: 这种战术理念是曼联在科莫付出代价的原因吗？费尔南德斯说：“这是主教练和工作人员的责任，而不是我的责任。”

paras.en: "I just said, I think sometimes we have to be more brave on the pressure, trying to take a risk of getting that press very high and making them uncomfortable - as they did to us."
paras.zh: “我只是说，我认为有时我们必须更加勇敢地应对压力，尝试冒让压力非常大并让他们感到不舒服的风险 - 就像他们对我们所做的那样。”

paras.en: Carra calls Fernandes comments 'a disgrace'
paras.zh: 卡拉称费尔南德斯的言论是“耻辱”

paras.en: Carragher has criticised Fernandes for questioning Man Utd's tactics following their defeat to Como, but believes that it could be the end of the line for Carrick.
paras.zh: 卡拉格批评费尔南德斯在输给科莫后质疑曼联的战术，但他认为这可能是卡里克的终结。

paras.en: "We said Lisandro Martinez was bang out of order for calling out the hierarchy," Carragher said on CBS Sports.
paras.zh: “我们说利桑德罗·马丁内斯喊出等级制度是不合常理的，”卡拉格在哥伦比亚广播公司体育节目中说道。

paras.en: "For Bruno Fernandes to do that, it is a disgrace. Last season he was Player of the Year. That was due to Michael Carrick coming in as manager. He wouldn't have got that award without Carrick. He put him back in his right position.
paras.zh: “对于布鲁诺·费尔南德斯来说，这样做是一种耻辱。上赛季他获得了年度最佳球员，这是因为迈克尔·卡里克成为了主教练。如果没有卡里克，他就不会获得这个奖项。他让他回到了正确的位置。”

paras.en: "His attitude and the way he goes about things, it is not right at all. He has reacted like that because he was brought off and he has been embarrassed tonight by the manager.
paras.zh: “他的态度和做事的方式根本不对。他有这样的反应是因为他被换下场，今晚他被主教练羞辱了。”

paras.en: "When he talks about pressing, whether it is man-to-man or zonal, for years, Bruno Fernandes has meant Man Utd can't press.
paras.zh: “多年来，当布鲁诺·费尔南德斯谈到压迫时，无论是人盯人还是区域压迫，他的意思是曼联不能压迫。

paras.en: "He runs all over the place like a kid in the school yard for the supporters. They all think he's working hard, he is not. He is killing the rest of the team by doing it.
paras.zh: “他像一个在校园里的孩子一样为球迷们跑来跑去。他们都认为他很努力，但事实并非如此。他这样做正在杀死球队的其他成员。”

paras.en: "He is not playing in a successful era at Manchester United but years ago there was a captain called Bryan Robson, one of the greatest players to ever play for Man Utd.
paras.zh: “他在曼联踢球的时代并不成功，但几年前有一位名叫布莱恩·罗布森的队长，他是曼联有史以来最伟大的球员之一。

paras.en: "He didn't play for teams that won leagues or European cups every year. He is still seen as one of the greatest players to play for the club. He never threw a manager or the players under the bus. He kept fighting for Man Utd.
paras.zh: “他并没有为每年赢得联赛或欧洲杯的球队效力。他仍然被视为俱乐部最伟大的球员之一。他从来没有抛弃主教练或球员。他一直在为曼联而战。”

paras.en: "Watching him [Bruno] play every week, throwing his arms up at players constantly, it is a disgrace that he has called out the manager considering how he has performed this season on the pitch. Awful attitude and not what a Manchester United captain should be.
paras.zh: “每周都会看他（布鲁诺）踢球，不断地向球员举起双臂，考虑到他本赛季在球场上的表现，他竟然对主教练大喊大叫，这是一种耻辱。态度很糟糕，不是曼联队长应该有的样子。”

paras.en: "How many managers has he had? Every single manager at Man Utd has not had an identity?
paras.zh: “他有多少位主帅？曼联的每一位主帅都没有身份？

paras.en: "[Como boss] Cesc Fabregas, I think he is the best young thing in managerial terms, but Man Utd is rotten from top to bottom. Everything about the club.
paras.zh: “[科莫主帅]法布雷加斯，我认为他是管理方面最优秀的年轻人，但曼联从上到下都腐烂了。关于俱乐部的一切。

paras.en: "This can't go on for a club of this stature. I am glad Michael Carrick came out and said that about Bruno Fernandes. That they don't run, because they don't run.
paras.zh: “对于这样一个地位的俱乐部来说，这种情况不能再继续下去。我很高兴迈克尔·卡里克站出来对布鲁诺·费尔南德斯说了这样的话。他们不逃跑，因为他们不逃跑。”

paras.en: "I am delighted he brought him off and delighted he had a pop back at him."
paras.zh: “我很高兴他把他带下场，也很高兴他能反击他。”

articles.title: Sherrock set to face Littler for first time with £501,000 on the line

paras.en: Fallon Sherrock set to face Luke Littler for first time over one leg with £501,000 on the line in special event
paras.zh: 法伦·谢洛克（Fallon Sherrock）将在特别赛事中首次单腿对阵卢克·利特勒（Luke Littler），奖金高达 501,000 英镑

paras.en: Fallon Sherrock has been named in the 24-player field that will try to beat Luke Littler in Manchester next Friday; the first player to beat two-time world champion Littler in a one leg shootout will win £501,000
paras.zh: 法伦·舍洛克 (Fallon Sherrock) 已入选 24 名球员名单，下周五将在曼彻斯特击败卢克·利特勒 (Luke Littler)；第一位在单腿点球大战中击败两届世界冠军利特勒的球员将赢得 501,000 英镑

paras.en: Fallon Sherrock is set to face Luke Littler for the first time in a special event taking place at the end of this month - 'Beat Luke Littler'.
paras.zh: 法伦·夏洛克将在本月底举行的一场特别赛事“​​击败卢克·利特勒”中首次对阵卢克·利特勒。

paras.en: Sherrock is one of 24 contestants who could go head-to-head with Littler over one leg in Manchester Central next Friday, with the first player to beat Littler winning £501,000.
paras.zh: 舍洛克是下周五在曼彻斯特市中心与利特勒单腿正面交锋的 24 名参赛者之一，第一位击败利特勒的选手赢得了 501,000 英镑。

paras.en: Sherrock is the most high-profile player while reigning world youth champion Mitchell Lawrie is also in the field along with regular members of the public who play darts socially.
paras.zh: 舍洛克 (Sherrock) 是最受瞩目的选手，而卫冕世界青年冠军米切尔·劳里 (Mitchell Lawrie) 以及经常在社交场合玩飞镖的公众也参加了比赛。

paras.en: - Luke Humphries withdraws from European Championship
paras.zh: - 卢克·汉弗里斯退出欧洲锦标赛

paras.en: - Latest Sky Sports deals or stream no contract with NOW
paras.zh: - 最新的天空体育交易或与 NOW 签订无合同

paras.en: - Darts in 2026: Full tournament schedule and winners
paras.zh: - 2026 年飞镖：完整比赛日程和获胜者

paras.en: Littler said: "There's half a million quid up for grabs, I won't be going easy at all!
paras.zh: 利特勒说：“有五十万英镑可供争夺，我一点也不轻松！

paras.en: "I'll be wanting to beat everyone who comes up. Maybe the first few legs could be a bit nervy, but once I get going then I don't think anyone will stop me."
paras.zh: “我会想击败所有上来的人。也许前几场比赛可能会有点紧张，但一旦我开始前进，我认为没有人会阻止我。”

paras.en: Sherrock has won just one title in the PDC Women's Series this year as Beau Greaves continues to dominate the circuit.
paras.zh: Sherrock 今年在 PDC 女子系列赛中只赢得了一项冠军，而 Beau Greaves 继续统治着赛道。

paras.en: But, 'The Queen of the Palace' has already qualified for the World Championship in December as she was in the top five in the Women's Series with Greaves, Lisa Ashton, Gemmy Hayter and Vicky Pruim also qualifying.
paras.zh: 但是，“宫廷女王”已经获得了参加 12 月世界锦标赛的资格，因为她在女子系列赛中进入了前五名，格里夫斯、丽莎·阿什顿、杰米·海特和维琪·普鲁姆也获得了资格。

paras.en: Next Friday's exhibition event in Manchester will be broadcast on Netflix and saw thousands of amateur darts players aged 12 and over put their skills to the test in a rigorous three-stage qualification process at Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park earlier this month.
paras.zh: 下周五在曼彻斯特举行的表演赛将在 Netflix 上直播，本月早些时候，数千名 12 岁及以上的业余飞镖运动员在伊丽莎白女王奥林匹克公园进行了严格的三阶段资格赛，检验了自己的技能。

paras.en: They had to check out 501 in 24 darts or fewer before the reality TV element of the competition came into play, with successful players then interviewed by the show's production team.
paras.zh: 在比赛的电视真人秀元素开始发挥作用之前，他们必须用 24 支或更少的飞镖检查 501 次，成功的选手随后接受节目制作团队的采访。

paras.en: The final stage required them to impress a PDC judging panel led by 16-time world champion Phil Taylor, who assessed their darting prowess and decided whether they had the ability to give Littler a realistic challenge in the event.
paras.zh: 最后阶段要求他们给由 16 次世界冠军菲尔·泰勒 (Phil Taylor) 领导的 PDC 评审团留下深刻印象，评审团评估了他们的飞镖实力，并决定他们是否有能力在比赛中给利特勒带来现实的挑战。

paras.en: "The event is great to be honest, it gives people the opportunity to change their lives," said Taylor.
paras.zh: “说实话，这个活动很棒，它给了人们改变生活的机会，”泰勒说。

paras.en: "It's a Rocky Balboa kind of fairytale really. It will boost the profile of darts even further. Any player who can throw a 12-dart leg has a great chance, but it's also about bottle as well as ability, so we'll see."

articles.title: Sri Lanka chase down 430 to stun England after Brook makes ODI history

paras.en: Sri Lanka chase down 430 to stun England in epic ODI tri-series clash despite Harry Brook's historic double century
paras.zh: 尽管哈里布鲁克取得了历史性的双世纪，斯里兰卡还是在史诗般的ODI三系列赛中以430的比分击败了英格兰

paras.en: Janith Liyanage hit a maximum off the penultimate delivery to see Sri Lanka chase down 430 in reply to England's 429-4; Harry Brook fired England's first double hundred in ODI history and overtook Ben Stokes' record score before their stunning defeat
paras.zh: 贾尼斯·利亚纳奇(Janith Liyanage)在倒数第二次投篮中打出了最高分，斯里兰卡队追至430分，回应了英格兰队的429-4；哈里·布鲁克 (Harry Brook) 打进了英格兰队 ODI 历史上的第一个双百，并在惨败之前超越了本·斯托克斯 (Ben Stokes) 创下的得分纪录

paras.en: Sri Lanka produced the second-highest successful chase in ODI history to complete an extraordinary two-wicket win over England in their high-scoring tri-series clash.
paras.zh: 斯里兰卡队创造了 ODI 历史上第二高的追击成功率，在高分三连赛中以两柱门战胜了英格兰队。

paras.en: Harry Brook smashed 202 from just 116 deliveries - the fastest double-hundred in ODI history and first by an Englishman - before being dismissed from the final ball of the innings, with England's 429-4 their fourth-highest total in the 50-over format.
paras.zh: 哈里·布鲁克 (Harry Brook) 仅 116 次投球，就轰出 202 分，这是 ODI 历史上最快的双百，也是英国人的第一名，但在该局的最后一球中被淘汰，英格兰队以 429-4 的成绩位居 50 杆以上比赛中第四高的总成绩。

paras.en: Sri Lanka slipped to 24-2 in reply but were offered hope by a 166-run third-wicket stand between Avishka Fernando (97) and Pavan Rathnayake, who completed an 87-ball century and put on another big partnership with Dasun Shanaka.
paras.zh: 斯里兰卡队以 24-2 落后，但阿维什卡·费尔南多 (97) 和帕万·拉特纳亚克之间的 166 分第三边门看台给了希望，后者完成了 87 球世纪，并与达桑·沙纳卡建立了另一场重要的合作关系。

paras.en: Rathnayake was dismissed for 130 and Shanaka fired eight maximums in his 97 from his 50 deliveries, before Janith Liyanage crashed in a 22-ball fifty to leave Sri Lanka needing eight runs from their final over.
paras.zh: 拉特纳亚克（Rathnayake）以 130 分被淘汰，沙纳卡（Shanaka）在 50 次投球中以 97 分的成绩打出 8 次最高分，然后贾尼斯·利亚纳奇（Janith Liyanage）在 22 球 50 分中摔倒，让斯里兰卡队在最后一轮还需要 8 分。

paras.en: Josh Tongue moved momentum back England's way by bowling Dunith Wellalage and Eshan Malinga in successive deliveries, only for Liyanage to fire a six off the penultimate ball and complete a famous victory.
paras.zh: 乔什·汤格（Josh Tongue）连续向杜尼斯·韦拉拉奇（Dunith Wellalage）和埃尚·马林加（Eshan Malinga）投球，为英格兰队扳平了比分，而利亚纳奇（Liyanage）在倒数第二个球上轰出六分，完成了一场著名的胜利。

paras.en: Sri Lanka's successful chase is just the third over 400 in ODI history and gives them their first points of the tri-series tournament, while England's second successive loss is another setback in their bid to reach the final on October 31.
paras.zh: 斯里兰卡队的成功追赶是ODI历史上第三次超过400分，并为他们带来了三系列赛的首个积分，而英格兰队的连续第二场失利则是他们在10月31日晋级决赛的过程中再次受挫。

paras.en: Brook breaks records with huge England knock
paras.zh: 布鲁克以巨大的英格兰撞击打破了记录

paras.en: England made a positive start after losing the toss and batting first, with Tom Banton racing to his half-century off 48 deliveries and putting on a 74-run opening stand with Ben Duckett.
paras.zh: 英格兰队在丢球和先击球后取得了积极的开局，汤姆·班顿(Tom Banton)在半个世纪内完成了48次传球，并与本·达克特(Ben Duckett)打出了74分的开局。

paras.en: The left-arm spin of Dunith Wellalage (2-56) removed both openers, as Banton (50) picked out Liyanage in the deep and Duckett (29) was trapped LBW, while Joe Root pushed England forward before Brook's acceleration.
paras.zh: Dunith Wellalage (2-56) 的左臂旋转消除了两个开门红，Banton (50) 在深处挑出了 Liyanage，而 Duckett (29) 则被困在 LBW 中，而 Joe Root 在 Brook 加速之前推动英格兰队前进。

paras.en: Brook - who felt his side were 'too careful' in the middle overs against Pakistan - was 13 from 24 deliveries when he smashed Kamindu Mendis for successive sixes, with a boundary burst seeing him quickly pass 50 and put on a 159-run stand with Root (69).
paras.zh: 布鲁克——他觉得自己的球队在对阵巴基斯坦的中场比赛中“过于小心”——在连续六次击倒卡明杜·门迪斯(Kamindu Mendis)时，他在24次投球中得到了13分，突破边界后他很快就超过了50分，并与鲁特(69分)展开了159分的较量。

paras.en: Asitha Fernando (1-68) saw Root chip him to mid-wicket but that was not the end of England's onslaught, as Brook and Will Jacks (66 not out) added 185 - including a staggering 156 in the last 10 overs - to post their monster score.
paras.zh: 阿西莎·费尔南多 (1-68) 看到鲁特将他切入中门，但这并不是英格兰进攻的结束，布鲁克和威尔·杰克斯 (66 岁未出局) 添加了 185 分 - 包括在最后 10 轮中惊人的 156 分 - 发布了他们的怪物得分。

paras.en: Brook took 39 balls from 100 to reach his double century, with his 31 boundaries - 21 fours and 10 of England's 13 sixes - setting another ODI record, before holing out to Sahan Arachchige off Liyanage (1-32) from the last delivery.
paras.zh: 布鲁克在 100 个球中拿下 39 个球，达到了他的双世纪，他的 31 个界线（英格兰 13 个六球中的 21 个四分球和 10 个）创造了另一项 ODI 记录，然后在最后一次投球中向 Liyanage 附近的 Sahan Arachchige（1-32）击球。

paras.en: England looked in full control when Tongue bowled Kamindu Mendis (18) and captain Kusal Mendis (0) was run out by Gus Atkinson at the non-striker's end without facing a ball, before Avishka and Rathnayake led Sri Lanka's rebuild.
paras.zh: 在阿维什卡和拉特纳亚克带领斯里兰卡重建之前，舌头击中了卡明杜·门迪斯（18），队长库萨尔·门迪斯（0）在非前锋位置被格斯·阿特金森在没有面对球的情况下将其击倒，英格兰看起来完全控制了局面。

paras.en: Avishka was on the verge of his century when he was out caught and bowled by Jamie Overton (1-77), with Sri Lanka still needing 213 from the last 20 overs before an incredible late fightback under the lights.
paras.zh: 当阿维什卡 (Avishka) 被杰米·奥弗顿 (1-77) 抓住并投出时，他正处于他的世纪边缘，而斯里兰卡在最后 20 轮比赛中仍需要 213 分，才能在灯光下进行令人难以置信的后期反击。

paras.en: Rathnayake picked out Banton at long-on to end his impressive 106-ball innings, but Shanaka kept hopes alive by spanking Sam Curran (2-102) for three sixes during a brilliant 20-run over.
paras.zh: 拉思纳亚克（Rathnayake）在长投中选择了班顿（Banton），结束了他令人印象深刻的 106 球局，但沙纳卡（Shanaka）通过在出色的 20 分中击败萨姆·柯兰（2-102）打出三个六分而保持了希望。

paras.en: Shanaka eventually picked out Banton in the deep off Liam Dawson (1-71) and Curran removed Arachchige (13) after a quick 43-run stand with Liyanage, who ended unbeaten 61 from 27 deliveries to guide Sri Lanka to their epic victory.
paras.zh: 沙纳卡最终在利亚姆·道森 (Liam Dawson) 深处击败了班顿 (1-71)，库兰 (Curran) 在与利亚纳奇 (Liyanage) 快速打了 43 分后淘汰了阿拉奇奇 (13)，后者在 27 次投球中以 61 分保持不败，带领斯里兰卡取得了史诗般的胜利。

paras.en: Brook on historic knock: 'It doesn't mean anything now!'
paras.zh: 布鲁克在历史性的敲门声中说道：“现在这没有任何意义了！”

paras.en: England captain Harry Brook, speaking at the presentation:
paras.zh: 英格兰队队长哈里·布鲁克在演讲中说道：

paras.en: "It was an incredible game of cricket. I thought both sides were exceptional but Sri Lanka just outplayed us unfortunately.
paras.zh: “这是一场令人难以置信的板球比赛。我认为双方都很出色，但不幸的是斯里兰卡队击败了我们。

paras.en: "We didn't hit our straps with the ball and played to their strengths a little bit. Fair play to them for an incredible achievement.
paras.zh: “我们没有用球击中我们的带子，而是发挥了他们的优势。公平竞争，他们取得了令人难以置信的成就。

paras.en: "It [his 202] was a nice innings. Unfortunately it doesn't mean anything now being on the losing side. It has no value whatsoever.
paras.zh: “（他的 202 分）是一局不错的局。不幸的是，这并不意味着现在处于失败的一方。它没有任何价值。

paras.en: "We have to go back to the drawing board a little bit. We know where we have gone wrong - we didn't execute well enough with the ball. We have an opportunity in the next couple of games to try and nail down a spot in the final.
paras.zh: “我们必须重新开始。我们知道自己哪里出了问题——我们的控球执行得不够好。在接下来的几场比赛中，我们有机会尝试锁定决赛席位。”

paras.en: "We need to keep things simple and keep our chins up."
paras.zh: “我们需要让事情变得简单并保持乐观。”

articles.title: Pope Leo won’t require further treatment after lung surgery, doctors say
articles.author: Claudio Lavanga

paras.en: Pope Leo XIV will not need further treatment following lung cancer surgery, his doctors said Wednesday.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世的医生周三表示，他的医生在肺癌手术后不需要进一步治疗。

paras.en: The Vatican’s press office said in an update from the pope’s doctors that final reports and analyses of tissue removed from his surgery were completed Wednesday.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈新闻办公室在教皇医生的最新消息中表示，对手术中取出的组织的最终报告和分析已于周三完成。

paras.en: Pope Leo rides popemobile for first time since surgery
paras.zh: 教皇利奥手术后首次乘坐教皇专车

paras.en: “The results have confirmed that the condition was a pulmonary adenocarcinoma and that the disease was localized,” said his doctors, Dr. Luigi Carbone and Professor Stefano Margaritora.
paras.zh: 他的医生 Luigi Carbone 博士和 Stefano Margaritora 教授说：“结果证实，他的病情是肺腺癌，而且是局部的。”

paras.en: “A subsequent oncological evaluation has confirmed that no further therapy is required,” the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“随后的肿瘤学评估证实不需要进一步治疗。”

paras.en: Leo, 71, had surgery this month at Rome’s Gemelli Hospital to remove a lung nodule found during recent routine medical tests. Leo said the nodule was detected “at a very early stage.”
paras.zh: 71 岁的 Leo 本月在罗马 Gemelli 医院接受了手术，切除了最近例行医学检查中发现的肺结节。利奥说，这个结节是在“非常早期的阶段”被发现的。

paras.en: He was discharged Saturday and returned to his public duties Sunday with a prayer from the window of the papal apartment at St. Peter’s Basilica.
paras.zh: 他于周六出院，周日返回公共岗位，在圣彼得大教堂教皇公寓的窗户上进行祈祷。

paras.en: “This experience has made me feel particularly close to all those who are experiencing illness and a condition of frailty,” he said, thanking well-wishers.
paras.zh: “这次经历让我对所有正在经历疾病和虚弱的人感到特别亲近，”他感谢祝福者。

paras.en: “Having come through this delicate phase, as you know, I will now gradually resume my activities, always with God’s help and your prayers,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“正如你们所知，在经历了这个微妙的阶段后，我现在将在上帝的帮助和你们的祈祷下逐渐恢复我的活动。”

paras.en: The pope’s diagnosis and surgery left his upcoming trip to South America up in the air. He is still scheduled to depart Nov. 6 for the 12-day journey to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru.
paras.zh: 教皇的诊断和手术使他即将到来的南美洲之行悬而未决。他仍计划于11月6日出发，开始为期12天的乌拉圭、阿根廷和秘鲁之旅。

paras.en: The trip will be a demanding one, covering 19,000 miles on multiple flights and two helicopter rides. His itinerary includes a stopover in Cuzco in the Peruvian Andes, which is at an elevation of 11,000 feet.
paras.zh: 这次旅行将是一次艰巨的旅行，需要多次飞行和两架直升机，行程 19,000 英里。他的行程包括在秘鲁安第斯山脉海拔 11,000 英尺的库斯科短暂停留。

paras.en: Peru is a special place for Leo, where he was bishop of Chiclayo and holds citizenship.
paras.zh: 秘鲁对利奥来说是一个特殊的地方，他曾担任奇克拉约主教并拥有公民身份。

paras.en: The pope’s surgeon, Margaritora, told Vatican News on Saturday that recovery from Leo’s type of surgery typically takes a couple of weeks.
paras.zh: 教皇的外科医生玛加里托拉周六告诉梵蒂冈新闻，利奥的手术通常需要几周的时间才能恢复。

paras.en: “As for a long trip involving air travel in about three weeks, I would say there are no clinical reasons why it should not take place,” Margaritora said.
paras.zh: “至于大约三周内涉及航空旅行的长途旅行，我认为没有任何临床原因不应该进行，”马加里托拉说。

articles.title: France’s Emmanuel Macron says ‘illegitimate’ protests will be banned as cities block demonstrations
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that “illegitimate” protests would be banned in the coming days and blamed “seditious” ultra-left groups and vandals for last weekend’s riots and looting.
paras.zh: 法国总统马克龙周四表示，未来几天将禁止“非法”抗议活动，并将上周末的骚乱和抢劫归咎于“煽动性”极左团体和破坏者。

paras.en: Speaking after a meeting with intelligence chiefs and senior ministers, Macron said demonstrations organised by groups such as trade unions would be allowed to go ahead but could be diverted along alternative routes to protect businesses.
paras.zh: 马克龙在与情报主管和高级部长会面后表示，工会等团体组织的示威活动将被允许继续进行，但可能会改道以保护企业。

paras.en: “Last Saturday we had political and seditious acts by ultra-left groups whose aim is to bring down the Republic,” Macron said.
paras.zh: 马克龙说：“上周六，极左团体实施了政治和煽动行为，其目的是推翻共和国。”

paras.en: His comments came as authorities across France prepared for fresh protests following some of the country’s worst urban unrest in years.
paras.zh: 他发表此番言论之际，法国各地当局正准备应对该国多年来最严重的一些城市骚乱后的新抗议活动。

paras.en: Authorities in multiple cities had already banned protests planned across the country on Thursday.
paras.zh: 多个城市的当局已经禁止周四全国范围内计划的抗议活动。

paras.en: The turmoil in Paris and other French cities has prompted a strong security response. Night curfews have been implemented in some areas of the French capital, as well as in other cities where calm has been restored.
paras.zh: 巴黎和其他法国城市的骚乱引发了强烈的安全反应。法国首都部分地区以及其他已恢复平静的城市已实施宵禁。

paras.en: Demonstrations planned Thursday in Paris, Lyon, Lille and Grenoble were banned, a move seen by some as an infringement on French people’s right to protest.
paras.zh: 计划于周四在巴黎、里昂、里尔和格勒诺布尔举行的示威活动被禁止，一些人认为此举侵犯了法国人民的抗议权利。

paras.en: But high school and university student groups say they will continue to mobilize, even though the autumn school break started this week.
paras.zh: 但高中和大学生团体表示，尽管秋季学校假期从本周开始，他们仍将继续动员起来。

paras.en: The Paris police prefecture said the ban was necessary given the risk of street violence that erupted over the weekend, when groups of masked youth clashed with police forces, looted shops and torched cars.
paras.zh: 巴黎警察局表示，鉴于周末爆发街头暴力的风险，该禁令是必要的，当时一群蒙面青年与警察部队发生冲突，抢劫商店并焚烧汽车。

paras.en: The ban in Paris will last until 8 p.m. local time and apply to areas including the Elysée presidential palace, both houses of parliament, and the city’s main train stations. Areas in downtown Paris which were severely hit by the looting are also covered.
paras.zh: 巴黎的禁令将持续到晚上8点。当地时间，适用于爱丽舍总统府、议会两院和城市主要火车站等地区。巴黎市中心遭受抢劫严重的地区也被覆盖​​。

paras.en: Thursday’s planned protests were seen as a prelude to Saturday’s big demonstration, when activists from the “yellow vest ” movement, whose demonstrations over fuel prices shook France in 2018 and 2019, are expected to join.
paras.zh: 周四计划的抗议活动被视为周六大型示威活动的前奏，预计“黄背心”运动的活动人士也将加入，“黄背心”运动曾在 2018 年和 2019 年因燃油价格问题举行的示威活动震惊了法国。

paras.en: Some of those protests, including marches in Lyon, will also be banned, local authorities said.
paras.zh: 地方当局表示，其中一些抗议活动，包括里昂的游行，也将被禁止。

paras.en: Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu, who met union representatives on Wednesday, said a “massive” security operation was planned for Saturday to prevent a repeat of the violence by small groups of rioters that had exposed shortcomings in security measures.
paras.zh: 周三会见工会代表的总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努表示，计划于周六采取“大规模”安全行动，以防止小群暴徒再次发生暴力事件，这些暴乱暴露了安全措施的缺陷。

paras.en: Union representatives said their meeting with Lecornu did not result in concrete proposals. They are now focusing on another big day of action scheduled on Nov. 5, and called on private and public sector employees to join.
paras.zh: 工会代表表示，他们与莱科尔努的会面并未产生具体建议。他们现在正专注于定于 11 月 5 日举行的另一个重要行动日，并呼吁私营和公共部门员工加入。

paras.en: The demonstrations first erupted last month in a high school in Creteil, southeast of Paris, over a lack of staff. From there, class strikes, blockades and demonstrations spread to other Paris suburbs and then nationwide, even in smaller towns.
paras.zh: 示威活动于上个月首次在巴黎东南部克雷泰伊的一所高中爆发，原因是人手不足。从那里，阶级罢工、封锁和示威蔓延到巴黎其他郊区，然后蔓延到全国，甚至在较小的城镇。

paras.en: High school students have raised concerns about underfunded schools, dilapidated facilities and staff shortages, particularly in lower-income neighborhoods. Some also called for a reform of the university admissions system, seen by many as complex and unfair.
paras.zh: 高中生对学校资金不足、设施破旧和教职员工短缺表示担忧，特别是在低收入社区。一些人还呼吁对大学招生制度进行改革，许多人认为这一制度复杂且不公平。

paras.en: With the government unable to respond to students’ demands, the school demonstrations and blockades have morphed into larger protests over soaring living costs, just months before next year’s presidential election to choose Macron’s successor.
paras.zh: 由于政府无法回应学生的要求，学校示威和封锁演变成针对生活成本飙升的更大规模抗议活动，距离明年选择马克龙继任者的总统选举仅几个月。

articles.title: Market sell-off gains steam as concerns about Iran war and high AI spending collide
articles.author: Rob Wile

paras.en: U.S. equity markets sold off sharply Thursday, as fears that Israel and the United States would restart attacks against Iran sent oil prices higher and major tech stocks failed to hold onto recent gains.
paras.zh: 由于担心以色列和美国将重启对伊朗的袭击，导致油价走高，而主要科技股未能守住近期涨幅，美国股市周四大幅下挫。

paras.en: The S&P 500 was down 1.4% by midmorning, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq saw declines of 2.2%. The price of international Brent crude climbed more than 2%, while U.S. crude gained more than 1%.
paras.zh: 截至上午中旬，标准普尔 500 指数下跌 1.4%，而以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数则下跌 2.2%。国际布伦特原油价格上涨超过2%，美国原油价格上涨超过1%。

paras.en: Demand for Treasury bonds also increased — bucking the trend of the last several months — as investors sought out the safe-haven assets as riskier ones like tech stocks sold off. That sent bond yields lower.
paras.zh: 与过去几个月的趋势相反，随着科技股等风险较高的资产遭到抛售，投资者纷纷寻求避险资产，对国债的需求也有所增加。这导致债券收益率走低。

paras.en: The broad sell-off was sparked in part by reporting Wednesday that Israel and the U.S. were preparing for a military operation in Iran after the November midterm elections.
paras.zh: 周三有报道称以色列和美国正在准备在 11 月中期选举后对伊朗采取军事行动，这在一定程度上引发了广泛的抛售。

paras.en: Likely targets include Iran’s energy infrastructure and nuclear sites, according to The New York Times.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，可能的目标包括伊朗的能源基础设施和核设施。

paras.en: U.S. military and diplomatic personnel were also being evacuated from several countries in the Middle East on Wednesday, NBC News reported.
paras.zh: 据美国全国广播公司新闻报道，美国军事和外交人员周三也从中东几个国家撤离。

paras.en: Iranian officials have promised widespread retaliation to any strikes, pointing to critical Middle East data center sites and undersea internet cables as potential targets.
paras.zh: 伊朗官员承诺对任何袭击进行广泛报复，并指出关键的中东数据中心站点和海底互联网电缆是潜在目标。

paras.en: Major tech stocks led the declines in early trading, with Meta and Tesla sliding after both companies reported quarterly earnings Wednesday evening.
paras.zh: 主要科技股在早盘交易中领跌，Meta 和特斯拉在周三晚间公布季度收益后股价下跌。

paras.en: Meta’s earnings and revenues beat forecasts, but only after excluding billions of dollars in legal penalties the company paid last quarter. It also warned investors that it expects to increase its spending in the coming year to meet demands for computing power.
paras.zh: Meta 的盈利和收入超出了预期，但前提是排除了该公司上季度支付的数十亿美元的法律罚款。它还警告投资者，预计未来一年将增加支出，以满足计算能力的需求。

paras.en: A separate regulatory filing revealed that Meta intends to spend an additional $825 billion on contracts related to its AI infrastructure buildout.
paras.zh: 另一份监管文件显示，Meta 打算额外花费 8250 亿美元购买与其人工智能基础设施建设相关的合同。

paras.en: Tesla, meanwhile, said it was reining in its capital spending plans, disappointing investors who were hoping for a signal of more aggressive expansion.
paras.zh: 与此同时，特斯拉表示正在控制资本支出计划，这令那些希望看到更积极扩张信号的投资者感到失望。

paras.en: The slide in the Nasdaq got additional fuel Thursday morning after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said in an appearance on CNBC that capital to finance the AI investment boom was becoming “scarce” due to higher interest rates and a glut of existing spending commitments.
paras.zh: 周四上午，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 在 CNBC 上表示，由于利率上升和现有支出承诺过剩，为人工智能投资热潮提供资金的资金变得“稀缺”，这进一步加剧了纳斯达克指数的下滑。

paras.en: U.S. markets remain near all-time highs. But signs of flagging returns on the AI investment boom have resulted in more intense gyrations lately.
paras.zh: 美国市场仍接近历史高点。但人工智能投资热潮回报率下降的迹象导致最近出现了更剧烈的波动。

paras.en: A major sell-off in French government debt has also dragged European stocks lower in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 最近几周，法国政府债务的大幅抛售也拖累欧洲股市走低。

paras.en: “It’s been another difficult 24 hours for markets, as investors grapple with AI growth concerns, higher oil prices, and ongoing fiscal stress,” wrote Henry Allen, director and macro strategist at Deutsche Bank, in a note to clients Thursday.
paras.zh: 德意志银行董事兼宏观策略师亨利·艾伦周四在给客户的一份报告中写道：“对于市场来说，这又是一个艰难的 24 小时，因为投资者正在努力应对人工智能增长的担忧、油价上涨和持续的财政压力。”

paras.en: A significant market drawdown may also put a further dent in Republicans’ midterm elections outlook.
paras.zh: 市场大幅下跌也可能进一步削弱共和党的中期选举前景。

paras.en: President Donald Trump frequently points to solid stock market gains as evidence that his economic agenda has made Americans richer. A significant market stumble ahead of the Nov. 3 election would undermine a core argument for Trump and the GOP.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统经常指出股市的强劲上涨作为他的经济议程使美国人变得更加富裕的证据。 11 月 3 日大选之前的重大市场下跌将削弱特朗普和共和党的核心论点。

articles.title: North and South Korea tensions rise as Pyongyang fortifies border
articles.author: Claire Campbell and Girish Sawlani

paras.en: North Korea says it will resume propaganda broadcasts along its border with the south this month.
paras.zh: 朝鲜表示将于本月恢复与韩国边境沿线的宣传广播。

paras.en: It is another sign the risk of clashes in the heavily militarised area may be rising.
paras.zh: 这是军事密集地区发生冲突的风险可能正在上升的另一个迹象。

paras.en: Both countries have threatened military retaliation for any provocation.
paras.zh: 两国都威胁对任何挑衅行为进行军事报复。

paras.en: The risk of clashes between North and South Korea is growing, according to international relations experts in Seoul, as Pyongyang steps up fortifications along their heavily militarised border.
paras.zh: 首尔国际关系专家表示，随着平壤在高度军事化的边境加强防御工事，朝鲜和韩国之间发生冲突的风险正在增加。

paras.en: Tensions have been escalating in the area since three South Korean soldiers were injured in a landmine blast within the demilitarised zone (DMZ) last month.
paras.zh: 自上个月三名韩国士兵在非军事区（DMZ）内的一次地雷爆炸中受伤以来，该地区的紧张局势不断升级。

paras.en: North Korea has said it will resume propaganda broadcasts along the border and has also been adding mines, barbed wire fences, anti-tank barriers and other fortifications.
paras.zh: 朝鲜表示将恢复边境沿线的宣传广播，并增加了地雷、铁丝网、反坦克屏障和其他防御工事。

paras.en: A visit from the North Korean leader's sister to the site this week prompted Pyongyang to renew its threat of retaliation against any South Korean provocation.
paras.zh: 朝鲜领导人的妹妹本周访问了该地点，促使平壤再次威胁要对韩国的任何挑衅进行报复。

paras.en: Kim Yo Jong said that if South Korean warning shots — which Seoul says are designed to force North Korean soldiers back across the border — caused "actual harm to our territorial security and our service persons' safety", North Korea "will show no mercy for the armed gangsters bereft of reason".
paras.zh: 金与正表示，如果韩国的警告性射击——首尔称其目的是迫使朝鲜士兵撤回边境——对“我们的领土安全和军人的安全造成实际伤害”，那么朝鲜“将不会对失去理智的武装匪徒毫不留情”。

paras.en: "Our tactical hunting teams are taking new positions, and within October, the loudspeakers for psychological warfare against the ROK will be in operation along the whole border," she said, using the initials of South Korea’s formal name, the Republic of Korea.
paras.zh: 她说：“我们的战术狩猎队正在采取新的阵地，十月份之内，针对韩国的心理战扩音器将在整个边境地区展开。”她用的是韩国正式国名“大韩民国”的首字母缩写。

paras.en: South Korea's defence ministry spokesperson Chung Binna said Seoul would need to take "proportionate measures" in response but did not elaborate on what that would involve.
paras.zh: 韩国国防部发言人郑彬娜表示，首尔需要采取“相应措施”予以回应，但没有详细说明具体涉及哪些内容。

paras.en: South Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff chairman, Jin Yong-Sung, has ordered the military to "sternly respond" to potential provocations by the north.
paras.zh: 韩国参谋长联席会议主席金永成已命令军方对朝鲜潜在的挑衅做出“严厉回应”。

paras.en: Daniel Pinkston, an international relations lecturer at Troy University in Seoul, told the ABC North Korea had been moving towards this position for two and a half years after its leader Kim Jong Un announced the two Koreas would be "permanently divided as two enemy states".
paras.zh: 首尔特洛伊大学国际关系讲师丹尼尔·平克斯顿（Daniel Pinkston）告诉美国广播公司（ABC），在朝鲜领导人金正恩宣布朝韩两国将“永久分裂为两个敌对国家”之后，朝鲜已经朝着这一立场迈进了两年半。

paras.en: "Koreans have lived in the shadow of this possibility [of border clashes] for decades now," he said.
paras.zh: “几十年来，韩国人一直生活在这种[边境冲突]可能性的阴影之下，”他说。

paras.en: "There have been patterns of increasing violence."
paras.zh: “暴力行为已经出现增加的趋势。”

paras.en: He told the ABC he visited a border observation post at the weekend and saw construction work being done but no sign of weapons.
paras.zh: 他告诉澳大利亚广播公司，他周末参观了一个边境观察哨，看到建筑工程正在完成，但没有武器的迹象。

paras.en: Mr Pinkston said a lot of the area was mountainous and it was uncertain where the actual military demarcation line was, meaning one wrong step could be problematic.
paras.zh: 平克斯顿先生表示，该地区很多地区都是山区，并且不确定实际的军事分界线在哪里，这意味着一步错误可能会出现问题。

paras.en: “There’s always a possibility of airplane overflights or accidental incursions into airspace with this building of the fortifications," he told ABC's The World.
paras.zh: 他告诉美国广播公司的《世界报》：“在这座防御工事建筑中，飞机总是有可能飞越上空或意外侵入空域。”

paras.en: "There have been accidental or even deliberate crossings that have resulted in the military rhetoric and the threats to retaliate."
paras.zh: “有一些意外甚至故意的越境事件导致了军事言论和报复威胁。”

paras.en: South Korea’s military has said North Korean soldiers crossed the border’s military demarcation line 50 times this year during fortification work, and that it responded with warning shots and broadcasts, a claim disputed by the north which said South Korean provocations had increased “beyond the red line” since the mine blasts.
paras.zh: 韩国军方表示，今年以来，朝鲜士兵在防御工事期间50次越过边境军事分界线，并以鸣枪示警和广播进行回应，但朝鲜对此说法提出异议，称自地雷爆炸以来，韩国的挑衅行为已“超出红线”。

paras.en: Mr Pinkston said despite North Korea putting a lot of focus on its ballistic missile program and carrying out nuclear tests and nuclear weapons development, he said command and communications issues held them back from war.
paras.zh: 平克斯顿表示，尽管朝鲜将重点放在弹道导弹计划、核试验和核武器开发上，但指挥和通信问题阻碍了他们发动战争。

paras.en: “I don’t think they could win a conventional war, they’re at a disadvantage, but they have these asymmetric advantages in nuclear weapons and WMD (weapons of mass destruction)," he told the ABC.
paras.zh: “我认为他们无法赢得常规战争，他们处于劣势，但他们在核武器和大规模杀伤性武器方面拥有这些不对称优势，”他告诉美国广播公司。

paras.en: Mr Pinkston said many South Koreans, including the president, wanted peace and reunification with the north but the north showed "no interest in dialogue".
paras.zh: 平克斯顿表示，包括总统在内的许多韩国人希望与朝鲜实现和平与统一，但朝鲜表现出“对对话没有兴趣”。

paras.en: He said North Korea's growing relationship with Russia, with Pyongyang sending many military personnel to help fight against Ukraine, could be giving Kim Jong Un more confidence to take stronger action against the south.
paras.zh: 他表示，朝鲜与俄罗斯的关系日益密切，平壤派遣了许多军事人员帮助对抗乌克兰，这可能会让金正恩更有信心对韩国采取更强有力的行动。

paras.en: “These relationships with China and with Russia in particular could embolden Kim Jong Un," he said.
paras.zh: “与中国、特别是与俄罗斯的关系可能会增强金正恩的胆量，”他说。

articles.title: Trump ordered to sit for deposition in his $14bn BBC lawsuit

paras.en: Trump ordered to sit for deposition in his $14bn BBC lawsuit
paras.zh: 特朗普下令在价值 140 亿美元的 BBC 诉讼中出庭作证

paras.en: A US judge has ordered Donald Trump appear at a deposition as part of his lawsuit against the British Broadcasting Corporation.
paras.zh: 一名美国法官下令唐纳德·特朗普出庭作证，作为他针对英国广播公司的诉讼的一部分。

paras.en: The US president is suing the BBC, alleging it defamed him by splicing together two pieces of his speech made to supporters before they stormed the US Capitol on January 6, 2021.
paras.zh: 美国总统正在起诉 BBC，指控该公司将他在支持者 2021 年 1 月 6 日冲击美国国会大厦之前向支持者发表的两段演讲拼接在一起，从而诽谤他。

paras.en: Mr Trump has until December 11 to sit for a deposition.
paras.zh: 特朗普必须在 12 月 11 日之前出庭作证。

articles.title: An artist's answer to finding a place for uncomfortable feelings
articles.author: Rhiannon Stevens

paras.en: The first time Clare James arranged funeral flowers was for her friend's 10-year-old son Harper, who was killed, along with his father, when a tree fell on their car in 2019.
paras.zh: 克莱尔·詹姆斯 (Clare James) 第一次为她朋友 10 岁的儿子哈珀 (Harper) 安排葬礼鲜花，2019 年，一棵树倒下来压住了他们的车，哈珀和他的父亲一起丧生。

paras.en: Impelled by the urge to give the children in the room something to look at beyond their friend's coffin, she created a wild and twisting semi-circle of branches, flowers, moss, pebbles and fungi. Woven into the installation were Harper's toys, and guests were invited to light a candle and place it among the pebbles when they arrived.
paras.zh: 她渴望给房间里的孩子们一些可以在朋友棺材之外看到的东西，她用树枝、花朵、苔藓、鹅卵石和真菌创造了一个狂野而扭曲的半圆。装置中融入了哈珀的玩具，客人到达时被邀请点燃蜡烛并将其放在鹅卵石中。

paras.en: "So, that was the first one. I just did that because I was worried about how the kids would get through such a funeral," Clare says.
paras.zh: “所以，这是第一个。我这样做是因为我担心孩子们如何度过这样的葬礼，”克莱尔说。

paras.en: That same year, Clare, an artist based in Victoria's Yarra Valley, created a similar installation in her backyard. Using flowers recycled from a wedding — floristry has been her long-time side hustle — she built a flowery alcove, an altar upon which to lay the grief that doesn't find a home at a funeral.
paras.zh: 同年，维多利亚亚拉河谷的艺术家克莱尔在她的后院创作了一个类似的装置。她利用婚礼上回收的鲜花——花艺一直是她长期以来的副业——建造了一个鲜花盛开的壁龛，一个祭坛，用来安放在葬礼上找不到家的悲伤。

paras.en: "For relationships broken, parents that had to leave, pets who died, bodies that no longer work, regrets that haunt, wilderness lost, rivers poisoned, animals slaughtered and the endless amount of grief out there which need a place to be acknowledged," she said at the time.
paras.zh: 她当时说道：“关系破裂、父母不得不离开、宠物死去、身体不再工作、对那些困扰的遗憾、荒野的消失、河流被毒害、动物被屠杀以及无尽的悲伤需要一个地方得到承认。”

paras.en: Growing up with anxiety disorder, Clare says her thoughts get caught in a loop and "things that have upset me or worried me in the world I've not found it easy to let go of". For once, until the flowers wilted and the candles melted, this altar gave her thoughts a place to rest.
paras.zh: 克莱尔从小就患有焦虑症，她说她的想法陷入了循环，“世界上那些让我心烦意乱或让我担心的事情我发现很难摆脱”。这一次，直到花谢蜡烛融化，这个祭坛给了她思绪安息的地方。

paras.en: In 2022, she built a similar installation for the public. With her sister, artist Kate James, she created The Place for Lost Feelings in an old hall in Healesville. "While we were building it, we got the giggles a few times going, 'Do you think anyone will come?'" Clare says.
paras.zh: 2022 年，她为公众建造了一个类似的装置。她与艺术家妹妹凯特·詹姆斯 (Kate James) 在希尔斯维尔的一座旧大厅里创作了“失落情感之地”(The Place for Lost Feelings)。 “当我们建造它时，我们有几次咯咯地笑，‘你认为有人会来吗？’”克莱尔说。

paras.en: But she had a hunch that she wasn't the only one searching for this place, or this experience, outside of organised religion. A church is a place she says she wouldn't feel safe or comfortable.
paras.zh: 但她有一种预感，她并不是唯一一个在有组织的宗教之外寻找这个地方或这种经历的人。她说教堂是一个让她感到不安全或不舒服的地方。

paras.en: The two sisters weren't quite ready for what happened next.
paras.zh: 两姐妹还没有为接下来发生的事情做好准备。

paras.en: "People came from so far and wide and people came with extraordinary grief," Clare says. They came to mourn, to remember and forget, to confront death.
paras.zh: 克莱尔说：“人们从四面八方赶来，带着极大的悲痛而来。”他们来哀悼、纪念和遗忘、面对死亡。

paras.en: One man in his 50s, diagnosed with terminal cancer, arrived with his wife and his two best friends. When it was their turn to enter the space, the man lay down in front of the installation and they sat with him, Clare says. Later, he told her "it was the first time he actually accepted his mortality".
paras.zh: 一名 50 多岁的男子被诊断出癌症晚期，与他的妻子和两个最好的朋友一起抵达。克莱尔说，当轮到他们进入这个空间时，那个人躺在装置前面，他们和他坐在一起。后来，他告诉她“这是他第一次真正接受自己的死亡”。

paras.en: In the comments book, someone wrote: "It's not like we were hungry for this; we were starving." Clare says it struck her as a "profound thing to say and feel about this little pop-up flower thing".
paras.zh: 在评论簿中，有人写道：“这并不是说我们饿了；我们是饿死了。”克莱尔说，这让她感到“对这朵突然出现的小花的说法和感受是深刻的”。

paras.en: Clare's installations reflect a high-end floristry movement that has emerged over the past two decades. A slave to the vase no more, bold installations of traditional cut flowers, branches, grasses and edible plants scrunch and twist up walls, creep along ceilings, and hang in defiance of gravity. They scream with life, and they're not cheap. They appear at well-heeled weddings, events and restaurants.
paras.zh: 克莱尔的装置作品反映了过去二十年兴起的高端花艺运动。传统的切花、树枝、草和可食用植物的大胆装置不再是花瓶的奴隶，它们挤压和扭曲墙壁，沿着天花板爬行，并无视重力而悬挂。他们用生命尖叫，而且价格并不便宜。他们出现在奢华的婚礼、活动和餐馆中。

paras.en: For Clare, giving everyone the chance to experience such a luscious installation at a free event is part of the appeal. Fresh flowers and candles are "there for the most important celebrations in our life", she says. And there's something about their fragility, their ephemerality, which make them the perfect medium for these artworks.
paras.zh: 对于克莱尔来说，让每个人都有机会在免费活动中体验如此美妙的装置是吸引力的一部分。她说，鲜花和蜡烛“是我们生命中最重要的庆祝活动”。它们的脆弱性和短暂性使它们成为这些艺术品的完美媒介。

paras.en: Tomorrow, Clare will open the doors on the second iteration of The Place for Lost Feelings in Healesville. For two days, people will have the opportunity to spend five minutes alone in the space and light a candle. As they exit, two trauma response workers will be available to check in with people.
paras.zh: 明天，克莱尔将在希尔斯维尔开设第二家“失落情感之地”。在两天的时间里，人们将有机会在空间里单独度过五分钟并点燃蜡烛。当他们离开时，两名创伤反应人员将可以与人们进行检查。

paras.en: The event was meant to occur in March, but as Clare was preparing it, her husband Mark suffered a massive stroke. Since then, grief has gained new meaning for her.
paras.zh: 该活动原定于三月举行，但当克莱尔准备活动时，她的丈夫马克遭遇了严重中风。从那时起，悲伤对她来说有了新的意义。

paras.en: There is a "new, profound grief that I feel, and that Mark feels, for everything that he has lost", she says. "The things that we together have lost is huge, and the level of his brain injuries is just so life changing." There is also gratitude that things could have been worse.
paras.zh: 她说，“我和马克都对自己失去的一切感到一种新的、深刻的悲伤”。 “我们一起失去的东西是巨大的，而他的脑损伤程度也改变了我们的生活。”也有人庆幸事情本来可以更糟。

paras.en: "I said to my sister the other day, 'Oh my God, I need The Place for Lost Feelings,'" she says. "I'll go in there and sob for myself and for Mark."
paras.zh: “有一天我对我姐姐说，‘天哪，我需要失落之地，’”她说。 “我会进去为自己和马克哭泣。”

paras.en: At the same time, she doesn't understand what it's all for: "It doesn't bring back your child, it doesn't make your body better, I don't understand, yet, what it is that makes it feel alright."
paras.zh: 与此同时，她也不明白这一切是为了什么：“它不会带回你的孩子，它不会让你的身体变得更好，我不明白，到底是什么让你感觉良好。”

paras.en: After we speak on the phone, Clare texts me photos of the flowers she was looking at in her garden while we talked. There are Granny's Bonnets in different shades of purple, an orange tree bursting with blossom, and a delicate flower, the colour of mango, turning its face to the sun. Brief glimpses of beauty that will return to the soil.
paras.zh: 我们通电话后，克莱尔给我发了短信，照片上是我们交谈时她在花园里看的花朵的照片。这里有不同深浅的紫色的奶奶帽，一棵盛开花朵的橙树，还有一朵娇嫩的芒果色花朵，将脸转向阳光。美丽的短暂一瞥将回归土壤。

paras.en: The Place for Lost Feelings, supported by the Margaret Lawrence Bequest, is a free event (bookings recommended) at The Healesville Living And Learning Centre on October 24 and 25.
paras.zh: 由玛格丽特·劳伦斯遗赠支持的失落之地是 10 月 24 日至 25 日在希尔斯维尔生活和学习中心举办的免费活动（建议预订）。

articles.title: 1st human case of livestock virus Shamonda reported in France

paras.en: 1st human case of livestock virus Shamonda reported in France
paras.zh: 法国报告第一例人畜感染沙蒙达病毒病例

paras.en: Man who later died is believed to be an isolated case, authorities say
paras.zh: 当局称，后来死亡的男子被认为是一个孤立的案例

paras.en: The first human case of a virus usually found in livestock was reported in France on Thursday in a patient who later died.
paras.zh: 周四，法国报告了第一例通常在牲畜中发现的病毒的人类病例，一名患者后来死亡。

paras.en: Authorities say there is no risk to the general population at this stage. It is suspected that the victim was bitten by a midge carrying the Shamonda virus in eastern France, where it had circulated among animals this spring and summer, the government said in a statement.
paras.zh: 当局表示，现阶段普通民众不存在风险。政府在一份声明中表示，受害者怀疑是在法国东部被携带沙蒙达病毒的蠓叮咬的，该病毒今年春天和夏天在该地区的动物中传播。

paras.en: The UN's World Health Organization said it was in contact with French authorities about the outbreak.
paras.zh: 联合国世界卫生组织表示，正在与法国当局就疫情爆发进行联系。

paras.en: The patient died in early October and had been receiving treatment for a serious illness that made them more susceptible to infection than the general population, the Stockholm-based European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control said in a statement.
