paras.zh: The Motley Fool 拥有 Visa 的股份并推荐该公司。

articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派别试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的形状而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰凉拌面，都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然充满活力的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答任何有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时间，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的奇妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。 My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通将比私家车多花一到两个小时。

articles.title: Jillian Michaels urges parents to fight back against Big Tech's 'addictive' grip on kids

paras.en: Fitness trainer and media personality Jillian Michaels is urging parents to "keep the pressure on" social media companies, warning about the platforms' allegedly "addictive" algorithms and content.
paras.zh: 健身教练兼媒体名人吉莉安·迈克尔斯敦促家长“继续向社交媒体公司施加压力”，并对这些平台据称“令人上瘾”的算法和内容发出警告。

paras.en: Michaels made the comments during an appearance on "The Faulkner Focus" while promoting her new Fox Nation documentary, "Toxic 2: A Generation on the Brink." Michaels advised parents to limit their children's access to online activities.
paras.zh: 迈克尔斯在宣传她的福克斯国家新纪录片《有毒2：边缘的一代》时，在“福克纳焦点”节目中发表了上述言论。迈克尔斯建议家长限制孩子参与在线活动。

paras.en: "You have to do everything you can," Michaels said. "And that means putting parental controls on your kid's phone, period. Take the phone away at night, limit the sites that they can access, have communications with them regularly about the content that they're seeing online. But you also have to be realistic about what they're going to do when they're not with you."
paras.zh: “你必须尽你所能，”迈克尔斯说。 “这意味着对孩子的手机进行家长控制，就这样。晚上把手机拿走，限制他们可以访问的网站，定期与他们沟通他们在网上看到的内容。但你也必须现实地考虑他们不在你身边时会做什么。”

paras.en: "This is the part where we also have to continue putting pressure on the social media companies to make their algorithms safer for kids," she said. "They created an addictive product, they know it, and we need to keep the pressure on."
paras.zh: “在这方面，我们还必须继续向社交媒体公司施加压力，让他们的算法对孩子们来说更安全，”她说。 “他们创造了一种令人上瘾的产品，他们知道这一点，我们需要继续施加压力。”

paras.en: In the documentary, Michaels examines the risks she says children face in the modern age, including excessive screen time, mental health issues and over-medicalization.
paras.zh: 在纪录片中，迈克尔斯探讨了她所说的现代儿童面临的风险，包括过多的屏幕时间、心理健康问题和过度医疗。

paras.en: "The truth is, a lot of parents probably don't realize the scale of what kids are dealing with today," she said. "From day one, the fragile little bodies and brains of the tiniest and most vulnerable among us are being targeted, treated and toxified from all angles."
paras.zh: "The truth is, a lot of parents probably don't realize the scale of what kids are dealing with today," she said. “从第一天起，我们当中最微小、最脆弱的人脆弱的身体和大脑就受到来自各个角度的攻击、治疗和毒害。”

paras.en: Michaels is joined by several experts in "Toxic 2: A Generation on the Brink," including psychology researcher Jean Twenge, who argues that individuals who begin using smartphones at an early age are more likely to experience mental health issues later in life.
paras.zh: 迈克尔斯在“有毒2 ：濒临灭绝的一代”中加入了几位专家，其中包括心理学研究员让·特温格（ Jean Twenge ） ，他认为，在幼年开始使用智能手机的人更有可能在以后的生活中遇到心理健康问题。

paras.en: "In some of the best design studies, the heaviest users of social media are about twice as likely to be depressed as lighter non-users," Twenge said. "Even in other studies, you see at least often a 40% or a 50% increase in depression from not using social media to being a heavy user of social media."
paras.zh: 特温格说：“在一些最好的设计研究中，最常使用社交媒体的人患抑郁症的可能性是较少使用社交媒体的人的两倍。” “即使在其他研究中，你也会发现，从不使用社交媒体到大量使用社交媒体，抑郁症的发病率至少会增加 40% 或 50%。”

paras.en: "Gen Z and Gen Alpha know how bad these technologies can be for them," Twenge added. "They're the ones who came up with phrases like 'chronically online,' which make it sound like a disease, 'brain rot,' that it's bad for your attention span and your focus."
paras.zh: “Z 世代和 Alpha 世代知道这些技术对他们来说有多糟糕，”特温格补充道。 “他们提出了诸如‘长期在线’之类的短语，这听起来像是一种疾病，‘大脑腐烂’，这对你的注意力持续时间和注意力都有害。”

paras.en: Social media companies have faced increasing pressure to be regulated and be held accountable for the potential effects of their platforms. In August, Meta agreed to pay as much as $17.1 billion and implement restrictions on teen accounts to settle claims that it designed Facebook and Instagram to addict children and misled the public about the platforms' safety. Meta denied the allegations.
paras.zh: 社交媒体公司面临着越来越大的压力，要求受到监管并对其平台的潜在影响负责。 8 月，Meta 同意支付高达 171 亿美元，并对青少年账户实施限制，以和解有关其设计 Facebook 和 Instagram 让儿童上瘾并误导公众了解平台安全的指控。梅塔否认了这些指控。

paras.en: For more on the potential risks personal tech and other issues pose to young children, make sure to watch "Toxic 2: A Generation on the Brink," now streaming on Fox Nation.
paras.zh: 有关个人科技和其他问题对幼儿构成的潜在风险的更多信息，请务必观看《有毒 2：边缘的一代》，该节目目前正在 Fox Nation 上直播。

articles.title: Comedian Heather McMahan cries sexism while reflecting on firing from Ryder Cup for 'f--- you Rory' chants

paras.en: Aside from Team Europe dominating the Americans over the course of the first two days of the 2025 Ryder Cup, one of the wilder moments from the biennial event involved comedian Heather McMahan and chants of "f--- you Rory" ringing out across the first tee at Bethpage Black.
paras.zh: 除了欧洲队在 2025 年莱德杯的前两天统治了美国队之外，两年一度的赛事中最疯狂的时刻之一还包括喜剧演员希瑟·麦克马汉 (Heather McMahan) 和贝斯佩奇布莱克 (Bethpage Black) 的第一洞发球台上响起的“f---you Rory”的口号。

paras.en: Now, a year removed from helping lead the vulgar chants, McMahan is claiming that if she were a man, the consequences that followed never would have happened.
paras.zh: 现在，距离帮助引导粗俗口号已经一年了，麦克马汉声称，如果她是一个男人，接下来的后果就不会发生。

paras.en: Ahead of Saturday's foursomes matches, McMahan, who was hired as an MC for the event, attempted to fire up the crowd on Long Island. While it's an admittedly awkward job for anyone to start chanting things into a microphone at sunrise in front of tens of thousands of rowdy golf fans screaming their own obscenities, McMahan made a mistake that immediately cost her.
paras.zh: 在周六的四人二球赛之前，被聘为该赛事主持人的麦克马汉试图煽动长岛的观众。虽然对于任何人来说，在日出时开始在数万名吵闹的高尔夫球迷面前对着麦克风喊出自己的脏话确实是一件尴尬的工作，但麦克马汉犯了一个错误，立即让她付出了代价。

paras.en: As fans in the stands started a "fâ you Rory" chant for Team Europe leader Rory McIlroy, McMahan joined in and started shouting the chant into her microphone. The following day, the PGA of America issued a statement explaining that McMahan had extended an apology to McIlroy and had stepped down from her role. McMahan recently told Oona McCaughan of Barstool Sports that she was "immediately fired" after joining in on the chants.
paras.zh: 当看台上的球迷开始为欧洲队领头羊罗里·麦克罗伊高喊“fâ you Rory”时，麦克马汉也加入了进来，并开始对着麦克风喊出这句口号。第二天，美国职业高尔夫协会发表声明解释说，麦克马汉已向麦克罗伊道歉，并辞去了她的职务。麦克马汉最近告诉 Barstool Sports 的乌娜·麦考恩 (Oona McCaughan)，她在加入这些口号后“立即被解雇”。

paras.en: During a recent sit-down with The Hollywood Reporter, McMahan reflected on nearly being "cancelled" after the incident while pinning the blame on golf not knowing its identity, whatever that means.
paras.zh: 在最近接受《好莱坞报道》采访时，麦克马汉反思了事件发生后差点被“取消”的情况，同时将责任归咎于高尔夫不知道其身份，无论这意味着什么。

paras.en: "The Ryder Cup has always been known to be heavily competitive between Europe and America," McMahan told the outlet. "But it's always been in good fun? I think [having it in Long Island], the already the weird animosity that America was having to outsiders, I don't think they were set up for success that year. And, I'll fall on the sword. I did not help the cause. It's just really wild.
paras.zh: “众所周知，莱德杯在欧洲和美洲之间竞争激烈，”麦克马汉告诉媒体。 “但它总是很有趣？我认为（在长岛举行），美国对外来者已经产生了奇怪的敌意，我不认为他们那一年会取得成功。而且，我会倒在剑上。我没有帮助这一事业。这真的很疯狂。

paras.en: "What does golf want to be? Is it all buttoned up like The Masters? Is it trying to be Happy Gilmore? I do think golf needed to like shake off the cobwebs, quit being as stuffy, but it doesn't know where it wants to go."
paras.zh: “高尔夫想要成为什么？是像美国大师赛那样把一切都搞定吗？是想成为快乐的吉尔摩吗？我确实认为高尔夫需要摆脱蜘蛛网，不再那么古板，但它不知道自己想要去哪里。”

paras.en: After explaining that she's only planning on attending LPGA events from now on, McMahan claimed that her being a woman played a role in the backlash and firing.
paras.zh: 在解释说她从现在开始只计划参加 LPGA 赛事后，麦克马汉声称她的女性身份在强烈反对和解雇中发挥了作用。

paras.en: "I went to the Masters and got to see him win again. I'm still a huge fan," McMahan said, referring to McIlroy winning the green jacket in April. "It's not the players. They're doing their thing. It's just this kind of weird environment with some of the male fans these days. And again, I apologized, but I do think, had a male comedian been in my shoes, we would have never had this conversation. They wouldn't have given a sât. Dudes being dudes. Set it on fire, man."
paras.zh: “我去了美国大师赛，看到他再次获胜。我仍然是他的忠实粉丝，”麦克马汉在谈到麦克罗伊四月份赢得绿夹克时说道。 “这不是球员的问题。他们在做他们的事情。这只是现在一些男球迷的这种奇怪的环境。我再次道歉，但我确实认为，如果一个男性喜剧演员处于我的位置，我们永远不会有这样的谈话。他们不会给予支持。男人就是男人。把它点燃，伙计。“

paras.en: It's extremely hard to find a modicum of truth in what McMahan is implying.
paras.zh: 很难在麦克马汉的暗示中找到一点点真理。

paras.en: If anyone who is hired to MC one of the largest events in golf grabs a microphone and joins in on "fâ you" chants directed at a player in the event you're being paid to be a part of, that person is undoubtedly being fired, regardless of gender.
paras.zh: 如果任何受雇担任高尔夫最大赛事之一的主持人的人拿起麦克风并加入到针对一名球员高喊“fâ you”的口号，而您是受雇参加该赛事的，那么该人无疑将被解雇，无论性别如何。

paras.en: When it comes to the idea that McMahan should have been cancelled for the chant, that's equally as absurd.
paras.zh: 当谈到麦克马汉应该因口号而被取消的想法时，这同样荒谬。

paras.en: The 2025 Ryder Cup was three full days of American fans shouting obscenities at every European player, but fans aren't held to the same standard as a paid employee of the event, as McMahan was presumed to be.
paras.zh: 2025 年莱德杯为期三天，美国球迷对每位欧洲球员大喊脏话，但球迷并没有像麦克马汉那样，遵守与赛事受薪员工相同的标准。

articles.title: Trump pushback, Biden 'disaster' and gender surprise: 5 key moments from Kansas Senate debate

paras.en: Sen. Roger Marshall, R-Kan., and Democratic challenger Adam Hamilton sparred over President Donald Trump, immigration, Iran, transgender athletes, artificial intelligence and personal controversies during a contentious Kansas Senate debate Wednesday night.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，在堪萨斯州参议院一场有争议的辩论中，堪萨斯州参议员罗杰·马歇尔和民主党挑战者亚当·汉密尔顿就唐纳德·特朗普总统、移民、伊朗、变性运动员、人工智能和个人争议等问题展开了争论。

paras.en: The hourlong showdown came less than two weeks before Election Day as Marshall seeks a second term and Hamilton, a longtime pastor, tries to become the first Democrat elected to the U.S. Senate from Kansas since 1932.
paras.zh: 这场长达一小时的对决发生在距离选举日不到两周的时候，当时马歇尔正在寻求连任，而长期担任牧师的汉密尔顿则试图成为自 1932 年以来第一位从堪萨斯州当选为美国参议院的民主党人。

paras.en: The race has drawn increased national attention as Republicans and Democrats battle for control of the Senate, with Trump traveling to Kansas earlier this week to campaign for Marshall.
paras.zh: 随着共和党和民主党争夺参议院的控制权，这场竞选吸引了越来越多的全国关注，特朗普本周早些时候前往堪萨斯州为马歇尔竞选。

paras.en: Here are five moments that stood out from Wednesday night's debate.
paras.zh: 以下是周三晚上辩论中最引人注目的五个时刻。

paras.en: Debate opens with candidates confronted over personal controversies
paras.zh: 辩论开始，候选人面临个人争议

paras.en: The debate wasted little time getting contentious, opening with questions about controversies that have fueled attacks against both candidates.
paras.zh: 这场辩论很快就引起了争议，一开始就引发了对两位候选人的攻击。

paras.en: Marshall was confronted with a New York Times review that found his former medical practice sued more than 700 patients over unpaid bills.
paras.zh: 马歇尔面临《纽约时报》的一篇评论，发现他以前的医疗机构因未付账单起诉了 700 多名患者。

paras.en: "Every year we gave away $3 to $4 million of charity, but we also had a business," Marshall responded. "We had 300 employees, we had a mortgage payment, we had electric."
paras.zh: “我们每年都会捐赠 3 到 400 万美元的慈善资金，但我们也有自己的生意，”马歇尔回答道。 “我们有 300 名员工，我们有抵押贷款，我们有电力。”

paras.en: Hamilton, meanwhile, was questioned about his handling of allegations involving a volunteer at his church's summer camp who was accused of sexual abuse.
paras.zh: 与此同时，汉密尔顿被问及他对教会夏令营一名志愿者被指控性虐待的指控的处理方式。

paras.en: Hamilton acknowledged that he should have ensured the individual did not return to the camp following an initial investigation.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿承认，他应该在初步调查后确保此人不会返回营地。

paras.en: "I should have checked to make sure that he wasn't going back," Hamilton said. "That was a mistake on my part."
paras.zh: “我应该检查一下以确保他不会回去，”汉密尔顿说。 “那是我的错误。”

paras.en: Marshall says 'President Trump is not always right'
paras.zh: 马歇尔表示“特朗普总统并不总是正确的”

paras.en: Trump became part of the debate after moderators played footage from the president's campaign appearance for Marshall in Kansas earlier in the week.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，主持人播放了总统在堪萨斯州为马歇尔竞选露面的镜头后，特朗普成为了辩论的一部分。

paras.en: "And at this election, I'm asking you to pretend, please, that I'm on the ballot. Just pretend," Trump told the crowd.
paras.zh: “在这次选举中，我要求你们假装我在选票上。就假装吧，”特朗普对人群说。

paras.en: Marshall was then asked whether Trump's support meant Kansans should expect him to back every part of the president's agenda.
paras.zh: 马歇尔随后被问及特朗普的支持是否意味着堪萨斯人应该期望他支持总统议程的每一个部分。

paras.en: "No," Marshall responded, saying there had been "multiple times" when he objected to Trump.
paras.zh: “不，”马歇尔回答道，并表示他曾“多次”反对特朗普。

paras.en: Pressed to identify a specific disagreement, Marshall pointed to recent immigration enforcement in southwest Kansas and Trump's approach to beef imports.
paras.zh: 当被要求指出具体分歧时，马歇尔指出了堪萨斯州西南部最近的移民执法以及特朗普对牛肉进口的态度。

paras.en: "Just like with my wife, I can disagree with her. My wife is always right," Marshall joked. "And President Trump is not always right."
paras.zh: “就像对待我的妻子一样，我可以不同意她的观点。我的妻子总是对的，”马歇尔开玩笑说。 “特朗普总统并不总是正确的。”

paras.en: Marshall nevertheless urged Trump voters to turn out for him, arguing that electing Hamilton could help Democrats capture the Senate.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，马歇尔还是敦促特朗普选民支持他，认为选举汉密尔顿可以帮助民主党夺取参议院席位。

paras.en: Both candidates say there are 'two genders'
paras.zh: 两位候选人都表示存在“两种性别”

paras.en: The two rivals found themselves in agreement when the moderator asked each candidate how many genders there are.
paras.zh: 当主持人询问每位候选人有多少种性别时，两位竞争对手发现自己达成了一致。

paras.en: "There's two. There's a boy and there's a girl," Marshall said. "I delivered 5,000 of them and almost half were boys and half were girls."
paras.zh: “有两个。一个男孩，一个女孩，”马歇尔说。 “我交付了 5,000 个孩子，其中几乎一半是男孩，一半是女孩。”

paras.en: "There are two genders, male and female," Hamilton responded.
paras.zh: “有两种性别，男性和女性，”汉密尔顿回答道。

paras.en: The candidates then turned to the debate over transgender participation in women's sports.
paras.zh: 候选人随后转向关于变性人参与女子体育运动的辩论。

paras.en: Hamilton said decisions over athletic eligibility should generally be made locally but was unequivocal about whether biological males should compete against females.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿表示，有关运动员资格的决定通常应在当地做出，但对于生物学上的男性是否应该与女性竞争的问题并没有含糊其辞。

paras.en: "I have a 12-year-old granddaughter. I don't want biological men or boys competing against her that could harm her," Hamilton said. "It's not a fair, fair fight."
paras.zh: “我有一个 12 岁的孙女。我不希望亲生男人或男孩与她竞争，这可能会伤害她，”汉密尔顿说。 “这不是一场公平、公正的战斗。”

paras.en: Marshall argued that by high school, "boys need to be in boys sports, girls in girls sports," while accusing national Democrats of pushing "transgender ideology."
paras.zh: 马歇尔认为，到了高中，“男孩需要参加男孩运动，女孩需要参加女孩运动”，同时指责全国民主党人推行“跨性别意识形态”。

paras.en: Hamilton later accused Marshall of using the issue to "pick on" and "bully" people.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿后来指责马歇尔利用这个问题“挑剔”和“欺凌”人们。

paras.en: Hamilton calls AI an 'existential threat' â but can't name regulations he'd support
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿称人工智能是“生存威胁”，但无法说出他支持的法规

paras.en: Hamilton called for greater federal oversight of artificial intelligence and compared the emerging technology to the development of nuclear power and nuclear weapons.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿呼吁联邦政府加强对人工智能的监督，并将新兴技术与核能和核武器的发展进行比较。

paras.en: "We developed a Nuclear Regulatory Commission. We need to do the same thing with AI," Hamilton said.
paras.zh: “我们成立了核监管委员会。我们需要对人工智能做同样的事情，”汉密尔顿说。

paras.en: But when the moderator pressed him to identify specific federal regulations he would support, Hamilton acknowledged he did not yet have an answer.
paras.zh: 但当主持人敦促他确定他将支持的具体联邦法规时，汉密尔顿承认他还没有答案。

paras.en: "You know what? I'm not sure, to be honest," Hamilton said, arguing that even experts are struggling to understand the technology's potential dangers.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿说：“你知道吗？老实说，我不确定。”他认为，即使是专家也很难理解这项技术的潜在危险。

paras.en: Marshall advocated a "light touch" approach focused on national security, transparency, protecting children and privacy, while slamming a one-size-fits-all global order for artificial intelligence advancement.
paras.zh: 马歇尔主张采取“温和”的做法，重点关注国家安全、透明度、保护儿童和隐私，同时猛烈抨击人工智能发展的一刀切的全球秩序。

paras.en: "This is an existential â potential existential threat to the human race," Hamilton said. "We can't just go with a light touch and hope everybody does their best."
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿说：“这是对人类存在的潜在威胁。” “我们不能只是轻描淡写地希望每个人都尽力而为。”

paras.en: Hamilton calls Biden's border policies a 'disaster'
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿称拜登的边境政策是一场“灾难”

paras.en: Hamilton sought to put distance between himself and former President Joe Biden when moderators challenged the Democrat over his claim that he would "lead from the middle."
paras.zh: 当主持人质疑民主党人声称他将“从中间领导”时，汉密尔顿试图与前总统乔·拜登保持距离。

paras.en: The moderator pointed to Hamilton's past donations to Democrats, including Biden, former Vice President Kamala Harris and Rep. Sharice Davids, D-Kan., before asking him to identify a progressive policy he opposed.
paras.zh: 主持人指出了汉密尔顿过去对民主党人的捐款，包括拜登、前副总统卡马拉·哈里斯和堪萨斯州民主党众议员沙里斯·戴维斯，然后要求他指出他反对的进步政策。

paras.en: "The Biden policies when it came to the border were a disaster," Hamilton responded. "I believe in strong and secure borders."
paras.zh: “拜登在边境问题上的政策是一场灾难，”汉密尔顿回应道。 “我相信强大而安全的边界。”

paras.en: "I'm not somebody who favors the Socialist Party," Hamilton added. "I'm somebody who stands in the middle."
paras.zh: “我不是一个支持社会党的人，”汉密尔顿补充道。 “我是一个站在中间的人。”

paras.en: Hamilton also reiterated during the debate that he would not support Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer for majority leader if Democrats capture control of the chamber.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿在辩论中还重申，如果民主党夺取参议院控制权，他不会支持参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默担任多数党领袖。

articles.title: Macron bans ‘illegitimate‘ protests in France as he tries to get a grip on unrest
articles.author: Jon Henley in Paris

paras.en: Emmanuel Macron has said “illegitimate” demonstrations will be banned over the coming days as France seeks to get a grip on civil unrest after some of its worst street violence in years erupted on the fringes of cost of living protests at the weekend.
paras.zh: 埃马纽埃尔·马克龙表示，未来几天将禁止“非法”示威活动，因为周末在生活成本抗议活动的边缘爆发了多年来最严重的街头暴力事件，法国试图控制内乱。

paras.en: Speaking after a meeting with intelligence chiefs and senior ministers, the French president said on Thursday that demonstrations organised by recognised groups would be allowed to go ahead, although their routes could be changed.
paras.zh: 法国总统周四在与情报主管和高级部长会面后表示，将允许由知名团体组织的示威活动继续进行，尽管他们的路线可能会改变。

paras.en: Protests requested by “individuals or groups with no legitimate authority” would be banned, Macron said. Requests by organisations such as trade unions would be “examined in accordance with the law” but they might have to use alternative routes.
paras.zh: 马克龙表示，“没有合法权力的个人或团体”要求的抗议活动将被禁止。工会等组织的请求将“依法审查”，但他们可能不得不使用替代途径。

paras.en: The measures were necessary to protect city centres, businesses and public buildings, he said, adding: “The rules are simple and I think they’re commonsense. The general recommendation is that there should be no demonstrations in the coming days.”
paras.zh: 他说，这些措施对于保护市中心、企业和公共建筑是必要的，并补充说：“规则很简单，我认为它们是常识。一般建议是未来几天不应举行示威活动。”

paras.en: Macron blamed much of last weekend’s unrest and looting on rioters who came expressly to loot, but said the worst of the violence was due to “political and seditious acts by ultra far-left groups who aimed to bring down the republic”.
paras.zh: 马克龙将上周末的骚乱和抢劫归咎于专门来抢劫的暴徒，但他表示，最严重的暴力事件是由于“旨在推翻共和国的极左团体的政治和煽动行为”。

paras.en: “The priority is a return to calm,” he said, adding that he would chair a defence council meeting of key ministers on Friday to decide concrete “next steps” for new nationwide demonstrations called for Saturday and afterwards.
paras.zh: 他说：“当务之急是恢复平静。”他补充说，他将在周五主持由主要部长组成的国防委员会会议，以决定周六及之后举行的新的全国性示威活动的具体“后续步骤”。

paras.en: An initial police ban on a student protest planned in Paris for Thursday was overturned by a court, but marches also scheduled for the day in Grenoble, Rouen, Le Havre and Toulon were halted.
paras.zh: 警方最初对计划于周四在巴黎举行的学生抗议活动实施的禁令被法院推翻，但原定于当天在格勒诺布尔、鲁昂、勒阿弗尔和土伦举行的游行也被叫停。

paras.en: Authorities have already declared a ban on “all protests” on Saturday in the centre of Lyon, France’s third-biggest city, where between 200 and 300 shops were ransacked and looted last weekend and the tourist office was set ablaze.
paras.zh: 周六，法国第三大城市里昂市中心当局已宣布禁止“所有抗议活动”，上周末里昂有 200 至 300 家商店遭到洗劫和抢劫，旅游局也被纵火焚烧。

paras.en: Authorities in Marseille, Nice and Toulon announced similar bans for Saturday. In Paris, a march planned for Saturday to be held in the east of the capital, starting at the Place de la Bastille, was authorised but banned from heading into the city centre.
paras.zh: 马赛、尼斯和土伦当局周六宣布了类似的禁令。在巴黎，计划于周六在首都东部从巴士底广场开始的游行获得批准，但被禁止进入市中心。

paras.en: However, a separate march through the capital planned for Saturday by students and some members of the gilets jaunes (yellow vests) movement, whose protests over fuel prices rocked France in 2018 and 2019, would not be permitted, authorities in the capital said.
paras.zh: 然而，首都当局表示，学生和黄背心运动的一些成员计划于周六在首都举行单独的游行，该运动在 2018 年和 2019 年针对燃油价格的抗议活动震惊了法国。

paras.en: France’s main student union, UNEF, has also called for rallies on Saturday. Businesses in central Paris and other cities had already begun boarding up their windows and hiring private security in preparation for violence, French media reported.
paras.zh: 法国主要学生会 UNEF 也呼吁周六举行集会。据法国媒体报道，巴黎市中心和其他城市的企业已经开始用木板封住窗户，并聘请私人保安，为应对暴力做好准备。

paras.en: The justice minister, Gérald Darmanin, said 174 of the 2,500 people arrested since last weekend’s rioting had been remanded in custody and more than 900 were being prosecuted. Two people have been arrested after Limoges town hall was set on fire.
paras.zh: 司法部长杰拉尔德·达尔马宁 (Gérald Darmanin) 表示，自上周末骚乱以来被捕的 2,500 人中，有 174 人已被还押候审，另有 900 多人正在受到起诉。利摩日市政厅纵火后，两人被捕。

paras.en: The prime minister, Sébastien Lecornu, was hosting a meeting of key figures from France’s main political parties on Thursday to hear their views and seek cooperation, and was due to meet several big-city mayors later in the day.
paras.zh: 周四，总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努 (Sébastien Lecornu) 主持了一次法国主要政党关键人物的会议，听取他们的观点并寻求合作，并将于当天晚些时候会见几位大城市的市长。

paras.en: The tough security response has included partial night-time curfews in parts of several cities including Paris, as well as bans on gatherings in areas such as around the Élysée presidential palace, the parliament and the city’s main train stations.
paras.zh: 严厉的安全应对措施包括在巴黎等多个城市的部分地区实行部分夜间宵禁，以及禁止在爱丽舍宫、议会和该市主要火车站等地区举行集会。

paras.en: The demonstrations began last month in a high school in Créteil, south-east of Paris, over staff shortages and dilapidated buildings, and spread nationwide, with strikes, blockades and demonstrations by high-school pupils around the country.
paras.zh: 示威活动于上个月在巴黎东南部克雷泰伊的一所高中开始，原因是教职员工短缺和校舍破旧，随后蔓延至全国范围，全国各地的高中生举行罢工、封锁和示威活动。

paras.en: Those demonstrations have morphed into larger protests over soaring living costs, six months before next year’s presidential elections, which will choose Macron’s successor.
paras.zh: 这些示威活动已演变成针对生活成本飙升的更大规模抗议活动，距离明年总统选举还有六个月，届时将选择马克龙的继任者。

articles.title: Revealed: billionaire Reform donor was in business with foundation linked to Iranian regime
articles.author: Rowena Mason Whitehall editor

paras.en: Nigel Farage’s newest billionaire donor was in business with a powerful Iranian religious foundation under the authority of the country’s supreme leader, raising questions about his past dealings with the hardline republic.
paras.zh: 奈杰尔·法拉奇（Nigel Farage）最新的亿万富翁捐助者与伊朗最高领导人权威下的一个强大的伊朗宗教基金会有业务往来，这引发了人们对他过去与强硬共和国的交易的质疑。

paras.en: Hossein Ghandehari, also called Sasan, was little known in the UK until he pledged to give millions to Reform UK this summer and donated £50,000 to Farage to cover the cost of two passes for the Davos World Economic Forum.
paras.zh: 侯赛因·甘德哈里（Hossein Ghandehari），又名萨桑（Sasan），在英国鲜为人知，直到他承诺今年夏天向改革英国捐赠数百万英镑，并向法拉奇捐赠 5 万英镑，用于支付达沃斯世界经济论坛两张通行证的费用。

paras.en: He has said he is moving his tax residency from Switzerland to the UK in order to make “regular payments” of more than “one or two million” to the party.
paras.zh: 他表示，他正在将自己的税务居民身份从瑞士转移到英国，以便向该党“定期付款”超过“一两百万”。

paras.en: The 61-year-old Iranian-born British businessman, who says he runs a $10bn (£7bn) fund called HP Trust, has declined to give details about how his family made its money beyond saying the fund owns assets in Europe and North America.
paras.zh: 这位 61 岁的伊朗出生的英国商人表示，他经营着一家名为 HP Trust 的 100 亿美元（70 亿英镑）基金。除了表示该基金在欧洲和北美拥有资产外，他拒绝透露其家族如何赚钱的详细信息。

paras.en: Now, a French arbitration decision unearthed by the Guardian sheds some light on Ghandehari’s past dealings with Iranian state-linked entities between 2013 and 2016.
paras.zh: 现在，《卫报》披露的一项法国仲裁裁决揭示了甘德哈里过去在 2013 年至 2016 年间与伊朗国家相关实体的交易。

paras.en: It also reveals Ghandehari’s further Iranian business links to another Reform UK donor, John Richard Simpson, an administration professional and church warden from Potters Bar, north of London. Simpson’s design firm, Interior Architecture Landscape, counts the Ghandehari family as a client and gave £200,000 to Reform UK last year.
paras.zh: 它还揭示了甘德哈里与另一位英国改革捐助者约翰·理查德·辛普森（John Richard Simpson）在伊朗业务上的进一步联系，约翰·理查德·辛普森是来自伦敦北部波特斯巴的行政专业人士和教堂典狱长。辛普森的设计公司 Interior Architecture Landscape 将甘德哈里家族视为客户，去年向 Reform UK 捐赠了 20 万英镑。

paras.en: Farage has been highly critical of Iran over the past year, and in March accused it of being a bigger danger to the UK than Russia’s president, Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 法拉奇在过去的一年里一直严厉批评伊朗，并在三月份指责伊朗对英国的威胁比俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京更大。

paras.en: The French judgment reveals that Ghandehari was the major investor behind a deal to supply and build a fibre-optic cable to carry telecoms traffic across Iran in a joint venture with a state-linked Iranian partner.
paras.zh: 法国的判决显示，甘德哈里是一项交易的主要投资者，该交易旨在与一家与国家有联系的伊朗合作伙伴成立一家合资企业，供应和建造一条光纤电缆，以在伊朗各地传输电信流量。

paras.en: The businessman’s HP Trust was the ultimate owner of Ori Group, which took a 49% stake in the venture, called Omran Razavi International Co, in 2015.
paras.zh: 这位商人的 HP Trust 是 Ori Group 的最终所有者，Ori Group 于 2015 年持有这家名为 Omran Razavi International Co 的合资企业 49% 的股份。

paras.en: The other 51% of the venture was owned by Astan Quds Razavi (AQR), a multibillion pound religious foundation in Iran’s second city of Mashhad.
paras.zh: 该合资企业另外 51% 的股份由阿斯坦圣城拉扎维 (AQR) 所有，这是一家位于伊朗第二大城市马什哈德、耗资数十亿英镑的宗教基金会。

paras.en: AQR’s leader at the time was ayatollah Abbas Vaez Tabasi, who was appointed custodian of the foundation by the first supreme leader, Ruhollah Khomeini, and served from the 1979 revolution until his death in 2016. Vaez Tabasi had been an ally of some reformers but remained close to the next supreme leader, Ali Khamenei, and, according to the BBC, was reported by state media in 2009 to have said of opposition protest movements that those behind “sedition” in the country were “enemies of god” who deserved to be executed under sharia law.
paras.zh: AQR 当时的领导人是阿亚图拉阿巴斯·瓦埃兹·塔巴西 (Ayatollah Abbas Vaez Tabasi)，他被第一任最高领导人鲁霍拉·霍梅尼 (Ruhollah Khomeini) 任命为该基金会的保管人，从 1979 年革命开始一直服务到 2016 年去世。瓦埃兹·塔巴西 (Vaez Tabasi) 曾是一些改革派的盟友，但仍与下一任最高领袖阿里·哈梅内伊 (Ali Khamenei) 关系密切，据英国广播公司 (BBC) 报道，官方媒体 2009 年报道，瓦埃兹·塔巴西曾表示反对派抗议一些运动认为，该国“煽动叛乱”的幕后黑手是“上帝的敌人”，应该根据伊斯兰教法被处决。

paras.en: The joint venture ended in about 2016, with the Ghandehari-backed entities being pushed out of the deal as a hardliner was appointed to replace Vaez Tabasi.
paras.zh: 该合资企业于 2016 年左右结束，甘地哈里支持的实体被排除在交易之外，因为强硬派被任命取代瓦埃兹·塔巴西 (Vaez Tabasi)。

paras.en: The US imposed sanctions on AQR in 2021, saying it controlled “large swaths of the Iranian economy, including assets expropriated from political dissidents and religious minorities, to the benefit of supreme leader Ali Khamenei and senior Iranian government officials”. It describes it as a bonyad, one of the “opaque, quasi-official organisations generally controlled by current and former government officials and clerics that report directly to the supreme leader”.
paras.zh: 美国于 2021 年对 AQR 实施制裁，称其控制“伊朗经济的大片领域，包括从政治异见人士和宗教少数群体手中没收的资产，以造福于最高领袖哈梅内伊和伊朗政府高级官员”。它将其描述为“bonyad”，“不透明的准官方组织，通常由现任和前任政府官员和神职人员控制，直接向最高领袖报告”。

paras.en: Ghandehari’s lawyers said it would be misleading to characterise him as “working with Iran” without the context that, after 2016, he was targeted by Iran’s supreme national security council with the false allegation that he was working with hostile western powers. They also said his involvement was intended to promote political change through greater access to information, which he believed was why the US and French authorities authorised the project.
paras.zh: 甘达哈里的律师表示，如果没有这样的背景，将他描述为“与伊朗合作”将会产生误导，因为2016年之后，他就被伊朗最高国家安全委员会针对，并错误地指控他正在与敌对的西方国家合作。他们还表示，他的参与旨在通过更多地获取信息来促进政治变革，他认为这就是美国和法国当局批准该项目的原因。

paras.en: Tom Keatinge, the director of the Centre for Finance and Security at Rusi, the foreign affairs thinktank, said dealing with Iran “has always been a risky business as a financial institution because of this blurring between kind of state and the private sector. The private sector is not free to operate. It’s just very hard to operate in that country without touching a live rail.”
paras.zh: 外交智库Rusi金融与安全中心主任汤姆·基廷格(Tom Keatinge)表示，“作为一家金融机构，与伊朗打交道一直是一件有风险的事情，因为国家和私营部门之间的界限很模糊。私营部门不能自由运营。在那个国家，如果不接触带电的铁路，就很难开展业务。”

paras.en: He said there was clearly a range of positions among ayatollahs but it would be “pretty difficult to operate in an industry like telecoms” without the acceptance of the core leadership.
paras.zh: 他表示，阿亚图拉之间显然有一系列的职位，但如果没有核心领导层的接受，“在电信这样的行业中运作将非常困难”。

paras.en: The judgment also revealed that, until 2016, Ghandehari’s HP Trust was the owner of Orico General Trading LLC, which was contracted to supply telecoms equipment from France’s Alcatel-Lucent and transport it from Dubai to Iran. After 2016, this company was transferred to Simpson, the administration professional, who was responsible for winding down Orico’s operations and taking hundreds of staff out of the region.
paras.zh: 判决还显示，直到 2016 年，甘德哈里的 HP Trust 一直是 Orico General Trading LLC 的所有者，该公司签订了从法国阿尔卡特朗讯供应电信设备并将其从迪拜运输到伊朗的合同。 2016年之后，这家公司被移交给行政专业人士辛普森，他负责结束奥睿科的业务并将数百名员工撤离该地区。

paras.en: Simpson told the Guardian he acquired the company after Iranian extremists took over AQR, when the project’s assets were seized and those involved faced political persecution on national security grounds, including accusations of working for hostile western governments. He said his plan was to wind down the business, adding that he carried out detailed checks before acquiring Orico.
paras.zh: 辛普森告诉《卫报》，他在伊朗极端分子接管 AQR 后收购了该公司，当时该项目的资产被扣押，相关人员因国家安全而面临政治迫害，包括被指控为敌对的西方政府工作。他表示，他的计划是结束该业务，并补充说，他在收购 Orico 之前进行了详细的检查。

paras.en: Ghandehari’s lawyers said AQR was independent and respected, and therefore the only viable choice for a joint venture in Iran. They said Ghandehari had never met Vaez Tabasi and that he did not regard him as an advocate for freedom or human rights but had believed him to be the only force in the Iranian hierarchy capable of holding back the hardliners in order for the project to go ahead.
paras.zh: 甘德哈里的律师表示，AQR 是独立且受尊重的，因此是在伊朗成立合资企业的唯一可行选择。他们说，甘德哈里从未见过瓦埃兹·塔巴西，也不认为他是自由或人权的倡导者，但相信他是伊朗等级制度中唯一有能力阻止强硬派以使该项目继续进行的力量。

paras.en: The original contract for the deal was awarded to the Omran consortium in 2012 by the Iranian state-owned Telecommunication Infrastructure Company of Iran.
paras.zh: 该交易的原始合同于2012年由伊朗国有电信基础设施公司授予奥姆兰财团。

paras.en: According to Iranian corporate filings, Omran Razavi International Co also owned stakes in two majority state-owned banks, Bank Mellat and Bank Tejerat, in 2013. Both were subject to sanctions over involvement in Iran’s nuclear programme at that point.
paras.zh: 根据伊朗公司备案文件，奥姆兰·拉扎维国际公司 (Omran Razavi International Co) 还于 2013 年持有两家多数国有银行：梅拉特银行 (Bank Mellat) 和特吉拉特银行 (Bank Tejerat) 的股份。当时，两家银行都因参与伊朗核计划而受到制裁。

paras.en: Ghandehari’s lawyers said Omran Razavi disposed of the small stakes in the banks before HP Trust’s Ori Group signed its agreement for a 49% stake in the venture in December 2014. They added that the deal was fully approved by authorities in France and the US.
paras.zh: 甘德哈里的律师表示，奥姆兰·拉扎维 (Omran Razavi) 在 HP Trust 旗下的 Ori Group 于 2014 年 12 月签署收购该合资企业 49% 股份的协议之前，就出售了银行的少量股份。他们补充说，该交易得到了法国和美国当局的完全批准。

paras.en: In 2016, AQR took over the whole of the joint venture. Around the same time, the project’s chair, Mohammed Reza Noory, ended up in Iran’s infamous Evin prison, serving an 18-year sentence.
paras.zh: 2016年，AQR接管了整个合资企业。大约在同一时间，该项目的主席穆罕默德·礼萨·努里 (Mohammed Reza Noory) 最终在伊朗臭名昭著的埃文监狱服刑 18 年。

paras.en: Ghandehari and Noory are both named on leaked judicial papers published by the hacktivist group Edaalat Ali as having being under investigation in Iran after the deal collapsed. Ghandehari’s lawyers say he first became aware of the “bogus allegations” during French court proceedings and that the intelligence services had not given him any further details. Ghandehari’s representatives said fabricating financial and social cases against its targets to discredit them was part of the Iranian regime’s playbook and had been widely documented and recognised by western governments, human rights organisations and independent journalists.
paras.zh: 黑客活动组织 Edaalat Ali 发表的泄露司法文件中，甘德哈里和努里的名字都被提及，因为交易失败后他们正在伊朗接受调查。甘德哈里的律师表示，他在法国法庭诉讼期间首次意识到这些“虚假指控”，但情报部门没有向他提供任何进一步的细节。甘达哈里的代表表示，捏造针对其目标的金融和社会案件来抹黑他们是伊朗政权剧本的一部分，并已被西方政府、人权组织和独立记者广泛记录和认可。

paras.en: Ghandehari’s lawyers said he had not been to Iran for 30 years and his wealth had no connection to the country, since his ancestral property and assets were confiscated in 2016.
paras.zh: 甘达哈里的律师表示，他已经30年没有去过伊朗了，自2016年他的祖传财产和资产被没收以来，他的财富与该国没有任何关系。

paras.en: Farage has been highly critical of Iran’s government this year, supporting Donald Trump’s war against it, and attending a protest outside the Iranian embassy with pro-democracy activists in the spring. Last week he warned about Iranian agents entering the UK via small boats across the Channel.
paras.zh: 法拉奇今年一直对伊朗政府持高度批评态度，支持唐纳德·特朗普对伊朗发动的战争，并于春季与亲民主活动人士一起参加了伊朗大使馆外的抗议活动。上周他警告伊朗特工通过小船穿越英吉利海峡进入英国。

paras.en: In a joint interview with Farage and Ghandehari in July, the Telegraph described Ghandehari’s business deal in Iran without mentioning its connections to Iranian regime-linked companies. It described it as a project to bring access to high-speed internet to Iran that would help drive reform, but that it later went wrong and resulted in Ghandehari’s assets being confiscated.
paras.zh: 在 7 月对法拉奇和甘德哈里的联合采访中，《每日电讯报》描述了甘德哈里在伊朗的商业交易，但没有提及其与伊朗政权相关公司的关系。它将其描述为一个为伊朗提供高速互联网的项目，有助于推动改革，但后来出现了问题，导致甘德哈里的资产被没收。

paras.en: It is still not clear how Ghandehari and his family have built up their extraordinary wealth. His fortune is said to have gone from an estimated $2bn, when his late mother bought a property on London’s “billionaire’s row” in 2008, to a reported $10bn now.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚甘德哈里和他的家人是如何积累了非凡的财富的。据说，当他已故的母亲 2008 年在伦敦“亿万富翁区”购买一处房产时，他的财富据称已从估计的 20 亿美元增至目前据报道的 100 亿美元。

paras.en: In a recent court case over a Picasso painting, Ghandehari was asked to provide proof that he could afford £1.5m in legal costs. His lawyers pointed only to a brochure from his Davos trip with Farage, with a description that he controls a trust with a “collective investment value in excess of $10bn”.
paras.zh: 在最近一起关于毕加索画作的法庭案件中，甘达哈里被要求提供证据，证明他有能力承担 150 万英镑的法律费用。他的律师只提到了他与法拉奇一起达沃斯之行的一本小册子，其中描述了他控制着一个“集体投资价值超过 100 亿美元”的信托基金。

paras.en: At one point, he offered a letter from a “partner in a leading accountancy firm” confirming he was the principal beneficiary of HP Trust, and drawing an annual income from it. However, this was later withdrawn, as Ghandehari decided he did not want its contents to enter the public domain.
paras.zh: 有一次，他提供了一封来自“一家领先会计师事务所的合伙人”的信，确认他是惠普信托的主要受益人，并从中提取年收入。然而，该消息后来被撤回，因为甘德哈里决定不希望其内容进入公共领域。

articles.title: Reader Q&A: What’s next for France after a weekend of riots? Ask our Europe columnists
articles.author: Rokhaya Diallo, Alexander Hurst, Michael Hubbard and Guardian moderators

paras.en: After weeks of protests and a weekend of riots in which a town hall was set ablaze, 2,000-plus shops were looted, 2,300 people were arrested and 1,000 police injured, the repercussions for France – for its society and its economy – continue. Allegations of police brutality surfaced, and the violent protests unnerved investors, resulting in a debt sell-off, with borrowing costs rising higher than for Greece. All of this ahead of a hotly contested presidential election that’s now just six months away.
paras.zh: 经过数周的抗议活动和一个周末的骚乱，市政厅被纵火，2,000多家商店被抢劫，2,300人被捕，1,000名警察受伤，法国社会和经济受到的影响仍在继续。对警察暴行的指控浮出水面，暴力抗议令投资者感到不安，导致债务抛售，借贷成本上升幅度高于希腊。所有这一切都发生在距离激烈竞争的总统选举仅剩六个月的时间之前。

paras.en: The French government’s escalating financial problems were covered by the Guardian’s Europe correspondent Jon Henley who wrote: “France’s national debt, at 119% of GDP, is at its highest level since 1946. Its budget deficit, at 5.1%, is also among the highest in the EU. There is just no money in the bank to ease the cost of living squeeze that brought 550,000 people on to the streets on Saturday.”
paras.zh: 《卫报》驻欧洲记者乔恩·亨利 (Jon Henley) 报道了法国政府不断升级的财政问题，他写道：“法国的国债占 GDP 的 119%，处于 1946 年以来的最高水平。其预算赤字为 5.1%，也是欧盟最高的国家之一。银行里没有钱来缓解生活成本的压力，导致周六有 55 万人走上街头。”

paras.en: Columnist Paul Taylor commented that “Last weekend’s violence has increased the likelihood of a law-and-order backlash among voters that could propel (Marine) Le Pen into the Élysée Palace. But if the financial situation worsens and the campaign turns on who can save the economy, she may yet lose out to a candidate who is firm on security and more orthodox on fiscal policy.”
paras.zh: 专栏作家保罗·泰勒评论道，“上周末的暴力事件增加了选民对法律和秩序的强烈反对，这可能会推动（海军陆战队）勒庞入主爱丽舍宫。但如果金融状况恶化，竞选活动转向谁能拯救经济，她可能会输给一位对安全坚定、在财政政策上更正统的候选人。”

paras.en: And the Guardian’s editorial noted that “In an increasingly febrile atmosphere, France is heading towards a seismic reckoning in May. Alarmingly, the civil strife witnessed at the weekend may only be a foretaste of what is to come.”
paras.zh: 《卫报》的社论指出，“在日益激烈的气氛中，法国将在五月迎来一场地震般的清算。令人担忧的是，周末目睹的内乱可能只是即将发生的事情的预兆。”

paras.en: What are your views on the riots, their causes and their aftermath? Are they paving a path to the presidency for Le Pen? In his final months in charge, can embattled incumbent Emmanuel Macron meaningfully address the situation in which France finds herself?
paras.zh: 您对骚乱及其起因和后果有何看法？他们是否为勒庞铺平了总统之路？在执政的最后几个月里，陷入困境的现任总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙能否有效解决法国面临的困境？

paras.en: France-based Guardian Europe columnists Rokhaya Diallo and Alexander Hurst will be live here at 1500BST on Friday 23 October to answer your questions on what happened, why, and where France goes from here.
paras.zh: 驻法国的《卫报》欧洲专栏作家 Rokhaya Diallo 和 Alexander Hurst 将于英国夏令时 10 月 23 日星期五 1500 点现场直播，回答您关于发生了什么、为什么以及法国将走向何方的问题。

paras.en: Comments will open at 0900BST on Friday, but you can send your questions by email now to conversations@theguardian.com
paras.zh: 评论将于周五 0900BST 开放，但您现在可以通过电子邮件将您的问题发送至conversations@theguardian.com

articles.title: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found

paras.en: Organisations and businesses are still scrambling to update their systems after cyber-security flaws were revealed in a widely-used programming language, PHP.
paras.zh: 在广泛使用的编程语言 PHP 中发现网络安全缺陷后，组织和企业仍在争先恐后地更新其系统。

paras.en: Websites around the world were taken offline on Wednesday and Thursday after the developers of PHP said "critical vulnerabilities" were found in the back-end language, used in web development for decades.
paras.zh: PHP 开发人员表示，在这种用于 Web 开发数十年的后端语言中发现了“严重漏洞”后，世界各地的网站于周三和周四下线。

paras.en: Researchers warned the "severe" flaws could expose millions of sites using it to potential hacks if left unpatched - and the UK government was among those to take some sites offline as a precaution.
paras.zh: 研究人员警告说，如果不及时修补，这些“严重”缺陷可能会让数百万使用它的网站面临潜在的黑客攻击，英国政府也是其中之一，将一些网站下线作为预防措施。

paras.en: There have been no successful attacks reported so far, but experts say any impact may take time - even months - to become fully apparent.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，还没有成功的攻击报告，但专家表示，任何影响可能需要时间——甚至几个月——才能完全显现出来。

paras.en: Downing Street said on Thursday "some" limited government services "may be offline" while security work was being carried out.
paras.zh: 唐宁街周四表示，在安全工作进行期间，“一些”有限的政府服务“可能会离线”。

paras.en: "The information I have is that 32 Government services are unavailable and four are partially unavailable," tech minister Baroness Lloyd of Effra told the House of Lords.
paras.zh: “我掌握的信息是，有 32 项政府服务无法使用，其中 4 项服务部分无法使用，”科技部长埃弗拉 (Effra) 劳埃德男爵夫人 (Baroness Lloyd of Effra) 告诉上议院。

paras.en: She attributed this to having "largely resulted from precautionary measures taken to protect systems while security updates and mitigations are applied".
paras.zh: 她将此归因于“很大程度上是由于在应用安全更新和缓解措施时为保护系统而采取的预防措施”。

paras.en: The government did not specify which services were taken offline - but it said no large UK public-facing critical services had been affected.
paras.zh: 政府没有具体说明哪些服务被下线，但表示英国面向公众的大型关键服务没有受到影响。

paras.en: A spokesperson said work had already taken place across government to "identify and fix potential exposures to our systems and our experts are continuing to work closely with both OpenAI and international partners on this issue".
paras.zh: 一位发言人表示，政府部门已经开展工作，“识别并修复我们系统的潜在风险，我们的专家将继续与 OpenAI 和国际合作伙伴就这个问题密切合作”。

paras.en: "But this does not mean they were hacked, and work continues to resolve any issues," they added.
paras.zh: “但这并不意味着他们遭到了黑客攻击，我们将继续努力解决任何问题，”他们补充道。

paras.en: Olly Whitehouse, chief technology officer of the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC), called the event "unprecedented".
paras.zh: 国家网络安全中心（NCSC）首席技术官奥利·怀特豪斯（Olly Whitehouse）称此次事件“史无前例”。

paras.en: "It will be universally felt, I suspect," he told BBC Radio 4's World At One.
paras.zh: “我怀疑，这将是普遍的感受，”他告诉 BBC 广播 4 台的 World At One。

paras.en: But he said there were "no indications" of any successful breaches by hackers.
paras.zh: 但他表示，“没有迹象表明”黑客成功实施了任何攻击。

paras.en: He said the NCSC was "starting to see positive confirmation" that advice sent to those affected, external had been received and was being acted on.
paras.zh: 他表示，NCSC“开始看到积极的确认”，即已收到发送给受影响者的外部建议，并正在采取行动。

paras.en: Cyber-security lecturer Rory Hopcraft told the BBC the government needed to make sure that its own infrastructure was up-to-date.
paras.zh: 网络安全讲师罗里·霍普克拉夫特 (Rory Hopcraft) 告诉 BBC，政府需要确保自己的基础设施是最新的。

paras.en: "Hacking has been around for many years," he said.
paras.zh: “黑客行为已经存在很多年了，”他说。

paras.en: "The government are the ones who set the rules for other organisations... they just need to effectively be practising what they're preaching at this point."
paras.zh: “政府是为其他组织制定规则的人……他们现在只需要有效地实践他们所宣扬的内容即可。”

paras.en: Dean Presley, who has a garage in Chepstow, South Wales, told BBC Your Voice he had been unable to properly process MOTs online.
paras.zh: Dean Presley 在南威尔士切普斯托拥有一个车库，他告诉 BBC Your Voice，他无法在网上正确处理 MOT。

paras.en: He said his computer system had been down since Wednesday morning, and while he has experienced outages before, they have not lasted this long.
paras.zh: 他说，自周三早上以来，他的计算机系统就一直宕机，虽然他以前也经历过宕机，但持续时间并没有这么长。

paras.en: "MOTs can be conducted and they're legal but none of the paperwork and certificates can be printed and they're not on the system," Dean said.
paras.zh: “MOT 可以进行，而且是合法的，但没有任何文件和证书可以打印，而且它们也不在系统中，”迪恩说。

paras.en: He said this has forced him to write everything on paper documents, leading to delays for customers.
paras.zh: 他说，这迫使他将所有内容都写在纸质文件上，导致客户延误。

paras.en: PHP stands for PHP: Hypertext Preprocessor.
paras.zh: PHP 代表 PHP：超文本预处理器。

paras.en: It's a programming language which runs on a web server, behind the scenes of a website, and effectively lets you see the sites you visit.
paras.zh: 它是一种在网站后台的网络服务器上运行的编程语言，可以有效地让您查看您访问的网站。

paras.en: When you go to a site, PHP is the code which collects data and effectively turns it into a page you can read.
paras.zh: 当您访问某个网站时，PHP 是收集数据并有效地将其转换为您可以阅读的页面的代码。

paras.en: It was developed in the early 1990s to help serve dynamic web pages and applications, but still powers lots of platforms today.
paras.zh: 它于 20 世纪 90 年代初开发，旨在帮助提供动态网页和应用程序，但至今仍为许多平台提供支持。

paras.en: PHP has been used across a wide range of platforms including Wikipedia, online shops and WordPress â the system behind many websites - as well as to write tools to build web apps, with Laravel, Symfony and Drupal among popular PHP frameworks.
paras.zh: PHP 已广泛用于各种平台，包括维基百科、在线商店和 WordPress（许多网站背后的系统），以及编写构建 Web 应用程序的工具，其中流行的 PHP 框架包括 Laravel、Symfony 和 Drupal。

paras.en: According to cyber-security firm Wiz, external, which helped uncover the critical PHP vulnerabilities surfaced this week, PHP powers 70% of the world's websites.
paras.zh: 根据帮助发现本周出现的关键 PHP 漏洞的网络安全公司 Wiz, external 的说法，PHP 为全球 70% 的网站提供支持。

paras.en: And it said the flaws - now coined "php2shell" - were inherent in the language itself, affecting many past versions of it.
paras.zh: 它表示这些缺陷（现在被称为“php2shell”）是该语言本身固有的，影响了它的许多过去的版本。

paras.en: The PHP Foundation, the non-profit which maintains the programming language, warned this meant that, under the right conditions, an unauthenticated attacker would be able to remotely execute code on servers running PHP.
paras.zh: 维护该编程语言的非营利组织 PHP 基金会警告说，这意味着在适当的条件下，未经身份验证的攻击者将能够在运行 PHP 的服务器上远程执行代码。

paras.en: Some large organisations said they had seen a high volume of attempts to breach their systems.
paras.zh: 一些大型组织表示，他们发现大量试图破坏其系统的行为。

paras.en: Matthew Prince, the boss of internet infrastructure firm Cloudflare, wrote on X, external on Thursday that the company saw "thousands" of attempts to exploit the PHP vulnerabilities across its network in the 10 hours before it was publicly announced.
paras.zh: 互联网基础设施公司 Cloudflare 的老板 Matthew Prince 周四在 X, external 上写道，在公开宣布之前的 10 小时内，该公司在其网络上发现了“数千次”利用 PHP 漏洞的尝试。

paras.en: "That jumped to tens of thousands in the 45 minutes post announcement, hundreds of thousands within two hours, and millions now," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“公告发布后 45 分钟内，人数跃升至数万，两小时内跃升至数十万，现在已达数百万。”

paras.en: Amazon also says it saw hackers attempt to exploit the flaws, but its websites were operating as normal.
paras.zh: 亚马逊还表示，它看到黑客试图利用这些漏洞，但其网站运行正常。

paras.en: While the impact of the PHP flaw remains to be seen, disruption continued for businesses and organisations after many sites were taken down on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 虽然 PHP 缺陷的影响仍有待观察，但在周三许多网站被关闭后，企业和组织的中断仍在继续。

paras.en: The website of a Dutch agency specialising in cyber-security, Finland's government and parts of Wikipedia, taken temporarily offline, had returned to business as usual by Thursday.
paras.zh: 一家专门从事网络安全的荷兰机构、芬兰政府和维基百科部分网站的网站暂时关闭，但到周四已恢复正常运行。

paras.en: But a number of sites appeared to have been taken offline on Thursday, as operators rushed to check if PHP might be running within their systems or if any patches were required.
paras.zh: 但周四，一些网站似乎已经下线，因为运营商急于检查 PHP 是否可能在其系统中运行，或者是否需要任何补丁。

paras.en: In France, telecommunications company Orange also said, external it had suspended access to certain services globally while it deployed security fixes.
paras.zh: 在法国，电信公司 Orange 也表示，在部署安全修复程序的同时，该公司已暂停在全球范围内访问某些服务。

paras.en: According to some cyber-security researchers using scans to check servers at risk of the PHP vulnerability, the rate of organisations implementing patches - but not as quickly as might be hoped globally.
paras.zh: 根据一些网络安全研究人员使用扫描来检查存在 PHP 漏洞风险的服务器的说法，组织实施补丁的速度 - 但没有全球希望的那么快。

paras.en: "The window to respond has shrunk dramatically," said Matt Hull, VP of cyber intelligence and response at global cyber security company NCC Group.
paras.zh: 全球网络安全公司 NCC 集团网络情报和响应副总裁马特·赫尔 (Matt Hull) 表示：“响应窗口已大幅缩小。”

paras.en: "A few years ago, attackers might have taken weeks to exploit a vulnerability. Now, it can be days or hours."
paras.zh: “几年前，攻击者可能需要几周的时间才能利用一个漏洞。现在，可能需要几天或几个小时。”

paras.en: Hull also highlighted the extent of the task facing developers and engineers working to deal with the issue.
paras.zh: 赫尔还强调了开发人员和工程师解决这一问题所面临的任务的艰巨性。

paras.en: "Several days into this incident, security professionals might already be dealing with significant burnout," he said, urging a need to "make time to rest, share the workload and look after each other".
paras.zh: “这起事件发生几天后，安全专业人员可能已经面临严重的倦怠，”他说，并敦促需要“腾出时间休息，分担工作量并互相照顾”。

paras.en: "Resilience depends on people as much as technology."
paras.zh: “复原力不仅取决于技术，还取决于人。”

articles.title: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit

paras.en: A US judge has ordered President Donald Trump to answer questions under oath in his defamation lawsuit against the BBC by 11 December.
paras.zh: 美国法官命令唐纳德·特朗普总统在 12 月 11 日之前在针对 BBC 的诽谤诉讼中宣誓回答问题。

paras.en: Trump is suing the BBC over an episode of Panorama that edited together two different sections of a speech he gave before the riot at the US Capitol in 2021.
paras.zh: 特朗普正在起诉 BBC，原因是《全景》中的一集将他在 2021 年美国国会大厦骚乱前发表的演讲的两个不同部分剪辑在一起。

paras.en: Charles Tobin, a lawyer representing the BBC, said in court that "we still haven't been able to depose the plaintiff" with two months left in the discovery period.
paras.zh: BBC 的代表律师查尔斯·托宾 (Charles Tobin) 在法庭上表示，距离证据披露期还剩两个月，“我们仍然无法宣判原告的罪名”。

paras.en: Trump cancelled a previous deposition on 16 October, citing "matters of national importance" while he was campaigning in Georgia.
paras.zh: 特朗普在 10 月 16 日取消了之前的证词，理由是他在佐治亚州竞选期间存在“国家重大问题”。

paras.en: In US law, a deposition is an out-of-court statement made under oath in response to questions, which is recorded for use in later proceedings.
paras.zh: 在美国法律中，证词是为回答问题而在宣誓下做出的庭外声明，该声明会被记录下来以供以后的诉讼程序使用。

paras.en: The judge in the case, US Magistrate Judge EnjoliquÃ© Lett, said that Trump must sit for the deposition by 11 December, unless the discovery period is extended.
paras.zh: 该案的法官、美国治安法官 Enjoliqué Lett 表示，特朗普必须在 12 月 11 日之前出庭作证，除非证据开示期限被延长。

paras.en: Last week, attorneys asked that Lett compel Trump to face deposition after the last scheduled meeting did not take place.
paras.zh: 上周，在上次预定的会议没有举行后，律师要求莱特强迫特朗普接受证词。

paras.en: On that day, Trump attended a midterms campaign rally in Dalton, Georgia and a fundraiser at his property in Mar-a-Lago in Florida.
paras.zh: 当天，特朗普参加了在佐治亚州道尔顿举行的中期竞选集会，以及在他位于佛罗里达州海湖庄园的房产举行的筹款活动。

paras.en: In a separate filing on Wednesday, Trump's lawyers said that the president could appear for the interview between 11 and 22 January next year, and claimed that the BBC was "wrong to claim that President Trump is avoiding his deposition in this action."
paras.zh: 在周三的另一份文件中，特朗普的律师表示，总统可能会在明年 1 月 11 日至 22 日期间出庭接受采访，并声称 BBC“声称特朗普总统在此行动中避免作证的说法是错误的”。

paras.en: Trump's lawsuit - filed in Florida - accuses the BBC of "intentionally, maliciously, and deceptively doctoring" the speech he gave outside the Capitol on 6 January 2021.
paras.zh: 特朗普在佛罗里达州提起诉讼，指控 BBC“故意、恶意和欺骗性地篡改”他 2021 年 1 月 6 日在国会大厦外发表的演讲。

paras.en: The BBC apologised for the error and said that the broadcast gave "the mistaken impression that President Trump made a direct call for violent action".
paras.zh: 英国广播公司为这一错误道歉，并表示广播给人“特朗普总统直接呼吁采取暴力行动的错误印象”。

paras.en: The broadcaster has since asked that the court dismiss the lawsuit, arguing that the programme does not meet the legal criteria for defamation and was not available in the US.
paras.zh: 该广播公司此后要求法院驳回诉讼，称该节目不符合诽谤的法律标准，并且无法在美国播放。

paras.en: In July, Trump's lawyers conceded that they had no evidence that the documentary was available in the US on the BBC's BritBox subscription service - as they originally claimed - or on the BBC's website, BBC select or through US broadcasters.
paras.zh: 今年 7 月，特朗普的律师承认，他们没有证据表明这部纪录片可以在美国通过 BBC 的 BritBox 订阅服务（正如他们最初声称的那样）、BBC 网站、BBC select 或通过美国广播公司观看。

paras.en: Trump ultimately agreed to drop the lawsuit against BBC Studios, its commercial arm, after the BBC argued that it had "no role in creating or producing the documentary.
paras.zh: 在 BBC 辩称“在创作或制作这部纪录片中没有任何作用”之后，特朗普最终同意放弃对其商业部门 BBC Studios 的诉讼。

paras.en: Typically, depositions take place in a lawyer's office - rather than a courtroom - without a judge physically present.
paras.zh: 通常，证词是在律师办公室而不是法庭进行的，没有法官亲自在场。

paras.en: Depositions, however, carry legal weight and take place under oath. They are recorded verbatim by a court reporter, and the transcripts can later be used as evidence during trials.
paras.zh: 然而，证词具有法律效力，并且是在宣誓后进行的。法庭记录员逐字记录这些内容，这些笔录可以在审判期间用作证据。

articles.title: 'Demeaning' and 'absurd': The backlash against a hugging grandparents consent ad

paras.en: It's the consent campaign that's sparked heated debate across Ireland and beyond - so why has a social media ad about getting a hug from your grandparents been pulled?
paras.zh: 正是同意运动在爱尔兰及其他地区引发了激烈的争论——那么为什么一则关于获得祖父母拥抱的社交媒体广告被撤下呢？

paras.en: The ad, described by an Irish government minister as "demeaning to grandparents", sees a house's front door opening to reveal an elderly couple.
paras.zh: 爱尔兰政府部长称这则广告“侮辱了祖父母”，广告中一栋房子的前门打开，露出一对老年夫妇。

paras.en: They hug their grandson and lean into embrace their granddaughter, who looks uncomfortable before it quickly cuts to a graphic and voiceover.
paras.zh: 他们拥抱孙子，又拥抱孙女，孙女看起来很不舒服，然后很快就切换到画面和画外音。

paras.en: "Not everyone wants a hug. Even from the people who love them. Awkward? Maybe. Important? Absolutely."
paras.zh: “不是每个人都想要拥抱。即使是爱他们的人。尴尬？也许。重要？绝对。”

paras.en: The tone is light-hearted, and the aim is to promote the importance of consent for children - but it has apparently landed with a thud in Ireland and with many online.
paras.zh: 语气轻松，目的是宣传儿童同意的重要性 - 但它显然在爱尔兰和许多网上引起了轰动。

paras.en: The ad, one of three, is part of a campaign called We-Consent, run by the Dublin Rape Crisis Centre (DRCC).
paras.zh: 这则广告是三则广告之一，是都柏林强奸危机中心 (DRCC) 发起的名为“We-Consent”的活动的一部分。

paras.en: The backlash has opened up a debate about changing norms, the role of family and how best to teach consent to children.
paras.zh: 这种强烈反对引发了一场关于改变规范、家庭角色以及如何最好地教导儿童同意的争论。

paras.en: While some have described it as a waste of money, others have defended it as showing how children have differences when it comes to boundaries and that it is "not campaigning against grandparents".
paras.zh: 虽然有些人认为这是浪费钱，但另一些人则辩称，这表明孩子们在边界问题上存在差异，并且“不是针对祖父母的运动”。

paras.en: Irish Justice Minister Jim O'Callaghan has been an instrumental critic - his department is one of the sources of funding for the campaign and its removal came after his officials intervened.
paras.zh: 爱尔兰司法部长吉姆·奥卡拉汉一直是一位重要的批评者——他的部门是这场运动的资金来源之一，在他的官员干预后，该部门被撤职。

paras.en: He said the video "does not represent the views of the government".
paras.zh: 他表示该视频“不代表政府的观点”。

paras.en: "It was both inappropriate and demeaning to grandparents and has been removed by DRCC following my officials engagement with them.
paras.zh: “这对祖父母来说既不恰当，又有辱人格，在我的官员与他们接触后，DRCC 已将其删除。

paras.en: "While it is vital to ensure that people understand the concept of consent when it comes to sexual relationships, this video did not advance that aim and in many ways was counterproductive."
paras.zh: “虽然确保人们在性关系方面理解同意的概念至关重要，但这段视频并没有推进这一目标，而且在很多方面都起到了反作用。”

paras.en: In a statement to Irish broadcaster RTÃ, the DRCC said the videos were "premised on the idea that boundaries should be respected from an early age and to respect others' boundaries too".
paras.zh: DRCC 在给爱尔兰广播公司 RTà 的一份声明中表示，这些视频“的前提是应该从小就尊重界限，也应该尊重他人的界限”。

paras.en: "We are going to remove the videos from our social media channels while we reflect on whether they are having the positive effect we want them to have," it added.
paras.zh: 它补充说：“我们将从我们的社交媒体渠道中删除这些视频，同时反思它们是否产生了我们希望它们产生的积极影响。”

paras.en: Fine Gael Senator Gareth Scahill, who is among the critics, said the video was a waste of resources.
paras.zh: 批评者之一的统一党参议员加雷斯·斯卡希尔表示，该视频浪费资源。

paras.en: "What's concerning here is public money has been used to fund an ad which at best has been ill-thought out, and at worst is offensive and potentially damaging to our older population," he said, adding that this "publicly-funded social media video is a million miles off the mark".
paras.zh: 他说：“令人担忧的是，公共资金被用来资助一则广告，这则广告充其量是经过深思熟虑的，最坏的情况是具有冒犯性，并可能对我们的老年人造成损害。”他补充说，这段“由公共资助的社交媒体视频离题一百万英里”。

paras.en: "What's next? Will we need to sign consent forms at arrival halls in Dublin, Shannon, Knock and Cork airports this Christmas before we can greet family members?"
paras.zh: “下一步是什么？今年圣诞节我们是否需要在都柏林、香农、诺克和科克机场的到达大厅签署同意书，然后才能迎接家人？”

paras.en: A spokesperson for the Department of Justice said the videos were "produced by DRCC at low cost using volunteers and are not part of a government advertising campaign".
paras.zh: 司法部发言人表示，这些视频“由 DRCC 使用志愿者以低成本制作，并非政府广告活动的一部分”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Dr Eoin O'Malley, an associate professor at Dublin City University, said he believes the advert is the latest example of the state overreaching.
paras.zh: 与此同时，都柏林城市大学副教授欧因·奥马利博士表示，他认为这则广告是政府过度干预的最新例子。

paras.en: "You are seeing people pushing ideas that are beyond mainstream," he said.
paras.zh: “你会看到人们提出超越主流的想法，”他说。

paras.en: O'Malley said that the importance of consent is reasonable to most people, but that the video is too extreme.
paras.zh: 奥马利表示，同意的重要性对大多数人来说是合理的，但该视频过于极端。

paras.en: "The idea that there needs to be an ad telling grandparents that they shouldn't hug their grandkids, that they should look for permission in advance of that, seems absurd to most normal people.
paras.zh: “需要有一个广告告诉祖父母他们不应该拥抱他们的孙子，他们应该提前寻求许可，这种想法对大多数普通人来说似乎很荒谬。

paras.en: "The Irish constitution is very clear that the family is the primary unit for teaching children and for raising children, and so to some extent this is kind of going beyond that."
paras.zh: “爱尔兰宪法非常明确，家庭是教育儿童和抚养儿童的主要单位，因此在某种程度上，这有点超出了这一范围。”

paras.en: However, the campaign has its defenders too.
paras.zh: 然而，该运动也有其捍卫者。

paras.en: Academic Dr Ãrfhlaith Campbell said it is not an attack on grandparents but instead aimed to highlight the importance of consent.
paras.zh: 学术界的 årflaith Campbell 博士表示，这并不是对祖父母的攻击，而是旨在强调同意的重要性。

paras.en: "The ad is highlighting differences in children's needs and the imp (sic) of consent. It is not campaigning against grandparents. Dear god in heaven!!!" she wrote on X, external.
paras.zh: “这则广告强调了儿童需求的差异以及同意的重要性。这并不是针对祖父母的运动。天哪！！！”她在X上写道，外部。

paras.en: An account named Danny Boy said it wasn't "discouraging grandparents from hugging children" but was "encouraging children to speak up" if they feel uncomfortable.
paras.zh: 一个名为 Danny Boy 的账户表示，这并不是“阻止祖父母拥抱孩子”，而是“鼓励孩子们在感到不舒服时大声说出来”。

paras.en: University of Galway academic Dr Eoin Daly said that while the video was "patronising", the message was correct.
paras.zh: 戈尔韦大学学者伊恩·戴利博士表示，虽然该视频“居高临下”，但所传达的信息是正确的。

paras.en: Fine Gael councillor Lorraine Hall also defended the advert, and said the message of the video was intended to be "figurative" rather than "literal".
paras.zh: 统一党议员洛林·霍尔也为该广告辩护，并表示该视频的信息旨在“比喻”而不是“字面意思”。
