articles.title: AIPAC halts endorsements and direct contributions to candidates
articles.author: Saige Miller

paras.en: AIPAC halts endorsements and direct contributions to candidates

The pro-Israel political organization AIPAC, or the American Israel Public Affairs Committee, announced on Wednesday that it will no longer issue endorsements, make direct PAC contributions or earmark funds for candidates.

A longtime influential lobbying group, AIPAC started its direct political involvement five years ago. Since then, particularly this midterm election cycle, AIPAC has been met with mounting resistance. The group has faced criticism over its stances on various issues, including the wars in Gaza and Iran.

Candidates endorsed by AIPAC have also faced tough opposition from both the political right and the political left for accepting the organization's support and financial contributions as public opinion on the U.S. relationship with Israel has shifted. In order to tame the criticism, some AIPAC-endorsed candidates said they won't accept any money from the organization.

AIPAC first announced the changes in a letter to members, stating "the challenges we are confronting will continue to grow in the years ahead." In the letter, AIPAC said it wouldn't stop funneling money to candidates that align with the group's mission by mobilizing individual donors.

"We will prioritize increasing direct, organized contributions from individual Americans to candidates—expanding upon our current efforts—and maximizing the emerging political fundraising tools," the letter said.

The letter added that the 2028 cycle will "demand an even stronger commitment by our activists to pro-Israel politics." As a result, the group plans to increase support "for the Republicans and Democrats who are advancing policies that strengthen America's alliance with Israel and standing up against anti-Israel legislation."
In a statement to NPR, AIPAC spokesperson Deryn Sousa said the group's mission and strategy remains the same despite the changes.

"Our goal is to build support for the U.S.-Israel relationship. AIPAC members gave more than $90 million directly to candidates this cycle, and that organized, direct giving from our members will continue and increase."

AIPAC contributed nearly $25 million to candidates and political committees in 2026 through Sept. 30, according to FEC filings. Its affiliated super PAC United Democracy Project contributed $13 million to candidates and political committees and spent an additional $53.5 million in independent expenditures.

AIPAC confirmed with NPR that its affiliated super PAC, United Democracy Project, will continue to operate and will be able to raise an unlimited amount of money. It has spent heavily to support pro-Israel candidates, and oppose those who criticize Israel.
In recent days, several of the super PAC's individual independent expenditures are being used to campaign against Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Michigan.

AIPAC also spent heavily to campaign against El-Sayed in the primary, backing his opponent, Rep. Haley Stevens. The Michigan Senate contest is just one of the high-profile races where AIPAC has spent in favor of a pro-Israel politician or in opposition to someone the organization sees as less favorable to Israel.

articles.title: Mass firings vow sparks clash with Klobuchar over Walz fraud legacy

paras.en: Minnesotaâs gubernatorial candidates clashed over the stateâs fraud scandals in their second debate of the week, with Republican House Speaker Lisa Demuth pledging to fire all state commissioners on her first day in office and Democratic Sen. Amy Klobuchar defending her response.
The scandals have rocked the North Star State, raising questions about how large-scale abuse of state programs went undetected and putting government oversight at the center of the governorâs race.
"Fraud unchecked here in the state of Minnesota has gone far too long, and it has finally come to the surface," Demuth said.

"The thing that I will do on day one is I am going to be firing all commissioners, choosing new commissioners that are expert in their field, that will carry out the accountability and transparency that is needed in our state. We have to change the culture of fraud."
Klobuchar called Demuthâs remarks "absurd" and said she contacted U.S. Attorney Andy Luger after the fraud came to light to ask what prosecutors needed.
"He said, 'I need more prosecutors'," Klobuchar said. "I called the highest level of the Justice Department, and I got him those prosecutors."
Klobuchar also said she would have caught the fraud earlier, while criticizing Walzâs response. "Tim Walz should have caught the fraud earlier and he should have done more," she said.

She also sought to distinguish herself from the outgoing governor and criticized Demuth for not clearly separating herself from President Donald Trump. "We donât need a rubber stamp of Donald Trump in the governorâs office," Klobuchar said.
Demuth countered that Klobuchar had not identified specific policies on which she would break with Walz, whom Klobuchar has called an "incredible governor."

Beyond fraud, Klobuchar and Demuth used the debate to draw broader contrasts over the economy, taxes, public safety and the direction of the state. Both candidates have ruled out tax increases, but Demuth has argued Minnesota needs to rein in spending and regulations, while Klobuchar has emphasized lowering costs for health care, housing and child care.

Wednesdayâs debate in Rochester was the candidatesâ second faceoff this week and likely their final debate before Election Day on Nov. 3. Republicans have not won a statewide race in Minnesota since 2006.
The race will also make history regardless of the outcome, producing Minnesotaâs first female governor. A Demuth victory would additionally make her the stateâs first Black governor.

articles.title: Angel Reese delivers another double-double as Atlanta Dream take 2–1 lead in WNBA Finals

paras.en: ATLANTA â Angel Reese helped the Atlanta Dream win a WNBA Finals game for the first time Monday. Two nights later, she helped them take their first lead in a Finals series.

Reese finished with 21 points and 12 rebounds as Atlanta beat the Golden State Valkyries 97-71 on Wednesday night at State Farm Arena, taking a 2â1 lead in the best-of-seven series. Reese has totaled 51 points and 28 rebounds in Atlantaâs two victories.
Reese became the youngest player in WNBA Finals history to record at least 20 points and 10 rebounds in consecutive games, joining Aâja Wilson as the only players to accomplish the feat.

And to give the Dream and their fans credit, I previously questioned whether Atlanta could fill State Farm Arena for the Finals. They answered that with a resounding yes on Wednesday night. Game 3 was a sellout, and the building was loud.

Before tip-off, both teams again left the court for the national anthem, marking their third straight absence in the series. They returned moments after the performance ended. The WNBAâs rulebook calls for players, coaches and trainers to stand and line up during the anthem, and the league has not answered OutKickâs questions about the absences.

Once the game started, Reese picked up where she left off in San Francisco. She scored Atlantaâs first basket and finished the opening quarter with eight points, including a three-pointer that pushed the Dreamâs lead to 22â12.
Golden State missed its first eight shots and didnât make a field goal until 4:38 remained in the first quarter. Atlanta led 23â15 after one.

Reese added another three in the second quarter and went into halftime with 15 points, matching her first-half total from Game 2. Naz Hillmon made three first-half threes of her own, helping Atlanta take a 46â40 lead into the break.
The Valkyries made a push to start the third. Cecilia Zandalasini hit two threes in the opening 68 seconds, and Golden State tied the game at 48, then again at 49.

Reese helped Atlanta answer. After Rhyne Howard put the Dream back in front, Reese made two free throws, assisted on an Isobel Borlase layup and scored on a running layup herself. That completed an 8â0 run and gave Atlanta a 57â49 lead.

Golden State cut the deficit to four, but the Dream kept scoring after Reese went to the bench with 3:31 left in the quarter. DeWanna Bonner hit a three to start a 12â2 finish to the period, scoring five points during that stretch.
Atlanta led 71â57 entering the fourth and Golden State never really threatened in the final period.
Hillmon finished with 15 points, while Jordin Canada added 8 assists. Rhyne Howard had her best offensive performance of the series, scoring 16 points.
Atlanta again held down Golden Stateâs Gabby Williams, who finished with 15 points on 5-of-18 shooting.
Atlanta entered these Finals without a win in its three previous appearances, then lost Saturdayâs opener. Now Reese and the Dream are two victories from a championship.

articles.title: Kansas Senate rivals distance themselves from party leaders in fiery debate

paras.en: Sen. Roger Marshall, R-Kan., and Democratic challenger Adam Hamilton repeatedly sought to distance themselves from the most unpopular elements of their respective parties Wednesday night during a contentious Kansas Senate debate.
Both candidates battled over President Donald Trump, immigration, the war in Iran and more in a race that could help determine control of the Senate.
The debate opened on a personal note, with both candidates pressed over controversies that have fueled attack ads in the closing weeks of the campaign.

Marshall was questioned about a New York Times review that found his former medical practice sued more than 700 patients over unpaid bills. The Republican defended the practice while emphasizing the millions of dollars in free care his practice provided.
"Every year we gave away $3 to $4 million of charity, but we also had a business," Marshall said. "We had 300 employees, we had a mortgage payment, we had electric."

Hamilton, meanwhile, was questioned about his handling of allegations involving a volunteer at his church's summer camp alleged to have been a sexual predator. Hamilton acknowledged that he should have ensured the individual did not return to the camp after an initial investigation.
"I should have checked to make sure that he wasn't going back," Hamilton said. "That was a mistake on my part."
The candidates spent much of the rest of the debate trying to define each other by their respective national parties.

Marshall repeatedly warned that electing Hamilton would help hand control of the Senate to Democrats and Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, while Hamilton sought to portray himself as an independent-minded Democrat willing to break with his party.
That divide came into focus when the moderator played footage of Trump campaigning for Marshall in Kansas earlier this week and telling voters to "pretend, please, that I'm on the ballot."
Asked whether that meant he would support every part of Trump's agenda, Marshall said no and pointed to recent disagreements involving immigration enforcement in southwest Kansas and beef imports.
"Just like with my wife, I can disagree with her. My wife is always right," Marshall joked. "And President Trump is not always right."
Nevertheless, Marshall emphasized his support for much of Trump's agenda and urged the president's supporters to turn out for him.

"We need the Trump voters to come out," Marshall said. "If you want the Trump agenda to continue, if you want secure borders, if you want a strong military, if you want lower taxes, then you â and you voted for President Trump â you need to come out."
Hamilton faced a similar challenge when moderators pressed him over his past support for Democrats and his campaign message of "leading from the middle."
The Democratic nominee explicitly broke with former President Joe Biden over immigration.
"The Biden policies when it came to the border were a disaster," Hamilton said. "I believe in strong and secure borders."
Hamilton also said he would not support Schumer for majority leader if Democrats win control of the Senate.
The debate did produce an unusual moment of agreement when both candidates were asked how many genders there are.
"There's two. There's a boy and there's a girl," Marshall said.
"There are two genders, male and female," Hamilton responded.

Hamilton later said he did not want biological males competing against his 12-year-old granddaughter in sports, calling it "not a fair fight," while arguing that decisions over athletic participation should generally be handled locally rather than by the federal government.

The Kansas contest has emerged as an unexpectedly competitive Senate race in the closing weeks of the midterms. Marshall is seeking a second term in a state that has not elected a Democratic U.S. senator since 1932, while Hamilton, a longtime pastor, has campaigned as a moderate Democrat.
Trump traveled to Kansas Monday to campaign for Marshall as Republicans work to defend the seat with control of the Senate at stake.

articles.title: Man fined after 700 frozen and taxidermied animals found on Victorian property
articles.author: Jordyn Beazley

paras.en: The white-walled room packed with magpies, galahs and sulphur-crested cockatoos, foxes and possums is eerily quiet. As a video pans across shelves filled with these and many other species, there is no flapping or squawking or hissing; the animals are frozen and silent.
They are among the more than 700 native animals that were found illegally taxidermied and frozen that were seized from the property of a Victorian antiques store owner last year.

On Tuesday, 74-year-old Glenn Richard Rollo was fined $10,000 by a court after he pleaded guilty to 13 charges, including selling and possessing protected and threatened wildlife and failing to provide treatment to a sick animal.

The regulator searched his property as part of a broader crackdown on the illegal wildlife trade, executing search warrants for the man’s store and home in April last year. Restrictions on selling and possessing threatened and protected species apply to both living and dead animals.

During their search they found 14 freezers containing animals. Across the property they found hundreds of dead reptiles, native birds and mammals, including 78 emus, 42 brushtail possums and 26 echidnas. They also found the remains of threatened species, including the barking owl, diamond python and Murray River short-necked turtle.

In addition to the dead animals, 15 live reptiles were found in enclosures, including North American red-eared slider turtles and corn snakes. Six of the reptiles, the regulator said, were not being kept under the required animal welfare standards.
The regulator said the man did not have the licence of authorisation under Victoria’s wildlife laws to obtain or possess the animals.

Wildlife in Victoria is protected under the Wildlife Act 1975, which outlaws taking native animals without approval. A commercial wildlife licence or private wildlife licence is required to trade dead animals.
Victorians who wish to taxidermy animals are also required obtain a licence under the conservation regulator. The man did not hold a licence.

During an appearance before Kynton local court on Tuesday, magistrate Patrick Southey reportedly told the man: “It is bewildering that a man of your intelligence and knowledge and love of wildlife would arrogantly flout the law so comprehensively.”

The conservation regulator director of regulatory operations, Cal Heppell, said: “The scale of offending in this case highlights why Victoria has strong protections in place for wildlife and animal welfare.
“Our laws and permit systems help protect wildlife from unlawful exploitation, ensure animals are appropriately cared for and safeguard Victoria’s environment and biodiversity from potential threats.
“These requirements are not optional. Anyone who keeps, trades or possesses wildlife must comply with the law.”
Victoria Animal Justice party MP Georgie Purcell said the wildlife laws in Victoria are not strong enough and called on the government to modernise the 50-year-old welfare act.
“This is a horrific case that has rattled our community of Kyneton but it should serve as a wake-up call as to just how broken our so-called wildlife protection laws are here in Victoria,” she said.

Purcell said that the $10,000 fine for possessing 700 dead native animals and keeping reptiles in poor conditions was “barely a deterrent and doesn’t send a message to the community that wildlife are respected and protected in Victoria”.

“The government talks a big game about protecting wildlife but cases like this show just how badly our native animals are being let down. If hundreds of native animals can end up dead in someone’s collection, questions need to be asked why the government has continued to stall when it comes to ensuring these laws meet community expectations.”

articles.title: ‘Almost looks fake’: two Sydney beaches closed after whale carcass washes up
articles.author: Kat Wong

paras.en: A whale carcass has forced the closure of two busy swimming and surfing spots after washing up between Coogee and Maroubra beaches in Sydney – but there are no plans to remove it.
paras.zh: 一具鲸鱼尸体在悉尼Coogee和Maroubra海滩之间冲洗后，迫使两个繁忙的游泳和冲浪场所关闭–但没有计划将其移除。

paras.en: The whale’s heavily decomposed body was found on Thursday morning at Lurline Bay, a rocky cove surrounded by cliffs in Sydney’s eastern suburbs.
paras.zh: 周四早上，在悉尼东郊悬崖环绕的岩石海湾Lurline Bay发现了鲸鱼严重腐烂的尸体。

paras.en: It’s believed to be a juvenile humpback.
paras.zh: 据信这是一只幼年座头鲸。

paras.en: Local council said nearby Coogee and Maroubra beaches would be closed until further notice to protect oceangoers as whale carcasses have been known to attract sharks.
paras.zh: 当地议会表示，附近的Coogee和Maroubra海滩将关闭，直到另行通知，以保护海洋生物，因为已知鲸鱼尸体会吸引鲨鱼。

paras.en: “We have cordoned off the area to leave this creature in peace and safe from the attention of people,” Randwick Council mayor, Dr Clare Willington, told reporters.
The council has also contacted Surf Life Saving about introducing extra drone patrols, but Willington said it was a precaution as there had not yet been reports of an increase in shark activity.
Willington said there were no plans to remove the whale and that staff were working with Gamay Rangers about a culturally and environmentally sensitive approach to take.
“This is a natural occurrence and in time nature will deal with the carcass,” Willington said.

The Gamay Rangers are an Indigenous ranger team who undertake natural and cultural resource management activities like protection work, conservation, and threatened species management in the La Perouse Local Aboriginal Land Council area.

The whale is an important totem animal to the local Bidjigal people, and Gamay Rangers manager Robert Cooley said previous instances where beached animal carcasses were taken to landfill had distressed his community.
However, Cooley said he was not “super confident” the rising tide would return the carcass to the sea.
“We’re got a reasonably strong north-east wind here and a bit of a swell pushing it back up – so that’s going to be a challenge,” he said.

“We’ll just have to wait and see what happens but the animal is in a pretty advanced stage of decomposition, so if it did go out into the ocean, I don’t think it would take long for nature to break it down.”
If intervention is necessary, the rangers would be discussing plans with cultural advisers, he said.
The whale is believed to be a young humpback, but it is difficult to confirm due to its state of decomposition, Cooley said.
The carcass was first spotted on Wednesday in Sydney’s northern beaches near Manly, where attempts were made to tow it out to sea, which is why there are pieces of rope found with the whale.
The council is encouraging residents and visitors to avoid the area and follow directions from lifeguards and authorities.
It comes as authorities are working to free a large whale found stuck in shallow waters off Turners Beach on Tasmania’s north-west coast.
“Members of the public are asked to avoid the area and not enter the water on the incoming tide due to the anticipated danger,” Tasmanian police said.
Curious locals have stopped by Lurline Bay throughout the morning to try catch a glimpse of the whale.
Meeri Pajala, an au pair from Finland who is living in Sydney, said she had never seen anything like this before.
“It almost looks fake to me,” she told Guardian Australia. “That skin looks so weird.”
Glenda, a local who did not want her full name published, says she usually watches whales swimming by the coast and was curious when she heard the news.
“My interest is in if it’s newborn, or if it’s juvenile,” she said. “I thought it would be more complete.”
It was nudging up against the rocks as the waves ebbed and flowed but had become stuck in a crevice due to low tide.
To the surprise of many onlookers, it doesn’t seem to have a smell.

articles.title: North Korea prepares to restart propaganda loudspeakers as ties sour with South
articles.author: Raphael Rashid in Seoul

paras.en: Propaganda loudspeakers aimed at South Korea will be ready to restart within days along the entire border, Kim Yo-jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, has said amid a worsening of ties between the two countries.
paras.zh: 朝鲜领导人金正恩(Kim Jong-un)的强大姐妹金友宗(Kim Yo-jong)表示，在两国关系恶化的情况下，针对韩国的宣传扬声器将在几天内在整个边境重新启动。

paras.en: The statement, carried by the state news agency KCNA on Thursday, came a day after she said the loudspeakers would be in operation along the whole border from some time in October.
paras.zh: 国家通讯社KCNA周四发表的声明是在她表示扬声器将从10月份的某个时候开始在整个边境运行的一天之后发表的。

paras.en: Both North and South Korea have historically used giant loudspeakers to broadcast propaganda across the border, with the North in recent years playing haunting bestial howls, and the South opting for K-pop music and news criticising Pyongyang.
paras.zh: 朝鲜和韩国历来都使用巨型扬声器在边境播放宣传，近年来朝鲜播放了令人难以忘怀的野兽嚎叫，而韩国则选择了批评平壤的韩国流行音乐和新闻。

paras.en: If the broadcasts resume, they would be the first loudspeaker exchange across the border in 16 months. South Korean president Lee Jae Myung suspended broadcasts from the southern side just days into his presidency in June 2025 to ease tensions with Pyongyang, and the military dismantled the speakers that August.
paras.zh: 如果广播恢复，这将是16个月内首次跨越边境的扬声器交换。韩国总统李在寅（ Lee Jae Myung ）在2025年6月上任几天后就暂停了南方的广播，以缓解与平壤的紧张关系，军方在8月份拆除了演讲者。

paras.en: At a briefing on Thursday, a defence ministry spokesperson in Seoul said that if North Korea went ahead, “naturally there would have to be a proportional measure”, but made clear no decision had been made.
paras.zh: 在周四的一次简报会上，国防部发言人在首尔表示，如果朝鲜继续前进， “自然必须有相称的措施” ，但明确表示没有做出任何决定。

paras.en: The joint chiefs of staff said routine maintenance of the North’s loudspeakers had been observed before Kim Yo-jong’s statements.
paras.zh: 参谋长联席会议表示，在Kim Yo-jong发表声明之前，已经观察到朝鲜扬声器的例行维护。

paras.en: Tensions between the two Koreas have risen since September, when a landmine blast south of the military demarcation line injured three South Korean soldiers, two of them seriously.
paras.zh: 自9月以来，两韩之间的紧张局势加剧，当时军事分界线以南发生地雷爆炸，造成3名韩国士兵受伤，其中2人伤势严重。

paras.en: Seoul and the UN command – which oversees the 1953 armistice that halted but did not end the Korean war – concluded it was a North Korean anti-personnel mine and an armistice violation. Pyongyang denied responsibility and called the incident a “self-staged farce”.
paras.zh: 首尔和负责监督1953年停止但并未结束朝鲜战争的停战协议的联合国司令部得出结论，这是朝鲜的杀伤人员地雷，违反了停战协议。平壤否认对此负责，称此次事件是“自我上演的闹剧”。

paras.en: The loudspeaker threat comes as North Korea continues to fortify its side of the border. Since Kim Jong-un declared that the two Koreas were “two states hostile to each other” in December 2023, North Korea has laid mines, strung barbed wire and erected anti-tank barriers along the border.
paras.zh: 扬声器威胁正值朝鲜继续加强边境防御之际。自金正恩于2023年12月宣布朝韩是“敌对的两个国家”以来，朝鲜在边境地区埋设了地雷，竖起了铁丝网，并设置了反坦克障碍。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Kim Yo-jong inspected several fortification points along the border with Pak Jong-chon, a marshal and adviser to Pyongyang’s defence ministry.
paras.zh: 周三，金友宗视察了与平壤国防部元帅兼顾问朴正全（ Pak Jong-chon ）接壤的边界沿线的几个防御工事点。

paras.en: The border had been “clearly blocked and turned into a fortress more thoroughly”, she said, adding that Kim Jong-un had told her it “should be a permanent line never to be crossed”.
paras.zh: 她说，边境“显然被封锁，更彻底地变成了堡垒” ，并补充说，金正恩告诉她， “应该是一条永不跨越的永久线路”。

paras.en: Seoul says North Korean troops have repeatedly crossed the military demarcation line, the 250km line dividing the two Koreas, during the construction work, prompting South Korean soldiers to issue warnings over loudspeakers and fire warning shots.
paras.zh: 首尔说，朝鲜军队在施工期间多次越过军事分界线，即分隔两韩的250公里线，促使韩国士兵通过扬声器发出警告并开火示警。

paras.en: North Korea has called the warning shots and broadcasts provocations by “armed rogues”.
paras.zh: 朝鲜已发出警告，并广播了“武装流氓”的挑衅行为。

articles.title: US embassy accuses Canada of election meddling ahead of midterms

paras.en: The US Embassy in Ottawa has accused Canadian officials of election meddling ahead of the November midterms.
paras.zh: 美国驻渥太华大使馆指责加拿大官员在11月中期选举前干预选举。

paras.en: The embassy said Canadian leaders have brushed off concerns over "potential interference", and that ministers and premiers "openly describe plans to influence American politics in official documents and public appearances".
paras.zh: 大使馆表示，加拿大领导人已经消除了对“潜在干涉”的担忧，部长和总理“在官方文件和公开露面时公开描述了影响美国政治的计划”。

paras.en: Canadian leaders, including Prime Minister Mark Carney, have dismissed the claims. Relations between the North American neighbours have hardened during second Trump administration.
paras.zh: 包括总理马克·卡尼（ Mark Carney ）在内的加拿大领导人驳回了这些说法。在特朗普第二次执政期间，北美邻国之间的关系变得更加强硬。

paras.en: The midterms will determine which political party controls both branches of the US Congress, which could have a significant impact on the rest of Donald Trump's presidency.
paras.zh: 中期选举将决定哪个政党控制美国国会的两个分支，这可能对唐纳德·特朗普总统任期的其余部分产生重大影响。

paras.en: The fact sheet released by the US Embassy on Wednesday alleges the Canadian government "brushes off concerns about potential interference in U.S. elections, even as its ministers and premiers openly describe plans to influence American politics in official documents and public appearances".
paras.zh: 美国大使馆周三发布的概况介绍称，加拿大政府“消除了对可能干涉美国选举的担忧，尽管其部长和总理在官方文件和公开露面时公开描述了影响美国政治的计划”。

paras.en: It cites comments and actions, like meetings with US Democrats and calling for retaliatory tariffs against the US.
paras.zh: 它引用了评论和行动，例如与美国民主党人的会晤，并呼吁对美国征收报复性关税。

paras.en: For example, it says that when Industry Minister MÃ©lanie Joly was asked what she expected regarding tariffs if Democrats were to win midterm elections, she responded, "That's exactly why I'm meeting so many governors and potential presidential candidates."
paras.zh: 例如，当工业部长Mélanie Joly被问及如果民主党赢得中期选举，她对关税的预期时，她回答说： “这就是为什么我会见这么多州长和潜在的总统候选人。”

paras.en: Ontario Premier Doug Ford pushed Canada's federal government, it states, to consider additional retaliatory tariffs on imports from "politically significant states to the current administration's base of support".
paras.zh: 安大略省省长道格·福特（ Doug Ford ）敦促加拿大联邦政府考虑对从“政治上重要的州到本届政府的支持基础”的进口产品征收额外的报复性关税。

paras.en: Asked on Wednesday about the allegations, Carney noted that it was the US that first initiated trade actions against Canada.
paras.zh: 周三被问及这些指控时，卡尼指出，是美国首次对加拿大发起贸易行动。

paras.en: "We've responded to those to protect Canadian jobs, to protect Canadian companies and develop our economy," Carney said.
paras.zh: “我们已经对这些措施做出了回应，以保护加拿大的就业机会，保护加拿大公司并发展我们的经济，”卡尼说。

paras.en: He said his government's response has been "in the interests of Canadian workers, Canadian families and the future of this economy".
paras.zh: 他说，他的政府的回应是“为了加拿大工人、加拿大家庭和这个经济体的未来”。

paras.en: Carney, who was announcing a nearly C$9bn ($6.2bn) aid package in response to US tariffs, was accompanied by both Joly and Ford.
paras.zh: 作为对美国关税的回应，卡尼宣布了近90亿加元（ 62亿美元）的援助计划，乔利和福特也在场。

paras.en: Ford said that he has "no interest at all" in interfering in US elections.
paras.zh: 福特表示，他“根本没有兴趣”干涉美国大选。

paras.en: "I'll tell you what the American people want. They want certainty, they want stability," Ford said, adding that he will focus on Ontario and Canada.
paras.zh: “我会告诉你美国人民想要什么。他们想要确定性，他们想要稳定，”福特说，并补充说，他将专注于安大略省和加拿大。

paras.en: "The people of the United States will make that determination in the midterms," he said.
paras.zh: “美国人民将在中期做出决定，”他说。

paras.en: Last week, Minister Joly denied Canadian interference and said that Canadians "never accept that also being done to us in Canada", according to CBC.
paras.zh: 据加拿大广播公司报道，上周，乔利部长否认加拿大的干涉，并表示加拿大人“永远不会接受加拿大对我们所做的事情”。

paras.en: She said that her recent visits to the US were "to attract investments" from American companies, which she plans to continue.
paras.zh: 她说，她最近访问美国是为了“吸引”美国公司的投资，她计划继续这样做。

paras.en: Washington and Ottawa have argued for months over tariffs and trade, which once flowed freely across their borders, and the effects of Canada's counter measures.
paras.zh: 几个月来，华盛顿和渥太华一直在争论曾经自由跨境流动的关税和贸易，以及加拿大反制措施的影响。

paras.en: Earlier this month, US Ambassador to Canada Pete Hoekstra warned that US officials are "closely watching" Canada's politicians for signs of election interference.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，美国驻加拿大大使皮特·胡克斯特拉（ Pete Hoekstra ）警告说，美国官员正在“密切关注”加拿大政客干预选举的迹象。

paras.en: Trump administration officials have also been accused of making inappropriate remarks about the separation referendum in the province of Alberta this week.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府官员还被指控对本周在阿尔伯塔省举行的分离公投发表了不恰当的言论。

paras.en: A petition calling for Hoekstra's removal from his post for "undermining the Canada-U.S. diplomatic relations" has received more than 280,000 signatures.
paras.zh: 一份要求Hoekstra因“破坏加拿大-美国外交关系”而被免职的请愿书已收到超过28万个签名。

articles.title: What is PHP and why did it spark a global cyber-security scramble?

paras.en: For more than a decade, serious flaws had gone undetected in technology underpinning much of the internet.
paras.zh: 十多年来，互联网的许多技术都存在严重缺陷，但却没有被发现。

paras.en: It took artificial intelligence (AI) to bring them to light and caused a global cyber-security alert.
paras.zh: 人工智能（ AI ）将它们曝光，并引发了全球网络安全警报。

paras.en: The vulnerabilities lie within a programming language called PHP, which has been used internationally since the 2000s to build websites.
paras.zh: 这些漏洞存在于一种名为PHP的编程语言中，该语言自2000年代以来一直在国际上用于构建网站。

paras.en: Governments and cyber-security agencies around the world scrambled to contain the fallout of this discovery on Wednesday, and have urged website operators to install a new emergency fix or consider taking their platforms offline.
paras.zh: 周三，世界各地的政府和网络安全机构争先恐后地遏制这一发现的后果，并敦促网站运营商安装新的紧急修复程序或考虑将其平台下线。

paras.en: Cyber-security firm Wiz - one of the companies whose researchers uncovered the vulnerabilities - described the flaws as the "most severe" ever detected by AI.
paras.zh: 网络安全公司Wiz是研究人员发现漏洞的公司之一，该公司将这些漏洞描述为人工智能有史以来发现的“最严重”的漏洞。

paras.en: OpenAI, whose technology was used to find the flaws, called the discovery "one of the most impactful security issues in recent memory".
paras.zh: OpenAI的技术被用来发现漏洞，称这一发现是“近期记忆中最具影响力的安全问题之一”。

paras.en: Most people may not have heard of PHP - short for PHP: Hypertext Preprocessor - but they most certainly interact with it daily.
paras.zh: 大多数人可能没有听说过PHP （ PHP的缩写：超文本预处理器） ，但他们肯定每天都会与它交互。

paras.en: PHP powers a vast number of platforms, including online shops, Wikipedia and WordPress â the content management system behind many websites like blogs.
paras.zh: PHP为众多平台提供支持，包括在线商店、维基百科和WordPress--许多网站（如博客）背后的内容管理系统。

paras.en: When you visit a website like Wikipedia, PHP is the code that collects information you need and presents it in a way you can read on the web, Paul Spain, chief executive of Gorilla Cyber Security, told the BBC.
paras.zh: 大猩猩网络安全公司首席执行官保罗·西班牙（ Paul Spain ）告诉英国广播公司，当您访问维基百科（ Wikipedia ）等网站时， PHP是收集所需信息并以您可以在网上阅读的方式呈现的代码。

paras.en: But due to a flaw that could allow attackers to take control of affected web servers without authentication and steal sensitive data, everything built on PHP was left exposed.
paras.zh: 但是，由于一个漏洞可能允许攻击者在没有身份验证的情况下控制受影响的Web服务器并窃取敏感数据，因此基于PHP构建的所有内容都暴露在外。

paras.en: AI could make such attacks easier and faster, Spain said, estimating that the flaw could affect "millions and millions" of websites.
paras.zh: 西班牙表示，人工智能可以使此类攻击变得更容易、更快，并估计该漏洞可能会影响“数百万”网站。

paras.en: It would be "disastrous" if hackers or countries weaponised the flaw and seized private data from websites, said cyber-security researcher Jill Slay from the University of Adelaide.
paras.zh: 阿德莱德大学的网络安全研究员Jill Slay表示，如果黑客或国家将这一漏洞武器化，并从网站上获取私人数据，那将是“灾难性的”。

paras.en: The alert has disrupted services globally, from gaming platforms to government portals and online forums.
paras.zh: 从游戏平台到政府门户网站和在线论坛，该警报已在全球范围内中断服务。

paras.en: That includes Wikimedia - the organisation behind the online encyclopaedia Wikipedia - which took down a number of its systems as a precautionary measure.
paras.zh: 其中包括在线百科全书维基百科背后的组织维基媒体（ Wikimedia ） ，作为预防措施，它关闭了许多系统。

paras.en: Sites and pages have been taken offline by the Finnish government, Edinburgh council and the BBC, with the Netherlands' cyber-security agency also pulling its website.
paras.zh: 芬兰政府、爱丁堡市议会和英国广播公司已将网站和页面下线，荷兰的网络安全机构也将其网站下线。

paras.en: A number of Scotland's public organisations, including councils and health boards, have also taken their websites offline.
paras.zh: 苏格兰的一些公共组织，包括理事会和卫生委员会，也已经将其网站下线。

paras.en: Some experts warn the vulnerability could leave poorly maintained websites, particularly those belonging to smaller organisations with limited security resources, at greater risk.
paras.zh: 一些专家警告说，该漏洞可能会使维护不善的网站，特别是那些属于安全资源有限的小型组织的网站，面临更大的风险。

paras.en: More attempts to exploit these flaws are likely in the coming weeks since the technical details are now being made public, cyber-security researcher Salil Kanhere from UNSW Sydney said.
paras.zh: 悉尼新南威尔士大学的网络安全研究员Salil Kanhere表示，由于技术细节现已公开，未来几周可能会有更多利用这些漏洞的尝试。

paras.en: What happened after the flaws were exposed?
paras.zh: 漏洞暴露后发生了什么？

paras.en: Developers of the PHP platform on Wednesday rolled out patches to fix the vulnerabilities that had been lurking in their software for years.
paras.zh: PHP平台的开发人员周三推出了补丁，以修复多年来潜伏在其软件中的漏洞。

paras.en: "All PHP users are strongly encouraged to update immediately," the company said.
paras.zh: 该公司表示： “强烈建议所有PHP用户立即更新。”

paras.en: Authorities and security organisations around the world have echoed those warnings to website operators to secure their platforms.
paras.zh: 世界各地的当局和安全组织都向网站运营商发出了这些警告，以确保其平台的安全。

paras.en: The US National Security Agency told all organisations that use PHP to take their systems offline if they were unable to patch them immediately, adding that the flaw could provide a "direct path" to exploit a system's database.
paras.zh: 美国国家安全局告诉所有使用PHP的组织，如果他们无法立即修补系统，就会使其系统离线，并补充说，该漏洞可能为利用系统数据库提供“直接路径”。

paras.en: "These risks are serious enough to require immediate patching across United States Government departments and agencies," the agency said.
paras.zh: 该机构表示： “这些风险严重到需要立即在美国政府部门和机构之间进行修补。”

paras.en: The UK's National Cyber Security Centre gave similar advice and told organisations to check for "backdoors installed by an attacker".
paras.zh: 英国国家网络安全中心提供了类似的建议，并告诉组织检查“攻击者安装的后门”。

paras.en: Its counterparts in the EU and Australia have also issued similar alerts.
paras.zh: 欧盟和澳大利亚的同行也发出了类似的警报。

paras.en: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi urged people to check if their publicly available websites ran on PHP.
paras.zh: 日本首相高市早苗（ Sanae Takaichi ）敦促人们检查他们的公开网站是否使用PHP。

paras.en: "We have an urgent request for everyone to take action tonight," Takaichi wrote on X.
paras.zh: “我们迫切需要每个人今晚采取行动，” Takaichi在X上写道。

paras.en: "If it is difficult to apply the fix patch promptly, temporarily suspending websites and similar measures can be considered an effective way to reduce risk," she said.
paras.zh: 她说： “如果很难及时应用修补程序，暂时停用网站和采取类似措施可以被视为降低风险的有效方法。”

paras.en: The vulnerabilities were found by researchers at the security firms Calif and Wiz.
paras.zh: 安全公司Calif和Wiz的研究人员发现了这些漏洞。

paras.en: The researchers used advanced AI tools that are able to analyse code and find flaws much faster than humans or older systems can.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用了先进的人工智能工具，这些工具能够比人类或旧系统更快地分析代码和发现缺陷。

paras.en: "Modern software is incredibly complex, and some vulnerabilities can remain undetected for years," Kanhere said.
paras.zh: Kanhere说： “现代软件非常复杂，一些漏洞可能多年未被发现。”

paras.en: "The underlying bugs weren't new; what changed was our ability to find them," Kanhere said.
paras.zh: “潜在的漏洞并不新鲜；改变的是我们找到它们的能力，” Kanhere说。

paras.en: Details of the discovery leaked online this week, forcing the PHP platform's developers to rush out its announcement of the security flaw and its huge scale.
paras.zh: 这一发现的细节本周在网上泄露，迫使PHP平台的开发人员急于宣布安全漏洞及其巨大规模。

paras.en: The incident "highlights how AI can uncover security flaws" but also how it can "help attackers rapidly develop offensive tools and exploits," OpenAI said in a blog post.
paras.zh: OpenAI在一篇博客文章中表示，该事件“突出了人工智能如何发现安全漏洞” ，以及它如何“帮助攻击者快速开发攻击性工具和漏洞利用”。

paras.en: The ChatGPT-maker said it had released a program to check if the PHP platform is secure.
paras.zh: ChatGPT制造商表示，它已经发布了一个程序来检查PHP平台是否安全。

paras.en: "Many of these flaws stem from the way software were built in the past, which were built for functionality and not with security in mind," said Ryan Ko, at the University of Queensland's Cyber Research Centre.
paras.zh: 昆士兰大学网络研究中心的Ryan Ko表示： “许多这些缺陷源于过去构建软件的方式，这些软件是为了功能而构建的，而不是为了安全。”

paras.en: What can people do to safeguard themselves?
paras.zh: 人们可以做些什么来保护自己？

paras.en: Website owners are being urged to secure their websites with the latest version of PHP.
paras.zh: 敦促网站所有者使用最新版本的PHP保护其网站。

paras.en: The US National Security Agency has urged "heightened awareness" in the coming weeks and to closely monitor updates from software vendors.
paras.zh: 美国国家安全局敦促在未来几周“提高认识” ，并密切监控软件供应商的更新。

paras.en: "Vigilance in applying patches related to those systems is paramount," it said.
paras.zh: “在应用与这些系统相关的补丁时保持警惕至关重要，”它说。

paras.en: The onus lies mainly on website operators, but users should stay alert for any security advice issued by affected services, such as requests to change passwords, Kanhere said.
paras.zh: Kanhere说，责任主要在于网站运营商，但用户应该对受影响服务发布的任何安全建议保持警惕，例如更改密码的请求。

paras.en: He warned people to be alert to any phishing messages exploiting the publicity around the incident too.
paras.zh: 他警告人们也要警惕任何利用事件周围的宣传的网络钓鱼消息。

articles.title: No purchase, no seats: Starbucks China rolls out new policy

paras.en: Taking a seat at a Starbucks in China? Just make sure you're also ordering something there.
paras.zh: 在中国的星巴克就座？只需确保您也在那里订购了餐点即可。

paras.en: A new policy by Starbucks China takes effect across all its 8,000 stores on Thursday, making it mandatory for people to purchase items if they want to sit in its cafes.
paras.zh: 星巴克中国(Starbucks China)的一项新政策将于周四在所有8000家门店生效，规定人们如果想坐在咖啡馆里，必须购买商品。

paras.en: Starbucks China said the move was part of efforts to improve the "in-store experience" for customers. The company is facing stiff competition from homegrown brands such as Luckin Coffee.
paras.zh: 星巴克中国表示，此举是为了改善顾客的“店内体验”。该公司正面临来自瑞幸咖啡等本土品牌的激烈竞争。

paras.en: Reports of the new policy circulated this week, along with social media videos of what appear to be "purchase to sit" signs in Starbucks stores.
paras.zh: 本周发布了有关新政策的报道，以及星巴克商店中似乎是“购买坐着”标志的社交媒体视频。

paras.en: Many on Chinese social media welcomed the new policy.
paras.zh: 中国社交媒体上的许多人对这项新政策表示欢迎。

paras.en: "Finally, there won't be peak periods where people are just sitting there not ordering anything, drinking Luckin coffee, playing games and yelling on the phone," reads one of the top-liked comment on Weibo. "Every time I walk around, there's nowhere to sit,"
paras.zh: “最后，不会有高峰期，人们只是坐在那里什么也不点，喝着瑞幸咖啡，玩游戏，在手机上大喊大叫，”微博上最受欢迎的评论之一写道。“每次走来走去，都无处可坐。”

paras.en: "There's nothing wrong with it. I'd feel awkward sitting there if I didn't make a purchase. I'd rather leave the seats for those who made purchases and need the seats," another Weibo user commented.
paras.zh: “这没什么不对的。如果我不购买，我会觉得坐在那里很尴尬。我宁愿把座位留给那些购买并需要座位的人，”另一位微博用户评论道。

paras.en: Starbucks stores around the world have been wrestling with non-paying seat-hoggers and other undesirable behaviour from customers.
paras.zh: 世界各地的星巴克商店一直在与不付费的买座者和其他客户的不良行为作斗争。

paras.en: Last month, a Starbucks store in Sichuan province sparked debate after video of its chained-up outdoor seats and tables were circulated on social media. It appeared to be an attempt to block people from sitting there without paying.
paras.zh: 上个月，星巴克在四川省的一家商店在社交媒体上流传其户外座椅和桌子的视频后引发了争论。这似乎是企图阻止人们坐在那里而不付钱。

paras.en: In South Korea, Starbucks has told customers to stop bringing "bulky items" into their stores, after some patrons reportedly hogged seats with printers and desktop computers in tow.
paras.zh: 在韩国，星巴克已经告诉顾客停止将“笨重物品”带入他们的商店，据报道，一些顾客占据了打印机和台式电脑的座位。

paras.en: In North America, Starbucks reversed its open-door policy which for years allowed people to use their seats and toilets without buying anything, saying that it wanted to "prioritise" paying customers.
paras.zh: 在北美，星巴克改变了多年来允许人们无需购买任何东西即可使用座位和卫生间的开放政策，称其希望“优先考虑”付费客户。

paras.en: Since opening its first store there in 1999, China has become Starbucks' second-largest market. But it has faced stiff competition in recent years from Luckin and other local brands that offer cheaper products.
paras.zh: 自1999年在那里开设第一家门店以来，中国已成为星巴克的第二大市场。但近年来，它面临着来自瑞幸和其他提供更便宜产品的本地品牌的激烈竞争。

paras.en: Luckin also offers a robust app-based ordering system that prioritises grab-and-go transactions, challenging Starbucks' model of a full cafe experience where people can sit down and enjoy their food and drinks.
paras.zh: Luckin还提供强大的基于应用程序的订购系统，优先考虑即取即用交易，挑战星巴克的完整咖啡馆体验模式，人们可以坐下来享用食物和饮料。

paras.en: In 2023, Luckin overtook Starbucks as China's largest coffee chain.
paras.zh: 2023年，瑞幸超越星巴克成为中国最大的咖啡连锁店。

paras.en: Starbucks said last year it would sell 60% stake of its business in China as part of a $4bn (Â£3.04bn) deal with investment firm Boyu Capital.
paras.zh: 星巴克去年表示，作为与投资公司博宇资本(Boyu Capital)达成的40亿美元(30.4亿英镑)交易的一部分，它将出售其在中国60%的股份。

paras.en: In another statement on Wednesday, Starbucks China said it was planning to increase staffing and improve digital systems at its stores, among other investments to "ensure customers receive timely and warm service even during peak hours".
paras.zh: 在周三的另一份声明中，星巴克中国表示，计划增加门店的人员配置并改进数字系统，以及其他投资，以“确保客户即使在高峰时段也能及时获得热情的服务”。

articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

(MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.

Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.

Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).

“We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.

EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.

Carlisle’s EL121 Series disc brake pads are available now through authorized Carlisle dealers and distributors. To learn more, visit https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el. To locate an authorized Carlisle dealer near you, search our online distributor listing https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor.

Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Exhibitor Registration Opens for AASP/NJ’s 50th Annual NORTHEAST 2027
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Exhibitor registration is open for AASP/NJ’s NORTHEAST 2027 Automotive Services Show, set for March 19-21 at the Meadowlands Exposition Center in Secaucus, N.J.

“2027 marks half a century of the NORTHEAST show!” said Ken Miller, president of AASP/NJ. “That’s 50 years of bringing the industry’s best resources, education and equipment to generations of automotive and collision repair professionals. We are pulling out all the stops to make NORTHEAST 2027 not only our biggest yet, but also our most memorable. Plenty of surprises are in store, so mark your calendar to be in Secaucus next March!”

NORTHEAST is the largest automotive and collision repair trade show of its kind and the second-largest nationwide after SEMA. Attendees come from around the world every March to experience innovations, tools and educational opportunities.

The three-day show will feature a floor with over 100 exhibitors from across the automotive repair industry and an expanded slate of educational offerings for both mechanical and collision repairers. Plans include full-day mechanical-focused sessions, more classes for the service sector and Spanish-speaking courses in addition to the collision repair curriculum.

Outside the classroom, NORTHEAST will offer networking, competition and interactive events on the show floor. The Fifth Annual Bodywork Bowl returns, allowing participants to test their skills in welding, painting and estimating on the show floor. Attendees will also be entered into drawings for NORTHEAST Dollars and other prizes.
To reserve booth space for NORTHEAST 2027, visit aaspnjnortheast.com and click on Exhibitor Info.
For more information about AASP/NJ, visit aaspnj.org.

articles.title: GCIA Donates Recycled Rides at Golf Fundraiser
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: A presentation of three National Auto Body Council (NABC) Recycled Rides took place Oct. 12 as part of a golf fundraiser by the Georgia Collision Industry Association (GCIA) in Woodstock, Ga.
paras.zh: 10月12日，乔治亚州碰撞工业协会（ GCIA ）在佐治亚州伍德斯托克举办了一场高尔夫筹款活动，其中包括三场国家汽车机构理事会（ NABC ）回收乘坐活动。

paras.en: The GCIA is a non-profit trade association dedicated to promoting professionalism, safety and consumer awareness within the automotive collision repair sector across Georgia. The organization connects collision repair professionals, vendors, insurers and educational entities to navigate industry evolution, advocate for safe repair processes and elevate standards.
paras.zh: GCIA是一个非营利性行业协会，致力于在佐治亚州的汽车碰撞修理行业内促进专业性、安全性和消费者意识。该组织将碰撞维修专业人员、供应商、保险公司和教育实体联系起来，以引导行业发展，倡导安全的维修流程并提高标准。

paras.en: Prior to the golf event, three Atlanta-area residents each received a vehicle to assist as they work and care for their families, thanks to the NABC Recycled Rides program along with vehicle donors Allstate and repair partners Larry’s Body Shop, Babb’s Body Shop and Ed Voyles Collision Center, who are all members of the GCIA.
paras.zh: 在高尔夫活动之前，三名亚特兰大地区的居民分别收到了一辆车，以协助他们工作和照顾他们的家人，这要归功于NABC回收乘车计划以及车辆捐赠者Allstate和维修合作伙伴Larry's Body Shop ， Babb's Body Shop和Ed Voyles Collision Center ，他们都是GCIA的成员。

paras.en: Juliesha Carter was nominated by the Women’s Resource Center. Carter, is a survivor of domestic violence and a mother of five children, including a newborn. Over the years, her family has faced many challenges while working to rebuild their lives and create a safe, stable future. Despite these difficulties, they continue to move forward with hope and determination. She was commuting more than 50 minutes each way to work every day. Reliable transportation is essential not only for maintaining Carter’s employment but also for getting her children to school, appointments, activities and the many responsibilities that come with raising a large family. The financial strain of maintaining dependable transportation had been a constant challenge. This vehicle from Recycled Rides will provide security, stability and peace of mind during a very important time in Carter’s life, allowing her to focus on building a brighter future for her children.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Karen Ajanel Ceto is a resident at Georgia Sheriffs’ Youth Homes – Cherokee Estate. When Ceto was 14 years old, she traveled alone from her country of origin, Guatemala, to the U.S. Due to family discord, she was forced to leave, with hopes of finding a safe place and continue her education. Unfortunately, after Ceto arrived, she had to live in an abusive environment. She was placed at Cherokee Estate, and it has provided her with counseling, helped her learn the language and graduate high school. She is currently attending college and is very driven to succeed. Ceto wants to go into the medical field to help others but had to reply on staff’s availability for transportation. This vehicle from Recycled Rides will allow her to continue accomplishing her goals as she seeks to help others.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: “In Guatemala, it is a luxury to own a car, and it is not very common for women to own a car,” said Ceto. “That is why this moment is so special to me. I will be the first woman in my family to own a car, and I am so grateful to everyone responsible for this wonderful gift.”

Michael Payton Jr. is a disabled Army veteran and a single father to a young daughter. He was nominated by the Southern Crescent Veteran Services Inc. He is a dedicated and loving father, a hardworking craftsman and a proud veteran whose character reflects resilience, responsibility and a deep commitment to improving his life and supporting those he loves. Payton cherishes the time he spends with his daughter, creating meaningful memories and providing her with the stability and encouragement every child deserves. Beyond his role as a father, Payton is a hands‑on worker who takes pride in his craft. He has a strong work ethic and excels in physically demanding tasks, particularly pouring concrete and working with his hands. His skill, reliability and determination make him an asset to any job site — but transportation barriers limited his ability to maintain consistent employment and fully utilize his talents. This vehicle from Recycled Rides will be transformative for Payton, allowing him to sustain stable employment in his trade, attend church on a regular basis with is daughter, and allow them to travel to his hometown of Ocean Springs, Miss., to see his mother and father often.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: “I’m so grateful for this truck, and I am ready to use it to give back to others in the community,” said Payton. “I want to thank all the technicians at Ed Voyles Collision that repaired this truck — it’s a beautiful truck, and I thank them, Allstate and the NABC.”

Individuals in the community can support this program in two ways — donate to the program directly or donate their unwanted or non-running vehicle through the Changing and Saving Lives Keys for Change program. They will receive a tax donation for their contribution, and proceeds will help provide reliable transportation for those in need across the country — and in their community.
Additional partners in this presentation included Day’s Chevrolet, LKQ, Advanced Remarketing Services, Cars for Charity, Copart and Enterprise.

Allstate, a level one partner of the NABC, has donated more than 300 vehicles to people and organizations through the Recycled Rides program, making it one of the largest vehicle donor partners of the program.

Larry’s Body Shop is a family-owned collision repair center located in Ellijay, Ga. Established in 1978, the shop specializes in comprehensive auto body collision repairs, insurance claim assistance and weather damage restoration.

Babb’s Body Shop is an OEM-certified automotive collision repair and towing facility located in Chatsworth, Ga. Operating for over 50 years, the family-owned business specializes in full-scale auto body repairs, professional paint refinishing, frame straightening and 24-hour towing services.
Ed Voyles Collision Center features 35 specialized repair bays and 16 factory-trained technicians capable of servicing all vehicle makes and model.
For more information on Recycled Rides, click here.

articles.title: SEMA Live Presented By AutoZone to Stream for 32 hours from SEMA Show
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: SEMA Live presented by AutoZone will deliver 32 hours of livestreamed coverage from the 2026 SEMA Show, providing access to new products, vehicle reveals, industry leaders and live demonstrations from the Las Vegas Convention Center Nov. 3-6.

Streaming on SEMA’s YouTube and Facebook channels, SEMA Live will cover new-product introductions, vehicle reveals, interviews with industry leaders and builders, emerging trends and live demonstrations across the show campus.

“The SEMA Show is where the automotive aftermarket comes together to discover what’s next, build meaningful relationships and create new opportunities for growth,” said Tom Gattuso, vice president of events for SEMA. “SEMA Live extends that experience to a global audience, connecting viewers with the people, products and ideas moving the industry forward.”
Hosted by Chris Jacobs, with reports from JC Fernandez and Cristy Lee, SEMA Live will feature programming across the Show floor and outdoor activation areas.

- New products and vehicle reveals: First looks at new products, technologies and custom vehicles from manufacturers including Ford, Harley-Davidson, Honda Racing Corporation, Mitsubishi, Mopar/Stellantis, Nissan and Toyota.

- Industry voices: Conversations with business leaders, builders and personalities. Scheduled guests include Harley-Davidson CEO Artie Starrs; In-N-Out President Lynsi Snyder; builders Chip Foose and Dave Kindig; and Jay Leno and Mario Andretti.
- SEMA Battle of the Builders Presented by Mothers: Coverage of the competition and craftsmanship behind standout vehicles.
- Expanded Powersports, Side-by-Side and Lifestyle Area: Dedicated coverage of vehicles, products, trends and experiences in the powersports and side-by-side markets.
- Live demonstrations: Action from the show’s outdoor activations and performance areas.
- SEMA Cruise: Coverage of vehicles departing the Las Vegas Convention Center on Friday, Nov. 6.

“Viewers will get more than show-floor highlights,” said Andy Tompkins, trade show director of SEMA. “SEMA Live will take them inside new-product and vehicle debuts, connect them with the builders and businesses creating the products and deliver live coverage of the demonstrations and experiences that make the SEMA Show unlike any other automotive event.”

The 2026 SEMA Show will take place Nov. 3-6, featuring more than 2,000 participating brands across more than 1 million net square feet of exhibit space. Programming will stream 9 a.m.-5 p.m. PST each day Nov. 3-6 on SEMA’s YouTube and Facebook channels. Viewers can follow SEMA’s social channels for programming announcements and broadcast updates.
The 2026 SEMA Show opens on Election Day, Nov. 3. SEMA’s Drive the Vote campaign encourages attendees to make a plan to vote before traveling to Las Vegas. Visit sema.org/vote for more information.
For information about the 2026 SEMA Show or to register, visit semashow.com.

articles.title: Survey: Buyers want their next vehicle to function like a smartphone
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Verra Mobility Corp.’s latest survey of 2,000 U.S. adults shows that 72% expect their next vehicle to function like a smartphone, with built-in apps and services.

Active connected services usage has crossed the majority threshold for the first time, with 54% of drivers using at least one manufacturer-provided connected service, up from 49% in Verra Mobility’s 2024 survey. Familiarity with the term “connected vehicle” rose to 69%, compared with 60% two years ago.

Fifty-one percent said connected features would influence their decision to buy a different make, model, or higher trim level. All survey respondents own or lease a 2019 or newer vehicle and were at least 18 years old in May at the time of the survey.

The survey defined connected vehicle services as those that use a vehicle’s embedded communications rather than a mobile phone connection. That definition didn’t include services accessed through smartphones, such as Apple CarPlay or Android Auto.

“The story of this year’s survey is that consumers have arrived at the connected vehicle category, and they’re bringing real expectations with them,” said Cathi Chinn, Verra Mobility’s innovation vice president, in a press release. “Drivers now expect their vehicles to behave like the connected devices they use everywhere else in their lives, which puts pressure on the automotive industry to deliver experiences that justify it, especially around the embedded payments, mobility services and safety features consumers say they want most.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Survey respondents also said they want their vehicles to do more of the work for them, with safety leading the list of services they value most. Accident and theft protection ranked first (31%) when respondents were asked which service category is most appealing if cost is not a factor, followed by maintenance and payments. Fifty-nine percent said they believe connected vehicles make driving safer.

Seventy-two percent said they would value proactive trip suggestions from their vehicles such as parking, fuel, or charging station locations, and handling toll transactions. Forty-three percent said they’ve already signed up for an app or service through their vehicle’s infotainment system regarding parking, EV charging, or tolling.
Sixty-six percent said it would be a valued convenience not having to connect a smartphone every time they get in the car.
The survey results also show that younger drivers led adoption across nearly every measure of the survey:
- Sixty-seven percent of those ages 18–24 actively use at least one connected service, compared to 44% of those ages 55–64.
- Sixty-nine percent of 18–24-year-olds said connected features would influence their vehicle purchase, versus 40% of those ages 55–64.
- Sixty-three percent of 18–24-year-olds and 61% of 25–34-year-olds find the in-vehicle digital wallet concept appealing compared to 44% overall.

As for data privacy, willingness to trade data for tangible benefits has held steady since 2024, but understanding and trust haven’t kept pace with adoption, according to the survey results. Sixty-six percent said they would share driving and location data for insurance discounts, automatic toll payments, and emergency services — mirroring the 2024 findings.
Only 14% said they fully understand what data their vehicle collects, down from 22% in 2024. Fifty-four percent expressed at least some concern about vehicle data collection practices.

Based on a recent large-scale study of the connected vehicle ecosystem, Northeastern University researchers conclude that improved transparency is necessary to identify and address existing harm to passengers caused by the data that “smartphones on wheels” collect.

Researchers found that vehicles and companion apps contact numerous third-party domains, including advertisers and trackers. They also found that vehicle-specific information is being tied to individual consumers. Companion apps expose VINs and a secondary type of personally identifiable information, such as email addresses, to three companies.

Last year, 54% of Americans believed new cars have too much technology, while 72% worried about repair costs if something breaks, according to the second annual Enterprise Mobility’s “On the Move” survey released in October 2025. Nearly 7 in 10 (68%) drivers said they would willingly give up the latest tech for a more affordable vehicle.
More than half of the “On the Move” survey respondents said they would prefer a mix of touch screens and physical buttons.

articles.title: Oklahoma to elect a new insurance commissioner at midterms
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Oklahoma will elect a new insurance commissioner Nov. 3 as its current commissioner, Glen Mulready, reaches the end of his second term.
Insurance commissioners in the state hold the position for four years and are limited to eight-years in the position.
This year’s voters will have a choice between Republican Bob Sullivan and Democrat Craig MacIntrye.
Sullivan identifies himself as a “property and casualty insurance expert” on his campaign website.

He states his expertise includes being a certified insurance counselor, certified risk manager, chartered property and casualty underwriter, associate in Fidelity & Surety Bonding and a certified environmental specialist.
Sullivan currently works for the Alera Group and previously for Rich and Cartmill, the website states.

“Bob has seen carriers pull out of Oklahoma, leaving entire industries with one option and homeowners forced to pay more—or go without,” the website states. “He’s running to restore competition, cut costs, and deliver fast, fair claims for the people who actually pay the premiums.”

It adds that Sullivan “won’t take orders from the insurance lobbyist or career politicians. He’ll call out the price-gouging, expose slow-walking of claims and make insurance fair again for Oklahoma families and small businesses.”
The website continues by saying that Sullivan will fight for transparency, lower rates and accountability.

MacIntyre has worked in the insurance industry for more than 30 years, according to his campaign website. This includes working as an actuary, product manager, underwriting and claims oversight, risk management, reserving, policy writing, state filings, legislative initiatives and consulting on new insurance legislation.
His previous insurance work on his linkedIn includes roles at MacIntyre Holdings, an insurance consulting service, Home State Insurance Group and Old American County Mutual Fire Insurance Company.
MacIntrye says on his site that Oklahomans deserve affordable insurance rates, acceptable and fair claims practices and available insurance.

“The Consumer Protection Division of the OID will be given new authority to track and initiate exams when there is a pattern of unfair claims practices reported,” the website states. “No longer will complaints just get a letter from the OID.”
The website also states that MacIntyre will strengthen fraud investigations and meet with legislators to make meditation mandatory if requested by either party.

“I will be available to the policyholders of Oklahoma,” MacIntyre said. “I want to hear from you. The Insurance Commissioner is an Advocate for the four million people who live in Oklahoma. I will have your back and work every day to improve insurance in Oklahoma.”
Insurify found that Oklahoma, California and Georgia are the states where policyholders are more likely to feel the influence of a news insurance commissioner on their home insurance premiums.

It found that since 2023, Oklahoma’s average home insurance premiums have increased by 38% and the next elected commissioner will be the first to exercise a new authority to reject excessive rate increases.

articles.title: Rivian launches invite-only Autonomy Early Access Program
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Some Rivian drivers have started receiving invites to the automaker’s Autonomy Early Access Program, according to the company’s website.
The program is designed to test and refine pre-released driver assistance features before they roll out to the broader fleet. The features include “point-to-point” autonomy features.

All owners with an active Autonomy+ subscription can indicate their interest to join the program by applying through their Rivian account. The invitations go to a limited group of owners with high autonomy feature usage and clean recent safety record.
It also will start with Rivian R1 Gen 2 and R2 owners in California and Florida. It will steadily expand to other states prior to a planned 2027 release, the website states.
The invitation rollout follows comments made by Rivian founder and CEO RJ Scaringe regarding the company’s plans for autonomous vehicle software during a TechCrunch Disrupt event, held last week.

TechCrunch reports Scaringe said he’s willing to delay profitability to develop autonomous vehicle software for EVs. Rivian could be venturing into a different type of vehicle from its outdoorsy SUVs in the future, he said.

“Where it gets really interesting is when you think beyond R2 and R3 and start to imagine the form factors that you want to build for a personally owned autonomous vehicle. You know, it opens up all kinds of design opportunities. It can create dramatically different experiences,” he said in an interview with TechCrunch. “I’m wildly excited about what the next 10 years look like in transportation because of what this enables us to dream and think about.”

TechCrunch states that Rivian is a few years away from reworking the company for a self-driving software. It describes Rivian’s “point-to-point’ navigation as driving without intervention but under supervision.
Rivian is also working toward a full autonomy software that will deploy in robotaxi versions of its R2 SUV, TechCrunch reports.
Scaringe told TechCrunch that he believes most driving with autonomy will continue to happen in personal vehicles.

“Where it gets really interesting is when you think beyond R2 and R3 and start to imagine the form factors that you want to build for a personally owned autonomous vehicle,” he told TechCrunch. “You know, it opens up all kinds of design opportunities. It can create dramatically different experiences. I’m wildly excited about what the next 10 years look like in transportation because of what this enables us to dream and think about.”

articles.title: The Details That Make or Break Sleeved Engines
articles.author: Dan Schechner

paras.en: This article is courtesy of Engine Builder.
On the surface, sleeving an engine may sound simple: machine the block, install the sleeves and finish hone the cylinders. In reality, success comes down to getting the details right.

Today’s sleeves benefit from advanced metallurgy and high-grade materials, while modern machining offers remarkable precision and repeatability. Even so, experienced builders still see sleeved-engine failures pretty regularly.

More often than not, those problems are the result of machining or installation errors. Some issues are obvious, while others, like poor ring seal or reduced heat transfer, can quietly affect performance and durability over time.
For Joe Irwin of Fast Forward Race Engines, preventing those problems starts with taking extra time on the sleeve itself.

“We probably have four or five hours more in each Coyote sleeving process than most guys do, and it’s simply deburr work on the sleeve,” Irwin says. “The entry of the sleeve needs to be radiused, and the surface finish of both the sleeve and the receiver bore matters.

“The better you finish those areas, the better off the end product will be. The sleeve will stay more dimensionally stable and is less likely to lose position or distort. Anytime you can make that geometry more stable, your crankcase pressure goes down and your bores seal up better. It’s all about doing your best work when you sleeve a block, and I think guys sometimes get away from that.”
Irwin’s approach reinforces a common theme among top builders: defective parts usually aren’t the real problem.

“Most failures come back to improper application, incorrect installation, or poor machining practices,” says Larry Goldbeck of Track Tamer Engines. “Modern sleeves themselves are usually extremely accurate.”
With that in mind, let’s take a closer look at some of the most common mistakes that continue to undermine sleeved engines, and the best ways to avoid them.

Ask engine builders what keeps a sleeve in place, and most will point to dimensions – counterbore depth, diameter, interference fit, and so on. Those factors are critical, but Jay Meagher of RS Garage believes one of the most overlooked variables is the quality of the receiver surface itself.

“Let’s give the builder the benefit of the doubt that his critical measurements are fine,” Meagher says. “Both the step where the sleeve is going to stop and the diameter in which the sleeve is to be received – let’s say all that stuff is right. I think the honing finish on the block that’s to receive the sleeve may matter more than people think.”

The reason comes down to contact area. A rough or inconsistent receiver surface creates microscopic high and low spots between the sleeve and parent material. The sleeve may still press in correctly, but uneven contact can weaken support, create stress concentrations and reduce heat transfer.

“You want as homogeneous a bond as possible between the sleeve and the block,” Meagher says. “Whether it’s a dry sleeve or a wet sleeve, some honing after boring goes a long way toward creating a better home for the sleeve.”

Irwin’s process includes honing the receiver bore after machining. “We’ll actually bore that block and then we’ll hone that block to get the actual press that we’re looking for and the actual surface finish as smooth as we possibly can,” he says.

The extra step adds time, but Irwin says it’s worth the effort. “We try to have as much contact area from the outside of the sleeve to the surface of that block, the parent material,” he explains. “That way you can dissipate the heat from the piston through the rings into the sleeve, from the sleeve into the block and then into the cooling system like it’s supposed to.”

That’s a key point, because the sleeve does more than contain cylinder pressure; it also helps carry heat away from the combustion chamber. When that path is compromised, problems can show up during teardown.

“A lot of times when we take those engines apart and we see that the cylinder’s cracked and we pull the sleeve out, you’ll see oil that’s migrated up the backside of that cylinder,” Irwin notes. “Hot oil gets thin and starts to run. There’s clearance there.”
That often suggests the sleeve and block never made full contact to begin with.

While interference fit determines how securely the sleeve sits in a block, getting it there depends on temperature management. Every sleeving job is an exercise in thermal expansion and contraction, using heat and cold to create enough clearance for assembly before components return to their normal dimensions.

“The parts have to be right,” Irwin says. “They’ve got to be the right size, and you need to have the right temperature differential between the two parts in order to have the clearance you’re looking for so you can slide them in without beating on them or pressing them in.
“Those blocks are able to hold a lot of horsepower, but they’re delicate. The last thing you want to do is go beat on them any more than you have to.”

Irwin explains that every sleeving job requires its own temperature strategy. A Coyote block behaves differently than an Alusil BMW casting or a cast-iron diesel block. Rather than using a fixed formula, builders should measure how the block material expands to determine exactly how much clearance is needed for installation.

“You can figure that out pretty easily – set a bore gauge, heat the block, check your clearancing, and then you just need to know how much larger that bore needs to be for you time-wise to get in however many sleeves it might be,” he says. “If you’re putting in one at a time, you need more of a temperature differential than if you do half the sleeves at once.”
The greater the interference fit, the more important temperature control becomes also.

“When we do the Brad Anderson blocks, I’m going to have a .008” press fit,” Goldbeck says. “You can’t just force a sleeve in with a press, so we carefully heat the block up, keeping it below the annealing temperature of aluminum so we don’t soften the casting. Once it reaches the right temperature, we literally just slide the sleeves in with no pressure at all. Then, when the block cools, you’ve got your full .008” interference fit back.”

Meagher also says the installation process shouldn’t necessarily end once the sleeves are in place. He remembers working alongside a veteran machinist who regularly heat-cycled sleeved blocks, alternating oven cycles with a vibratory stress-relief table before the final deck and bore hone.
“I never had a dropped sleeve with him,” Meagher says. “My sleeving jobs were always successful, which was pretty great because he was doing it with manual machines.”

Meagher suspects some sleeve movement, particularly on newer platforms like the B58, S58, and S55, may happen during the engine’s initial heat cycles, after the car has already been put together and run a few times.

“The head gasket leaks because the sleeve has moved in the block,” he says. “They’ll take the block out, deck it a second time, put it back in and they won’t have problems. But they do get initial movement through the first few heat cycles. I think that could be eliminated by heat cycling the block while it’s still in the workshop.”

Even when a sleeve is installed correctly, the job isn’t done until the engine has made it through repeated heat cycles under load. If the sleeve isn’t secure, it can move or “walk” inside the block. That often shows up as coolant leaks, head gasket failures, or sealing issues that are hard to pin down.

One way to help prevent sleeve movement is with a step at the receiver bore. Many builders machine a register into the block to physically support the sleeve and keep it from sliding down once the engine is running.

“On retrofit repair sleeves, I typically leave a step at the bottom of the block, so the sleeve has a positive stop,” Goldbeck says. “A lot of machinists don’t leave that bottom step and the sleeve can move during operation because cylinder temperatures get extremely high. Once the sleeve moves, you lose your press fit, the sleeve drops and you end up with coolant leakage.”

Some shops skip the step because it’s more difficult to machine. “You have to bore to a specific depth, then come back with a counterbore tool and flatten the step at the bottom,” Goldbeck notes. “You also need to make sure the sleeve is touching that step. I put sealant down there as well to help prevent leaks.”

Leaving out that feature can be costly. Goldbeck recently inspected a 390 block that had been sleeved without a bottom step. The sleeve moved and it started leaking coolant at the top because the head gasket wasn’t sealing properly anymore.

Meagher has observed similar failures. “I’ve seen where the bottom register isn’t in the right place and the sleeve drops,” he says. “That’s probably one of the worst things because then you have to take the engine completely back apart.”

Both agree that sleeve movement usually isn’t caused by just one factor. It can result from not enough interference fit, a poorly designed register, lack of support at the bottom of the bore, or repeated heat cycles. High-horsepower engines are especially vulnerable, since extreme cylinder pressure and temperature make it harder for the sleeve to stay put.

Securing the sleeve is one thing. But if the cylinder bore isn’t machined correctly, it can still lead to poor ring seal, excessive blow-by, oil consumption, and uneven wear – any of which may show up long before the sleeve itself becomes an issue.

According to Goldbeck, builders may not always account for bore distortion once the heads are bolted in place. Often, he says, that comes down to not having the right torque plate during honing. It is why Goldbeck has a wall full of them in his shop.

Tightening the head changes bore shape. A torque plate simulates those stresses during machining, allowing the cylinder to be honed under assembled conditions. But distortion isn’t just limited to head-bolt loading.

“The other thing that sometimes isn’t done is setting up the over and under stroke on the hone correctly,” Goldbeck says. “And that would depend on your manufacturer. If that process isn’t right, it can give you several different shapes on the cylinder you really don’t want. It could end up V-shaped, hourglass-shaped, barrel-shaped, or otherwise distorted.”

Goldbeck also points to surface finish and the crosshatch pattern in the sleeve itself. While some machinists still like reading cylinder walls by sight and touch, today’s ring packages require a more dialed-in approach.

“You can’t just feel it by hand or look at it and say it has an Ra of this or an Rp of that,” he notes. “You really need to check it with a profilometer. They’re not cheap, but for higher-end work you’re probably going to need one.”

Honing remains one of the most important steps in the sleeving process. “We finish ours up with a plateau honing technique like the OEMs use,” Goldbeck states. “A cylinder can look great, but then you start checking the ovality of it, the taper in it, or whether it’s barrel shaped.

“The hone job is just critical. It’s the last thing the block gets before you put the rings in it. Years ago, rings were big and forgiving. Maybe you’d have a 5/64 and a 3/64. But now we’re running 1.1mm- and 1.2mm ring packages with almost no tension. They’re a lot less tolerant of mistakes, which makes honing hugely important.”

If there’s a common thread connecting most successful sleeving jobs, it’s that no single measurement can guarantee a great outcome. Even with the right parts and equipment, trouble can still show up if critical dimensions, material expansion and surface finish aren’t working together. Those elements affect nearly every aspect of sleeve performance and durability.
That’s why achieving consistent results still depends on understanding each platform’s unique requirements, as well as the skill and experience of the person doing the work.
