articles.title: Russia arrests German man, calls him a Ukraine 'mercenary'

paras.en: Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB) domestic intelligence agency said on Wednesday that it had arrested a German national on allegations of mercenary activity, calling him an "active member of the Ukrainian armed forces."
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦安全局（FSB）国内情报机构周三表示，已因涉嫌雇佣军活动逮捕了一名德国国民，称他是“乌克兰武装部队的活跃成员”。

paras.en: The news came on the same day that Russia released a retired teacher from the US, Stephen Hubbard, after years in detention on similar mercenary charges, which he denied.
paras.zh: 这一消息发布的同一天，俄罗斯释放了美国退休教师斯蒂芬·哈伯德(Stephen Hubbard)，他因类似的雇佣军指控被​​拘留多年，但他否认了这一指控。

paras.en: Russia has detained a number of foreign nationals since its 2022 full-scale invasion of Ukraine, accusing them of assisting Kyiv in some way or another.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年全面入侵乌克兰以来，俄罗斯已拘留了多名外国人，指控他们以某种方式协助基辅。

paras.en: There was no immediate comment from Germany's government, besides acknowledging that it had seen the reports and was pursuing them.
paras.zh: 德国政府没有立即发表评论，只是承认已看到这些报告并正在追查这些报告。

paras.en: The FSB said in a statement carried widely by Russian media that the man was a former Bundeswehr soldier and trained sniper. It did not issue his name but published a short video in which he could be heard speaking German.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦安全局在一份被俄罗斯媒体广泛转载的声明中表示，该男子是一名前联邦国防军士兵，也是受过训练的狙击手。它没有公布他的名字，但发布了一段简短的视频，可以听到他说德语。

paras.en: According to the FSB, the man was a Bundeswehr soldier from 1996 to 2010, who served in Afghanistan and Somalia between 2004 and 2010.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯联邦安全局称，该男子于1996年至2010年期间是一名德国联邦国防军士兵，2004年至2010年期间曾在阿富汗和索马里服役。

paras.en: They alleged that he later operated as a mercenary fighter in Syria's civil war.
paras.zh: 他们声称他后来在叙利亚内战中担任雇佣兵。

paras.en: From 2016 to 2018, according to the Russian spy agency, he fought in Ukraine against the Russian-backed rebels in eastern states, prior to Moscow's full-scale invasion in 2022.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯间谍机构称，2016年至2018年，他在乌克兰东部各州与俄罗斯支持的叛乱分子作战，随后莫斯科于2022年全面入侵。

paras.en: The FSB claimed that he returned to Ukraine as a "mercenary" in 2025 and was fighting in the contested region of Donetsk, but then deserted over non-payment of wages.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦安全局声称，他于2025年以“雇佣兵”身份返回乌克兰，并在有争议的顿涅茨克地区作战，但随后因拖欠工资而开小差。

paras.en: They did not comment on why or how the man, whom they said was born in 1976, had come to be in Russia. Nor did they say where or under what circumstances they arrested him.
paras.zh: 他们没有评论这个出生于 1976 年的男子为什么或如何来到俄罗斯。他们也没有透露在哪里或在什么情况下逮捕了他。

paras.en: A spokesperson at the German Foreign Ministry only initially responded by saying that Berlin was aware of the reports from Russia.
paras.zh: 德国外交部发言人最初回应称柏林了解俄罗斯的报道。

paras.en: The spokesperson said the ministry would not comment on the individual case or specifics for the time being.
paras.zh: 该发言人表示，该部暂时不会对个案或具体细节发表评论。

paras.en: Similar Swedish arrest last week, US prisoner freed
paras.zh: 瑞典上周类似逮捕，美国囚犯获释

paras.en: Russia has arrested hundreds of foreign nationals on charges like espionage, sabotage and treason amid its invasion of neighboring Ukraine. The charges can carry lengthy prison sentences.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯在入侵邻国乌克兰期间以间谍、破坏和叛国罪等罪名逮捕了数百名外国人。这些指控可能会导致长期监禁。

paras.en: A smaller number have also been accused of mercenary activity.
paras.zh: 少数人还被指控从事雇佣军活动。

paras.en: The FSB last week arrested a Swedish national, again accusing him of fighting on Kyiv's behalf.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦安全局上周逮捕了一名瑞典国民，再次指控他为基辅而战。

paras.en: In his case, they said he was operating as the commander of a drone unit and that he was detained attempting to illegally cross the border in the western Pskov region.
paras.zh: 在他的案件中，他们说他是一支无人机部队的指挥官，他因试图非法越过普斯科夫西部地区的边境而被拘留。

paras.en: A Japanese journalist was also arrested last week, accused of espionage, prompting sharp criticism from Tokyo.
paras.zh: 一名日本记者上周也因间谍罪被捕，引发东京方面的严厉批评。

paras.en: Also on Wednesday, Russia released a retired US teacher, Stephen Hubbard, who had been arrested in 2024 on comparable allegations.
paras.zh: 同样在周三，俄罗斯释放了美国退休教师斯蒂芬·哈伯德 (Stephen Hubbard)，他曾因类似指控于 2024 年被捕。

paras.en: This took place as US negotiator Steve Witkoff was visiting St. Petersburg and after a series of recent concessions to Russia and criticisms of Ukraine from US President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 此事发生之际，美国谈判代表史蒂夫·威特科夫正在访问圣彼得堡，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普最近对俄罗斯做出了一系列让步，并对乌克兰提出了批评。

paras.en: Trump claimed there was no quid pro quo involved in the release, but later said Hubbard would not be free if he had not eased sanctions on Russian diesel shipments.
paras.zh: 特朗普声称此次释放不涉及任何交换条件，但后来表示，如果哈伯德不放松对俄罗斯柴油运输的制裁，他就不会获得自由。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Catalonia’s new far right: How anti-Muslim sentiment is reshaping politics

paras.en: Barcelona, Spain – Almost a decade after a failed independence bid in Catalonia, anti-migration and anti-Muslim sentiment has replaced secession as the driving force among voters in this wealthy region.
paras.zh: 西班牙巴塞罗那 — — 加泰罗尼亚独立申请失败近十年后，反移民和反穆斯林情绪已取代分裂国家，成为这个富裕地区选民的推动力。

paras.en: A new far-right party, Alianca Catalana, or Catalan Alliance (AC), which wants a crackdown on migration and has targeted Islam as a threat to society, has surged in the polls in a region with the largest Muslim population in Spain.
paras.zh: 一个新的极右翼政党加泰罗尼亚联盟（AC）希望打击移民，并将伊斯兰教视为对社会的威胁，该党在西班牙穆斯林人口最多的地区的民意调查中支持率大幅上升。

paras.en: The party is on course to become the second biggest political force in Catalonia after the Socialists at the next Catalan regional election in 2028, polls predict.
paras.zh: 民意调查预测，在 2028 年下一次加泰罗尼亚地区选举中，该党有望成为加泰罗尼亚第二大政治力量，仅次于社会党。

paras.en: It has capitalised on the anti-migrant sentiment sweeping Europe, which has seen victories for the far-right in Germany, Italy, and France.
paras.zh: 它利用了席卷欧洲的反移民情绪，极右翼分子在德国、意大利和法国取得了胜利。

paras.en: The rise of Catalan Alliance has alarmed Muslims, who fear a backlash in a country which has previously seemed welcoming.
paras.zh: 加泰罗尼亚联盟的崛起令穆斯林感到震惊，他们担心这个此前看似热情的国家会遭到强烈反对。

paras.en: “This has surprised all of us,” said Soukayna El Abdi, president of the Young Moroccans of Ripoll, referring to the party’s growth.
paras.zh: “这让我们所有人都感到惊讶，”里波尔青年摩洛哥人主席苏凯纳·阿卜迪 (Soukayna El Abdi) 在谈到该党的发展时说道。

paras.en: “Most people come to integrate, to work and live among others. The rise of [Catalan] Alliance is about unfounded hate. They spread lots of things about our community which are not true.”
paras.zh: “大多数人来这里是为了融入社会、与他人一起工作和生活。[加泰罗尼亚]联盟的崛起是毫无根据的仇恨。他们散布了许多关于我们社区的不实信息。”

paras.en: Spain will vote in a snap election in November. Polls show the conservative People’s Party and the far-right Vox gaining support. The rise of the Catalan Alliance shows a shift towards the right in the fourth biggest economy in the eurozone.
paras.zh: 西班牙将于 11 月举行提前选举。民意调查显示，保守派人民党和极右翼 Vox 获得支持。加泰罗尼亚联盟的崛起表明欧元区第四大经济体正在向右转。

paras.en: The party backs independence and has taken support from the other secessionist parties, Together for Catalonia and Catalan Republican Left, which were behind the failed bid to break away from Spain in 2017.
paras.zh: 该党支持独立，并得到了其他分离主义政党的支持，包括加泰罗尼亚团结党和加泰罗尼亚左翼共和党，这两个政党是2017年脱离西班牙失败的幕后黑手。

paras.en: “All my friends support Catalan Alliance. There are too many migrants around now and Islam is a threat,” Eduard Lopez, a businessman from Molins de Rei near Barcelona, told Al Jazeera. “These other independence parties are from the past. They failed to do what they said they would.”
paras.zh: “我所有的朋友都支持加泰罗尼亚联盟。现在周围有太多移民，伊斯兰教是一种威胁，”来自巴塞罗那附近莫林斯德雷伊的商人爱德华·洛佩兹告诉半岛电视台。 “这些其他独立政党都是过去的。他们没有按照自己的承诺去做。”

paras.en: A fifth of Spain’s population of nearly 50 million was born outside the country, according to the Spanish National Statistics Institute (INE). Colombians, Venezuelans and Moroccans are the three largest groups by nationality.
paras.zh: 根据西班牙国家统计局 (INE) 的数据，西班牙近 5000 万人口中，有五分之一出生在国外。哥伦比亚人、委内瑞拉人和摩洛哥人是国籍最多的三个群体。

paras.en: Catalan Alliance started in Ripoll, a small town near the French border. It was where members of a cell plotted an attack on Barcelona in 2017 which killed 16 people and was claimed by ISIL.
paras.zh: 加泰罗尼亚联盟始于法国边境附近的一个小镇里波尔。 2017 年，一个小组成员正是在这里策划了对巴塞罗那的袭击，造成 16 人死亡，ISIL 声称对袭击负责。

paras.en: Silvia Orriols, leader of Catalan Alliance, is also mayor of the town.
paras.zh: 加泰罗尼亚联盟领导人西尔维娅·奥里奥尔斯 (Silvia Orriols) 也是该镇的市长。

paras.en: After the 2017 attack, she became fervently anti-Muslim.
paras.zh: 2017 年袭击事件后，她变得强烈反穆斯林。

paras.en: “If there is no substantial change, the prospects for Catalonia are bleak,” Orriols told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “如果没有实质性的改变，加泰罗尼亚的前景是黯淡的，”奥里奥尔告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: “The decline in the use of our own language, the depersonalisation of neighbourhoods, the rise in insecurity and crime, the fraudulent use of public services, the mass and invasive immigration, the demographic growth of those who advocate [Islamic] law, the fiscal plundering we suffer by Spain, threaten the welfare state and the rights and freedoms we have achieved up to now.”
paras.zh: “我们自己语言使用的减少、社区的人格化、不安全和犯罪的增加、公共服务的欺诈性使用、大规模和侵入性移民、拥护[伊斯兰]法的人的人口增长、我们遭受西班牙的财政掠夺，威胁着福利国家以及我们迄今为止所实现的权利和自由。”

paras.en: She said her party was for “those who have not surrendered to globalisation and barbarism”.
paras.zh: 她说她的政党是为“那些没有屈服于全球化和野蛮主义的人”而存在的。

paras.en: There are 2.4 million Muslims living in Spain, with the largest community in Catalonia, according to the Union of Islamic Federations of Spain.
paras.zh: 据西班牙伊斯兰联邦联盟称，西班牙有 240 万穆斯林，其中最大的社区位于加泰罗尼亚。

paras.en: El Abdi of the Young Moroccans of Ripoll said, “I am very scared. I fear for my parents and my two brothers who still live there. This racism affects all Muslims. It started after the 2017 attack in Barcelona.”
paras.zh: 里波尔青年摩洛哥人组织的埃尔阿卜迪说：“我非常害怕。我担心我的父母和仍然住在那里的两个兄弟。这种种族主义影响到所有穆斯林。它是在 2017 年巴塞罗那袭击事件后开始的。”

paras.en: Ironically, she said, Orriols’ daughters used to be friends with her cousins, but this changed after the Catalan Alliance leader went into politics.
paras.zh: 讽刺的是，她说，奥里奥尔的女儿们曾经和她的表兄弟姐妹是朋友，但在这位加泰罗尼亚联盟领导人从政后，这种情况发生了变化。

paras.en: The party currently has just two seats in the Catalan parliament, but polls predict it is set to rival the Socialists to run a region which accounts for 20 percent of the Spanish economy.
paras.zh: 该党目前在加泰罗尼亚议会中只有两个席位，但民意调查预测，该党将与社会党竞争，争夺占西班牙经济20%的地区的席位。

paras.en: A poll for El Mundo newspaper, published in September, found the Catalan Alliance would win 25-28 seats, with 16.7 percent of votes if there were an election. The Socialists would be the largest party but would lose 10 seats, garnering 23.3 percent of support and 19-22 seats. All other secessionist parties would lose out.
paras.zh: 《世界报》9月发表的一项民意调查显示，如果举行选举，加泰罗尼亚联盟将赢得25-28个席位，得票率为16.7%。社会党将成为最大政党，但将失去 10 个席位，获得 23.3% 的支持率和 19-22 个席位。所有其他分裂主义政党都将失败。

paras.en: Juan Ignacio Castien Maestro, a specialist in Islamic affairs at the Complutense University in Madrid, said anti-Muslim feeling is on the rise in Spain.
paras.zh: 马德里康普顿斯大学伊斯兰事务专家胡安·伊格纳西奥·卡斯蒂安·马埃斯特罗表示，西班牙的反穆斯林情绪正在上升。

paras.en: “People are focusing on Islamophobia, which has existed for centuries but has risen in Spain in recent years. The Muslim migrant is seen as the symbol of many ills such as the housing crisis, unemployment and other problems. It plays on feelings of insecurity,” he told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “人们关注的是伊斯兰恐惧症，这种恐惧症已经存在了几个世纪，但近年来在西班牙有所抬头。穆斯林移民被视为住房危机、失业和其他问题等许多弊病的象征。它利用了不安全感，”他告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: “Catalonia is a special case in that some Catalan [nationalist] parties were already Islamophobic.”
paras.zh: “加泰罗尼亚是一个特例，一些加泰罗尼亚[民族主义]政党已经仇视伊斯兰教。”

paras.en: Jose Pablo Martínez, a specialist in migration at the Real Elcano Institute, a think tank in Madrid, said the left-wing Spanish government, unlike many other European countries, is applying a policy which is more favourable towards migration.
paras.zh: 马德里智库皇家埃尔卡诺研究所的移民问题专家何塞·巴勃罗·马丁内斯表示，与许多其他欧洲国家不同，西班牙左翼政府正在实施一项更有利于移民的政策。

paras.en: But “certain sections of the population consider migrants to be competing for their jobs and housing,” he said.
paras.zh: 但“某些人群认为移民是在争夺工作和住房，”他说。

articles.title: Canada wants to expand its LNG business. Critics raise red flags

paras.en: Kitimat, British Columbia: As Canada tries to position itself as an emerging leader in global liquefied natural gas (LNG) markets, it risks locking in multidecade, multibillion-dollar contracts with companies whose current and past ventures include human rights abuses and environmental damage.
paras.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚省基蒂马特：当加拿大试图将自己定位为全球液化天然气（LNG）市场的新兴领导者时，它面临着与那些当前和过去的企业涉及侵犯人权和环境破坏的公司签订数十年、数十亿美元合同的风险。

paras.en: LNG Canada, which began operations in mid-2025 in Kitimat in British Columbia on the country's west coast, is the nation's first major export facility.
paras.zh: 加拿大液化天然气公司于 2025 年中期在该国西海岸不列颠哥伦比亚省基蒂马特开始运营，是该国第一个主要出口设施。

paras.en: In late September, it gave the green light to a $33bn expansion which will double production in the coming years at Kitimat.
paras.zh: 9 月下旬，它为 330 亿美元的扩建项目开了绿灯，这将使基蒂马特未来几年的产量翻一番。

paras.en: But the Kitimat plant has had challenges with its flaring equipment since beginning commissioning in late 2024. In 2025, the new liquefaction facility burned 350 million cubic metres of gas due to an issue with its main flare stack.
paras.zh: 但基蒂马特工厂自 2024 年底开始调试以来，其火炬设备一直面临挑战。2025 年，由于主火炬烟囱出现问题，新液化设施燃烧了 3.5 亿立方米天然气。

paras.en: “The flaring noise was on a whole other level when they were first getting started up,” a resident who asked not to be named said in an interview. “It was just huge, way bigger than I think it was supposed to be.”
paras.zh: 一位不愿透露姓名的居民在接受采访时表示：“他们刚开始启动时，发出的噪音完全是另一个水平。” “它太大了，比我想象的要大得多。”

paras.en: “I am devastated about the changes to my home territory,” another resident said. “I can't always see the stars like I used to from my parents' place here. My friend returned temporarily, and her asthma has been much worse.”
paras.zh: 另一位居民说：“我对家乡的变化感到震惊。” “我不能像以前一样在父母那里总能看到星星了。我的朋友暂时回来了，她的哮喘更严重了。”

paras.en: The residents requested to remain unnamed because Kitimat is a small community and the industrial project is a major employer and donor to local organisations.
paras.zh: 居民要求匿名，因为基蒂马特是一个小社区，而该工业项目是当地组织的主要雇主和捐助者。

paras.en: The project has political support, especially as Canada faces economic pressures from United States President Donald Trump’s administration, which has unleashed a slew of tariffs on it, including on Canadian steel, lumber and aluminium in 2025 and added an additional suite of tariffs on Canadian products worth $20bn in August, including wine, dairy and textiles.
paras.zh: 该项目得到了政治支持，特别是在加拿大面临美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府的经济压力之际，美国总统特朗普政府已对其征收一系列关税，包括2025年对加拿大钢铁、木材和铝征收的关税，并于8月对价值200亿美元的加拿大产品征收额外关税，包括葡萄酒、乳制品和纺织品。

paras.en: Since Trump started his tariff campaign, the Canadian government has announced a flurry of deals and agreements aimed at diversifying trade partners and expanding domestic infrastructure developments.
paras.zh: 自特朗普开始关税运动以来，加拿大政府宣布了一系列旨在实现贸易伙伴多元化和扩大国内基础设施发展的交易和协议。

paras.en: Prime Minister Mark Carney’s government recently added two LNG developments – LNG Canada and Ksi Lisims LNG – to its major projects list, promising strong federal support. The Major Projects Office, a dedicated agency, has been established to speed up infrastructure projects deemed to be of national interest.
paras.zh: 马克·卡尼总理领导的政府最近在其主要项目清单中添加了两个液化天然气开发项目——加拿大液化天然气公司和 Ksi Lisims 液化天然气公司，并承诺提供联邦政府的大力支持。重大项目办公室是一个专门机构，其成立是为了加快被认为符合国家利益的基础设施项目。

paras.en: “Canada is building big again,” Carney said at a news conference in Vancouver following the announcement. “A year ago, the federal government referred LNG Canada Phase 2 to our Major Projects Office. One office. One point of contact. One goal: get to the right decision, rapidly and efficiently. Working with Shell and LNG Canada, British Columbia and First Nations, we have accomplished exactly that.”
paras.zh: “加拿大再次大规模建设，”卡尼在宣布这一消息后在温哥华举行的新闻发布会上表示。 “一年前，联邦政府将加拿大液化天然气公司第二阶段转交给我们的重大项目办公室。一个办公室。一个联络点。一个目标：快速高效地做出正确的决定。与壳牌和加拿大液化天然气公司、不列颠哥伦比亚省和原住民合作，我们已经实现了这一目标。”

paras.en: Marc Lee, senior economist with the Canadian Centre for Policy Alternatives, said the underlying economics of oil and gas markets over the next 10 to 20 years are ultimately driving those decisions — and maintained the government is unconcerned with companies’ conduct in other countries.
paras.zh: 加拿大替代政策中心高级经济学家马克·李表示，未来 10 到 20 年石油和天然气市场的基本经济状况最终将推动这些决定，并坚称政府并不关心公司在其他国家的行为。

paras.en: “None of that matters to the federal government,” he said. “It's all about investment.”
paras.zh: “这些对联邦政府来说都不重要，”他说。 “一切都与投资有关。”

paras.en: Lee said the ongoing trade war with the US is being used as an excuse to fast-track major projects — and it comes at the expense of environmental protection and community-level impacts.
paras.zh: 李表示，与美国持续的贸易战被用作快速推进重大项目的借口，而这是以牺牲环境保护和社区影响为代价的。

paras.en: “I don't think it’s part of some broader strategic game around diversifying from Trump or supporting the energy transition,” he said, explaining how the Canadian LNG projects predate Trump's first term in office.
paras.zh: “我不认为这是围绕特朗普多元化或支持能源转型的更广泛战略游戏的一部分，”他说，并解释了加拿大液化天然气项目如何早于特朗普的第一个任期。

paras.en: “It's just pure growth and extraction for very short-term benefit and long-term costs. We're essentially promising to liquidate this resource that should be the inheritance of British Columbians for hundreds of years into the future, and we're squandering it all at bargain-basement prices.”
paras.zh: “这只是为了短期利益和长期成本而纯粹的增长和开采。我们本质上是承诺变现这种资源，这些资源本应成为不列颠哥伦比亚省人在未来数百年的遗产，而我们却以低廉的价格浪费了这一切。”

paras.en: “It's like this bicycle you have to keep pedalling or you fall off,” he said. “You always need this new capital investment. That's what the governments are chasing right now.”
paras.zh: “这就像这辆自行车，你必须一直踩踏板，否则就会摔倒，”他说。 “你总是需要这种新的资本投资。这就是政府现在正在追求的。”

paras.en: Carney’s office declined an interview request and referred questions to the federal government’s Privy Council Office, which did not respond prior to publication.
paras.zh: 卡尼的办公室拒绝了采访请求，并将问题转介给联邦政府的枢密院办公室，但该办公室在发布之前没有做出回应。

paras.en: Construction on the expansion, which includes adding five new compressor stations to the Coastal GasLink pipeline that supplies the export plant, is to begin immediately.
paras.zh: 扩建工程将立即开始，其中包括在为出口工厂供货的 Coastal GasLink 管道上增加五个新的压缩机站。

paras.en: Several of the companies involved in the two projects, either directly or through financing agreements, have murky histories and troubling portfolios. Domestic costs also include accusations of environmental pollution and potential human rights violations.
paras.zh: 直接或通过融资协议参与这两个项目的几家公司都有不为人知的历史和令人不安的投资组合。国内成本还包括对环境污染和潜在侵犯人权的指控。

paras.en: Since commissioning began in early 2025, a technical problem at the newly built LNG Canada facility led to the plant burning off more than 350 million cubic metres of gas that year, putting it among the world’s highest sources of flaring emissions.
paras.zh: 自 2025 年初开始调试以来，新建的加拿大液化天然气工厂出现技术问题，导致该工厂当年燃烧了超过 3.5 亿立方米的天然气，使其成为世界上火炬排放量最高的来源之一。

paras.en: The local community was unaware of the scale or nature of the issue until reporting by the Canadian environmental news outlet The Narwhal revealed the plant had started operations despite identifying an “integrity issue” with its equipment.
paras.zh: 当地社区并不知道问题的规模或性质，直到加拿大环境新闻媒体《独角鲸》报道称，该工厂尽管发现其设备存在“完整性问题”，但仍已开始运营。

paras.en: LNG Canada is owned by a consortium of five foreign companies: Shell, Petronas, Korea Gas, PetroChina and Mitsubishi. Shell is the majority shareholder.
paras.zh: 加拿大液化天然气公司由五家外国公司组成的财团拥有：壳牌、马来西亚国家石油公司、韩国天然气公司、中石油和三菱公司。壳牌是大股东。

paras.en: Like TotalEnergies, Shell signed a deal to purchase two million tonnes of LNG from Ksi Lisims in 2024. The corporation recently bought Arc Resources, a Canadian oil and gas company with assets in northeast British Columbia and Alberta.
paras.zh: 与 TotalEnergies 一样，壳牌也签署了一项协议，将于 2024 年从 Ksi Lisims 购买 200 万吨液化天然气。该公司最近收购了加拿大石油和天然气公司 Arc Resources，该公司在不列颠哥伦比亚省东北部和艾伯塔省拥有资产。

paras.en: Shell’s oil and gas operations in Nigeria are among its more notorious. The United Nations estimates Shell spilled more than 13 million barrels of crude oil in at least 7,000 incidents in the Niger Delta since it started operations there in 1958. Those spills, and the company’s subsequent attempts to evade responsibility, have allegedly devastated the lives and livelihoods of local residents.
paras.zh: 壳牌在尼日利亚的石油和天然气业务是最臭名昭著的业务之一。据联合国估计，自 1958 年在尼日尔三角洲开展业务以来，壳牌公司在尼日尔三角洲至少发生了 7,000 起事故，泄漏了超过 1,300 万桶原油。这些泄漏事件以及该公司随后试图逃避责任的行为据称已经严重破坏了当地居民的生活和生计。

paras.en: Anna Zalik, a professor with York University in Toronto, has been documenting Shell’s conduct in Nigeria for more than 20 years. She said the way the company portrays itself as a “responsible actor in the Canadian context” is disingenuous.
paras.zh: 多伦多约克大学教授 Anna Zalik 20 多年来一直在记录壳牌在尼日利亚的行为。她表示，该公司将自己描绘成“加拿大背景下负责任的演员”的方式是不诚实的。

paras.en: “The firm has been associated with these major human rights violations and all sorts of legal cases around actual violence against communities and severe environmental devastation in Nigeria, and yet tries to act as if their operations here are somehow not the same as their operations there,” she said.
paras.zh: “该公司与尼日利亚的这些重大侵犯人权行为以及针对社区的实际暴力和严重环境破坏的各种法律案件有关，但他们却试图表现得好像他们在这里的业务与在那里的业务有所不同，”她说。

paras.en: “Their track record demonstrates an attempt to evade responsibility and liability for the pollution that they cause.”
paras.zh: “他们的记录表明他们试图逃避其造成的污染的责任和义务。”

paras.en: Shell declined an interview request and said the characterisation of its operations “is not one we recognise”.
paras.zh: 壳牌拒绝了采访请求，并表示其业务特征“我们不认可”。

paras.en: “Shell is committed to honesty, integrity and respect for people, and to conducting its business in an ethical and transparent manner, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations where we operate,” a spokesperson wrote in an emailed statement.
paras.zh: 一位发言人在一份电子邮件声明中写道：“壳牌致力于诚实、正直和尊重他人，并根据我们经营所在地的适用法律和法规，以道德和透明的方式开展业务。”

paras.en: The spokesperson added its operations in Nigeria included “complex and contested issues” and the allegations “do not reflect the challenging operating environment in the Niger Delta at the time, including large-scale oil theft, sabotage and illegal refining carried out by organized criminal gangs”.
paras.zh: 该发言人补充说，该公司在尼日利亚的业务包括“复杂且有争议的问题”，这些指控“并未反映尼日尔三角洲当时充满挑战的运营环境，包括有组织犯罪团伙进行的大规模石油盗窃、破坏和非法炼油”。

paras.en: Shell’s LNG facility in northwest British Columbia is supplied by the contentious Coastal GasLink pipeline, built by TC Energy between 2019 and 2024 across Wet’suwet’en territories without the consent of the nation’s Indigenous leaders, or Hereditary Chiefs. In 2020, construction of the 670-kilometre (420-mile) pipeline became the focal point for Indigenous-led protests, arrests and nationwide outrage.
paras.zh: 壳牌位于不列颠哥伦比亚省西北部的液化天然气设施由有争议的 Coastal GasLink 管道供应，该管道由 TC Energy 于 2019 年至 2024 年间在 Wet’suwet’en 领土上建造，未经该国原住民领袖或世袭酋长的同意。 2020 年，这条全长 670 公里（420 英里）的管道建设成为原住民领导的抗议、逮捕和全国愤怒的焦点。

paras.en: KKR, a New York investment firm with vast global reach, is a majority owner of the pipeline. Last year, KKR faced controversy after its acquisition of Superstruct Entertainment, the parent company of numerous music festivals and franchises including the electronic music outfit, Boiler Room, and festivals like Barcelona’s Sonar and London’s Field Day. Dozens of artists also accused KKR of promoting illegal occupation of Palestinian territory.
paras.zh: KKR 是一家具有广泛全球影响力的纽约投资公司，是该管道的多数所有者。去年，KKR 在收购 Superstruct Entertainment 后面临争议，Superstruct Entertainment 是众多音乐节和特许经营权的母公司，其中包括电子音乐公司 Boiler Room 以及巴塞罗那 Sonar 和伦敦 Field Day 等音乐节。数十名艺术家还指责 KKR 推动非法占领巴勒斯坦领土。

paras.en: At the time, KKR had holdings in a German media company, Axel Springer, which advertises real estate developments in the occupied West Bank, where Israel has been accused of ethnic cleansing as it forcibly displaces Palestinian residents.
paras.zh: 当时，KKR 持有德国媒体公司 Axel Springer 的股份，该公司为被占领的约旦河西岸的房地产开发做广告，以色列被指控在约旦河西岸实施种族清洗，因为它强迫巴勒斯坦居民流离失所。

paras.en: KKR said it does not have real estate interests in the West Bank and no longer invests in Axel Springer. Whether the investment company retains financial interests in companies linked to Israeli defence contractors and cyber security firms that provide support to the Israeli military remains unclear.
paras.zh: KKR 表示，其在约旦河西岸没有房地产权益，也不再投资 Axel Springer。该投资公司是否保留与以色列国防承包商和为以色列军方提供支持的网络安全公司有关联的公司的财务利益，目前尚不清楚。

paras.en: As part of LNG Canada’s proposed expansion, the pipeline operator would install compressor stations along the route, including on Wet’suwet’en territories, to double the amount of gas it currently transports. In addition to its holdings in the Coastal GasLink pipeline, KKR is one of three investment companies vying for a purchase of Shell’s shares in LNG Canada, which would include the proposed expansion.
paras.zh: 作为加拿大液化天然气公司拟议扩建的一部分，该管道运营商将在沿线（包括在 Wet'suwet'en 地区）安装压缩机站，使其目前运输的天然气量增加一倍。除了持有 Coastal GasLink 管道之外，KKR 也是争夺壳牌在加拿大液化天然气公司股份的三家投资公司之一，其中包括拟议的扩建。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Ksi Lisims would be supplied by the Prince Rupert Gas Transmission pipeline, an 800-kilometre (500-mile) linear project that would cross numerous First Nations territories. The pipeline and LNG facility are co-owned by Nisga’a Lisims, an Indigenous government in northwest British Columbia. Some of the neighbouring nations claim they were not adequately consulted and do not consent to the projects.
paras.zh: 与此同时，Ksi Lisims 将由鲁珀特王子港输气管道供应，这是一个长 800 公里（500 英里）的线性项目，将穿越许多原住民领土。该管道和液化天然气设施由不列颠哥伦比亚省西北部的原住民政府 Nisga’a Lisims 共同拥有。一些邻国声称没有充分征求他们的意见，因此不同意这些项目。

paras.en: In 2025, French multinational TotalEnergies signed an agreement with Ksi Lisims LNG to buy two million tonnes of liquefied gas per year, while simultaneously acquiring a 5 percent stake in the project’s parent company, Texas-based Western LNG.
paras.zh: 2025年，法国跨国公司TotalEnergies与Ksi Lisims LNG签署协议，每年购买200万吨液化天然气，同时收购该项目母公司德克萨斯州Western LNG 5%的股份。

paras.en: TotalEnergies has been accused of “complicity in war crimes, torture and enforced disappearance” at its LNG facility in Mozambique, according to a criminal complaint filed by the European Center for Constitutional and Human Rights (ECCHR) in late 2025. The complaint, filed with France’s national antiterrorism prosecutor, centres around the company’s complicity in the so-called “container massacre” in 2021. There is no update on the investigation by the prosecutor.
paras.zh: 根据欧洲宪法与人权中心 (ECCHR) 于 2025 年底提交的刑事起诉书，TotalEnergies 被指控在莫桑比克的液化天然气设施“共谋战争罪、酷刑和强迫失踪”。该起诉书向法国国家反恐检察官提交，主要围绕该公司在 2021 年参与所谓的“集装箱大屠杀”。检察官的调查没有最新消息。

paras.en: TotalEnergies was also implicated in reports about crude oil supplies to Israel, enabling the genocide in Gaza, where at least 75,000 Palestinians have been killed since Israel waged war there in 2023. The French corporation was also accused of supplying the Russian military with feed gas used to produce jet fuel for planes that have bombed Ukraine.
paras.zh: TotalEnergies 还涉及向以色列供应原油的报道，导致加沙发生种族灭绝。自 2023 年以色列在加沙发动战争以来，至少有 75,000 名巴勒斯坦人被杀害。这家法国公司还被指控向俄罗斯军方提供原料气，用于为轰炸乌克兰的飞机生产喷气燃料。

paras.en: TotalEnergies did not respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: TotalEnergies 没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: Aidan Gilchrist-Blackwood, a coordinator with the Canadian Network for Corporate Accountability, said the public is largely ignorant of how companies involved in major projects in Canada are linked to alleged human rights abuses, which he attributed in part to a “power imbalance”.
paras.zh: 加拿大企业责任网络协调员艾丹·吉尔克里斯特-布莱克伍德表示，公众基本上不知道参与加拿大重大项目的公司如何与所谓的侵犯人权行为联系在一起，他将其部分归因于“权力失衡”。

paras.en: “These companies have a lot of money, a lot of influence, and it's a lot easier for them to get their message out there,” he said. “When we're talking about communities who are having their human rights violated, we're talking about communities that are structurally disempowered compared to those companies.”
paras.zh: “这些公司有很多钱，有很大的影响力，而且他们更容易传播他们的信息，”他说。 “当我们谈论人权受到侵犯的社区时，我们谈论的是与这些公司相比在结构上被剥夺权力的社区。”

paras.en: Gilchrist-Blackwood said Canada doesn’t have legal tools to ensure companies conducting business in the country are upholding international human rights obligations.
paras.zh: 吉尔克里斯特-布莱克伍德表示，加拿大没有法律工具来确保在该国开展业务的公司遵守国际人权义务。

paras.en: “This pattern of widespread and systemic human rights abuses linked to Canadian companies is the result of intentional policy decisions,” he said. “I think that's something that surprises a lot of people, that there's a lack of even that basic level of legal accountability.”
paras.zh: “与加拿大公司有关的这种广泛和系统性的侵犯人权行为是有意的政策决定的结果，”他说。 “我认为这让很多人感到惊讶，因为甚至缺乏基本的法律责任。”

paras.en: York University's Zalik recently returned to Canada from the Niger Delta, where she said the ongoing legacy of pollution and corruption is far-reaching and intergenerational. Over the past few years, Shell has been divesting from its Nigerian holdings, but Zalik said the multinational is directly financing local companies to buy up its operations.
paras.zh: 约克大学的扎里克最近从尼日尔三角洲返回加拿大，她说那里持续存在的污染和腐败问题影响深远，而且是代际间的。过去几年，壳牌一直在剥离其在尼日利亚的持股，但扎利克表示，该跨国公司正在直接为当地公司提供融资，以收购其业务。

paras.en: “Here's a location where Shell made windfall profits over decades and has now sought to basically abandon or sell off its oilfields in order to avoid liability,” she said. “But Shell actually had to lend money to the Nigerian firms buying these assets.”
paras.zh: “这里是壳牌几十年来赚取暴利的地方，现在基本上寻求放弃或出售其油田以避免责任，”她说。 “但壳牌实际上不得不向购买这些资产的尼日利亚公司提供贷款。”

paras.en: The company, in partnership with nine Nigerian banks, launched a $3bn financing programme aimed at facilitating the transfer of its assets in July 2026. This follows the 2025 sale of its onshore operations to a consortium of Nigerian and international companies.
paras.zh: 该公司与九家尼日利亚银行合作，启动了一项 30 亿美元的融资计划，旨在促进其资产于 2026 年 7 月转移。在此之前，该公司于 2025 年将其境内业务出售给尼日利亚和国际公司组成的财团。

paras.en: As Shell distances itself from its controversies in Nigeria, it is shifting its investments to places like Canada — and from oil to LNG, which is marketed as a cleaner fuel. Zalik noted the oil and gas sector is “a global industry” with executives regularly moving from one location to another.
paras.zh: 随着壳牌与尼日利亚的争议保持距离，它正在将投资转移到加拿大等地，并从石油转向液化天然气，后者被宣传为更清洁的燃料。扎里克指出，石油和天然气行业是“一个全球性行业”，高管经常从一个地点调到另一个地点。

paras.en: “People go from Malaysia to Nigeria to Canada, et cetera,” she said. “There are direct relationships between these different sites.”
paras.zh: “人们从马来西亚到尼日利亚再到加拿大，等等，”她说。 “这些不同站点之间存在直接关系。”

articles.title: Macron makes surprise Saudi visit as France secures extra diesel supplies

paras.en: French President Emmanuel Macron visited Riyadh on a surprise “solidarity” visit, making him the first Western leader to touch down in Saudi Arabia since the Houthis intensified their attacks this month.
paras.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙对利雅得进行了一次出人意料的“团结”访问，这使他成为自胡塞武装本月加强袭击以来第一位抵达沙特阿拉伯的西方领导人。

paras.en: The unannounced trip comes as Saudi Arabia agreed to supply extra diesel to France “for as many months as necessary”, the Elysee Palace told the AFP news agency on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 爱丽舍宫周三告诉法新社，这次未经宣布的访问正值沙特阿拉伯同意向法国供应额外柴油“必要时持续数月”。

paras.en: The visit aims to “demonstrate France’s solidarity with the kingdom in the face of the attacks carried out by the Houthis against its territory, and to continue efforts undertaken on securing and diversifying hydrocarbon supplies”, the French presidency said earlier.
paras.zh: 法国总统早些时候表示，此次访问旨在“展示法国在胡塞武装对其领土发动袭击时对该王国的声援，并继续努力确保碳氢化合物供应的安全和多样化”。

paras.en: The diplomatic push follows days of rioting in France, fuelled by the cost of living, especially as the US-Iran war and Iran’s blockade of the Strait of Hormuz have kept energy prices high.
paras.zh: 此次外交行动之前，法国因生活成本上涨而发生了数日骚乱，特别是美伊战争和伊朗封锁霍尔木兹海峡导致能源价格居高不下。

paras.en: Faced with criticism of his Gulf tour at home, Macron told reporters he was just “doing his job” in a bid to “ease tensions” over petrol prices, one of the causes of social unrest in France.
paras.zh: 面对对国内海湾之行的批评，马克龙告诉记者，他只是在“尽自己的职责”，以“缓解汽油价格紧张局势”，汽油价格是法国社会动荡的原因之一。

paras.en: “There must be no sign of febrility,” he said. “I am fulfilling my role. I am at my post.”
paras.zh: “一定没有发烧的迹象，”他说。 “我正在履行我的职责。我在我的岗位上。”

paras.en: Macron met Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman in the Saudi capital, and the two agreed to consult on expanding security cooperation and on infrastructure projects to bypass the blockaded strait, the palace said.
paras.zh: 沙特王宫表示，马克龙在沙特首都会见了沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼，两人同意就扩大安全合作以及绕过封锁海峡的基础设施项目进行磋商。

paras.en: It did not say how much extra diesel Saudi Arabia would supply.
paras.zh: 它没有透露沙特阿拉伯将额外供应多少柴油。

paras.en: The deal follows pledges secured earlier in Macron’s Gulf tour. The presidency said on Tuesday that the United Arab Emirates had committed to about 100,000 tonnes a month, with a further 100,000 tonnes monthly to be secured in Bahrain.
paras.zh: 该协议是在马克龙海湾之行早些时候做出的承诺之后达成的。总统府周二表示，阿拉伯联合酋长国已承诺每月供应约 10 万吨，巴林每月还将供应 10 万吨。

paras.en: Together with Saudi deliveries, France now has commitments for 295,000 tonnes a month, just more than 10 percent of its consumption, it said.
paras.zh: 加上沙特的交付量，法国目前每月承诺交付 295,000 吨，仅占其消费量的 10% 以上。

paras.en: Meanwhile, France is also sending military assets to Saudi Arabia, under an earlier agreement, to help protect the Red Sea port of Yanbu, which has come under attack from the Iran-backed Houthis, an armed group also known as Ansar Allah (Arabic for Supporters of God).
paras.zh: 与此同时，根据此前达成的协议，法国还向沙特阿拉伯派遣军事资产，以帮助保护红海港口延布，该港口受到伊朗支持的胡塞武装组织的攻击。

paras.en: The United Kingdom also announced on Tuesday that it would deploy fighter jets to help shield the kingdom. Both countries say their support is purely defensive.
paras.zh: 英国周二还宣布将部署战斗机来帮助保护王国。两国均表示，他们的支持纯粹是防御性的。

paras.en: Analysts say the moves protect Saudi oil exports that matter to Europe’s energy markets and bolster the Gulf alliance as the US shows reluctance to offer direct military help. They also carry risks, analysts say, potentially drawing the two European states into the protracted Saudi-Houthi conflict.
paras.zh: 分析人士表示，这些举措保护了对欧洲能源市场至关重要的沙特石油出口，并在美国表现出不愿提供直接军事帮助的情况下加强了海湾联盟。分析人士称，它们也存在风险，可能会将这两个欧洲国家卷入旷日持久的沙特与胡塞武装冲突中。

articles.title: Former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine on Trump's turn toward Russia
articles.author: Steve Inskeep

paras.en: Former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine on Trump's turn toward Russia
paras.zh: 前美国驻乌克兰大使谈特朗普转向俄罗斯

paras.en: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine John Herbst about President Trump's embrace of Russia as envoy Steve Witkoff heads to Moscow after meeting Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 特使史蒂夫·威特科夫在与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基会面后前往莫斯科，美国国家公共广播电台的史蒂夫·英斯基普向前美国驻乌克兰大使约翰·赫布斯特询问特朗普总统对俄罗斯的拥抱。

paras.en: Let's bring Ambassador John Herbst into the conversation. He served 31 years in the U.S. State Department and was ambassador to Ukraine in the George W. Bush administration. He's now senior director of the Atlantic Council's Eurasia Center. Ambassador, good morning.
paras.zh: 让我们邀请约翰·赫布斯特大使参与对话。他在美国国务院工作了 31 年，并在乔治·W·布什政府中担任驻乌克兰大使。他现在是大西洋理事会欧亚中心的高级主任。大使，早上好。

paras.en: INSKEEP: We just heard Volodymyr Zelenskyy's perspective saying, we're not losing this war. We're losing people, we're losing time, but we're not losing the war. I want to just go right to President Trump's perspective, what he's saying most recently. He says President Zelenskyy doesn't want the war to end. Let's listen to Trump's claim.
paras.zh: 因斯基普：我们刚刚听到弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基的观点说，我们不会输掉这场战争。我们正在失去人员，我们正在失去时间，但我们并没有输掉战争。我想直接谈谈特朗普总统的观点，即他最近所说的话。他说泽连斯基总统不希望战争结束。我们来听听特朗普的说法。

paras.en: PRESIDENT DONALD TRUMP: Zelenskyy has to want to settle this war. And if he doesn't, I think it's going to be a very bad thing. Look, we have given tremendous amounts to Ukraine. We've got nothing back, other than high diesel.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统：泽伦斯基必须想要解决这场战争。如果他不这样做，我认为这将是一件非常糟糕的事情。看，我们已经向乌克兰捐赠了大量资金。除了高柴油之外，我们一无所获。

paras.en: INSKEEP: He also said Ukraine is weaker, smaller, fewer people, and so they should, quote, "make a deal" from that position of weakness, as Trump perceives it, giving up. Do you agree with that assessment?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：他还表示，乌克兰更弱、更小、人口更少，因此他们应该从这种弱势地位“达成协议”，正如特朗普所认为的那样，放弃。你同意这个评价吗？

paras.en: HERBST: President Trump's statement is factually incorrect in many ways. The war is a stalemate. It's been a stalemate for over four years. I think it - actually, it's been a stalemate over since the beginning back in 2014. The big invasion has not enabled Putin to achieve his aim of seizing most of the country. They haven't even been able to seize the most important strategic depth in western Donbas, which is why they want the United States to persuade Ukraine to give them that strategically valuable land 'cause their forces were not able to take it.
paras.zh: 赫伯斯特：特朗普总统的声明在很多方面都不符合事实。战争陷入胶着状态。这场僵局已经持续四年多了。我认为是的——实际上，从2014年开始就一直处于僵局。大入侵并没有让普京实现他夺取大部分国家领土的目标。他们甚至还没有能够夺取顿巴斯西部最重要的战略纵深，这就是为什么他们希望美国说服乌克兰给他们那片具有战略价值的土地，因为他们的军队无法占领它。

paras.en: And they've taken tremendous casualties. They're losing 35, 40,000 soldiers a month, more than half of them dead. And, of course, the Ukrainian drone strikes in Russia have taken out roughly 40% of their refining capability. So the Russians are not winning. The only way Moscow could win this war is if Western aid ceased, both American and European.
paras.zh: 他们造成了巨大的伤亡。他们每个月都会失去 35、40,000 名士兵，其中一半以上死亡。当然，乌克兰对俄罗斯的无人机袭击已经消耗了大约 40% 的炼油能力。所以俄罗斯人没有获胜。莫斯科赢得这场战争的唯一方法是西方停止援助，包括美国和欧洲的援助。

paras.en: INSKEEP: You just said that Russia wants to persuade the United States to help them take more territory. Looking at the news over the last week to 10 days, do you think that Vladimir Putin is making progress in persuading the United States or the U.S. president onto their side?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：你刚才说俄罗斯想说服美国帮助他们占领更多领土。看看过去一周到十天的新闻，你认为普京在说服美国或美国总统方面是否取得了进展？

paras.en: HERBST: You know, Trump's policy has been inconsistent since he returned to the White House. He has a positive impulse, which he used to state frequently, he wanted to create an end to the war around the current lines held by the two forces and having Ukraine emerge sovereign and secure (inaudible). So that's a positive impulse.
paras.zh: 赫伯斯特：你知道，自从特朗普回到白宫以来，他的政策一直不一致。他有一种积极的冲动，他经常说，他希望结束两国军队目前控制的战线周围的战争，并让乌克兰获得主权和安全（听不清）。所以这是一个积极的推动力。

paras.en: But then he has this peculiar fascination with Putin, and he doesn't want to cross him. So his policy jumps back and forth between really hammering Ukraine and then sometimes putting some lesser form of pressure on the Kremlin.
paras.zh: 但他对普京有一种特殊的迷恋，他不想得罪他。因此，他的政策在真正打击乌克兰和有时向克里姆林宫施加某种较小形式的压力之间来回跳跃。

paras.en: INSKEEP: Well, I'm trying to figure out how the release of Stephen Hubbard fits into this, Russia's effort to cultivate President Trump. I suppose there may have been negotiations behind the scenes that we don't see. I suppose this could've been a humanitarian gesture. Or do you see the release of Stephen Hubbard right now as a friendly gesture toward the United States, which Russia may want to use to widen the gap between the United States and Ukraine?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：嗯，我试图弄清楚斯蒂芬·哈伯德的释放如何适应俄罗斯培养特朗普总统的努力。我想可能有一些我们看不到的幕后谈判。我想这可能是一种人道主义姿态。或者你认为现在释放斯蒂芬·哈伯德是对美国的友好姿态，俄罗斯可能想利用这一姿态来扩大美国和乌克兰之间的差距？

paras.en: HERBST: I'm sorry to say that this is exactly Putin's intention, and sadly, President Trump plays along. And the news story I listened to before I got onto this interview helps them do that because they talked about merely the release of Hubbard. They didn't talk about the American role in freeing a person we've wanted extradited to the United States, a guy named Mikhail Zvinchuk, who was arrested in Montenegro. He was released - I don't know - eight or nine days ago because the U.S. insisted on it. So this is a straight-up trade deal where we trade the release of a bad guy for the release of an American citizen who's not a bad guy. We've seen this play before, not just under Trump.
paras.zh: 赫伯斯特：我很遗憾地说，这正是普京的意图，可悲的是，特朗普总统也配合了。我在接受采访之前听到的新闻报道有助于他们做到这一点，因为他们只谈论了哈伯德的释放。他们没有谈论美国在释放我们想要引渡到美国的人方面所扮演的角色，这个人名叫米哈伊尔·兹文丘克(Mikhail Zvinchuk)，他在黑山被捕。他是在八、九天前被释放的——我不知道——因为美国的坚持。所以这是一项直接的贸易协议，我们用释放一个坏人来换取释放一个不是坏人的美国公民。我们以前见过这样的戏，不仅仅是在特朗普执政期间。

paras.en: INSKEEP: So you're telling me there's another layer to this beyond the release today. This is the United States...
paras.zh: 因斯基普：所以你告诉我，除了今天的发布之外，还有另一层内容。这就是美国...

paras.en: INSKEEP: ...Doing a deal with Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 因斯基普：……与弗拉基米尔·普京达成协议。

paras.en: HERBST: Yes. And then we saw this before. You know, when Witkoff went to Moscow the first time, at the beginning of the Trump administration and brought home an American, we released a notorious Russian arms dealer, whom we had captured - I don't know - six, eight, 12 months before. So in trade, that's perfect for Russia's nasty foreign policy, we get an innocent American released. So that's good. We want Americans to come home. But we pay a national security price for it. So it's no wonderful gestures from Putin. It's a cynical game.
paras.zh: 赫伯斯特：是的。然后我们之前就看到过这个。你知道，当威特科夫在特朗普政府上任之初第一次前往莫斯科并带回一名美国人时，我们释放了一名臭名昭著的俄罗斯军火商，我们在六、八、十二个月前抓获了他——我不知道。因此，在贸易方面，这对于俄罗斯恶劣的外交政策来说是完美的，我们释放了一名无辜的美国人。所以这样很好。我们希望美国人回家。但我们为此付出了国家安全的代价。所以普京的举动并不美妙。这是一个愤世嫉俗的游戏。

paras.en: INSKEEP: One other question then. How is Volodymyr Zelenskyy doing in this situation, mending fences with the United States, trying to get back on the same page with Trump or trying to get Trump back on the same page with him?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：那么还有一个问题。弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基在这种情况下表现如何，与美国修复关系，试图与特朗普重归于好，还是试图让特朗普与他重归于好？

paras.en: HERBST: Zelenskyy is handling this as best he can. He made a mistake for criticizing publicly the diesel deal, but ever since he's been trying to fix things. And he's helped by the fact that over 80% of the American people consider Putin a villain, and over 60% of the Congress - Republicans and Democrats - support a much stronger policy in aid of Ukraine. And we know that President Trump's being raked over the coals, including by Republicans, for this weak turn of the last, you know, week and a half.
paras.zh: 赫伯斯特：泽伦斯基正在尽力处理这个问题。他公开批评柴油交易是一个错误，但从那以后他一直在努力解决问题。超过 80% 的美国民众认为普京是恶棍，超过 60% 的国会议员（共和党和民主党）支持采取更强有力的援助乌克兰政策，这一事实对他有所帮助。我们知道，特朗普总统因过去一周半的软弱转变而受到包括共和党在内的严厉批评。

paras.en: INSKEEP: Former U.S. ambassador to Ukraine, John Herbst. Thanks so much.
paras.zh: 因斯基普：前美国驻乌克兰大使约翰·赫布斯特。非常感谢。
